questions.content:
A company is building a web-based Al application by using Amazon SageMaker.The application wil provide the following capabilities and features:ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring. The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecydle.The training data is stored in Amazon S3. The company needs to use the central model registry to manage different versions of models in the application.

Which action will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a separate Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository for each model.

contents.en: Create a separate Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository for each model.
contents.zh: 为每个模型创建一个单独的亚马逊弹性容器注册表（Amazon ECR）存储库。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) and unique tags for each model version.

contents.en: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) and unique tags for each model version.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊弹性容器注册表（Amazon ECR）并为每个模型版本添加唯一标签。

options.label: C
options.content: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and model groups to catalog the models.

contents.en: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and model groups to catalog the models.
contents.zh: 使用 SageMaker 模型注册表和模型组对模型进行编目。

options.label: D
options.content: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and unique tags for each model version.

contents.en: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and unique tags for each model version.
contents.zh: 使用 SageMaker 模型注册表并为每个模型版本添加唯一标签。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Model Registry 是 SageMaker 内置的中央模型注册表。一个 model package group 保存同一模型的所有版本，每个注册的版本会自动编号，并记录元数据、谱系和审批状态，因此无需自定义标签或额外基础设施即可管理版本，运营开销最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon ECR 存储的是容器镜像而不是模型工件或模型元数据，为每个模型建一个仓库并不能提供内置的模型版本管理或审批流程。
  • B: ECR 的镜像标签标识的是容器镜像版本而非模型版本，手动维护标签规范会增加工作量，却不能提供模型注册表功能。
  • D: Model Registry 已经在 model group 内自动为模型分配版本，再为每个版本手动添加唯一标签是多余的，只会增加不必要的运营开销。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Model Registry 是 SageMaker 内置的中央模型注册表。一个 model package group 保存同一模型的所有版本，每个注册的版本会自动编号，并记录元数据、谱系和审批状态，因此无需自定义标签或额外基础设施即可管理版本，运营开销最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon ECR 存储的是容器镜像而不是模型工件或模型元数据，为每个模型建一个仓库并不能提供内置的模型版本管理或审批流程。
  • B: ECR 的镜像标签标识的是容器镜像版本而非模型版本，手动维护标签规范会增加工作量，却不能提供模型注册表功能。
  • D: Model Registry 已经在 model group 内自动为模型分配版本，再为每个版本手动添加唯一标签是多余的，只会增加不必要的运营开销。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: SageMaker Model Registry is the central model registry built into SageMaker. A model package group holds every version of one model, and each registered version is automatically numbered and catalogued with its metadata, lineage, and approval status, so version management needs no custom tagging or extra infrastructure and has the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon ECR stores container images, not model artifacts or model metadata, and one repository per model provides no built-in model versioning or approval workflow.
  • B: ECR image tags identify container image versions rather than model versions, and maintaining a tagging convention by hand adds work without providing a model registry.
  • D: Model Registry already versions models automatically inside model groups, so hand-tagging every version is redundant and adds unnecessary operational overhead.

questions.content:
A company is building a web-based Al application by using Amazon SageMaker.The application wil provide the following capabilities and features: ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring. The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecycle.The training data is stored in Amazon S3. The company is experimenting with consecutive training jobs.

How can the company MINIMIZE infrastructure startup times for these jobs?

options.label: A
options.content: Use Managed Spot Training.

contents.en: Use Managed Spot Training.
contents.zh: 使用托管 Spot 训练。

options.label: B
options.content: Use SageMaker managed warm pools.

contents.en: Use SageMaker managed warm pools.
contents.zh: 使用 SageMaker 托管预热池。

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Training Compiler.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Training Compiler.
contents.zh: 使用 SageMaker 训练编译器。

options.label: D
options.content: Use the SageMaker distributed data parallelism (SMDDP) library.

contents.en: Use the SageMaker distributed data parallelism (SMDDP) library.
contents.zh: 使用 SageMaker 分布式数据并行（SMDDP）库。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker managed warm pools 会在训练任务结束后，按配置的 keep-alive 时长保留已预置的训练基础设施，配置匹配的连续任务可以复用同一批实例，跳过实例预置和容器下载，从而最大限度地减少基础设施启动时间。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Managed Spot Training 通过使用空闲容量降低训练成本，但任务可能需要等待 Spot 容量并可能被中断，并不能缩短启动时间。
  • C: SageMaker Training Compiler 通过优化模型计算图来加速 GPU 实例上的训练计算本身，对基础设施预置时间没有帮助。
  • D: SMDDP 库用于加速跨多 GPU、多节点的分布式训练，与训练基础设施的启动速度无关。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker managed warm pools 会在训练任务结束后，按配置的 keep-alive 时长保留已预置的训练基础设施，配置匹配的连续任务可以复用同一批实例，跳过实例预置和容器下载，从而最大限度地减少基础设施启动时间。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Managed Spot Training 通过使用空闲容量降低训练成本，但任务可能需要等待 Spot 容量并可能被中断，并不能缩短启动时间。
  • C: SageMaker Training Compiler 通过优化模型计算图来加速 GPU 实例上的训练计算本身，对基础设施预置时间没有帮助。
  • D: SMDDP 库用于加速跨多 GPU、多节点的分布式训练，与训练基础设施的启动速度无关。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: SageMaker managed warm pools keep the provisioned training infrastructure alive for a configurable keep-alive period after a training job finishes, so consecutive jobs with a matching configuration reuse the same instances and skip instance provisioning and container download, which MINIMIZES infrastructure startup time.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Managed Spot Training lowers training cost by using spare capacity, but jobs may wait for Spot capacity and can be interrupted, so it does not reduce startup time.
  • C: SageMaker Training Compiler speeds up the training computation itself on GPU instances by optimizing the model graph; it does nothing to shorten infrastructure provisioning.
  • D: The SMDDP library accelerates distributed training across multiple GPUs and nodes but has no effect on how quickly the training infrastructure starts.

A company is building a web-based Al application by using Amazon SageMaker. The application will rovide the following capabilities and features:ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring. The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecydle.The training data is stored in Amazon S3. The company must implement a manual approval-based workflow to ensure that only approved models can be deployed to production endpoints.

Which solution will meetthis requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Use SageMaker Experiments to facilitate the approval process during model registration.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Experiments to facilitate the approval process during model registration.
contents.zh: 在模型注册期间，使用 SageMaker 实验来促进审批流程。

options.label: B
options.content: Use SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking on the central model registry.Create tracking entities for the approval process.

contents.en: Use SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking on the central model registry.Create tracking entities for the approval process.
contents.zh: 在中央模型注册表上使用 SageMaker ML 谱系跟踪。为审批流程创建跟踪实体。

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Model Monitor to evaluate the performance of the model and to manage the approval.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Model Monitor to evaluate the performance of the model and to manage the approval.
contents.zh: 使用 SageMaker 模型监控器来评估模型性能并管理审批。

options.label: D
options.content: Use SageMaker Pipelines.When a model version is registered,use the AWS SDK to change the approval status to "Approved."

contents.en: Use SageMaker Pipelines.When a model version is registered,use the AWS SDK to change the approval status to "Approved."
contents.zh: 使用 SageMaker 管道。当模型版本注册时，使用 AWS SDK 将审批状态更改为"已批准"。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Pipelines 可以把每个训练好的模型版本注册到 Model Registry，并将审批状态设为 PendingManualApproval。审核人随后通过 AWS SDK（update_model_package）把状态改为 Approved，只有已批准的 model package 才允许部署到生产端点，这正是所需的手动审批门禁。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Experiments 用于跟踪和比较训练运行与试验，没有审批状态或部署门禁机制。
  • B: ML Lineage Tracking 记录数据集、训练任务和模型之间的谱系图以便审计，创建跟踪实体并不能强制执行审批流程。
  • C: Model Monitor 用于监控已经部署到端点的模型质量，无法批准或阻止部署。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Pipelines 可以把每个训练好的模型版本注册到 Model Registry，并将审批状态设为 PendingManualApproval。审核人随后通过 AWS SDK（update_model_package）把状态改为 Approved，只有已批准的 model package 才允许部署到生产端点，这正是所需的手动审批门禁。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Experiments 用于跟踪和比较训练运行与试验，没有审批状态或部署门禁机制。
  • B: ML Lineage Tracking 记录数据集、训练任务和模型之间的谱系图以便审计，创建跟踪实体并不能强制执行审批流程。
  • C: Model Monitor 用于监控已经部署到端点的模型质量，无法批准或阻止部署。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker Pipelines can register each trained model version in the Model Registry with an approval status of PendingManualApproval. A reviewer then uses the AWS SDK (update_model_package) to change the status to Approved, and only approved model packages are allowed to be deployed to the production endpoint, which implements the required manual approval gate.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SageMaker Experiments tracks and compares training runs and trials; it has no approval status or deployment gating mechanism.
  • B: ML Lineage Tracking records the lineage graph of datasets, training jobs, and models for auditability, but creating tracking entities does not enforce an approval workflow.
  • C: Model Monitor observes the quality of models that are already deployed to endpoints; it cannot approve or block deployments.

questions.content:
A company is building a web-based Al application by using Amazon SageMaker. The application will rovide the following capabilities and features:ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring. The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecydle.The training data is stored in Amazon S3. The company needs to run an on-demand workflow to monitor bias drift for models that are deployed to real-time endpoints from the application.

Which action will meetthis requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure the application to invoke an AWS Lambda function that runs a SageMaker Clarify job.

contents.en: Configure the application to invoke an AWS Lambda function that runs a SageMaker Clarify job.
contents.zh: 配置应用程序以调用一个运行 SageMaker Clarify 任务的 AWS Lambda 函数。

options.label: B
options.content: Invoke an AWS Lambda function to pull the sagemaker-model-monitor-analyzer built-in SageMaker image.

contents.en: Invoke an AWS Lambda function to pull the sagemaker-model-monitor-analyzer built-in SageMaker image.
contents.zh: 调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数来拉取内置的 sagemaker-model-monitor-analyzer SageMaker 镜像。

options.label: C
options.content: Use AWS Glue Data Quality to monitor bias.

contents.en: Use AWS Glue Data Quality to monitor bias.
contents.zh: 使用 AWS Glue 数据质量来监控偏差。

options.label: D
options.content: Use SageMaker notebooks to compare the bias.

contents.en: Use SageMaker notebooks to compare the bias.
contents.zh: 使用 SageMaker 笔记本电脑来比较偏差。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Clarify 负责计算偏差指标，可以按需对实时端点捕获的数据运行 Clarify processing job 来检测偏差漂移。让应用程序调用一个启动 Clarify 任务的 Lambda 函数，就得到了事件驱动的按需工作流，而不是固定的监控计划。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: sagemaker-model-monitor-analyzer 镜像是 Model Monitor 内部为计划任务使用的容器，仅拉取该镜像并不会运行偏差漂移分析。
  • C: AWS Glue Data Quality 对数据集执行基于规则的数据质量检查，无法计算 ML 公平性或偏差指标。
  • D: 在 SageMaker notebooks 中手动比较偏差是交互式操作，不是应用程序可以调用的按需自动化工作流。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Clarify 负责计算偏差指标，可以按需对实时端点捕获的数据运行 Clarify processing job 来检测偏差漂移。让应用程序调用一个启动 Clarify 任务的 Lambda 函数，就得到了事件驱动的按需工作流，而不是固定的监控计划。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: sagemaker-model-monitor-analyzer 镜像是 Model Monitor 内部为计划任务使用的容器，仅拉取该镜像并不会运行偏差漂移分析。
  • C: AWS Glue Data Quality 对数据集执行基于规则的数据质量检查，无法计算 ML 公平性或偏差指标。
  • D: 在 SageMaker notebooks 中手动比较偏差是交互式操作，不是应用程序可以调用的按需自动化工作流。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker Clarify computes bias metrics, and a Clarify processing job can be run on demand against the data captured from a real-time endpoint to detect bias drift. Having the application invoke a Lambda function that launches the Clarify job gives an event-driven, on-demand workflow instead of a fixed monitoring schedule.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: The sagemaker-model-monitor-analyzer image is the container that Model Monitor uses internally for its scheduled jobs; pulling the image does not run a bias drift analysis.
  • C: AWS Glue Data Quality evaluates rule-based data quality checks on datasets and cannot compute ML fairness or bias metrics.
  • D: Comparing bias manually in SageMaker notebooks is an interactive process, not an on-demand automated workflow that the application can invoke.

questions.content:
A company stores historical data in.csv fles in Amazon S3.Only some of the rows and columns in the .csv files are populated. The columns are not labeled.An ML engineer needs to prepare and store the data so that the company can use the data to train ML models. Select and order the correct steps from the following list to perform this task.Each step should be selected one time or not at all (Select and order three.)

  • Create an Amazon SageMaker batch transform job for data cleaning and feature engineering.
  • Store the resulting data back in Amazon S3.
  • Use Amazon Athena to infer the schemas and available columns.
  • Use AWS Glue crawlers to infer the schemas and available columns.
  • Use AWS Glue DataBrew for data cleaning and feature engineering.

Step 1:

options.label: A
options.content: Create an Amazon SageMaker batch transform job for data cleaning and feature engineering

contents.en: Create an Amazon SageMaker batch transform job for data cleaning and feature engineering
contents.zh: 创建一个亚马逊SageMaker批量转换作业用于数据清理和特征工程

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon Athena to infer the schemas and available columns.

contents.en: Use Amazon Athena to infer the schemas and available columns.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Athena 推断模式（schema）和可用列。

options.label: C
options.content: Use AWS Glue crawlers to inferthe schemas and available columns.

contents.en: Use AWS Glue crawlers to inferthe schemas and available columns.
contents.zh: 使用 AWS Glue 爬网程序推断模式（schema）和可用列。

options.label: D
options.content: Store the resulting data back inAmazon S3.

contents.en: Store the resulting data back inAmazon S3.
contents.zh: 将处理后的数据存储回亚马逊 S3。

options.label: E
options.content: Use AWS Glue DataBrew for data cleaning and feature engineering.

contents.en: Use AWS Glue DataBrew for data cleaning and feature engineering.
contents.zh: 使用 AWS Glue DataBrew 进行数据清洗和特征工程。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：.csv 文件没有列标签，且行和列只有部分填充，因此工作流必须先弄清数据结构。AWS Glue crawlers 会扫描 Amazon S3 中的文件，推断模式和可用列，并把结果注册为 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中的表，后续每一步都依赖这一结果。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker batch transform job 是用训练好的模型对数据集做推理，不是数据清洗或特征工程工具，也不属于此工作流。
  • B: Amazon Athena 通过 Data Catalog 中的表定义查询数据，本身不推断模式，在模式未知之前不能作为第一步。
  • D: 将处理后的数据存回 Amazon S3 是最后一步，要在清洗和特征工程完成之后进行。
  • E: AWS Glue DataBrew 在第 2 步执行清洗和特征工程，要在模式和列被推断出来之后。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：.csv 文件没有列标签，且行和列只有部分填充，因此工作流必须先弄清数据结构。AWS Glue crawlers 会扫描 Amazon S3 中的文件，推断模式和可用列，并把结果注册为 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中的表，后续每一步都依赖这一结果。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker batch transform job 是用训练好的模型对数据集做推理，不是数据清洗或特征工程工具，也不属于此工作流。
  • B: Amazon Athena 通过 Data Catalog 中的表定义查询数据，本身不推断模式，在模式未知之前不能作为第一步。
  • D: 将处理后的数据存回 Amazon S3 是最后一步，要在清洗和特征工程完成之后进行。
  • E: AWS Glue DataBrew 在第 2 步执行清洗和特征工程，要在模式和列被推断出来之后。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: The .csv files have no column labels and only partially populated rows and columns, so the workflow must begin by discovering the structure. AWS Glue crawlers scan the files in Amazon S3, infer the schema and available columns, and register them as tables in the AWS Glue Data Catalog, which every later step depends on.

Why the other options are incorrect:

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：Token 是 LLM 处理的文本基本单元。分词会把输入文本切分成单词、子词或字符，在 Amazon Bedrock 上模型以 token 为单位读取、生成并计费。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Embedding 是捕捉文本语义的数值向量，不是文本单元本身。
  • B: RAG 是一种在生成前检索外部信息来丰富提示的技术。
  • C: Temperature 是控制生成输出随机性的推理参数。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：Token 是 LLM 处理的文本基本单元。分词会把输入文本切分成单词、子词或字符，在 Amazon Bedrock 上模型以 token 为单位读取、生成并计费。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Embedding 是捕捉文本语义的数值向量，不是文本单元本身。
  • B: RAG 是一种在生成前检索外部信息来丰富提示的技术。
  • C: Temperature 是控制生成输出随机性的推理参数。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: A token is the basic unit of text that an LLM processes. Tokenization splits input text into words, subwords, or characters, and the model reads, generates, and is billed in tokens on Amazon Bedrock.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: An embedding is a numerical vector that captures the semantic meaning of text, not the text unit itself.
  • B: RAG is a technique that retrieves external information to enrich the prompt before generation.
  • C: Temperature is an inference parameter that controls the randomness of the generated output.

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: RAG 使用 embedding 来检索相关文档，但该术语描述的是检索加生成的技术，不是向量本身。

explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Embeddings are high-dimensional numerical vectors produced by an embedding model, such as Amazon Titan Text Embeddings on Amazon Bedrock, that encode the semantic meaning of text so that similar texts lie close together in vector space.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: RAG uses embeddings to retrieve relevant documents, but the term describes the retrieval and generation technique, not the vectors themselves.
  • C: Temperature is a scalar inference parameter that adjusts output randomness and has nothing to do with vector representations.
  • D: A token is a discrete unit of text processed by the model, not a semantic vector.

The algorithm is not capturing all the desired underlying patterns in the data.

Which AWS service or feature can aggregate the data from the various data sources?

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：AWS Lake Formation 通过 JDBC blueprints 从 Amazon S3 和本地 MySQL 等数据库摄取数据，编目到 AWS Glue Data Catalog 并施加集中式访问控制，从而构建受治理的数据湖。这使 ML 工程师能把交易日志、客户资料和 MySQL 表聚合到一处。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon EMR Spark jobs 可以处理大规模数据，但 EMR 是需要管理集群和编写自定义代码的计算框架，而不是聚合并治理多源数据的服务。
  • B: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 用于摄取实时流数据，并非为从本地 MySQL 数据库拉取表或整合已存储在 S3 中的文件而设计。
  • C: Amazon DynamoDB 是面向低延迟应用访问的 NoSQL 键值数据库，不是聚合异构数据源用于 ML 训练的服务。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：AWS Lake Formation 通过 JDBC blueprints 从 Amazon S3 和本地 MySQL 等数据库摄取数据，编目到 AWS Glue Data Catalog 并施加集中式访问控制，从而构建受治理的数据湖。这使 ML 工程师能把交易日志、客户资料和 MySQL 表聚合到一处。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon EMR Spark jobs 可以处理大规模数据，但 EMR 是需要管理集群和编写自定义代码的计算框架，而不是聚合并治理多源数据的服务。
  • B: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 用于摄取实时流数据，并非为从本地 MySQL 数据库拉取表或整合已存储在 S3 中的文件而设计。
  • C: Amazon DynamoDB 是面向低延迟应用访问的 NoSQL 键值数据库，不是聚合异构数据源用于 ML 训练的服务。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: AWS Lake Formation builds a governed data lake by ingesting data from Amazon S3 and from on-premises databases such as MySQL through JDBC blueprints, cataloging it in the AWS Glue Data Catalog, and applying centralized access control. This lets the ML engineer aggregate the transaction logs, customer profiles, and MySQL tables in one place.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon EMR Spark jobs can process large datasets, but EMR is a compute framework that requires cluster management and custom code rather than a service that aggregates and governs data from multiple sources.
  • B: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams ingests real-time streaming data; it is not designed to pull tables from an on-premises MySQL database or to consolidate files already stored in S3.
  • C: Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL key-value database for low-latency application access, not a service for aggregating heterogeneous data sources for ML training.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon Athena is a SQL query engine; it has no automatic anomaly detection and no built-in visualization capability.
  • B: Amazon Redshift Spectrum queries data in S3 from Redshift but does not automatically detect anomalies, so adding QuickSight covers only the visualization half.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：LightGBM 是 SageMaker 内置的梯度提升树算法，适用于表格数据分类。其决策树能捕捉非线性模式以及相互依赖特征之间的交互，并支持针对不平衡数据的类别权重参数，能同时应对该欺诈检测数据集的两个问题。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Linear learner 建模的是特征与标签之间的线性关系，无法捕捉当前算法所遗漏的特征相互依赖和复杂模式。
  • C: K-means 聚类是用于分组数据的无监督算法，不能在带标签的欺诈数据上训练分类模型。
  • D: Neural Topic Model（NTM）用于在文本语料中发现主题，与表格型欺诈分类无关。

explanations.zh:

  • C: K-means 聚类是用于分组数据的无监督算法，不能在带标签的欺诈数据上训练分类模型。
  • D: Neural Topic Model（NTM）用于在文本语料中发现主题，与表格型欺诈分类无关。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: LightGBM is a SageMaker built-in gradient boosted tree algorithm for tabular classification. Its decision trees capture nonlinear patterns and interactions between interdependent features, and it supports class weighting parameters for imbalanced data, which addresses both problems in this fraud detection dataset.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Linear learner models a linear relationship between features and the label, so it cannot capture the feature interdependencies and complex patterns that the current algorithm is missing.
  • C: K-means clustering is an unsupervised algorithm for grouping data and cannot be trained on labeled fraud data for classification.
  • D: Neural Topic Model (NTM) discovers topics in text corpora and is unrelated to tabular fraud classification.

questions.content:
A company has deployed an XGBoost prediction model in production to predict ifa customer is likely to cancel a subscription.The company uses Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor to detect deviations inthe F1 score. During a baseline analysis of model quality, the company recorded a threshold for the F1 score.After several months of no change,the model's F1 score decreases significantly.

What could be the reason for the reduced F1 score?

options.label: A
options.content: Concept drift occurred in the underlying customer data that was used for predictions.

contents.en: Concept drift occurred in the underlying customer data that was used for predictions.
contents.zh: 用于预测的基础客户数据发生了概念漂移。

options.label: B
options.content: The model was not sufficiently complex to capture all the patterns inthe original baseline data.

contents.en: The model was not sufficiently complex to capture all the patterns inthe original baseline data.
contents.zh: 模型不够复杂，无法捕捉原始基线数据中的所有模式。

options.label: C
options.content: The original baseline data had a data quality issue of missing values.

contents.en: The original baseline data had a data quality issue of missing values.
contents.zh: 原始基线数据存在缺失值的数据质量问题。

options.label: D
options.content: Incorrect ground truth labels were provided to Model Monitor during the calculation ofthe baseline.

contents.en: Incorrect ground truth labels were provided to Model Monitor during the calculation ofthe baseline.
contents.zh: 在计算基线时，向模型监控器提供了错误的真实标签。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：模型在基线阶段表现良好，投入生产数月后才出现下降，这正是概念漂移的典型特征：客户特征与取消订阅行为之间的关系随时间发生了变化，预测不再匹配新的真实标签，Model Monitor 计算出的 F1 分数因此跌破阈值。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 如果模型过于简单而无法捕捉基线数据的模式，其 F1 分数从一开始就会很低，而不是在数月良好表现之后才下降。
  • C: 基线数据中的缺失值会影响基线指标本身，无法解释生产环境中后来出现的下降。
  • D: 计算基线时提供错误的真实标签会从一开始就得到错误的阈值，而不会造成观测到的 F1 分数逐渐下降。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：模型在基线阶段表现良好，投入生产数月后才出现下降，这正是概念漂移的典型特征：客户特征与取消订阅行为之间的关系随时间发生了变化，预测不再匹配新的真实标签，Model Monitor 计算出的 F1 分数因此跌破阈值。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 如果模型过于简单而无法捕捉基线数据的模式，其 F1 分数从一开始就会很低，而不是在数月良好表现之后才下降。
  • C: 基线数据中的缺失值会影响基线指标本身，无法解释生产环境中后来出现的下降。
  • D: 计算基线时提供错误的真实标签会从一开始就得到错误的阈值，而不会造成观测到的 F1 分数逐渐下降。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: The model performed well at baseline and only degraded after several months in production, which is the signature of concept drift: the relationship between customer features and cancellation behavior changed over time, so predictions no longer match the new ground truth and the F1 score that Model Monitor computes falls below the threshold.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: If the model had been too simple to capture the baseline patterns, its F1 score would have been low from the start rather than decreasing after months of good performance.
  • C: Missing values in the baseline data would have affected the baseline metrics themselves and cannot explain a later decline in production.
  • D: Incorrect ground truth labels during baseline calculation would have produced a wrong threshold from the start, not a gradual drop in the observed F1 score.

explanations.en:
Correct answer A: A SageMaker notebook instance assumes an IAM execution role. Creating one IAM role with the required permissions and attaching it to every notebook instance the team uses centralizes permission management, because a change to that single role applies to all notebooks at once.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: IAM groups are collections of IAM users and cannot be associated with a SageMaker notebook instance, which requires an IAM role.
  • C: A notebook instance cannot be configured to use an IAM user, and attaching AdministratorAccess violates the principle of least privilege.
  • D: An IAM role cannot be associated with an IAM group, a group cannot be attached to a notebook instance, and AdministratorAccess grants far more than the necessary permissions.

options.label: B
options.content: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC)

options.label: C

contents.zh: F1分数

options.label: D

contents.en: Mean absolute error(MAE)
contents.zh: 平均绝对误差（Mean absolute error，MAE）

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：预测公寓价格是目标值连续的回归问题。平均绝对误差（MAE）衡量预测价格与实际价格差异的平均幅度，单位与价格相同，因此是合适的评估指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Accuracy 衡量类别预测正确的比例，适用于分类而不是连续的价格预测。
  • B: AUC 评估二分类器区分正负类的能力，对回归输出没有定义。
  • C: F1 分数结合了分类任务的精确率和召回率，无法对连续预测值计算。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：预测公寓价格是目标值连续的回归问题。平均绝对误差（MAE）衡量预测价格与实际价格差异的平均幅度，单位与价格相同，因此是合适的评估指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Accuracy 衡量类别预测正确的比例，适用于分类而不是连续的价格预测。
  • B: AUC 评估二分类器区分正负类的能力，对回归输出没有定义。
  • C: F1 分数结合了分类任务的精确率和召回率，无法对连续预测值计算。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Predicting apartment prices is a regression problem with a continuous target. Mean absolute error measures the average magnitude of the difference between predicted and actual prices in the same units as the price, which makes it the appropriate evaluation metric.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Accuracy measures the fraction of correct class predictions and applies to classification, not to continuous price prediction.
  • B: AUC evaluates how well a binary classifier separates positive and negative classes and is not defined for regression output.
  • C: F1 score combines precision and recall for classification and cannot be computed for continuous predictions.

questions.content:
An ML engineer has trained a neural network by using stochastic gradient descent (SGD).The neural network performs poorly on the test set. The values for training loss and validation loss remain high and show an oscilating pattern.The values decrease for a few epochs and then increase for a few epochs before repeating the same cycle.

What should the ML engineer do to improve the training process?

options.label: A
options.content: Introduce early stopping.

contents.en: Introduce early stopping.
contents.zh: 引入早停法（Early stopping）。

options.label: B
options.content: Increase the size of thetest set.

contents.en: Increase the size of thetest set.
contents.zh: 增加测试集的大小。

options.label: C
options.content: Increase the learning rate.

contents.en: Increase the learning rate.
contents.zh: 提高学习率。

options.label: D
options.content: Decrease the learning rate.

contents.en: Decrease the learning rate.
contents.zh: 降低学习率。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：损失一直很高并且振荡，下降几个 epoch 后又上升，说明学习率过大：每一步 SGD 更新都越过了最小值并在其附近来回跳动。降低学习率可以让优化器以更小的步长平稳收敛。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 早停法在验证损失因过拟合而开始上升时停止训练；这里训练损失和验证损失都居高不下并振荡，训练尚未收敛，提前停止无法解决问题。
  • B: 测试集的大小不会影响训练动态，也与振荡的损失无关。
  • C: 提高学习率会让步长更大，使振荡和发散更加严重。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：损失一直很高并且振荡，下降几个 epoch 后又上升，说明学习率过大：每一步 SGD 更新都越过了最小值并在其附近来回跳动。降低学习率可以让优化器以更小的步长平稳收敛。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 早停法在验证损失因过拟合而开始上升时停止训练；这里训练损失和验证损失都居高不下并振荡，训练尚未收敛，提前停止无法解决问题。
  • B: 测试集的大小不会影响训练动态，也与振荡的损失无关。
  • C: 提高学习率会让步长更大，使振荡和发散更加严重。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Loss that stays high and oscillates, falling for a few epochs and then rising again, indicates that the learning rate is too large: each SGD step overshoots the minimum and bounces around it. Decreasing the learning rate lets the optimizer take smaller steps and converge smoothly.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Early stopping halts training when validation loss starts to rise because of overfitting; here both losses remain high and oscillate, so training has not converged and stopping early would not fix it.
  • B: The size of the test set has no effect on the training dynamics or on the oscillating loss.
  • C: Increasing the learning rate would make the steps even larger and worsen the oscillation and divergence.

contents.en:
An ML engineer has trained a neural network by using stochastic gradient descent (SGD).The neural network performs poorly on the test set. The values for training loss and validation loss remain high and show an oscilating pattern.The values decrease for a few epochs and then increase for a few epochs before repeating the same cycle.

What should the ML engineer do to improve the training process?

一名机器学习工程师使用随机梯度下降（SGD）训练了一个神经网络。该神经网络在测试集上表现不佳。训练损失和验证损失的值一直很高，并且呈现出振荡模式。这些值会下降几个周期，然后上升几个周期，如此反复循环。

questions.content:
An MLengineer needsto process thousands ofexisting CSV objects and new CSV objects that are uploaded.The CSV objects are stored ina central Amazon S3 bucket and have the same number of columns.One of the columns is a transaction date.The ML engineer must query the data based on the transaction date.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Use an Amazon Athena CREATE TABLE AS SELECT(CTAS) statement to create a table based on the transaction date from data in the central S3 bucket.Query the objects from the table.

contents.en: Use an Amazon Athena CREATE TABLE AS SELECT(CTAS) statement to create a table based on the transaction date from data in the central S3 bucket.Query the objects from the table.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊Athena的CREATE TABLE AS SELECT（CTAS）语句，基于中央S3存储桶中数据的交易日期创建一个表，然后从该表中查询对象。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a new S3 bucket for processed data.Set up S3 replication from the central S3 bucket to the new S3 bucket.Use S3 Object Lambda toquery the objects based on transaction date.

contents.en: Create a new S3 bucket for processed data.Set up S3 replication from the central S3 bucket to the new S3 bucket.Use S3 Object Lambda toquery the objects based on transaction date.
contents.zh: 创建一个用于处理后数据的新S3存储桶，设置从中央S3存储桶到新S3存储桶的S3复制，使用S3 Object Lambda根据交易日期查询对象。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a new S3 bucket for processed data.Use AWS Glue for Apache Spark to create a job to query the CSV objects based on transaction date. Configure the job to store the results in the new S3 bucket.Query the objects from the new S3 bucket.

contents.en: Create a new S3 bucket for processed data.Use AWS Glue for Apache Spark to create a job to query the CSV objects based on transaction date. Configure the job to store the results in the new S3 bucket.Query the objects from the new S3 bucket.
contents.zh: 创建一个用于处理后数据的新S3存储桶，使用AWS Glue for Apache Spark创建一个作业，基于交易日期查询CSV对象，配置该作业将结果存储在新S3存储桶中，然后从新S3存储桶中查询对象。

options.label: D
options.content: Create a new S3 bucket for processeddata.Use Amazon Data Firehose to transfer the data from the central S3 bucket to the new S3 bucket.Configure Firehose to run an AWS Lambda function to query the data based on transaction date.

contents.en: Create a new S3 bucket for processeddata.Use Amazon Data Firehose to transfer the data from the central S3 bucket to the new S3 bucket.Configure Firehose to run an AWS Lambda function to query the data based on transaction date.
contents.zh: 创建一个用于处理后数据的新S3存储桶，使用亚马逊Data Firehose将数据从中央S3存储桶传输到新S3存储桶，配置Firehose运行一个AWS Lambda函数，基于交易日期查询数据。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Amazon Athena 是无服务器的，只需一条 CREATE TABLE AS SELECT 语句就能直接读取 S3 中的 CSV 对象，并生成按交易日期分区的新表，新上传的对象可以通过 INSERT INTO 追加。之后按交易日期查询只会扫描相关分区，无需管理集群、作业或复制，运营开销最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: S3 Object Lambda 只能在单个 GET 请求返回时转换对象内容，并不是查询引擎，S3 复制还额外引入了需要管理的第二个存储桶却不能实现按日期查询。
  • C: AWS Glue for Apache Spark 作业需要编写、调度和维护作业代码并管理额外的存储桶，比无服务器的 SQL 语句开销更大。
  • D: Amazon Data Firehose 不能以 S3 存储桶作为数据源，其 Lambda 转换功能处理的是流式记录，而不是对已存储数据进行查询。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Amazon Athena 是无服务器的，只需一条 CREATE TABLE AS SELECT 语句就能直接读取 S3 中的 CSV 对象，并生成按交易日期分区的新表，新上传的对象可以通过 INSERT INTO 追加。之后按交易日期查询只会扫描相关分区，无需管理集群、作业或复制，运营开销最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: S3 Object Lambda 只能在单个 GET 请求返回时转换对象内容，并不是查询引擎，S3 复制还额外引入了需要管理的第二个存储桶却不能实现按日期查询。
  • C: AWS Glue for Apache Spark 作业需要编写、调度和维护作业代码并管理额外的存储桶，比无服务器的 SQL 语句开销更大。
  • D: Amazon Data Firehose 不能以 S3 存储桶作为数据源，其 Lambda 转换功能处理的是流式记录，而不是对已存储数据进行查询。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Amazon Athena is serverless, so a single CREATE TABLE AS SELECT statement can read the CSV objects in place and write a new table that is partitioned by the transaction date, and INSERT INTO can add newly uploaded objects. Querying by transaction date then scans only the relevant partitions, with no clusters, jobs, or replication to manage, which is the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: S3 Object Lambda only transforms the response of individual GET requests and is not a query engine, and S3 replication adds a second bucket to manage without enabling date-based queries.
  • C: An AWS Glue for Apache Spark job requires writing, scheduling, and maintaining job code plus a second bucket, which is more overhead than a serverless SQL statement.
  • D: Amazon Data Firehose cannot use an S3 bucket as a source, and its Lambda transformation processes streaming records rather than querying stored data.

Which solution on AWS will detect duplicates in the dataset with the LEAST code development?

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon Mechanical Turk jobs to detect duplicates.

contents.en: Use Amazon Mechanical Turk jobs to detect duplicates.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊Mechanical Turk任务来检测重复项。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon QuickSight ML Insights to build a custom deduplication model.

contents.en: Use Amazon QuickSight ML Insights to build a custom deduplication model.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊QuickSight ML Insights构建一个自定义去重模型。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to pre-process and detect duplicates.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to pre-process and detect duplicates.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊SageMaker Data Wrangler进行预处理并检测重复项。

options.label: D
options.content: Use the AWS Glue FindMatches transform to detect duplicates.

contents.en: Use the AWS Glue FindMatches transform to detect duplicates.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Glue FindMatches转换来检测重复项。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：AWS Glue FindMatches ML 转换专门用于查找重复或匹配的记录，包括跨多个属性的模糊匹配，只需在控制台中提供少量标注示例即可训练，无需编写去重代码，代码开发量最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon Mechanical Turk 依赖人工审核，无法扩展到大型数据集，而且仍需构建任务模板和结果处理代码。
  • B: Amazon QuickSight ML Insights 提供的是面向 BI 仪表板的异常检测、预测和自动叙述功能，无法构建自定义去重模型。
  • C: Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler 只能删除完全相同的重复行，要检测跨关键属性的近似重复记录仍需编写自定义转换代码。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：AWS Glue FindMatches ML 转换专门用于查找重复或匹配的记录，包括跨多个属性的模糊匹配，只需在控制台中提供少量标注示例即可训练，无需编写去重代码，代码开发量最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon Mechanical Turk 依赖人工审核，无法扩展到大型数据集，而且仍需构建任务模板和结果处理代码。
  • B: Amazon QuickSight ML Insights 提供的是面向 BI 仪表板的异常检测、预测和自动叙述功能，无法构建自定义去重模型。
  • C: Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler 只能删除完全相同的重复行，要检测跨关键属性的近似重复记录仍需编写自定义转换代码。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: The AWS Glue FindMatches ML transform is purpose-built to find duplicate or matching records, including fuzzy matches across several attributes, and it is trained from a few labeled examples in the console without writing deduplication code, which is the LEAST code development.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon Mechanical Turk relies on manual human review, which does not scale to a large dataset and still requires building task templates and result-processing code.
  • B: Amazon QuickSight ML Insights offers anomaly detection, forecasting, and narratives for BI dashboards and cannot build a custom deduplication model.
  • C: Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler can only drop exact duplicate rows, so detecting near-duplicates across key attributes would require custom transformation code.

contents.en:
A company has a large,unstructured dataset. The dataset includes many duplicate records across several key attributes.

Which solution on AWS will detect duplicates in the dataset with the LEAST code development?

A company needs to run a batch data-processing job on Amazon EC2 instances.The job will run during the weekend and will ake 90 minutes to finish running. The processing can handle interruptions. The company will run the job every weekend for the next 6 months.

Which EC2 instance purchasing option will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.label: A
options.content: Spot Instances

contents.en: Spot Instances
contents.zh: 竞价型实例（Spot Instances）

options.label: B
options.content: Reserved Instances

contents.en: Reserved Instances
contents.zh: 预留实例（Reserved Instances）

options.label: C
options.content: On-Demand Instances

contents.en: On-Demand Instances
contents.zh: 按需实例（On-Demand Instances）

options.label: D
options.content: Dedicated Instances

contents.en: Dedicated Instances
contents.zh: 专用实例（Dedicated Instances）

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Spot Instances 相比按需价格最多可节省 90%，适用于能够容忍中断的工作负载，而这个每周只运行一次、耗时 90 分钟且可处理中断的周末批处理作业完全符合这种模式，因此最具成本效益。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Reserved Instances 需要 1 年或 3 年的承诺并按持续时间计费，为每周 90 分钟的作业购买 6 个月的预留容量是浪费。
  • C: On-Demand Instances 价格是 Spot 的数倍，而该作业可容忍中断，不需要按需实例保证的容量。
  • D: Dedicated Instances 运行在单租户硬件上且价格更高，只在有许可或合规隔离要求时才有意义。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Spot Instances 相比按需价格最多可节省 90%，适用于能够容忍中断的工作负载，而这个每周只运行一次、耗时 90 分钟且可处理中断的周末批处理作业完全符合这种模式，因此最具成本效益。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Reserved Instances 需要 1 年或 3 年的承诺并按持续时间计费，为每周 90 分钟的作业购买 6 个月的预留容量是浪费。
  • C: On-Demand Instances 价格是 Spot 的数倍，而该作业可容忍中断，不需要按需实例保证的容量。
  • D: Dedicated Instances 运行在单租户硬件上且价格更高，只在有许可或合规隔离要求时才有意义。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Spot Instances offer discounts of up to 90 percent compared with On-Demand pricing for workloads that can tolerate interruptions, and a fault-tolerant 90-minute weekend batch job that runs only once a week fits this model exactly, making it the MOST cost-effective option.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Reserved Instances require a one-year or three-year commitment and are billed continuously, so paying for 6 months of capacity to run 90 minutes a week wastes money.
  • C: On-Demand Instances cost several times more than Spot Instances and their guaranteed capacity is unnecessary because the job tolerates interruptions.
  • D: Dedicated Instances run on single-tenant hardware at a price premium and only make sense for licensing or compliance isolation requirements.

为什么其他选项错误：

explanations.zh:

  • A: Comprehend 自定义模型的工件由服务托管，不会以可下载的 S3 对象形式暴露，因此无法通过 S3 复制。

  • D: AWS Site-to-Site VPN 用于连接本地网络与 VPC，与在账户之间复制服务托管模型无关。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Amazon Comprehend supports sharing custom models across accounts natively: the owner attaches a resource-based policy to the model in Account A, and Account B calls the ImportModel API operation to create its own copy in the same Region. This uses built-in features only, which is the LEAST development effort.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Comprehend custom model artifacts are managed by the service and are not exposed as downloadable S3 objects, so there is nothing to copy through S3.
  • C: AWS DataSync transfers files between storage systems such as NFS, SMB, S3, and EFS and cannot move a managed Comprehend model.
  • D: An AWS Site-to-Site VPN connects an on-premises network to a VPC and has no role in copying a service-managed model between accounts.

questions.content:
An MLengineer is training a simple neural network model.The ML engineer tracks the performance of the model over time on a validation dataset.The model's performance improves substantially at first and then degrades after a specific number of epochs.

Which solutions will mitigate this problem?(Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.content: Enable early stopping on the model.

contents.en: Enable early stopping on the model.
contents.zh: 对模型启用早停法（Early stopping）。

options.label: B
options.content: Increase dropout in the layers.

contents.en: Increase dropout in the layers.
contents.zh: 增加各层中的丢弃率（Dropout）。

options.label: C
options.content: Increase the numberof layers.

contents.en: Increase the numberof layers.
contents.zh: 增加层数。

options.label: D
options.content: Increase the number of neurons.

contents.en: Increase the number of neurons.
contents.zh: 增加神经元数量。

options.label: E
options.content: Investigate and reduce the sources of model bias.

contents.en: Investigate and reduce the sources of model bias.
contents.zh: 调查并减少模型偏差的来源。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A、B：验证集性能先显著提升、在特定轮次后开始下降，是典型的过拟合表现。早停法会在验证指标不再改善时停止训练并保留最佳权重；增加 Dropout 则通过随机屏蔽神经元来正则化网络，降低模型记忆训练数据的能力。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • C: 增加层数会提升模型容量，只会加剧过拟合而不是缓解它。
  • D: 增加神经元数量同样提升容量，使模型更容易记忆训练数据。
  • E: 减少偏差针对的是欠拟合或不公平预测，而不是模型对训练数据拟合过度的问题。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A、B：验证集性能先显著提升、在特定轮次后开始下降，是典型的过拟合表现。早停法会在验证指标不再改善时停止训练并保留最佳权重；增加 Dropout 则通过随机屏蔽神经元来正则化网络，降低模型记忆训练数据的能力。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • C: 增加层数会提升模型容量，只会加剧过拟合而不是缓解它。
  • D: 增加神经元数量同样提升容量，使模型更容易记忆训练数据。
  • E: 减少偏差针对的是欠拟合或不公平预测，而不是模型对训练数据拟合过度的问题。
explanations.en:
Correct answers A and B: Validation performance that improves and then degrades after a certain number of epochs is the classic sign of overfitting. Early stopping halts training when the validation metric stops improving, so the model keeps the best weights, and increasing dropout regularizes the network by randomly disabling neurons, which reduces its ability to memorize the training data.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • C: Adding layers increases model capacity, which makes overfitting worse rather than mitigating it.
  • D: Adding neurons likewise increases capacity and the tendency to memorize training data.
  • E: Reducing bias addresses underfitting or unfair predictions, not a model that fits the training data too closely.

questions.content:
A company has a Retrieval Augmented Generation(RAG) application that uses a vector database to store embedings of documents.The company must migrate the application to AWS and must implement a solution that provides semantic search of text fles.The company has already migrated the text repository to an Amazon S3 bucket.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use an AWS Batch job to process the files and generate embeddings.Use AWS Glue to store the embeddings.Use SQL queries to perform the semantic searches.

contents.en: Use an AWS Batch job to process the files and generate embeddings.Use AWS Glue to store the embeddings.Use SQL queries to perform the semantic searches.
contents.zh: 使用一个AWS Batch作业来处理文件并生成嵌入向量，使用AWS Glue来存储嵌入向量，使用SQL查询来执行语义搜索。

options.label: B
options.content: Use a custom Amazon SageMaker notebook to run a custom script to generate embeddings.Use SageMaker Feature Store to store the embeddings.Use SQL queries to perform the semantic searches.

contents.en: Use a custom Amazon SageMaker notebook to run a custom script to generate embeddings.Use SageMaker Feature Store to store the embeddings.Use SQL queries to perform the semantic searches.
contents.zh: 使用一个自定义的亚马逊SageMaker笔记本运行一个自定义脚本来生成嵌入向量，使用SageMaker特征库来存储嵌入向量，使用SQL查询来执行语义搜索。

options.label: C
options.content: Use the Amazon Kendra S3 connector to ingest the documents from the S3 bucket into Amazon Kendra.Query Amazon Kendra to perform the semantic searches.

contents.en: Use the Amazon Kendra S3 connector to ingest the documents from the S3 bucket into Amazon Kendra.Query Amazon Kendra to perform the semantic searches.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊Kendra S3连接器将文档从S3存储桶摄取到亚马逊Kendra中，查询亚马逊Kendra来执行语义搜索。

options.label: D
options.content: Use an Amazon Textract asynchronous job to ingest the documents from the S3 bucket.Query Amazon Textract to perform the semantic searches.

contents.en: Use an Amazon Textract asynchronous job to ingest the documents from the S3 bucket.Query Amazon Textract to perform the semantic searches.
contents.zh: 使用一个亚马逊Textract异步作业将文档从S3存储桶摄取进来，查询亚马逊Textract来执行语义搜索。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Amazon Kendra 是完全托管的智能搜索服务，利用 ML 理解自然语言查询和文档语义。其内置的 S3 连接器可以直接从存储桶摄取已迁移的文本文件，Kendra 的 Query 和 Retrieve API 返回语义相关的段落，可作为 RAG 应用的检索层。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Glue 是 ETL 和数据目录服务，不是向量存储，而 SQL 查询执行的是精确或关键字匹配，无法实现语义相似度搜索。
  • B: SageMaker Feature Store 用于存储训练和推理所需的表格特征，不提供向量相似度搜索，SQL 查询也无法完成语义搜索。
  • D: Amazon Textract 用于从扫描文档和图像中提取文本和表格，不是搜索服务，无法进行语义查询。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Amazon Kendra 是完全托管的智能搜索服务，利用 ML 理解自然语言查询和文档语义。其内置的 S3 连接器可以直接从存储桶摄取已迁移的文本文件，Kendra 的 Query 和 Retrieve API 返回语义相关的段落，可作为 RAG 应用的检索层。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Glue 是 ETL 和数据目录服务，不是向量存储，而 SQL 查询执行的是精确或关键字匹配，无法实现语义相似度搜索。
  • B: SageMaker Feature Store 用于存储训练和推理所需的表格特征，不提供向量相似度搜索，SQL 查询也无法完成语义搜索。
  • D: Amazon Textract 用于从扫描文档和图像中提取文本和表格，不是搜索服务，无法进行语义查询。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Amazon Kendra is a fully managed intelligent search service that uses ML to understand natural language queries and document semantics. Its built-in S3 connector ingests the migrated text files directly from the bucket, and the Kendra Query and Retrieve APIs return semantically relevant passages that can serve as the retrieval layer of the RAG application.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: AWS Glue is an ETL and catalog service, not a vector store, and SQL queries perform exact or keyword matching rather than semantic similarity search.
  • B: SageMaker Feature Store stores tabular ML features for training and inference and does not provide vector similarity search, which SQL queries also cannot perform.
  • D: Amazon Textract extracts text and tables from scanned documents and images; it is not a search service and cannot be queried semantically.

options.content: Create a new model by using Amazon SageMaker Autopilot. Report the model's achieved performance.

options.label: B
options.content: Implement custom scripts to perform data pre-processing,multiple linear regression,and performance evaluation.Run the scripts on Amazon EC2 instances.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Amazon SageMaker Autopilot 是 AutoML 功能，只需提供表格数据集和目标列，就会自动完成预处理、算法选择、训练和超参数调优，并生成带有客观指标的候选模型排行榜。报告最佳候选模型的性能即可判断目标变量是否可预测，开发工作量最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • C: Amazon Macie 是用于发现 S3 中敏感数据的数据安全服务，不会训练或评估预测模型。
  • D: Amazon Bedrock 提供的是生成式基础模型，用它微调来做表格数据预测既不合适，工作量也高于 AutoML。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Amazon SageMaker Autopilot 是 AutoML 功能，只需提供表格数据集和目标列，就会自动完成预处理、算法选择、训练和超参数调优，并生成带有客观指标的候选模型排行榜。报告最佳候选模型的性能即可判断目标变量是否可预测，开发工作量最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 编写自定义的预处理、回归和评估脚本并管理 EC2 实例，是所有选项中开发工作量最大的。
  • C: Amazon Macie 是用于发现 S3 中敏感数据的数据安全服务，不会训练或评估预测模型。
  • D: Amazon Bedrock 提供的是生成式基础模型，用它微调来做表格数据预测既不合适，工作量也高于 AutoML。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Amazon SageMaker Autopilot is an AutoML capability that takes a tabular dataset and target column, automatically performs preprocessing, algorithm selection, training, and hyperparameter tuning, and produces a leaderboard with objective metrics for each candidate. Reporting the best candidate's performance answers whether the target is predictable with the LEAST development effort.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Writing custom preprocessing, regression, and evaluation scripts and managing EC2 instances is the most development effort of all the options.
  • C: Amazon Macie is a data security service that discovers sensitive data in S3 and does not train or evaluate predictive models.
  • D: Amazon Bedrock offers generative foundation models; fine-tuning one for a tabular prediction task is inappropriate and requires more effort than AutoML.

A company wants to predict the success ofadvertising campaigns by considering the color scheme of each advertisement.An ML engineer is preparing data for a neural network model. The dataset includes colorinformation as categorical data.

Which technique for feature engineering should the ML engineer use forthemodel?

options.label: A
options.content: Apply label encoding to the color categories.Automatically assign each color a unique integer.

contents.en: Apply label encoding to the color categories.Automatically assign each color a unique integer.
contents.zh: 对颜色类别应用标签编码，自动为每种颜色分配一个唯一的整数。

options.label: B
options.content: Implement padding to ensure that all color feature vectors have the same length.

contents.en: Implement padding to ensure that all color feature vectors have the same length.
contents.zh: 实施填充（Padding）操作，确保所有颜色特征向量具有相同的长度。

options.label: C
options.content: Perform dimensionality reduction on the color categories.

contents.en: Perform dimensionality reduction on the color categories.
contents.zh: 对颜色类别执行降维操作。

options.label: D
options.content: One-hot encode the color categories to transform the color scheme feature into a binary matrix.

contents.en: One-hot encode the color categories to transform the color scheme feature into a binary matrix.
contents.zh: 对颜色类别进行独热编码（One-hot encoding），将配色方案特征转换为一个二进制矩阵。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：颜色是没有天然顺序的名义型分类特征，而神经网络需要数值输入。独热编码将每种颜色转换为一个二元指示列，使网络能为每种颜色学习独立的权重，而不会假设颜色之间存在排序或距离关系。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 标签编码分配的任意整数会被神经网络当作有大小顺序的数值，暗示某种颜色大于另一种颜色。
  • B: 填充用于统一文本或时间序列等变长序列的长度，不是分类值的编码方法。
  • C: 降维作用于数值特征并会丢失信息，无法把原始分类标签转换为模型输入。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：颜色是没有天然顺序的名义型分类特征，而神经网络需要数值输入。独热编码将每种颜色转换为一个二元指示列，使网络能为每种颜色学习独立的权重，而不会假设颜色之间存在排序或距离关系。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 标签编码分配的任意整数会被神经网络当作有大小顺序的数值，暗示某种颜色大于另一种颜色。
  • B: 填充用于统一文本或时间序列等变长序列的长度，不是分类值的编码方法。
  • C: 降维作用于数值特征并会丢失信息，无法把原始分类标签转换为模型输入。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Color is a nominal categorical feature with no natural ordering, and neural networks require numeric inputs. One-hot encoding converts each color into a binary indicator column, so the network learns an independent weight for each color without assuming any ranking or distance between colors.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Label encoding assigns arbitrary integers that a neural network interprets as ordered magnitudes, implying that one color is greater than another.
  • B: Padding equalizes the length of variable-length sequences such as text or time series and is not an encoding method for categorical values.
  • C: Dimensionality reduction operates on numeric features and discards information; it cannot convert raw categorical labels into model inputs.

Which technique for feature engineering should the ML engineer use forthemodel?

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Amazon Macie 是完全托管的服务，利用 ML 和模式匹配自动发现 S3 存储桶中的 PII 等敏感数据，无需编写检测代码或管理基础设施。随后由无服务器的 AWS Lambda 函数移除被标记的数据，本地部署的模型无需改动，运营开销最少。

  • D: Amazon Comprehend 能检测文本中的 PII，但需要自建管道逐个对象送入，而 EC2 实例还需要打补丁、扩缩容和日常管理。

explanations.en:

Serverless AWS Lambda functions then remove the flagged data, and the on-premises model keeps running unchanged, which is the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • D: Amazon Comprehend can detect PII in text but requires a custom pipeline to feed it every object, and EC2 instances need patching, scaling, and management.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a custom tag for each of the three categories.Add the tags to the model packages in the SageMaker Model Registry.

contents.en: Create a custom tag for each of the three categories.Add the tags to the model packages in the SageMaker Model Registry.
contents.zh: 为这三个类别中的每一个创建一个自定义标签。将标签添加到SageMaker模型注册表中的模型包上。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a model group for each category. Move the existing models into these category model groups.

contents.en: Create a model group for each category. Move the existing models into these category model groups.
contents.zh: 为每个类别创建一个模型组。将现有模型移入这些类别模型组中。

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking to automatically identify and tag which model groups should contain the models.

contents.en: Use SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking to automatically identify and tag which model groups should contain the models.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking自动识别并标记哪些模型组应包含这些模型。

options.label: D

contents.zh: 为这三个类别中的每一个创建一个模型注册表集合。将现有的模型组移入这些集合中。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 为每个模型包逐一打标签在数百名数据科学家的规模下难以维护，而且标签只提供筛选功能，不是有组织的分组结构。
  • B: 将模型移入新的模型组会改变其现有分组和版本历史，违反了题目要求。
  • C: SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking 记录数据集、训练作业和模型的血缘关系，不会对模型组进行分类或打标签。

explanations.zh:

  • B: 将模型移入新的模型组会改变其现有分组和版本历史，违反了题目要求。

explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker Model Registry Collections are a hierarchical grouping layer that sits above model groups. Creating a collection for computer vision, NLP, and speech recognition and adding the existing model groups to them improves discoverability at scale while leaving the model packages, artifacts, and model group memberships untouched.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Tagging every individual model package is hard to maintain for hundreds of data scientists and provides filtering rather than an organized grouping structure.
  • B: Moving models into new model groups changes their existing groupings and versioning history, which the requirements prohibit.
  • C: SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking records the lineage of datasets, training jobs, and models; it does not categorize or tag model groups.

Recently, the company discovered suspicious traffic to the domain from a specifc lP adress.The company needs to block traffic from the specific IP address.

Which update to the network configuration will meet thisrequirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a security group inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address.Assign the security group to the domain.

contents.en: Create a security group inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address.Assign the security group to the domain.
contents.zh: 创建一个安全组入站规则来拒绝来自特定IP地址的流量。将该安全组分配给该域。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a network ACL inbound rule to deny traffic from the specifc IP adress.Assign the rule to the default network Ad for the subnet where the domain is located.

contents.en: Create a network ACL inbound rule to deny traffic from the specifc IP adress.Assign the rule to the default network Ad for the subnet where the domain is located.
contents.zh: 创建一个网络访问控制列表（ACL）入站规则来拒绝来自特定IP地址的流量。将该规则分配给该域所在子网的默认网络ACL。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a shadow variant for the domain.Configure SageMaker Inference Recommender to send trafficfrom the specific IP adressto the shadow endpoint.

contents.en: Create a shadow variant for the domain.Configure SageMaker Inference Recommender to send trafficfrom the specific IP adressto the shadow endpoint.
contents.zh: 为该域创建一个影子变体。配置SageMaker推理推荐器将来自特定IP地址的流量发送到影子端点。

options.label: D
options.content: Create a VPC route table to deny inbound traffic from the specific IP address.Assign the route table to the domain.

contents.en: Create a VPC route table to deny inbound traffic from the specific IP address.Assign the route table to the domain.
contents.zh: 创建一个VPC路由表来拒绝来自特定IP地址的入站流量。将该路由表分配给该域。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：网络 ACL 是子网级别的无状态防火墙，支持按编号顺序评估的显式拒绝规则。在承载 SageMaker 域的子网所关联的网络 ACL 中添加针对该可疑 IP 地址的入站拒绝规则，即可阻止该来源，同时不影响其他流量。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 安全组只支持允许规则，无法针对特定 IP 地址表达拒绝。
  • C: 影子变体和 SageMaker Inference Recommender 用于在端点上测试和基准评估模型变体，不能过滤流向域的网络流量。
  • D: 路由表决定出站流量的转发方向，无法按源 IP 拒绝入站流量，而且路由表关联的是子网而不是域。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：网络 ACL 是子网级别的无状态防火墙，支持按编号顺序评估的显式拒绝规则。在承载 SageMaker 域的子网所关联的网络 ACL 中添加针对该可疑 IP 地址的入站拒绝规则，即可阻止该来源，同时不影响其他流量。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 安全组只支持允许规则，无法针对特定 IP 地址表达拒绝。
  • C: 影子变体和 SageMaker Inference Recommender 用于在端点上测试和基准评估模型变体，不能过滤流向域的网络流量。
  • D: 路由表决定出站流量的转发方向，无法按源 IP 拒绝入站流量，而且路由表关联的是子网而不是域。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Network ACLs are stateless subnet-level firewalls that support explicit deny rules evaluated in numbered order. Adding an inbound deny rule for the suspicious IP address to the network ACL of the subnet that hosts the SageMaker domain blocks that source while leaving all other traffic unchanged.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Security groups support allow rules only and cannot express a deny for a specific IP address.
  • C: Shadow variants and SageMaker Inference Recommender are used to test and benchmark model variants on endpoints, not to filter network traffic to a domain.
  • D: Route tables determine where outbound traffic is forwarded; they cannot deny inbound traffic by source IP and are associated with subnets, not with a domain.

  • B: 部署 SageMaker 端点加 Lambda 消费者意味着要训练、托管、扩缩容并维护自定义的异常检测组件。

No model has to be trained, hosted, or wired to custom functions, which is the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Deploying a SageMaker endpoint and a Lambda consumer means training, hosting, scaling, and maintaining custom anomaly detection components.
  • C: Self-managed Apache Kafka on EC2 requires patching, scaling, and operating brokers in addition to the SageMaker endpoint and Lambda code.
  • D: Routing records through an SQS FIFO queue into AWS Glue ETL jobs is batch processing that adds latency and cannot flag anomalies in real time.

  • D: 随机森林分类器同样需要标注数据和完整的训练流程，比直接调用预训练 API 耗时得多。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Amazon Comprehend 是预训练的 NLP 服务，其情感分析 API 可立即返回文本的正面、负面、中性或混合情感，因此只需批量调用 API 即可评估聊天记录，无需收集标注或训练模型，耗时最少。

explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Amazon Comprehend is a pretrained NLP service whose sentiment analysis API returns positive, negative, neutral, or mixed sentiment for text immediately, so the chat recordings can be evaluated by calling the API in batch without collecting labels or training a model, which is the LEAST amount of time.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon Rekognition analyzes images and video and has no capability for text sentiment analysis.
  • B: Training a Naive Bayes classifier requires labeled chat data, feature engineering, training, and evaluation before any results are available.
  • D: A random forest classifier likewise needs labeled data and a full training cycle, which takes far longer than a pretrained API.

Acompany has a conversational Al assistant that sends requests through Amazon Bedrock to an Anthropic Claude large language model (LLM).Users report that when they ask similar questions multiple times, they sometimes receive different answers.An ML engineer needs to improve theresponses to be moreconsistent andless random.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Increase the temperature parameter and the top_k parameter.

contents.en: Increase the temperature parameter and the top_k parameter.
contents.zh: 增加温度（temperature）参数和top_k参数。

options.label: B
options.content: Increase the temperature parameter.Decrease the top_k parameter.

contents.en: Increase the temperature parameter.Decrease the top_k parameter.
contents.zh: 增加温度（temperature）参数，降低top_k参数。

options.label: C
options.content: Decrease the temperature parameter.Increase the top_k parameter.

contents.en: Decrease the temperature parameter.Increase the top_k parameter.
contents.zh: 降低温度（temperature）参数，增加top_k参数。

options.label: D
options.content: Decrease the temperature parameter and the top_k parameter.

contents.en: Decrease the temperature parameter and the top_k parameter.
contents.zh: 降低温度（temperature）参数和top_k参数。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：temperature 控制词元概率分布的平坦程度，top_k 将采样范围限制在概率最高的 k 个词元。同时降低两者会让模型几乎每次都选择最高概率的词元，从而对相似问题给出更一致、更确定的回答。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 提高 temperature 和 top_k 都会扩大候选词元范围，使回复更随机。
  • B: 提高 temperature 会拉平分布并增加随机性，抵消了降低 top_k 带来的好处。
  • C: 提高 top_k 让模型可以从更多候选词元中采样，即便 temperature 降低也会增加变化。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：temperature 控制词元概率分布的平坦程度，top_k 将采样范围限制在概率最高的 k 个词元。同时降低两者会让模型几乎每次都选择最高概率的词元，从而对相似问题给出更一致、更确定的回答。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 提高 temperature 和 top_k 都会扩大候选词元范围，使回复更随机。
  • B: 提高 temperature 会拉平分布并增加随机性，抵消了降低 top_k 带来的好处。
  • C: 提高 top_k 让模型可以从更多候选词元中采样，即便 temperature 降低也会增加变化。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Temperature controls how flat the token probability distribution is, and top_k limits sampling to the k most likely tokens. Lowering both makes the model pick the highest-probability tokens almost every time, which produces more consistent, deterministic answers to similar questions.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Increasing temperature and top_k both widen the set of likely tokens and make responses more random.
  • B: A higher temperature flattens the distribution and adds randomness, which cancels out the benefit of a lower top_k.
  • C: Increasing top_k lets the model sample from more candidate tokens, adding variability even though the temperature is lower.

questions.content:
Acompany is using ML to predict the presence of a specific weed in a farmer's field.The company is using the Amazon SageMake linear learner built-in algorithm with avalue of multiclass_dassifier for the predictorjype hyperparameter.

What should the company do to MINIMIZE false positives?

options.label: A
options.content: Set the value of the weight decay hyperparameter to zero.

contents.en: Set the value of the weight decay hyperparameter to zero.
contents.zh: 将权重衰减（weight decay）超参数的值设置为零。

options.label: B
options.content: Increase the number of training epochs.

contents.en: Increase the number of training epochs.
contents.zh: 增加训练轮数（number of training epochs）。

options.label: C
options.content: Increase the value of the target_precision hyperparameter.

contents.en: Increase the value of the target_precision hyperparameter.
contents.zh: 增加目标精度（target_precision）超参数的值。

options.label: D
options.content: Change the value of the predictorjype hyperparameter to regressor.

contents.en: Change the value of the predictorjype hyperparameter to regressor.
contents.zh: 将预测器类型（predictor_type）超参数的值更改为回归器（regressor）。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：减少误报需要提高精度，SageMaker 线性学习器算法正是为此提供了 target_precision 超参数。当模型选择标准为 recall_at_target_precision 时，算法会将精度保持在目标值并最大化召回率，因此提高 target_precision 能直接把误报降到最低。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 将 weight decay 设为零会取消 L2 正则化，容易导致过拟合，对误报没有针对性作用。
  • B: 增加训练轮数可能改善整体拟合或造成过拟合，但不会把精度与召回率的权衡向减少误报的方向移动。
  • D: 把 predictor_type 改为 regressor 会让模型输出连续值而不是类别预测，无法再进行杂草存在与否的分类。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：减少误报需要提高精度，SageMaker 线性学习器算法正是为此提供了 target_precision 超参数。当模型选择标准为 recall_at_target_precision 时，算法会将精度保持在目标值并最大化召回率，因此提高 target_precision 能直接把误报降到最低。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 将 weight decay 设为零会取消 L2 正则化，容易导致过拟合，对误报没有针对性作用。
  • B: 增加训练轮数可能改善整体拟合或造成过拟合，但不会把精度与召回率的权衡向减少误报的方向移动。
  • D: 把 predictor_type 改为 regressor 会让模型输出连续值而不是类别预测，无法再进行杂草存在与否的分类。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: False positives are reduced by raising precision, and the SageMaker linear learner algorithm exposes the target_precision hyperparameter for exactly this purpose. When the model selection criterion is recall_at_target_precision, the algorithm holds precision at the target value while maximizing recall, so increasing target_precision directly MINIMIZES false positives.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Setting weight decay to zero removes L2 regularization, which encourages overfitting and does nothing specific to false positives.
  • B: More training epochs may improve overall fit or cause overfitting but do not shift the precision and recall trade-off toward fewer false positives.
  • D: Changing predictor_type to regressor makes the model output continuous values instead of class predictions, so the weed presence classification would no longer be produced.

questions.content:
A company has implemented a data ingestion pipeline for sales transactions from its ecommerce website.The company uses Amazon Data Firehose to ingest data into Amazon OpenSearch Service.The buffer interval of the Firehose stream is set for 60 seconds.An OpenSearch linear model generates real-time sales forecasts based on the data and presents the data in an OpenSearch dashboard. The company needs to optimize the data ingestion pipeline to support sub-second latency for the real-time dashboard.

Which change to the architecture will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use zero buffering in the Firehose stream.Tune the batch size that is used in the PutRecordBatch operation.

contents.en: Use zero buffering in the Firehose stream.Tune the batch size that is used in the PutRecordBatch operation.
contents.zh: 在数据传输流中使用零缓冲。调整PutRecordBatch操作中使用的批量大小。

options.label: B
options.content: Replace the Firehose stream with an AWS DataSync task.Configure the task with enhanced fan-out consumers.

contents.en: Replace the Firehose stream with an AWS DataSync task.Configure the task with enhanced fan-out consumers.
contents.zh: 用AWS DataSync任务替换数据传输流。为任务配置增强型扇出（enhanced fan-out）消费者。

options.label: C
options.content: Increase the buffer interval of the Firehose stream from 60 seconds to 120 seconds.

contents.en: Increase the buffer interval of the Firehose stream from 60 seconds to 120 seconds.
contents.zh: 将数据传输流的缓冲间隔从60秒增加到120秒。

options.label: D
options.content: Replace the Firehose stream with an Amazon Simple Queue Service(Amazon SQS) queue.

contents.en: Replace the Firehose stream with an Amazon Simple Queue Service(Amazon SQS) queue.
contents.zh: 用亚马逊简单队列服务（Amazon SQS）队列替换数据传输流。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：60 秒的缓冲间隔正是延迟数据投递到 Amazon OpenSearch Service 的原因。Amazon Data Firehose 支持零缓冲配置，记录一到达就投递到目标，同时调整 PutRecordBatch 使用的批量大小可保持生产端吞吐效率，让现有管道达到仪表板所需的最低延迟。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: AWS DataSync 是用于迁移的文件传输服务，而增强型扇出是 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 的消费者功能，该选项不是有效的流式管道。
  • C: 把缓冲间隔提高到 120 秒会使投递延迟翻倍，而不是降低延迟。
  • D: Amazon SQS 是消息队列，无法原生投递到 OpenSearch Service，需要自建消费者，也不能降低延迟。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：60 秒的缓冲间隔正是延迟数据投递到 Amazon OpenSearch Service 的原因。Amazon Data Firehose 支持零缓冲配置，记录一到达就投递到目标，同时调整 PutRecordBatch 使用的批量大小可保持生产端吞吐效率，让现有管道达到仪表板所需的最低延迟。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: AWS DataSync 是用于迁移的文件传输服务，而增强型扇出是 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 的消费者功能，该选项不是有效的流式管道。
  • C: 把缓冲间隔提高到 120 秒会使投递延迟翻倍，而不是降低延迟。
  • D: Amazon SQS 是消息队列，无法原生投递到 OpenSearch Service，需要自建消费者，也不能降低延迟。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: The 60-second buffer interval is what delays delivery to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Amazon Data Firehose supports a zero buffering configuration that delivers records to the destination as soon as they arrive, and tuning the batch size used with PutRecordBatch keeps producer throughput efficient, so the existing pipeline reaches the lowest latency the dashboard needs.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: AWS DataSync is a file transfer service for migrations, and enhanced fan-out is an Amazon Kinesis Data Streams consumer feature, so the option is not a valid streaming pipeline.
  • C: Raising the buffer interval to 120 seconds doubles the delivery delay instead of reducing it.
  • D: Amazon SQS is a message queue with no native delivery to OpenSearch Service, so it would require custom consumers and would not lower latency.

questions.content:
Acompany has trained an ML model in Amazon SageMaker.The company needs to host the model to provide inferences in a production environment. The model must be highly available and must respond with minimum latency. The size of each request will be between 1 KB and 3MB.The model willreceive unpredictable bursts of requests during the day. The inferences must adapt proportionallyto the changes in demand.

How should the company deploy the model into production to meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a SageMaker real-time inference endpoint. Configure auto scaling. Configure the endpoint to present the existing model.

contents.en: Create a SageMaker real-time inference endpoint. Configure auto scaling. Configure the endpoint to present the existing model.
contents.zh: 创建一个SageMaker实时推理端点。配置自动缩放。配置端点以提供现有模型的服务。

options.label: B
options.content: Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service(Amazon ECS) cluster.Use ECS scheduled scaling that is based on the CPU of the ECS cluster.

contents.en: Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service(Amazon ECS) cluster.Use ECS scheduled scaling that is based on the CPU of the ECS cluster.
contents.zh: 将模型部署在使用AWS Fargate的亚马逊弹性容器服务（Amazon ECS）集群上。使用基于ECS集群CPU的定时缩放功能。

options.label: C
options.content: Install SageMaker Operator on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service(Amazon EKS) cluster.Deploy the model in Amazon EKS.Set horizontal pod auto scaling to scale replicas based on the memory metric.

contents.en: Install SageMaker Operator on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service(Amazon EKS) cluster.Deploy the model in Amazon EKS.Set horizontal pod auto scaling to scale replicas based on the memory metric.
contents.zh: 在亚马逊弹性 Kubernetes服务（Amazon EKS）集群上安装SageMaker Operator。将模型部署在Amazon EKS中。设置水平Pod自动缩放，以便根据内存指标来扩展副本数量。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker 实时推理端点专为低延迟同步预测而设计，支持最大 6 MB 的负载，1 KB 到 3 MB 的请求完全适用。运行多个实例可实现跨可用区的高可用，基于 InvocationsPerInstance 指标的应用自动缩放能按不可预测的突发需求成比例地增减实例。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: ECS 定时缩放只在固定时间调整容量，无法响应不可预测的突发流量，还要自行管理容器，而这些 SageMaker 端点已替你处理。
  • C: 在 Amazon EKS 上运行模型需要运维 Kubernetes 集群，基于内存指标的水平 Pod 自动缩放也无法准确反映请求量。
  • D: Spot Instances 随时可能被中断，与生产推理服务的高可用要求相冲突。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker 实时推理端点专为低延迟同步预测而设计，支持最大 6 MB 的负载，1 KB 到 3 MB 的请求完全适用。运行多个实例可实现跨可用区的高可用，基于 InvocationsPerInstance 指标的应用自动缩放能按不可预测的突发需求成比例地增减实例。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: ECS 定时缩放只在固定时间调整容量，无法响应不可预测的突发流量，还要自行管理容器，而这些 SageMaker 端点已替你处理。
  • C: 在 Amazon EKS 上运行模型需要运维 Kubernetes 集群，基于内存指标的水平 Pod 自动缩放也无法准确反映请求量。
  • D: Spot Instances 随时可能被中断，与生产推理服务的高可用要求相冲突。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: A SageMaker real-time inference endpoint is designed for low-latency synchronous predictions with payloads up to 6 MB, so 1 KB to 3 MB requests fit. Running multiple instances gives multi-AZ high availability, and application auto scaling on the InvocationsPerInstance metric adds or removes instances in proportion to unpredictable bursts of demand.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: ECS scheduled scaling changes capacity at fixed times and cannot react to unpredictable bursts, and it adds container management that the SageMaker endpoint handles for you.
  • C: Running the model on Amazon EKS requires operating a Kubernetes cluster, and memory-based horizontal pod autoscaling is a poor proxy for request volume.
  • D: Spot Instances can be interrupted at any time, which conflicts with the high availability requirement for a production inference service.

contents.en:
Acompany has trained an ML model in Amazon SageMaker.The company needs to host the model to provide inferences in a production environment. The model must be highly available and must respond with minimum latency. The size of each request will be between 1 KB and 3MB.The model willreceive unpredictable bursts of requests during the day. The inferences must adapt proportionallyto the changes in demand.

How should the company deploy the model into production to meet these requirements?
contents.zh:
一家公司已在亚马逊SageMaker中训练了一个机器学习模型。该公司需要托管该模型，以便在生产环境中提供推理服务。该模型必须具有高可用性，并且响应延迟要最小。每个请求的大小将在1 KB到3 MB之间。该模型在一天内会收到不可预测的请求突发情况。推理服务必须根据需求的变化按比例进行调整。

该公司应如何将模型部署到生产环境中以满足这些要求？

Which instance purchasing option will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.label: A
options.content: Run the primary node,core nodes, and task nodes on On-Demand Instances.

contents.en: Run the primary node,core nodes, and task nodes on On-Demand Instances.
contents.zh: 在按需实例（On-Demand Instances）上运行主节点、核心节点和任务节点。

options.label: B
options.content: Run the primary node,core nodes, and task nodes on Spot Instances.

contents.en: Run the primary node,core nodes, and task nodes on Spot Instances.
contents.zh: 在竞价型实例（Spot Instances）上运行主节点、核心节点和任务节点。

options.label: C
options.content: Run the primary node on an On-Demand Instance.Run the core nodes and task nodes on Spot Instances.

contents.en: Run the primary node on an On-Demand Instance.Run the core nodes and task nodes on Spot Instances.
contents.zh: 在按需实例（On-Demand Instances）上运行主节点，在竞价型实例（Spot Instances）上运行核心节点和任务节点。

options.label: D

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：在 Amazon EMR 中，主节点负责协调集群，核心节点在 HDFS 中存储数据，两者都必须运行在 On-Demand Instances 上才能保证不丢失数据。任务节点只执行计算任务、不保存 HDFS 数据，可以安全地使用 Spot Instances，这是最具成本效益的组合。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 任务节点使用 On-Demand Instances 是为可被中断且不会造成数据丢失的计算支付全价。
  • B: 主节点被 Spot 中断会导致整个集群终止，核心节点被中断会丢失 HDFS 数据。
  • C: 核心节点使用 Spot Instances 随时可能被回收，其存储的 HDFS 数据块会丢失，违反了不允许数据丢失的要求。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：在 Amazon EMR 中，主节点负责协调集群，核心节点在 HDFS 中存储数据，两者都必须运行在 On-Demand Instances 上才能保证不丢失数据。任务节点只执行计算任务、不保存 HDFS 数据，可以安全地使用 Spot Instances，这是最具成本效益的组合。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 任务节点使用 On-Demand Instances 是为可被中断且不会造成数据丢失的计算支付全价。
  • B: 主节点被 Spot 中断会导致整个集群终止，核心节点被中断会丢失 HDFS 数据。
  • C: 核心节点使用 Spot Instances 随时可能被回收，其存储的 HDFS 数据块会丢失，违反了不允许数据丢失的要求。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: In Amazon EMR, the primary node coordinates the cluster and core nodes store data in HDFS, so both must run on On-Demand Instances to guarantee no data loss. Task nodes only run compute tasks and hold no HDFS data, so Spot Instances can be used for them safely, which is the MOST cost-effective combination.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Running task nodes on On-Demand Instances pays full price for compute that could be interrupted without any data loss.
  • B: A Spot interruption of the primary node terminates the cluster and an interruption of core nodes loses HDFS data.
  • C: Core nodes on Spot Instances can be reclaimed at any time, which loses the HDFS blocks they store and violates the no data loss requirement.

A company wants to improve the sustainability of its ML operations.

Which actions will reduce the energy usage and computational resources that are associated with the company's training jobs?(Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker Debugger to stop training jobs when non-converging conditions are detected.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker Debugger to stop training jobs when non-converging conditions are detected.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊SageMaker Debugger，在检测到不收敛情况时停止训练作业。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth for data labeling.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth for data labeling.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊SageMaker Ground Truth进行数据标注。

options.label: C
options.content: Deploy models by using AWS Lambda functions.

contents.en: Deploy models by using AWS Lambda functions.
contents.zh: 通过AWS Lambda函数部署模型。

options.label: D
options.content: Use AWS Trainium instances for training.

contents.en: Use AWS Trainium instances for training.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Trainium实例进行训练。

options.label: E
options.content: Use PyTorch orTensorFlow with the distributed training option.

contents.en: Use PyTorch orTensorFlow with the distributed training option.
contents.zh: 使用带有分布式训练选项的PyTorch或TensorFlow。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A、D：Amazon SageMaker Debugger 的内置规则能检测损失不下降等情况并自动停止训练作业，避免在永远不会收敛的训练上浪费计算和能源。AWS Trainium 是专为 ML 训练打造的芯片，每瓦性能高于通用 GPU 实例，可降低每个训练作业的能耗。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth 是数据标注服务，不会改变训练作业消耗的计算或能源。
  • C: 用 AWS Lambda 部署模型影响的是推理托管，而不是训练作业使用的资源。
  • E: 分布式训练把作业分散到更多实例以缩短时间，但总计算量至少不减，还会增加通信开销。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A、D：Amazon SageMaker Debugger 的内置规则能检测损失不下降等情况并自动停止训练作业，避免在永远不会收敛的训练上浪费计算和能源。AWS Trainium 是专为 ML 训练打造的芯片，每瓦性能高于通用 GPU 实例，可降低每个训练作业的能耗。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth 是数据标注服务，不会改变训练作业消耗的计算或能源。
  • C: 用 AWS Lambda 部署模型影响的是推理托管，而不是训练作业使用的资源。
  • E: 分布式训练把作业分散到更多实例以缩短时间，但总计算量至少不减，还会增加通信开销。
explanations.en:
Correct answers A and D: Amazon SageMaker Debugger built-in rules can detect conditions such as loss not decreasing and automatically stop a training job, so compute and energy are not wasted on runs that will never converge. AWS Trainium is a purpose-built ML training chip that delivers higher performance per watt than general-purpose GPU instances, reducing the energy used for each training job.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth is a data labeling service and does not change the compute or energy consumed by training jobs.
  • C: Deploying models on AWS Lambda affects inference hosting, not the resources used by training jobs.
  • E: Distributed training spreads a job across more instances to finish faster but consumes at least as much total compute, plus communication overhead.
