questions.content:
A company is planning to create several MLprediction models.The training data is stored in Amazon S3.The entire dataset is more than 5TB in size and consists of CSV,JSON,Apache Parquet, and simple text files. The data must be processed in several consecutive steps.The steps include complex manipulations that can take hours to finish running. Some of the processing involves natural language processing(NLP)transformations.The entire process must be automated.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Process data at each step by using Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler.Automate the process by using Data Wrangler jobs.

contents.en: Process data at each step by using Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler.Automate the process by using Data Wrangler jobs.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊SageMaker Data Wrangler在每个步骤处理数据。使用Data Wrangler作业自动化该过程。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker notebooks for each data processing step.Automate the process by using Amazon EventBridge.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker notebooks for each data processing step.Automate the process by using Amazon EventBridge.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊SageMaker笔记本处理每个数据处理步骤。使用亚马逊EventBridge自动化该过程。

options.label: C
options.content: Process data at each step by using AWS Lambda functions.Automate the process by using AWS Step Functions and Amazon EventBridge.

contents.en: Process data at each step by using AWS Lambda functions.Automate the process by using AWS Step Functions and Amazon EventBridge.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Lambda函数处理每个步骤的数据。使用AWS Step Functions和亚马逊EventBridge自动化该过程。

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker Pipelines to create a pipeline of data processing steps.Automate the pipeline by using Amazon EventBridge.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker Pipelines to create a pipeline of data processing steps.Automate the pipeline by using Amazon EventBridge.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊SageMaker Pipelines创建数据处理步骤的管道。使用亚马逊EventBridge自动化该管道。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：Amazon SageMaker Pipelines 以有向图的方式编排各步骤，其处理步骤运行 SageMaker Processing 作业，可使用 Spark 或自定义容器处理数 TB 的多格式数据以及耗时数小时的 NLP 转换。再通过 Amazon EventBridge 定时或按事件触发管道，即可端到端地自动化整个流程。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler 是面向表格数据准备的交互式可视化工具，不适合串联对 5 TB 混合文件进行数小时 NLP 转换的多步流程。
  • B: SageMaker 笔记本是交互式开发环境，不是用于连续长时间步骤的生产级编排机制。
  • C: AWS Lambda 函数最长执行 15 分钟且内存有限，无法运行对 5 TB 数据集耗时数小时的处理步骤。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：Amazon SageMaker Pipelines 以有向图的方式编排各步骤，其处理步骤运行 SageMaker Processing 作业，可使用 Spark 或自定义容器处理数 TB 的多格式数据以及耗时数小时的 NLP 转换。再通过 Amazon EventBridge 定时或按事件触发管道，即可端到端地自动化整个流程。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler 是面向表格数据准备的交互式可视化工具，不适合串联对 5 TB 混合文件进行数小时 NLP 转换的多步流程。
  • B: SageMaker 笔记本是交互式开发环境，不是用于连续长时间步骤的生产级编排机制。
  • C: AWS Lambda 函数最长执行 15 分钟且内存有限，无法运行对 5 TB 数据集耗时数小时的处理步骤。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Amazon SageMaker Pipelines orchestrates a directed graph of steps, and its processing steps run SageMaker Processing jobs with Spark or custom containers that handle multi-terabyte mixed-format data and hours-long NLP transformations. Scheduling or event-triggering the pipeline with Amazon EventBridge automates the entire process end to end.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler is an interactive visual tool for tabular data preparation and is not designed for chaining hours-long NLP transformations over 5 TB of mixed files.
  • B: SageMaker notebooks are interactive development environments, not a production orchestration mechanism for consecutive long-running steps.
  • C: AWS Lambda functions have a 15-minute maximum execution time and limited memory, so they cannot run processing steps that take hours on a 5 TB dataset.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：AWS::SageMaker::Model 资源定义了 SageMaker 模型本身：推理容器镜像、模型工件在 S3 中的位置以及执行角色。端点配置和端点随后引用这个模型资源，因此要创建模型就应声明它。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: AWS::SageMaker::Endpoint 根据端点配置创建托管端点，本身并不定义模型。
  • C: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance 用于预置 Jupyter 笔记本开发环境，不是可部署的模型。
  • D: AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline 定义的是 SageMaker Pipelines 工作流，而不是模型资源。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：AWS::SageMaker::Model 资源定义了 SageMaker 模型本身：推理容器镜像、模型工件在 S3 中的位置以及执行角色。端点配置和端点随后引用这个模型资源，因此要创建模型就应声明它。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: AWS::SageMaker::Endpoint 根据端点配置创建托管端点，本身并不定义模型。
  • C: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance 用于预置 Jupyter 笔记本开发环境，不是可部署的模型。
  • D: AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline 定义的是 SageMaker Pipelines 工作流，而不是模型资源。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: The AWS::SageMaker::Model resource defines the SageMaker model itself: the inference container image, the S3 location of the model artifacts, and the execution role. An endpoint configuration and endpoint then reference this model resource, so it is the one to declare to create the model.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: AWS::SageMaker::Endpoint creates the hosting endpoint from an endpoint configuration and does not itself define a model.
  • C: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance provisions a Jupyter notebook development environment, not a deployable model.
  • D: AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline defines a SageMaker Pipelines workflow rather than a model resource.

正确答案 C：AWS Lake Formation 集中管理数据湖的授权，其基于标签的访问控制（LF-Tags）允许公司按广告活动为数据库、表和 S3 数据位置打标签，并按匹配的标签向每位 ML 工程师授权。Athena 和 Glue 会自动执行这些权限，新增广告活动只需打标签即可，运营效率最高。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 在 AWS Glue Data Catalog 上配置 IAM 策略只能控制 Athena 的元数据访问，无法管控直接浏览 S3 存储桶，而且每个广告活动都要维护一条策略。
  • B: 用 DynamoDB、DynamoDB Streams 和 Lambda 自建系统来改写 S3 存储桶策略需要运维自定义代码，且无法与 Lake Formation 或 Athena 的权限集成。
  • D: S3 存储桶策略无法控制 Athena 或 Data Catalog 的访问，按广告活动逐条编写会很快难以管理并触及存储桶策略大小上限。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：AWS Lake Formation 集中管理数据湖的授权，其基于标签的访问控制（LF-Tags）允许公司按广告活动为数据库、表和 S3 数据位置打标签，并按匹配的标签向每位 ML 工程师授权。Athena 和 Glue 会自动执行这些权限，新增广告活动只需打标签即可，运营效率最高。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 在 AWS Glue Data Catalog 上配置 IAM 策略只能控制 Athena 的元数据访问，无法管控直接浏览 S3 存储桶，而且每个广告活动都要维护一条策略。
  • B: 用 DynamoDB、DynamoDB Streams 和 Lambda 自建系统来改写 S3 存储桶策略需要运维自定义代码，且无法与 Lake Formation 或 Athena 的权限集成。
  • D: S3 存储桶策略无法控制 Athena 或 Data Catalog 的访问，按广告活动逐条编写会很快难以管理并触及存储桶策略大小上限。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: AWS Lake Formation centralizes authorization for the data lake, and Lake Formation tag-based access control (LF-Tags) lets the company tag databases, tables, and S3 data locations by campaign and grant each ML engineer permissions on the matching tag. Athena and Glue enforce these permissions automatically, so a new campaign only needs a tag, which is the MOST operationally efficient approach.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: IAM policies on the AWS Glue Data Catalog only control metadata access for Athena, do not govern browsing the S3 bucket, and need a policy per campaign to maintain.
  • B: Building a DynamoDB, DynamoDB Streams, and Lambda system to rewrite S3 bucket policies is custom code to operate and does not integrate with Lake Formation or Athena permissions.
  • D: S3 bucket policies do not control Athena or Data Catalog access, and per-campaign statements quickly become unmanageable and hit the bucket policy size limit.

contents.en:
An advertising company uses AWS Lake Formation to manage a data lake.The data lake contains structureddata and unstructured data.The company's MLengineers are assigned to specific advertisement campaigns. The ML engineers must interact with the data through Amazon Athena and by browsing the data directly in an Amazon S3 bucket.The ML engineers must have access to only the resources that are specific to their assigned advertisement campaigns.

questions.content:
An ML engineer needs to use data with Amazon SageMaker Canvas to train an MLmodel. The data is stored in Amazon S3 and is complex in structure. The ML engineer must use a file format that minimizes processing time for the data.

Which file format will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: CSV files compressed with Snappy

contents.en: CSV files compressed with Snappy
contents.zh: 使用Snappy压缩的CSV文件

options.label: B
options.content: JSON objects in JSONL format

contents.en: JSON objects in JSONL format
contents.zh: JSONL格式的JSON对象

options.label: C
options.content: JSON files compressed with gzip

contents.en: JSON files compressed with gzip
contents.zh: 使用gzip压缩的JSON文件

options.label: D
options.content: Apache Parquet files

contents.en: Apache Parquet files
contents.zh: Apache Parquet文件

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：Apache Parquet 是列式、压缩的二进制格式，自带 schema 并原生支持嵌套和复杂结构。SageMaker Canvas 可以直接从 S3 导入 Parquet，只读取需要的列并跳过文本解析，对结构复杂的数据集能最大限度地减少处理时间。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CSV 是扁平的行式文本格式，难以表达复杂结构且必须完整解析，而 Snappy 压缩的 CSV 也不是 Canvas 支持的导入格式。
  • B: JSONL 是冗长的行式文本，每条记录和每个键都需要解析，比列式二进制格式慢。
  • C: gzip 压缩的 JSON 使用前必须完整解压并解析，且无法切分进行并行处理。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：Apache Parquet 是列式、压缩的二进制格式，自带 schema 并原生支持嵌套和复杂结构。SageMaker Canvas 可以直接从 S3 导入 Parquet，只读取需要的列并跳过文本解析，对结构复杂的数据集能最大限度地减少处理时间。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CSV 是扁平的行式文本格式，难以表达复杂结构且必须完整解析，而 Snappy 压缩的 CSV 也不是 Canvas 支持的导入格式。
  • B: JSONL 是冗长的行式文本，每条记录和每个键都需要解析，比列式二进制格式慢。
  • C: gzip 压缩的 JSON 使用前必须完整解压并解析，且无法切分进行并行处理。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Apache Parquet is a columnar, compressed, binary format with an embedded schema that natively supports nested and complex structures. SageMaker Canvas can import Parquet directly from S3, reading only the needed columns and skipping text parsing, which minimizes processing time for a complex dataset.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: CSV is a flat, row-oriented text format that represents complex structures poorly and must be fully parsed, and Snappy-compressed CSV is not a supported Canvas import format.
  • B: JSONL is verbose row-oriented text that requires parsing every record and every key, which is slower than a columnar binary format.
  • C: gzip-compressed JSON must be fully decompressed and parsed before use and cannot be split for parallel processing.

contents.en:
An ML engineer needs to use data with Amazon SageMaker Canvas to train an MLmodel. The data is stored in Amazon S3 and is complex in structure. The ML engineer must use a file format that minimizes processing time for the data.

Which file format will meet these requirements?

questions.content:
An ML engineer is evaluating several MLmodels and must choose one model to use in production.The cost of false negative predictions by the models is much higher than the cost of false positive predictions.

Which metric finding shouldthe ML engineer prioritize the MOSTwhen choosing the model?

options.label: A
options.content: Low precision

contents.en: Low precision
contents.zh: 低精度（Low precision）

options.label: B
options.content: High precision

contents.en: High precision
contents.zh: 高精度（High precision）

options.label: C
options.content: Low recall

contents.en: Low recall
contents.zh: 低召回率（Low recall）

options.label: D
options.content: High recall

contents.en: High recall
contents.zh: 高召回率（High recall）

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：召回率是模型正确识别出的实际正例比例，计算方式为真正例除以真正例加假反例。当假反例的成本远高于假正例时，召回率最高的模型漏掉的真实案例最少，因此应最优先考虑高召回率。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 低精度从来不是目标，它只意味着大量被预测为正例的结果是错的。
  • B: 高精度最小化的是假正例，而在本场景中这是成本较低的错误，且可能以更多假反例为代价。
  • C: 低召回率意味着更多假反例，这正是工程师必须避免的高成本结果。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：召回率是模型正确识别出的实际正例比例，计算方式为真正例除以真正例加假反例。当假反例的成本远高于假正例时，召回率最高的模型漏掉的真实案例最少，因此应最优先考虑高召回率。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 低精度从来不是目标，它只意味着大量被预测为正例的结果是错的。
  • B: 高精度最小化的是假正例，而在本场景中这是成本较低的错误，且可能以更多假反例为代价。
  • C: 低召回率意味着更多假反例，这正是工程师必须避免的高成本结果。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Recall is the fraction of actual positives that the model correctly identifies, calculated as true positives divided by true positives plus false negatives. When false negatives are far more costly than false positives, the model with the highest recall misses the fewest true cases, so high recall should be prioritized the MOST.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Low precision is never a goal; it just means many predicted positives are wrong.
  • B: High precision minimizes false positives, which is the cheaper error in this scenario, and may come at the expense of more false negatives.
  • C: Low recall means more false negatives, which is exactly the costly outcome the engineer must avoid.

contents.en:
An ML engineer is evaluating several MLmodels and must choose one model to use in production.The cost of false negative predictions by the models is much higher than the cost of false positive predictions.

Which metric finding shouldthe ML engineer prioritize the MOSTwhen choosing the model?
contents.zh:
一名机器学习工程师正在评估几个机器学习模型，并且必须选择一个模型用于生产环境。这些模型中误报（false negative）预测的成本远高于误报（false positive）预测的成本。

机器学习工程师在选择模型时应最优先考虑哪个指标？

questions.content:
A company has trained and deployed an MLmodel by using Amazon SageMaker. The company needs to implement a solution to record and monitor all the APl call events for the SageMaker endpoint. The solution also must provide a notification when the number of API call events breaches a threshold.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use SageMaker Debuggerto track the inferences andto report metrics.Create a custom rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Debuggerto track the inferences andto report metrics.Create a custom rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Debugger跟踪推理并报告指标。创建一个自定义规则，在阈值被突破时提供通知。

options.label: B
options.content: Use SageMaker Debugger to track the inferences and to report metrics. Use the tensor_variance built-in rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Debugger to track the inferences and to report metrics. Use the tensor_variance built-in rule to provide a notification when the threshold is breached.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Debugger跟踪推理并报告指标。使用张量方差（tensor_variance）内置规则在阈值被突破时提供通知。

options.label: C
options.content: Log all the endpoint invocation APlevents by using AWS CloudTrail.Use an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached.

contents.en: Log all the endpoint invocation APlevents by using AWS CloudTrail.Use an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached.
contents.zh: 使用AWS CloudTrail记录所有端点调用API事件。使用亚马逊CloudWatch仪表板进行监控。设置一个CloudWatch警报，在阈值被突破时提供通知。

options.label: D
options.content: Add the lnvocations metric to an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached.

contents.en: Add the lnvocations metric to an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard for monitoring. Set up a CloudWatch alarm to provide notification when the threshold is breached.
contents.zh: 将调用次数（Invocations）指标添加到亚马逊CloudWatch仪表板进行监控。设置一个CloudWatch警报，在阈值被突破时提供通知。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：AWS CloudTrail 记录 SageMaker 端点的 API 调用事件，包括谁在何时调用了哪个操作，满足记录并监控所有 API 调用事件的要求。将这些事件发送到 Amazon CloudWatch 后可用仪表板进行可视化，并通过 CloudWatch 警报在数量突破阈值时发送通知。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Debugger 检查训练作业期间的张量和指标，不跟踪对已部署端点的 API 调用。
  • B: tensor_variance 规则是 Debugger 用于检测权重方差问题的训练规则，与端点 API 事件无关。
  • D: Invocations 指标只提供可用于报警的计数，并不记录每个 API 调用事件本身，无法满足记录的要求。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：AWS CloudTrail 记录 SageMaker 端点的 API 调用事件，包括谁在何时调用了哪个操作，满足记录并监控所有 API 调用事件的要求。将这些事件发送到 Amazon CloudWatch 后可用仪表板进行可视化，并通过 CloudWatch 警报在数量突破阈值时发送通知。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Debugger 检查训练作业期间的张量和指标，不跟踪对已部署端点的 API 调用。
  • B: tensor_variance 规则是 Debugger 用于检测权重方差问题的训练规则，与端点 API 事件无关。
  • D: Invocations 指标只提供可用于报警的计数，并不记录每个 API 调用事件本身，无法满足记录的要求。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: AWS CloudTrail records API call events for the SageMaker endpoint, including who invoked which operation and when, so it satisfies the requirement to record and monitor all API call events. Publishing those events to Amazon CloudWatch lets a dashboard visualize them and a CloudWatch alarm sends a notification when the count breaches the threshold.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SageMaker Debugger inspects tensors and metrics during training jobs and does not track API calls to deployed endpoints.
  • B: The tensor_variance rule is a Debugger training rule for detecting weight variance problems and has nothing to do with endpoint API events.
  • D: The Invocations metric provides a count for alarming but does not record the individual API call events, so the recording requirement is not met.

contents.en:
A company has trained and deployed an MLmodel by using Amazon SageMaker. The company needs to implement a solution to record and monitor all the APl call events for the SageMaker endpoint. The solution also must provide a notification when the number of API call events breaches a threshold.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

一家公司已使用亚马逊SageMaker训练并部署了一个机器学习模型。该公司需要实施一个解决方案来记录和监控SageMaker端点的所有API调用事件。该解决方案还必须在API调用事件数量突破阈值时提供通知。

questions.content:
A company has AWS Glue data processing jobs that are orchestrated by an AWS Glue workflow. The AWS Glue jobs can run on a schedule or can be launched manually. The company isdeveloping pipelines in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines for MLmodel development.The pipelines willuse the output of the AWS Glue jobs during the data processing phase of model development.An MLengineer needs to implement a solution that integrates the AWS Glue jobswith the pipelines.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Use AWS Step Functions for orchestration ofthe pipelines and the AWS Glue jobs.

contents.en: Use AWS Step Functions for orchestration ofthe pipelines and the AWS Glue jobs.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Step Functions对管道和AWS Glue作业进行编排。

options.label: B
options.content: Use processing steps in SageMaker Pipelines.Configure inputs that point to the Amazon Resource Names(ARNs) of the AWS Glue jobs.

contents.en: Use processing steps in SageMaker Pipelines.Configure inputs that point to the Amazon Resource Names(ARNs) of the AWS Glue jobs.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker Pipelines中使用处理步骤。配置指向AWS Glue作业的亚马逊资源名称（ARNs）的输入。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Callback steps in SageMaker Pipelines to start the AWS Glue workflow and to stop the pipelines unti the AWS Glue jobs finish running.

contents.en: Use Callback steps in SageMaker Pipelines to start the AWS Glue workflow and to stop the pipelines unti the AWS Glue jobs finish running.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker Pipelines中使用回调（Callback）步骤来启动AWS Glue工作流，并在AWS Glue作业完成运行之前暂停管道。

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the pipelinesand the AWS Glue jobs in the desired order.

contents.en: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the pipelinesand the AWS Glue jobs in the desired order.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊EventBridge按期望的顺序调用管道和AWS Glue作业。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Pipelines 的 Callback 步骤专为集成外部流程而设计：它向 Amazon SQS 队列发布令牌，由轻量的消费者启动现有 AWS Glue 工作流，管道随即暂停，直到 Glue 作业完成并通过 SendPipelineExecutionStepSuccess 返回令牌。现有 Glue 工作流及其调度保持不变，运营开销最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 引入 AWS Step Functions 相当于在 Glue 工作流和 SageMaker Pipelines 之外再构建并维护第二个编排器。
  • B: 处理步骤启动的是 SageMaker Processing 作业并接受 S3 数据输入，无法以 AWS Glue 作业 ARN 作为输入或运行 Glue 作业。
  • D: 用 EventBridge 规则串联管道和 Glue 作业需要自定义事件管道，而且管道在执行过程中无法等待 Glue 的输出。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Pipelines 的 Callback 步骤专为集成外部流程而设计：它向 Amazon SQS 队列发布令牌，由轻量的消费者启动现有 AWS Glue 工作流，管道随即暂停，直到 Glue 作业完成并通过 SendPipelineExecutionStepSuccess 返回令牌。现有 Glue 工作流及其调度保持不变，运营开销最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 引入 AWS Step Functions 相当于在 Glue 工作流和 SageMaker Pipelines 之外再构建并维护第二个编排器。
  • B: 处理步骤启动的是 SageMaker Processing 作业并接受 S3 数据输入，无法以 AWS Glue 作业 ARN 作为输入或运行 Glue 作业。
  • D: 用 EventBridge 规则串联管道和 Glue 作业需要自定义事件管道，而且管道在执行过程中无法等待 Glue 的输出。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: The Callback step in SageMaker Pipelines is designed to integrate external processes: it publishes a token to an Amazon SQS queue, a lightweight consumer starts the existing AWS Glue workflow, and the pipeline pauses until the Glue jobs finish and the token is returned with SendPipelineExecutionStepSuccess. The existing Glue workflow and its scheduling stay unchanged, which is the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Introducing AWS Step Functions adds a second orchestrator to build and maintain on top of both the Glue workflow and SageMaker Pipelines.
  • B: Processing steps launch SageMaker Processing jobs and accept S3 data inputs; they cannot take AWS Glue job ARNs as inputs or run Glue jobs.
  • D: Chaining pipelines and Glue jobs with EventBridge rules requires custom event plumbing and gives the pipeline no way to wait for the Glue output within its execution.

contents.en:
A company has AWS Glue data processing jobs that are orchestrated by an AWS Glue workflow. The AWS Glue jobs can run on a schedule or can be launched manually. The company isdeveloping pipelines in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines for MLmodel development.The pipelines willuse the output of the AWS Glue jobs during the data processing phase of model development.An MLengineer needs to implement a solution that integrates the AWS Glue jobswith the pipelines.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
contents.zh:

options.label: D
options.content: Unload the Amazon Redshift data to Amazon S3.Create an AWS Glue job to anonymize the data.Share the dataset with the data scientist.

contents.en: Unload the Amazon Redshift data to Amazon S3.Create an AWS Glue job to anonymize the data.Share the dataset with the data scientist.
contents.zh: 将亚马逊Redshift数据卸载到亚马逊S3。创建一个AWS Glue作业来匿名化数据。将数据集共享给数据科学家。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Amazon Redshift 的 Dynamic Data Masking 会在查询时根据执行查询的用户或角色应用屏蔽策略，源数据不会被转换，数据库中也不会存储任何屏蔽后的副本。只需几条 SQL 语句即可配置，实施工作量最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 物化视图会把屏蔽后的结果集物理存储在 Redshift 数据库中，违反了不得存储匿名化数据的要求。
  • C: 卸载到 Amazon S3 并用 Athena 构建 schema-on-read 层引入了第二套数据平台和数据搬运流程，比原生屏蔽策略费力得多。
  • D: AWS Glue 作业会转换数据并存储匿名化副本，既违反要求，又需要构建和维护 ETL 作业。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Amazon Redshift 的 Dynamic Data Masking 会在查询时根据执行查询的用户或角色应用屏蔽策略，源数据不会被转换，数据库中也不会存储任何屏蔽后的副本。只需几条 SQL 语句即可配置，实施工作量最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 物化视图会把屏蔽后的结果集物理存储在 Redshift 数据库中，违反了不得存储匿名化数据的要求。
  • C: 卸载到 Amazon S3 并用 Athena 构建 schema-on-read 层引入了第二套数据平台和数据搬运流程，比原生屏蔽策略费力得多。
  • D: AWS Glue 作业会转换数据并存储匿名化副本，既违反要求，又需要构建和维护 ETL 作业。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Amazon Redshift dynamic data masking (DDM) applies masking policies at query time based on the user or role that runs the query, so the source data is never transformed and no masked copy is stored in the database. It is configured with a few SQL statements, which is the LEAST implementation effort.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: A materialized view physically stores the masked result set in the Redshift database, which violates the requirement not to store anonymized data.
  • C: Unloading to Amazon S3 and building an Athena schema-on-read layer adds a second data platform and a data movement pipeline, far more effort than a native masking policy.
  • D: An AWS Glue job transforms the data and stores an anonymized copy, which violates the requirements and requires building and maintaining an ETL job.

questions.content:
An ML engineer is using a training job to fine-tune a deep learning model in Amazon SageMaker Studio. The ML engineer previously used the same pre-trained model with a similar dataset. The ML engineer expects vanishing gradient, underutilized GPU, and overfiting problems. The ML engineer needs to implement a solution to detect these issues and to react in predefined ways when the issues occur. The solution also must provide comprehensive real-time metrics during the training.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEASToperational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Use TensorBoard to monitor the training job.Publish the findings to an Amazon Simple Notification Service(Amazon SNS) topic.Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the findings and to initiate the predefined actions.

contents.en: Use TensorBoard to monitor the training job.Publish the findings to an Amazon Simple Notification Service(Amazon SNS) topic.Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the findings and to initiate the predefined actions.
contents.zh: 使用TensorBoard监控训练作业。将发现结果发布到Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。创建一个AWS Lambda函数来消费结果并启动预定义的操作。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon CloudWatch default metrics to gain insights about the training job.Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions.

contents.en: Use Amazon CloudWatch default metrics to gain insights about the training job.Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon CloudWatch默认指标来了解训练作业。使用这些指标调用AWS Lambda函数来启动预定义的操作。

options.label: C
options.content: Expand the metrics in Amazon CloudWatch to include the gradients in each training step.Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions.

contents.en: Expand the metrics in Amazon CloudWatch to include the gradients in each training step.Use the metrics to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the predefined actions.
contents.zh: 在Amazon CloudWatch中扩展指标，包括每个训练步骤中的梯度。使用这些指标调用AWS Lambda函数来启动预定义的操作。

options.label: D
options.content: Use SageMaker Debugger built-in rules to monitor the training job.Configure the rules to initiate the predefined actions.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Debugger built-in rules to monitor the training job.Configure the rules to initiate the predefined actions.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Debugger内置规则监控训练作业。配置规则以启动预定义的操作。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：Amazon SageMaker Debugger 提供 VanishingGradient、LowGPUUtilization、Overfit 等内置规则，可在训练期间实时分析张量和系统指标，并且每条规则都可配置内置动作（StopTraining、Email、SMS），在规则触发时自动执行。整个方案完全托管，运营开销最小。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: TensorBoard 只能可视化训练指标，没有检测梯度消失或 GPU 利用率不足的规则引擎，需要自行构建检测逻辑、SNS 发布和 Lambda 处理。
  • B: 训练作业的 CloudWatch 默认指标只覆盖实例级别的资源利用率，无法检测梯度消失或过拟合。
  • C: 把每一步的梯度作为自定义 CloudWatch 指标发布需要在训练脚本中自定义埋点并编写 Lambda 逻辑，相比 Debugger 内置规则运营开销大得多。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：Amazon SageMaker Debugger 提供 VanishingGradient、LowGPUUtilization、Overfit 等内置规则，可在训练期间实时分析张量和系统指标，并且每条规则都可配置内置动作（StopTraining、Email、SMS），在规则触发时自动执行。整个方案完全托管，运营开销最小。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: TensorBoard 只能可视化训练指标，没有检测梯度消失或 GPU 利用率不足的规则引擎，需要自行构建检测逻辑、SNS 发布和 Lambda 处理。
  • B: 训练作业的 CloudWatch 默认指标只覆盖实例级别的资源利用率，无法检测梯度消失或过拟合。
  • C: 把每一步的梯度作为自定义 CloudWatch 指标发布需要在训练脚本中自定义埋点并编写 Lambda 逻辑，相比 Debugger 内置规则运营开销大得多。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Amazon SageMaker Debugger provides built-in rules such as VanishingGradient, LowGPUUtilization, and Overfit that analyze tensors and system metrics in real time during training, and each rule can be configured with built-in actions (StopTraining, Email, SMS) that run automatically when the rule triggers. This is fully managed, so it has the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: TensorBoard visualizes training metrics but has no rule engine to detect vanishing gradients or GPU underutilization, so you would have to build custom detection, SNS publishing, and Lambda handling yourself.
  • B: CloudWatch default metrics for training jobs cover instance-level utilization only and cannot detect vanishing gradients or overfitting.
  • C: Emitting per-step gradient values as custom CloudWatch metrics requires custom instrumentation in the training script plus custom Lambda logic, which is significant operational overhead compared with Debugger built-in rules.

An ML engineer is using a training job to fine-tune a deep learning model in Amazon SageMaker Studio. The ML engineer previously used the same pre-trained model with a similar dataset. The ML engineer expects vanishing gradient, underutilized GPU, and overfiting problems. The ML engineer needs to implement a solution to detect these issues and to react in predefined ways when the issues occur. The solution also must provide comprehensive real-time metrics during the training.

哪种解决方案将以最小的运营开销满足这些要求？

questions.content:
A credit card company has a fraud detection model in production on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint.The company develops a new version of the model. The companyneeds to assess the new model's performance by using live data and without affecting production end users.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Set up SageMaker Debugger and create a custom rule.

contents.en: Set up SageMaker Debugger and create a custom rule.
contents.zh: 设置SageMaker Debugger并创建自定义规则。

options.label: B
options.content: Set up blue/green deployments with all-at-once traffic shifting.

contents.en: Set up blue/green deployments with all-at-once traffic shifting.
contents.zh: 设置蓝/绿部署，并进行一次性流量切换。

options.label: C
options.content: Set up blue/green deployments with canary traffic shifting.

contents.en: Set up blue/green deployments with canary traffic shifting.
contents.zh: 设置蓝/绿部署，并进行金丝雀流量切换。

options.label: D
options.content: Set up shadow testing with a shadow variant of the new model.

contents.en: Set up shadow testing with a shadow variant of the new model.
contents.zh: 设置影子测试，使用新模型的影子变体。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 影子测试（shadow testing）会把新模型作为 shadow variant 部署在同一端点后面：生产请求的副本被发送到影子变体，但只有生产变体的响应会返回给调用方。这样就能用真实流量评估新模型，而完全不影响终端用户。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Debugger 用于分析训练作业，不能评估已部署模型在实时流量上的表现。
  • B: 一次性流量切换会把 100% 的生产流量转到新模型，任何缺陷都会立即影响终端用户。
  • C: 金丝雀流量切换会让一部分真实用户由新模型提供服务，这部分用户会受到新模型预测结果的影响。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 影子测试（shadow testing）会把新模型作为 shadow variant 部署在同一端点后面：生产请求的副本被发送到影子变体，但只有生产变体的响应会返回给调用方。这样就能用真实流量评估新模型，而完全不影响终端用户。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Debugger 用于分析训练作业，不能评估已部署模型在实时流量上的表现。
  • B: 一次性流量切换会把 100% 的生产流量转到新模型，任何缺陷都会立即影响终端用户。
  • C: 金丝雀流量切换会让一部分真实用户由新模型提供服务，这部分用户会受到新模型预测结果的影响。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker shadow testing deploys the new model as a shadow variant behind the same endpoint; a copy of live production requests is sent to the shadow variant while only the production variant's responses are returned to callers. This evaluates the new model on real traffic without any impact on end users.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SageMaker Debugger analyzes training jobs, not the inference performance of a deployed model on live traffic.
  • B: All-at-once traffic shifting moves 100 percent of production traffic to the new model, so end users are immediately affected by any defects.
  • C: Canary traffic shifting serves a portion of real users from the new model, so those users are affected by its predictions.

A credit card company has a fraud detection model in production on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint.The company develops a new version of the model. The companyneeds to assess the new model's performance by using live data and without affecting production end users.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

questions.content:
A company storestime-series data about user clicks in an Amazon S3 bucket.The raw data consists of milions of rows of user activity every day.ML engineers access the data to developtheir ML models. The ML engineers need to generate daily reports and analyze click trends over the past 3 days by using Amazon Athena. The company must retain the data for 30 days before archiving the data.

Which solution will provide the HIGHEST performance for data retrieval?

options.label: A
options.content: Keep all the time-series data without partitioning in the S3 bucket.Manually move data that is older than 30 daysto separate S3 buckets.

contents.en: Keep all the time-series data without partitioning in the S3 bucket.Manually move data that is older than 30 daysto separate S3 buckets.
contents.zh: 保留S3桶中所有未分区的时序数据。手动将超过30天的数据移动到单独的S3桶中。

options.label: B
options.content: Create AWS Lambda functions to copy the time-series data into separate S3 buckets.Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

contents.en: Create AWS Lambda functions to copy the time-series data into separate S3 buckets.Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
contents.zh: 创建AWS Lambda函数将时序数据复制到单独的S3桶中。应用S3生命周期策略，将超过30天的数据存档到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

options.label: C
options.content: Organize the time-series data into partitions by date prefix in the S3 bucket.Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive partitions that are older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

contents.en: Organize the time-series data into partitions by date prefix in the S3 bucket.Apply S3 Lifecycle policies to archive partitions that are older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
contents.zh: 在S3桶中按日期前缀组织时序数据分区。应用S3生命周期策略，将超过30天的分区存档到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

options.label: D
options.content: Put each day's time-series data into its own S3 bucket.Use S3 Lifecycle policies to archive S3 buckets that hold data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

contents.en: Put each day's time-series data into its own S3 bucket.Use S3 Lifecycle policies to archive S3 buckets that hold data that is older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
contents.zh: 将每天的时序数据放入其自己的S3桶中。使用S3生命周期策略将持有超过30天数据的S3桶存档到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：在同一个 S3 桶中按日期前缀分区，可以让 Athena 进行分区裁剪，查询过去 3 天的趋势时只扫描 3 天的数据而不是整个数据集，检索性能最高。随后用 S3 Lifecycle 规则自动把超过 30 天的前缀转移到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 不分区意味着 Athena 每次查询都要扫描全部数据，手动移动旧数据既容易出错也不能提升性能。
  • B: 用 Lambda 把数据复制到其他桶会重复存储并引入自定义管道，而且 Athena 表仍然需要分区才能避免全表扫描。
  • D: 每天一个桶难以管理、使 Athena 表定义复杂化，而且 S3 Lifecycle 策略作用于桶内对象，不能归档整个桶。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：在同一个 S3 桶中按日期前缀分区，可以让 Athena 进行分区裁剪，查询过去 3 天的趋势时只扫描 3 天的数据而不是整个数据集，检索性能最高。随后用 S3 Lifecycle 规则自动把超过 30 天的前缀转移到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 不分区意味着 Athena 每次查询都要扫描全部数据，手动移动旧数据既容易出错也不能提升性能。
  • B: 用 Lambda 把数据复制到其他桶会重复存储并引入自定义管道，而且 Athena 表仍然需要分区才能避免全表扫描。
  • D: 每天一个桶难以管理、使 Athena 表定义复杂化，而且 S3 Lifecycle 策略作用于桶内对象，不能归档整个桶。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Partitioning the data by date prefix in a single S3 bucket lets Athena prune partitions, so a query over the past 3 days scans only three days of data instead of the whole dataset, giving the HIGHEST retrieval performance. S3 Lifecycle rules can then transition prefixes older than 30 days to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval automatically.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Without partitions Athena must scan the entire dataset for every query, and manually moving old data is error prone and adds no performance benefit.
  • B: Copying data with Lambda into separate buckets duplicates storage and adds a custom pipeline, and Athena tables still need partitioning to avoid full scans.
  • D: One bucket per day is unmanageable, complicates the Athena table definition, and S3 Lifecycle policies operate on objects within a bucket rather than archiving whole buckets.

contents.en:
A company storestime-series data about user clicks in an Amazon S3 bucket.The raw data consists of milions of rows of user activity every day.ML engineers access the data to developtheir ML models. The ML engineers need to generate daily reports and analyze click trends over the past 3 days by using Amazon Athena. The company must retain the data for 30 days before archiving the data.

Which solution will provide the HIGHEST performance for data retrieval?

一家公司在Amazon S3桶中存储有关用户点击的时序数据。原始数据包括每天数百万行的用户活动数据。机器学习工程师访问这些数据以开发他们的机器学习模型。机器学习工程师需要生成每日报告，并使用Amazon Athena分析过去3天的点击趋势。公司必须在将数据存档前保留数据30天。

questions.content:
A company has deployed an ML model that detects fraudulent credit card transactions in real time in a banking aplication.The model uses Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference.Consumers are reporting delays in receiving the inference results. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to improve the inference performance. The solution also must provide a notification when a deviation in model quality occurs.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use SageMaker real-time inference for inference.Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality.

contents.en: Use SageMaker real-time inference for inference.Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker实时推理进行推理。使用SageMaker模型监控提供有关模型质量的通知。

options.label: B
options.content: Use SageMaker batch transform for inference.Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality.

contents.en: Use SageMaker batch transform for inference.Use SageMaker Model Monitor for notifications about model quality.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker批量转换进行推理。使用SageMaker模型监控提供有关模型质量的通知。

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Serverless Inference for inference.Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Serverless Inference for inference.Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker无服务器推理进行推理。使用SageMaker推理推荐器提供有关模型质量的通知。

options.label: D
options.content: Keep using SageMaker Asynchronous Inference for inference.Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality.

contents.en: Keep using SageMaker Asynchronous Inference for inference.Use SageMaker Inference Recommender for notifications about model quality.
contents.zh: 继续使用SageMaker异步推理进行推理。使用SageMaker推理推荐器提供有关模型质量的通知。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：银行应用中的欺诈检测需要同步、低延迟的预测，这正是 SageMaker real-time inference 提供的能力；Asynchronous Inference 会把请求放入队列，面向长时间运行或大负载的推理，这正是延迟的来源。SageMaker Model Monitor 通过定期监控作业检测数据质量和模型质量的偏差，并可通过 Amazon CloudWatch 发出告警。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Batch transform 用于离线处理数据集，无法响应实时交易请求。
  • C: Serverless Inference 存在冷启动延迟，而 SageMaker Inference Recommender 用于为部署做实例类型基准测试，不监控模型质量也不发送通知。
  • D: 继续使用 Asynchronous Inference 无法解决延迟问题，而且 Inference Recommender 是负载测试工具，不是模型质量监控器。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：银行应用中的欺诈检测需要同步、低延迟的预测，这正是 SageMaker real-time inference 提供的能力；Asynchronous Inference 会把请求放入队列，面向长时间运行或大负载的推理，这正是延迟的来源。SageMaker Model Monitor 通过定期监控作业检测数据质量和模型质量的偏差，并可通过 Amazon CloudWatch 发出告警。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Batch transform 用于离线处理数据集，无法响应实时交易请求。
  • C: Serverless Inference 存在冷启动延迟，而 SageMaker Inference Recommender 用于为部署做实例类型基准测试，不监控模型质量也不发送通知。
  • D: 继续使用 Asynchronous Inference 无法解决延迟问题，而且 Inference Recommender 是负载测试工具，不是模型质量监控器。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Fraud detection in a banking application needs synchronous, low-latency predictions, which SageMaker real-time inference provides; Asynchronous Inference queues requests and is designed for long-running or large-payload jobs, which explains the delays. SageMaker Model Monitor schedules monitoring jobs that detect deviations in data quality and model quality and can publish alerts through Amazon CloudWatch.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Batch transform processes offline datasets and cannot serve real-time transaction requests.
  • C: Serverless Inference introduces cold-start latency, and SageMaker Inference Recommender benchmarks instance types for deployment; it does not monitor model quality or send notifications.
  • D: Keeping Asynchronous Inference leaves the latency problem unsolved, and Inference Recommender is a load-testing tool, not a model quality monitor.

contents.en:
A company has deployed an ML model that detects fraudulent credit card transactions in real time in a banking aplication.The model uses Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference.Consumers are reporting delays in receiving the inference results. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to improve the inference performance. The solution also must provide a notification when a deviation in model quality occurs.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh:
一家公司部署了一个实时检测欺诈性信用卡交易的机器学习模型在一个银行应用中。该模型使用Amazon SageMaker异步推理。消费者报告说在接收推理结果时有延迟。一位机器学习工程师需要实现一个解决方案来提高推理性能。解决方案还必须在模型质量发生偏差时提供通知。

哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

questions.content:
An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to host a trained ML model. The rate of requests to the model will be inconsistent throughout the day. The ML engineer needs a scalable solution that minimizes costs when the model is not in use. The solution also must maintain the model's capacity to respond to requests during times of peak usage.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create AWS Lambda functions that have fixed concurrency to host the model.Configure the Lambda functions to automatically scale based on the number of requests to the model.

contents.en: Create AWS Lambda functions that have fixed concurrency to host the model.Configure the Lambda functions to automatically scale based on the number of requests to the model.
contents.zh: 创建具有固定并发性的AWS Lambda函数来托管模型。配置Lambda函数根据对模型的请求数量自动扩展。

options.label: B
options.content: Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service(Amazon ECS) cluster that uses AWS Fargate.Set a static number of tasks to handle requests during times of peak usage.

contents.en: Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Container Service(Amazon ECS) cluster that uses AWS Fargate.Set a static number of tasks to handle requests during times of peak usage.
contents.zh: 在使用AWS Fargate的Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）集群上部署模型。设置一个静态任务数量来处理高峰使用期间的请求。

options.label: C
options.content: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. Deploy multiple copies of the model to the endpoint. Create an Application Load Balancer to route traffic between the different copies of the model at the endpoint.

contents.en: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. Deploy multiple copies of the model to the endpoint. Create an Application Load Balancer to route traffic between the different copies of the model at the endpoint.
contents.zh: 将模型部署到Amazon SageMaker端点。在端点部署多个模型副本。创建一个应用负载均衡器，在端点的不同模型副本之间路由流量。

options.label: D
options.content: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint.Create SageMaker endpoint auto scaling policies that are based on Amazon CloudWatch metrics to adjust the number of instances dynamically.

contents.en: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint.Create SageMaker endpoint auto scaling policies that are based on Amazon CloudWatch metrics to adjust the number of instances dynamically.
contents.zh: 将模型部署到Amazon SageMaker端点。创建基于Amazon CloudWatch指标的SageMaker端点自动扩展策略，以动态调整实例数量。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：为 SageMaker endpoint 配置基于 CloudWatch 指标（如 InvocationsPerInstance）的自动扩展策略，可以在高峰期增加实例、在流量下降时减少实例，既在空闲时最小化成本，又能保证高峰时的响应能力。这正是 SageMaker 托管推理的标准可扩展方案。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 固定并发与按需扩展相矛盾，而且 Lambda 的包大小、内存和 15 分钟超时限制使其不适合托管大多数训练好的 ML 模型。
  • B: 按高峰负载设置静态数量的 Fargate 任务会在模型空闲时依然为高峰容量付费，无法最小化成本。
  • C: SageMaker endpoint 内部已经在实例间做负载均衡，无法在端点前放置 Application Load Balancer，而且固定数量的模型副本不会随需求扩展。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：为 SageMaker endpoint 配置基于 CloudWatch 指标（如 InvocationsPerInstance）的自动扩展策略，可以在高峰期增加实例、在流量下降时减少实例，既在空闲时最小化成本，又能保证高峰时的响应能力。这正是 SageMaker 托管推理的标准可扩展方案。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 固定并发与按需扩展相矛盾，而且 Lambda 的包大小、内存和 15 分钟超时限制使其不适合托管大多数训练好的 ML 模型。
  • B: 按高峰负载设置静态数量的 Fargate 任务会在模型空闲时依然为高峰容量付费，无法最小化成本。
  • C: SageMaker endpoint 内部已经在实例间做负载均衡，无法在端点前放置 Application Load Balancer，而且固定数量的模型副本不会随需求扩展。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: A SageMaker endpoint with auto scaling policies driven by CloudWatch metrics such as InvocationsPerInstance adds instances during peak usage and removes them when traffic drops, which minimizes cost during idle periods while maintaining capacity at peak. This is the managed, scalable hosting option SageMaker is built for.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Fixed concurrency contradicts scaling on demand, and Lambda package size, memory, and 15-minute limits make it a poor fit for hosting most trained ML models.
  • B: A static number of Fargate tasks sized for peak keeps paying for peak capacity when the model is idle, so it does not minimize cost.
  • C: SageMaker endpoints already load-balance across instances internally; you cannot place an Application Load Balancer in front of an endpoint, and a fixed number of copies does not scale with demand.

contents.en:
An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to host a trained ML model. The rate of requests to the model will be inconsistent throughout the day. The ML engineer needs a scalable solution that minimizes costs when the model is not in use. The solution also must maintain the model's capacity to respond to requests during times of peak usage.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

questions.content:
A company uses Amazon SageMaker Studioto develop an ML model. The company has a single SageMaker Studio domain.An ML engineer needs to implement a solution that provides an automated alert when SageMaker compute costs reach a specific threshold.

Which solution will meetthese requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Add resource tagging by editing the SageMaker user profile in the SageMaker domain.Configure AWS Cost Explorer to send an alert when the threshold is reached.

contents.en: Add resource tagging by editing the SageMaker user profile in the SageMaker domain.Configure AWS Cost Explorer to send an alert when the threshold is reached.
contents.zh: 通过编辑SageMaker域中的SageMaker用户配置文件添加资源标记。配置AWS成本探索器在达到阈值时发送警报。

options.label: B
options.content: Add resource tagging byediting the SageMaker user profile in the SageMakerdomain.Configure AWS Budgets to send an alert when the threshold is reached.

contents.en: Add resource tagging byediting the SageMaker user profile in the SageMakerdomain.Configure AWS Budgets to send an alert when the threshold is reached.
contents.zh: 通过编辑SageMaker域中的SageMaker用户配置文件添加资源标记。配置AWS预算在达到阈值时发送警报。

options.label: C
options.content: Add resource tagging by editing each users IAM profile. Configure AWS Cost Explorer to send an alert when the threshold is reached.

contents.en: Add resource tagging by editing each users IAM profile. Configure AWS Cost Explorer to send an alert when the threshold is reached.
contents.zh: 通过编辑每个用户的IAM配置文件添加资源标记。配置AWS成本探索器在达到阈值时发送警报。

options.label: D
options.content: Add resource tagging by editing each user's IAM profile. Configure AWS Budgets to send an alert when the threshold is reached.

contents.en: Add resource tagging by editing each user's IAM profile. Configure AWS Budgets to send an alert when the threshold is reached.
contents.zh: 通过编辑每个用户的IAM配置文件添加资源标记。配置AWS预算在达到阈值时发送警报。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：在 SageMaker 用户配置文件上添加的标签会自动传播到该配置文件创建的 Studio 资源，从而可以作为成本分配标签启用。AWS Budgets 允许按这些标签设置成本阈值，并在实际或预测支出达到阈值时发送告警（邮件或 Amazon SNS）。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Cost Explorer 是可视化和分析工具，不会发送阈值告警，这是 AWS Budgets 的功能。
  • C: IAM 身份上的标签不会附加到产生费用的 SageMaker 计算资源上，而且 Cost Explorer 无法发送告警。
  • D: AWS Budgets 是正确的告警服务，但给 IAM 用户打标签不会给需要跟踪用量的 SageMaker 应用和实例打上标签。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：在 SageMaker 用户配置文件上添加的标签会自动传播到该配置文件创建的 Studio 资源，从而可以作为成本分配标签启用。AWS Budgets 允许按这些标签设置成本阈值，并在实际或预测支出达到阈值时发送告警（邮件或 Amazon SNS）。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Cost Explorer 是可视化和分析工具，不会发送阈值告警，这是 AWS Budgets 的功能。
  • C: IAM 身份上的标签不会附加到产生费用的 SageMaker 计算资源上，而且 Cost Explorer 无法发送告警。
  • D: AWS Budgets 是正确的告警服务，但给 IAM 用户打标签不会给需要跟踪用量的 SageMaker 应用和实例打上标签。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Tags added to a SageMaker user profile are automatically propagated to the Studio resources that the profile creates, so they can be activated as cost allocation tags. AWS Budgets is the service that lets you set a cost threshold filtered by those tags and sends an alert (email or Amazon SNS) when actual or forecasted spend reaches it.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: AWS Cost Explorer is a visualization and analysis tool; it does not send threshold alerts, that is the job of AWS Budgets.
  • C: Tags on IAM identities are not applied to the SageMaker compute resources that incur the cost, and Cost Explorer cannot send alerts.
  • D: AWS Budgets is the right alerting service, but tagging IAM users does not tag the SageMaker apps and instances whose usage needs to be tracked.

questions.content:
A company uses Amazon SageMaker for its ML workloads.The companys ML engineer receives a 50 MB Apache Parquet data fle to build a fraud detection model. The file includes several correlated columns that are not required.

What should the ML engineer do to drop the unnecessary columns in the file with the LEAST effort?

options.label: A
options.content: Download the file to a local workstation.Perform one-hot encoding by using a custom Python script.

contents.en: Download the file to a local workstation.Perform one-hot encoding by using a custom Python script.
contents.zh: 将文件下载到本地工作站。使用自定义Python脚本执行独热编码。

options.label: B
options.content: Create an Apache Spark job that uses a custom processing script on Amazon EMR.

contents.en: Create an Apache Spark job that uses a custom processing script on Amazon EMR.
contents.zh: 创建一个在Amazon EMR上使用自定义处理脚本的Apache Spark作业。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a SageMaker processing job by calling the SageMaker Python SDK.

contents.en: Create a SageMaker processing job by calling the SageMaker Python SDK.
contents.zh: 通过调用SageMaker Python SDK创建SageMaker处理作业。

options.label: D
options.content: Create a data flow in SageMaker Data Wrangler.Configure a transform step.

contents.en: Create a data flow in SageMaker Data Wrangler.Configure a transform step.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker Data Wrangler中创建数据流。配置转换步骤。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Data Wrangler 可以导入 Parquet 文件、查看相关性分析，并通过可视化界面中内置的 Manage columns 转换直接删除列，无需编写代码。对于 50 MB 的文件来说，这是工作量最少的做法。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 独热编码是一种类别特征编码技术，并不会删除列，而且编写自定义脚本比无代码转换更费力。
  • B: 为一个 50 MB 文件的简单删列操作去创建 Amazon EMR 集群并编写 Spark 作业过于重量级。
  • C: SageMaker Processing 作业需要编写处理脚本并通过 SDK 配置作业，比 Data Wrangler 的可视化步骤更费力。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Data Wrangler 可以导入 Parquet 文件、查看相关性分析，并通过可视化界面中内置的 Manage columns 转换直接删除列，无需编写代码。对于 50 MB 的文件来说，这是工作量最少的做法。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 独热编码是一种类别特征编码技术，并不会删除列，而且编写自定义脚本比无代码转换更费力。
  • B: 为一个 50 MB 文件的简单删列操作去创建 Amazon EMR 集群并编写 Spark 作业过于重量级。
  • C: SageMaker Processing 作业需要编写处理脚本并通过 SDK 配置作业，比 Data Wrangler 的可视化步骤更费力。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker Data Wrangler lets you import the Parquet file, view the correlation analysis, and drop columns with a built-in Manage columns transform through a visual interface, with no code to write. For a 50 MB file this is the LEAST effort approach.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: One-hot encoding is a categorical encoding technique; it does not remove columns, and writing a custom script is more effort than a no-code transform.
  • B: Provisioning an Amazon EMR cluster and writing a Spark job is heavyweight for a 50 MB file and a simple column drop.
  • C: A SageMaker Processing job requires writing a processing script and configuring the job through the SDK, which is more effort than a visual Data Wrangler step.

contents.en:
A company uses Amazon SageMaker for its ML workloads.The companys ML engineer receives a 50 MB Apache Parquet data fle to build a fraud detection model. The file includes several correlated columns that are not required.

What should the ML engineer do to drop the unnecessary columns in the file with the LEAST effort?

机器学习工程师应该如何以最少的努力删除文件中的不必要列？

questions.content:
A company is creating an application that willrecommend products for customers to purchase. The application will make API calls to Amazon Q Business.The company must ensure that responses from Amazon Q Business do not indlude the name of the company'smain competitor.

Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure the competitor's name as a blocked phrase in Amazon Q Business.

contents.en: Configure the competitor's name as a blocked phrase in Amazon Q Business.
contents.zh: 在Amazon Q Business中将竞争对手的名称配置为屏蔽短语。

options.label: B
options.content: Configure an Amazon Q Business retrieverto exclude the competitor's name.

contents.en: Configure an Amazon Q Business retrieverto exclude the competitor's name.
contents.zh: 配置Amazon Q Business检索器以排除竞争对手的名称。

options.label: C
options.content: Configure an Amazon Kendra retriever for Amazon Q Business to build indexes that exclude the competitor's name.

contents.en: Configure an Amazon Kendra retriever for Amazon Q Business to build indexes that exclude the competitor's name.
contents.zh: 为Amazon Q Business配置Amazon Kendra检索器以构建排除竞争对手名称的索引。

options.label: D
options.content: Configure document attribute boosting in Amazon QBusiness to deprioritize the competitor's name.

contents.en: Configure document attribute boosting in Amazon QBusiness to deprioritize the competitor's name.
contents.zh: 在Amazon Q Business中配置文档属性提升，以降低竞争对手名称的优先级。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Amazon Q Business 的管理控制与 guardrails 提供 blocked phrases 功能，可以阻止应用返回任何包含所配置词语的响应。把竞争对手名称配置为屏蔽短语，就能直接在响应层面满足要求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: retriever 决定搜索哪个数据源或索引，不能从生成的响应中过滤特定词语。
  • C: Amazon Kendra 索引只影响检索到的文档，模型仍可能根据自身知识或其他内容生成竞争对手的名称。
  • D: 文档属性提升只是调整检索文档的排序，不能阻止某个短语出现在答案中。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Amazon Q Business 的管理控制与 guardrails 提供 blocked phrases 功能，可以阻止应用返回任何包含所配置词语的响应。把竞争对手名称配置为屏蔽短语，就能直接在响应层面满足要求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: retriever 决定搜索哪个数据源或索引，不能从生成的响应中过滤特定词语。
  • C: Amazon Kendra 索引只影响检索到的文档，模型仍可能根据自身知识或其他内容生成竞争对手的名称。
  • D: 文档属性提升只是调整检索文档的排序，不能阻止某个短语出现在答案中。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Amazon Q Business admin controls and guardrails include blocked phrases, which prevent the application from returning any response that contains a configured word or phrase. Adding the competitor's name as a blocked phrase directly enforces the requirement at the response level.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: A retriever controls which data source or index is searched; it cannot filter specific words out of generated responses.
  • C: An Amazon Kendra index only affects retrieved documents, and the model could still produce the competitor's name from its own knowledge or from other content.
  • D: Document attribute boosting changes the ranking of retrieved documents; it does not block a phrase from appearing in the answer.

contents.en:
A company is creating an application that willrecommend products for customers to purchase. The application will make API calls to Amazon Q Business.The company must ensure that responses from Amazon Q Business do not indlude the name of the company'smain competitor.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
contents.zh: 一家公司正在创建一个将为客户推荐购买产品的应用程序。该应用程序将向Amazon Q Business发起API调用。公司必须确保来自Amazon Q Business的响应不包括公司主要竞争对手的名称。哪种解决方案将满足这一要求？

Which solution will meetthese requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use SageMakerStudio to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances.

contents.en: Use SageMakerStudio to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Studio在Amazon EC2实例上微调部署的LLM。

options.label: B
options.content: Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed by a custom APl endpoint

contents.en: Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed by a custom APl endpoint
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Autopilot通过自定义API端点部署的LLM进行微调。

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Autopilot在Amazon EC2实例上部署的LLM进行微调。

options.label: D
options.content: Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed by SageMaker JumpStart.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Autopilot to fine-tune an LLM that is deployed by SageMaker JumpStart.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Autopilot通过SageMaker JumpStart部署的LLM进行微调。

questions.explanation:

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 在 Studio 中对自管理的 Amazon EC2 实例上的 LLM 进行微调需要编写和维护自定义训练代码，不是 LCNC 方式。
  • B: Autopilot 不能微调位于任意自定义 API 端点后面的模型，它只支持 JumpStart 基础模型。
  • C: Autopilot 不能微调部署在 SageMaker 之外的 Amazon EC2 实例上的模型。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Autopilot 支持对大型语言模型进行文本生成类任务（如文本摘要）的微调，其可微调的模型正是通过 SageMaker JumpStart 提供的基础模型。整个流程可通过 Studio 界面或少量 API 参数完成，符合低代码/无代码（LCNC）要求。

  • B: Autopilot 不能微调位于任意自定义 API 端点后面的模型，它只支持 JumpStart 基础模型。
  • C: Autopilot 不能微调部署在 SageMaker 之外的 Amazon EC2 实例上的模型。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker Autopilot supports fine-tuning large language models for text generation tasks such as summarization, and the models it fine-tunes are foundation models provided through SageMaker JumpStart. The workflow runs through the Studio UI or a few API parameters, which matches the low-code no-code (LCNC) requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Fine-tuning an LLM on self-managed Amazon EC2 instances from Studio requires writing and managing custom training code, which is not an LCNC approach.
  • B: Autopilot does not fine-tune models that are served behind an arbitrary custom API endpoint; it works with JumpStart foundation models.
  • C: Autopilot does not fine-tune models that were deployed on Amazon EC2 instances outside SageMaker.

questions.content:
A company has an ML model that needs to run one time each night to predict stock values.The model input is 3 MB of data that is cllected during the current day.The model produces the predictions for the next day.The prediction process takesless than 1 minute to finish runing.

How should the company deploy the model on Amazon SageMakerto meetthese requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use a multi-model serverless endpoint. Enable caching.

contents.en: Use a multi-model serverless endpoint. Enable caching.
contents.zh: 使用无服务器多模型端点。启用缓存。

options.label: B
options.content: Use an asynchronous inference endpoint. Set the InitiallnstanceCount parameter to 0.

contents.en: Use an asynchronous inference endpoint. Set the InitiallnstanceCount parameter to 0.
contents.zh: 使用异步推理端点。将初始实例数量（InitialInstanceCount）参数设置为0。

options.label: C
options.content: Use a real-time endpoint. Configure an auto scaling policy to scale the model to O when the model is not in use.

contents.en: Use a real-time endpoint. Configure an auto scaling policy to scale the model to O when the model is not in use.
contents.zh: 使用实时端点。配置自动缩放策略，以便在模型不使用时将其缩放到0。

options.label: D
options.content: Use a serverless inference endpoint.Setthe MaxConcurrency parameter to 1.

contents.en: Use a serverless inference endpoint.Setthe MaxConcurrency parameter to 1.
contents.zh: 使用无服务器推理端点。将最大并发度（MaxConcurrency）参数设置为1。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Serverless Inference 专为间歇性工作负载设计：调用之间会缩容到零，其余时间不产生费用，同时支持 3 MB 的负载和不到 1 分钟的执行时间。由于模型每晚只调用一次，MaxConcurrency 设为 1 就足够了。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Serverless 端点不支持多模型端点，也没有可启用的缓存功能，而且公司只有一个模型。
  • B: 异步推理端点的 InitialInstanceCount 至少为 1，缩容到零只能之后通过自动扩展实现，而且排队模式对一个 1 分钟的夜间作业毫无必要。
  • C: 实时端点无法缩容到零实例，公司必须全天为至少一个实例付费。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Serverless Inference 专为间歇性工作负载设计：调用之间会缩容到零，其余时间不产生费用，同时支持 3 MB 的负载和不到 1 分钟的执行时间。由于模型每晚只调用一次，MaxConcurrency 设为 1 就足够了。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Serverless 端点不支持多模型端点，也没有可启用的缓存功能，而且公司只有一个模型。
  • B: 异步推理端点的 InitialInstanceCount 至少为 1，缩容到零只能之后通过自动扩展实现，而且排队模式对一个 1 分钟的夜间作业毫无必要。
  • C: 实时端点无法缩容到零实例，公司必须全天为至少一个实例付费。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker Serverless Inference is purpose-built for intermittent workloads: it scales to zero between invocations so the company pays nothing for the rest of the day, and it supports the 3 MB payload and the sub-60-second run time. Because the model is invoked once per night, MaxConcurrency of 1 is sufficient.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Serverless endpoints do not support multi-model endpoints, and there is no caching feature to enable; the company also has only one model.
  • B: An asynchronous inference endpoint requires an InitialInstanceCount of at least 1; scaling to zero is only possible later through auto scaling, and the queueing model is unnecessary for a 1-minute nightly job.
  • C: Real-time endpoints cannot scale to zero instances, so the company would pay for at least one instance around the clock.

questions.content:
An MLengineer trained an ML model on Amazon SageMaker to detect automobile accidents from dosed-circuit TV footage. The ML engineer used SageMaker Data Wrangler to create a training dataset of imagesof accidents and non- accidents. The model performed wellduring training and validation.However,the model is underperforming in production because of variation in the quality of the images from variouscameras.

Which solution will improve the model's accuracy in the LEAST amount of time?

options.label: A
options.content: Collect more images from all the cameras.Use Data Wrangler to prepare a new training dataset.

contents.en: Collect more images from all the cameras.Use Data Wrangler to prepare a new training dataset.
contents.zh: 从所有摄像机收集更多图像。使用Data Wrangler准备一个新的训练数据集。

options.label: B
options.content: Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler corrupt image transform.Specify the impulse noise option.

contents.en: Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler corrupt image transform.Specify the impulse noise option.
contents.zh: 使用Data Wrangler的损坏图像变换功能重新创建训练数据集。指定脉冲噪声选项。

options.label: C
options.content: Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler enhance image contrast transform.Specify the Gamma contrast option.

contents.en: Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler enhance image contrast transform.Specify the Gamma contrast option.
contents.zh: 使用Data Wrangler的增强图像对比度变换功能重新创建训练数据集。指定伽马对比度选项。

options.label: D
options.content: Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler resize image transform.Crop all images to the same size.

contents.en: Recreate the training dataset by using the Data Wrangler resize image transform.Crop all images to the same size.
contents.zh: 使用Data Wrangler的调整图像大小变换功能重新创建训练数据集。将所有图像裁剪为相同大小。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：模型在生产环境表现欠佳，是因为训练时从未见过部分摄像机产生的带噪声、低质量画面。Data Wrangler 的 corrupt image 转换配合 impulse noise 选项，可以用生产环境中常见的画质退化来增强现有训练图像，让模型学会对不同画质保持鲁棒，无需收集或标注新数据，是最快的修复方式。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 从每台摄像机收集并标注新图像所需时间远多于对现有数据集做增强。
  • C: 增强对比度只是对训练集的单一图像属性做归一化，无法让模型学会应对生产画面中的噪声和画质差异。
  • D: 调整大小和裁剪只是统一尺寸，而不是画质，无法解决准确率下降的根源。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：模型在生产环境表现欠佳，是因为训练时从未见过部分摄像机产生的带噪声、低质量画面。Data Wrangler 的 corrupt image 转换配合 impulse noise 选项，可以用生产环境中常见的画质退化来增强现有训练图像，让模型学会对不同画质保持鲁棒，无需收集或标注新数据，是最快的修复方式。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 从每台摄像机收集并标注新图像所需时间远多于对现有数据集做增强。
  • C: 增强对比度只是对训练集的单一图像属性做归一化，无法让模型学会应对生产画面中的噪声和画质差异。
  • D: 调整大小和裁剪只是统一尺寸，而不是画质，无法解决准确率下降的根源。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: The model fails in production because it never saw the noisy, lower-quality frames that some cameras produce. The Data Wrangler corrupt image transform with the impulse noise option augments the existing training images with the kind of degradation seen in production, so the model learns to be robust to varying image quality without collecting or labeling new data, which is the fastest fix.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Collecting and labeling new images from every camera takes far longer than augmenting the dataset that already exists.
  • C: Enhancing contrast only normalizes one image property in the training set and does not teach the model to handle the noise and quality variation present in production frames.
  • D: Resizing and cropping standardizes dimensions, not image quality, so it does not address the source of the degraded accuracy.

An MLengineer trained an ML model on Amazon SageMaker to detect automobile accidents from dosed-circuit TV footage. The ML engineer used SageMaker Data Wrangler to create a training dataset of imagesof accidents and non- accidents. The model performed wellduring training and validation.However,the model is underperforming in production because of variation in the quality of the images from variouscameras.

Which solution will improve the model's accuracy in the LEAST amount of time?
contents.zh:
一位机器学习工程师在亚马逊SageMaker上训练了一个机器学习模型，用于从闭路电视镜头中检测汽车事故。该工程师使用SageMaker Data Wrangler创建了一个包含事故和非事故图像的训练数据集。模型在训练和验证期间表现良好，但由于来自不同摄像机的图像质量存在差异，该模型在生产环境中的表现欠佳。

questions.content:
A company has an application that uses diferent APls to generate embeddings for input text.The company needs to implement a solution to automatically rotate the APl tokens every 3 months.

Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Store the tokens in AWS Secrets Manager.Create an AWS Lambda function to perform the rotation.

contents.en: Store the tokens in AWS Secrets Manager.Create an AWS Lambda function to perform the rotation.
contents.zh: 将令牌存储在AWS Secrets Manager中。创建一个AWS Lambda函数来执行轮换操作。

options.label: B
options.content: Store the tokens in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an AWS Lambda function to perform the rotation.

contents.en: Store the tokens in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an AWS Lambda function to perform the rotation.
contents.zh: 将令牌存储在AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store中。创建一个AWS Lambda函数来执行轮换操作。

options.label: C
options.content: Store the tokens in AWS Key Management Service(AWS KMS).Use an AWS managed key to perform the rotation.

contents.en: Store the tokens in AWS Key Management Service(AWS KMS).Use an AWS managed key to perform the rotation.
contents.zh: 将令牌存储在AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）中。使用AWS托管密钥来执行轮换操作。

options.label: D
options.content: Store the tokens in AWS Key Management Service(AWS KMS).Use an AWS owned key to perform the rotation.

contents.en: Store the tokens in AWS Key Management Service(AWS KMS).Use an AWS owned key to perform the rotation.
contents.zh: 将令牌存储在AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）中。使用AWS拥有的密钥来执行轮换操作。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：AWS Secrets Manager 原生支持按计划自动轮换；对于第三方 API 令牌，可以提供一个 AWS Lambda 轮换函数来获取新令牌并更新密钥。把轮换计划设为每 3 个月（90 天）即可满足要求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Systems Manager Parameter Store 没有内置的轮换调度器，需要自行构建调度和编排。
  • C: AWS KMS 存储的是加密密钥而非 API 令牌，AWS managed key 的自动轮换只是每年轮换一次密钥材料，与应用密钥无关。
  • D: AWS owned key 完全由 AWS 控制，不能存储令牌，其轮换也不可配置。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：AWS Secrets Manager 原生支持按计划自动轮换；对于第三方 API 令牌，可以提供一个 AWS Lambda 轮换函数来获取新令牌并更新密钥。把轮换计划设为每 3 个月（90 天）即可满足要求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Systems Manager Parameter Store 没有内置的轮换调度器，需要自行构建调度和编排。
  • C: AWS KMS 存储的是加密密钥而非 API 令牌，AWS managed key 的自动轮换只是每年轮换一次密钥材料，与应用密钥无关。
  • D: AWS owned key 完全由 AWS 控制，不能存储令牌，其轮换也不可配置。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: AWS Secrets Manager natively supports automatic rotation on a schedule, and for third-party API tokens you supply an AWS Lambda rotation function that obtains a new token and updates the secret. Setting the rotation schedule to every 3 months (90 days) fulfills the requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Systems Manager Parameter Store has no built-in rotation scheduler; you would have to build the schedule and orchestration yourself.
  • C: AWS KMS stores encryption keys, not API tokens, and automatic rotation of an AWS managed key rotates the key material once a year, not application secrets.
  • D: AWS owned keys are controlled entirely by AWS; they cannot store tokens and their rotation is not configurable.

contents.en:
A company has an application that uses diferent APls to generate embeddings for input text.The company needs to implement a solution to automatically rotate the APl tokens every 3 months.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
contents.zh:
一家公司有一个应用程序，它使用不同的API为输入文本生成嵌入向量。该公司需要实施一个解决方案，每3个月自动轮换API令牌。

哪种解决方案能满足这一要求？

questions.content:
An ML engineer receives datasets that contain missing values,duplicates,and extreme outliers.The ML engineer must consolidate these datasets into a single data frame and must prepare the data for ML.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to import the datasets and to consolidate them into a single data frame.Use the cleansing and enrichment functionalities to prepare the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to import the datasets and to consolidate them into a single data frame.Use the cleansing and enrichment functionalities to prepare the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊SageMaker Data Wrangler导入数据集，并将它们整合到一个单一的数据框中。使用清洗和丰富功能来准备数据。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to import the datasets and to consolidate them into a single data frame. Use the human-in-theloop capability to prepare the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to import the datasets and to consolidate them into a single data frame. Use the human-in-theloop capability to prepare the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊SageMaker Ground Truth导入数据集，并将它们整合到一个单一的数据框中。使用人工介入功能来准备数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Manually import and merge the datasets.Consolidate the datasets into a single data frame.Use Amazon Q Developer to generate code snippets that will prepare the data.

contents.en: Manually import and merge the datasets.Consolidate the datasets into a single data frame.Use Amazon Q Developer to generate code snippets that will prepare the data.
contents.zh: 手动导入并合并数据集。将数据集整合到一个单一的数据框中。使用亚马逊Q开发者来生成准备数据的代码片段。

options.label: D
options.content: Manually import and merge the datasets.Consolidate the datasets into a single data frame.Use Amazon SageMaker data labeling to prepare the data.

contents.en: Manually import and merge the datasets.Consolidate the datasets into a single data frame.Use Amazon SageMaker data labeling to prepare the data.
contents.zh: 手动导入并合并数据集。将数据集整合到一个单一的数据框中。使用亚马逊SageMaker数据标注来准备数据。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Data Wrangler 可以导入多个数据集，通过 join 或 concatenate 把它们合并成一个数据框，并使用内置转换处理缺失值、删除重复项、管理异常值，还能进行编码和特征工程等丰富操作。它覆盖了整个整合与数据准备流程。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: SageMaker Ground Truth 是数据标注服务，不能合并数据集，也不能清洗缺失值、重复项和异常值。
  • C: 手动合并数据再用 Amazon Q Developer 生成零散代码片段是手工且易错的流程，而不是专门的数据准备方案。
  • D: SageMaker 数据标注只负责给记录打标签，没有清洗或异常值处理能力。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Data Wrangler 可以导入多个数据集，通过 join 或 concatenate 把它们合并成一个数据框，并使用内置转换处理缺失值、删除重复项、管理异常值，还能进行编码和特征工程等丰富操作。它覆盖了整个整合与数据准备流程。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: SageMaker Ground Truth 是数据标注服务，不能合并数据集，也不能清洗缺失值、重复项和异常值。
  • C: 手动合并数据再用 Amazon Q Developer 生成零散代码片段是手工且易错的流程，而不是专门的数据准备方案。
  • D: SageMaker 数据标注只负责给记录打标签，没有清洗或异常值处理能力。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker Data Wrangler can import multiple datasets, join or concatenate them into a single data frame, and apply built-in transforms to handle missing values, drop duplicates, and manage outliers, along with enrichment steps such as encoding and feature engineering. It covers the entire consolidation and preparation workflow.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: SageMaker Ground Truth is a data labeling service; it does not merge datasets or clean missing values, duplicates, and outliers.
  • C: Manually merging data and generating ad hoc code snippets with Amazon Q Developer is a manual, error-prone process rather than a purpose-built data preparation solution.
  • D: SageMaker data labeling assigns labels to records; it has no cleansing or outlier-handling capabilities.

contents.en:
An ML engineer receives datasets that contain missing values,duplicates,and extreme outliers.The ML engineer must consolidate these datasets into a single data frame and must prepare the data for ML.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh:
一位机器学习工程师收到的数据集包含缺失值、重复数据以及极端异常值。该工程师必须将这些数据集整合到一个单一的数据框中，并为机器学习准备数据。

哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

questions.content:
A company has historical data that shows whether customers needed long-term support from company staff.The company needs to develop an ML model to predict whether new customers will require long-term support.

Which modeling approach should the company use to meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Anomaly detection

contents.en: Anomaly detection
contents.zh: 异常检测

options.label: B
options.content: Linear regression

contents.en: Linear regression
contents.zh: 线性回归

options.label: C
options.content: Logistic regression

contents.en: Logistic regression
contents.zh: 逻辑回归

options.label: D
options.content: Semantic segmentation

contents.en: Semantic segmentation
contents.zh: 语义分割

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：目标是一个是/否结果（客户是否需要长期支持），并且有带标签的历史数据，这是典型的监督式二元分类问题。逻辑回归对正类概率建模，是这类预测的标准方法。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 异常检测通常是无监督的，用于发现罕见或异常记录，不能预测有标签的二元结果。
  • B: 线性回归预测连续数值，而不是是/否这样的类别。
  • D: 语义分割是对图像每个像素分类的计算机视觉技术，与表格型客户数据无关。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：目标是一个是/否结果（客户是否需要长期支持），并且有带标签的历史数据，这是典型的监督式二元分类问题。逻辑回归对正类概率建模，是这类预测的标准方法。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 异常检测通常是无监督的，用于发现罕见或异常记录，不能预测有标签的二元结果。
  • B: 线性回归预测连续数值，而不是是/否这样的类别。
  • D: 语义分割是对图像每个像素分类的计算机视觉技术，与表格型客户数据无关。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: The target is a yes/no outcome (whether a customer will need long-term support) with labeled historical data, which is a supervised binary classification problem. Logistic regression models the probability of the positive class and is the standard approach for this type of prediction.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Anomaly detection is typically unsupervised and finds rare or unusual records; it does not predict a labeled binary outcome.
  • B: Linear regression predicts a continuous numeric value, not a categorical yes/no class.
  • D: Semantic segmentation is a computer vision technique that classifies each pixel of an image, unrelated to tabular customer data.

contents.en:
A company has historical data that shows whether customers needed long-term support from company staff.The company needs to develop an ML model to predict whether new customers will require long-term support.

Which modeling approach should the company use to meet this requirement?
contents.zh:
一家公司有历史数据，这些数据显示了客户是否需要公司员工提供长期支持。该公司需要开发一个机器学习模型来预测新客户是否需要长期支持。

该公司应使用哪种建模方法来满足这一要求？

questions.content:
An ML engineer has developed a binary classification model outside of Amazon SageMaker. The ML engineer needs to make the model accessible to a SageMaker Canvas user for additional tuning. The model rtifacts are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket.The ML engineer and the Canvas user are part of the same SageMaker domain.

Which combination of requirements must be met so that the ML engineer can share the model with the Canvas user?(Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.content: The ML engineer and the Canvas user must be in separate SageMaker domains.

contents.en: The ML engineer and the Canvas user must be in separate SageMaker domains.
contents.zh: 机器学习工程师和Canvas用户必须位于不同的SageMaker域中。

options.label: B
options.content: The Canvas user must have permissions to access the S3 bucket where the model artifacts are stored.

contents.en: The Canvas user must have permissions to access the S3 bucket where the model artifacts are stored.
contents.zh: Canvas用户必须有权限访问存储模型工件的S3存储桶。

options.label: C
options.content: The model must be registered in the SageMaker Model Registry.

contents.en: The model must be registered in the SageMaker Model Registry.
contents.zh: 模型必须在SageMaker Model Registry中注册。

options.label: D
options.content: The ML engineer must host the model on AWS Marketplace.

contents.en: The ML engineer must host the model on AWS Marketplace.
contents.zh: 机器学习工程师必须将模型托管在AWS Marketplace上。

options.label: E
options.content: The ML engineer must deploy the model to a SageMaker endpoint.

contents.en: The ML engineer must deploy the model to a SageMaker endpoint.
contents.zh: 机器学习工程师必须将模型部署到SageMaker端点上。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B、C：要把自有模型引入 SageMaker Canvas，模型必须在 SageMaker Model Registry 中注册为模型包版本，才能共享给同一域中的 Canvas 用户；同时 Canvas 用户的执行角色必须能够读取存放模型工件的 S3 存储桶，Canvas 才能导入并调优该模型。

为什么其他选项错误：

questions.content:
A company is building a deep learning model on Amazon SageMaker.The company uses a large amount of data as the training dataset.The company needs to optimize the model's hyperparameters to minimize the loss function on the validation dataset.

Which hyperparameter tuning strategy will accomplish this goal with the LEAST computation time?

options.label: A
options.content: Hyperband

contents.en: Hyperband
contents.zh: Hyperband

options.label: B
options.content: Grid search

contents.en: Grid search
contents.zh: 网格搜索

options.label: C
options.content: Bayesian optimization

contents.en: Bayesian optimization
contents.zh: 贝叶斯优化

options.label: D
options.content: Random search

contents.en: Random search
contents.zh: 随机搜索

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Hyperband 是一种多保真度策略：先给大量配置分配少量预算，利用中间结果提前终止表现差的训练作业，并把资源重新分配给有希望的配置。对于在大数据集上训练的深度学习模型，这种提前停止相比把每个作业都跑完的策略能显著减少总计算时间。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 网格搜索会把所有超参数组合都完整训练一遍，是计算开销最大的方法。
  • C: 贝叶斯优化样本效率高，但作业按顺序完整运行，在长时间的深度学习作业上比 Hyperband 耗时更多。
  • D: 随机搜索会运行大量完整的训练作业，不利用中间结果终止差的作业，因此比 Hyperband 消耗更多计算资源。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Hyperband 是一种多保真度策略：先给大量配置分配少量预算，利用中间结果提前终止表现差的训练作业，并把资源重新分配给有希望的配置。对于在大数据集上训练的深度学习模型，这种提前停止相比把每个作业都跑完的策略能显著减少总计算时间。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 网格搜索会把所有超参数组合都完整训练一遍，是计算开销最大的方法。
  • C: 贝叶斯优化样本效率高，但作业按顺序完整运行，在长时间的深度学习作业上比 Hyperband 耗时更多。
  • D: 随机搜索会运行大量完整的训练作业，不利用中间结果终止差的作业，因此比 Hyperband 消耗更多计算资源。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Hyperband is a multi-fidelity strategy that allocates a small budget to many configurations, uses intermediate results to stop poorly performing training jobs early, and reallocates resources to promising ones. For a deep learning model trained on a large dataset, this early stopping dramatically reduces total computation time compared with strategies that run every job to completion.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Grid search exhaustively trains every combination of hyperparameter values to completion, which is the most computationally expensive approach.
  • C: Bayesian optimization is sample-efficient but runs jobs sequentially and to completion, so it takes longer than Hyperband on long-running deep learning jobs.
  • D: Random search runs many full training jobs without using intermediate results to stop bad ones, so it consumes more compute than Hyperband.

contents.en:
A company is building a deep learning model on Amazon SageMaker.The company uses a large amount of data as the training dataset.The company needs to optimize the model's hyperparameters to minimize the loss function on the validation dataset.

Which hyperparameter tuning strategy will accomplish this goal with the LEAST computation time?
