questions.content:
A company is planning to use Amazon Redshift MLinits primary AWS account. The source data is in an Amazon S3 bucket in a secondary account. An ML engineer needs to set up an MLpipeline in the primary account to access the S3 bucket in the secondary account.The solution must not require public IPv4 addresses.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Provision a Redshift dluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC with no public access enabled in the primary account.Create a VPC peering connection between the accounts.Update the VPC route tables to remove the route to 0.0.0.0/0.

contents.en: Provision a Redshift dluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC with no public access enabled in the primary account.Create a VPC peering connection between the accounts.Update the VPC route tables to remove the route to 0.0.0.0/0.
contents.zh: 在主账户中，在一个不启用公共访问的VPC内配置Redshift集群和亚马逊SageMaker Studio。在账户之间创建VPC对等连接。更新VPC路由表以删除指向0.0.0.0/0的路由。

options.label: B
options.content: Provision a Redshift duster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC with no public accessenabled in the primary account. Create an AWS Direct Connect connection and a transit gateway.Associate the VPCs from both accounts with the transit gateway.Update the VPC route tables to remove the route to 0.0.0.0/0.

contents.en: Provision a Redshift duster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC with no public accessenabled in the primary account. Create an AWS Direct Connect connection and a transit gateway.Associate the VPCs from both accounts with the transit gateway.Update the VPC route tables to remove the route to 0.0.0.0/0.
contents.zh: 在主账户中，在一个不启用公共访问的VPC内配置Redshift集群和亚马逊SageMaker Studio。创建AWS Direct Connect连接和一个中转网关。将两个账户的VPC与中转网关相关联。更新VPC路由表以删除指向0.0.0.0/0的路由。

options.label: C
options.content: Provision a Redshift dluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC in the primary account. Create an AWS Site- to-Site VPN connection with two encrypted IPsec tunnels between the accounts. Set up interface VPC endpoints for Amazon S3.

contents.en: Provision a Redshift dluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC in the primary account. Create an AWS Site- to-Site VPN connection with two encrypted IPsec tunnels between the accounts. Set up interface VPC endpoints for Amazon S3.
contents.zh: 在主账户中，在一个VPC内配置Redshift集群和亚马逊SageMaker Studio。在账户之间创建具有两条加密IPsec隧道的AWS Site-to-Site VPN连接。为亚马逊S3设置接口VPC端点。

options.label: D
options.content: Provision a Redshift cluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC in the primary account. Create an S3 gateway endpoint.Update the S3 bucket policy to allow AM principals from the primary account.Set up interface VPC endpoints for SageMaker and Amazon Redshift.

contents.en: Provision a Redshift cluster and Amazon SageMaker Studio in a VPC in the primary account. Create an S3 gateway endpoint.Update the S3 bucket policy to allow AM principals from the primary account.Set up interface VPC endpoints for SageMaker and Amazon Redshift.
contents.zh: 在主账户中，在一个VPC内配置Redshift集群和亚马逊SageMaker Studio。创建一个S3网关端点。更新S3存储桶策略，以允许来自主账户的主体访问。为SageMaker和亚马逊Redshift设置接口VPC端点。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：S3 gateway endpoint 让主账户 VPC 中的资源通过 AWS 内部网络访问 Amazon S3，无需公共 IPv4 地址或互联网网关；跨账户访问则通过辅助账户中的存储桶策略授权主账户的 IAM 主体来实现。为 SageMaker 和 Amazon Redshift 设置 interface VPC endpoint 可以让管道的其余流量也保持私有。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: VPC 对等连接只连接两个 VPC，而 Amazon S3 是位于 VPC 之外的区域级服务，对等连接无法提供对存储桶的访问。
  • B: AWS Direct Connect 用于连接本地网络与 AWS，transit gateway 用于连接 VPC，两者都不能提供跨账户访问 Amazon S3 的私有路径。
  • C: Site-to-Site VPN 用于连接外部网络，其隧道使用公共 IPv4 端点，而且有 VPC endpoint 加存储桶策略就已足够，不需要 VPN。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：S3 gateway endpoint 让主账户 VPC 中的资源通过 AWS 内部网络访问 Amazon S3，无需公共 IPv4 地址或互联网网关；跨账户访问则通过辅助账户中的存储桶策略授权主账户的 IAM 主体来实现。为 SageMaker 和 Amazon Redshift 设置 interface VPC endpoint 可以让管道的其余流量也保持私有。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: VPC 对等连接只连接两个 VPC，而 Amazon S3 是位于 VPC 之外的区域级服务，对等连接无法提供对存储桶的访问。
  • B: AWS Direct Connect 用于连接本地网络与 AWS，transit gateway 用于连接 VPC，两者都不能提供跨账户访问 Amazon S3 的私有路径。
  • C: Site-to-Site VPN 用于连接外部网络，其隧道使用公共 IPv4 端点，而且有 VPC endpoint 加存储桶策略就已足够，不需要 VPN。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: An S3 gateway endpoint lets resources in the primary account's VPC reach Amazon S3 over the AWS network with no public IPv4 addresses or internet gateway, and cross-account access is granted by a bucket policy in the secondary account that allows the primary account's IAM principals. Interface VPC endpoints for SageMaker and Amazon Redshift keep the rest of the pipeline traffic private as well.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: VPC peering connects two VPCs, but Amazon S3 is a regional service outside any VPC, so peering does not provide access to the bucket.
  • B: AWS Direct Connect links on-premises networks to AWS and a transit gateway connects VPCs; neither provides a private path to Amazon S3 across accounts.
  • C: Site-to-Site VPN is for connecting external networks and its tunnels use public IPv4 endpoints, and a VPN is not needed to reach S3 when a VPC endpoint plus bucket policy suffices.

options.label: B
options.content: Log the metrics from the Lambda function to Amazon CloudFront.Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to send the email message.

options.label: C

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：把 Lambda 函数中的模型指标作为自定义指标发布到 Amazon CloudWatch，就可以基于阈值创建 CloudWatch alarm，告警动作可以通知带邮件订阅的 Amazon SNS 主题。这是指标超阈值时发送邮件的标准全托管做法。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS CloudTrail 记录 API 活动用于审计，不存储自定义指标，也不发送通知。
  • B: Amazon CloudFront 是内容分发网络，不能接收来自 Lambda 的指标。
  • D: 记录到 CloudWatch 是对的，但 CloudFront 没有可以发送邮件的规则，告警必须由 CloudWatch alarm 触发。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：把 Lambda 函数中的模型指标作为自定义指标发布到 Amazon CloudWatch，就可以基于阈值创建 CloudWatch alarm，告警动作可以通知带邮件订阅的 Amazon SNS 主题。这是指标超阈值时发送邮件的标准全托管做法。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS CloudTrail 记录 API 活动用于审计，不存储自定义指标，也不发送通知。
  • B: Amazon CloudFront 是内容分发网络，不能接收来自 Lambda 的指标。
  • D: 记录到 CloudWatch 是对的，但 CloudFront 没有可以发送邮件的规则，告警必须由 CloudWatch alarm 触发。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Publishing the model metrics from the Lambda function to Amazon CloudWatch as custom metrics lets you create a CloudWatch alarm on a threshold, and the alarm action can notify an Amazon SNS topic with an email subscription. This is the standard, fully managed way to send an email when a metric is breached.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: AWS CloudTrail records API activity for auditing; it does not store custom metrics or send notifications.
  • B: Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network and cannot receive metrics from Lambda.
  • D: Logging to CloudWatch is correct, but CloudFront has no rules that send email; the alerting must come from a CloudWatch alarm.

questions.content:
A company has used Amazon SageMaker to deploy a predictive ML modelin production.The company is using SageMaker Model Monitoron the model.After a model update, an ML engineer notices data quality issues in the Model Monitor checks.

What should the ML engineer do to mitigate the data quality issues that Model Monitor has identified?

options.label: A
options.content: Adjust the model's parameters and hyperparameters.

contents.en: Adjust the model's parameters and hyperparameters.
contents.zh: 调整模型的参数和超参数。

options.label: B
options.content: Initiate a manual Model Monitorjob that uses the most recent production data.

contents.en: Initiate a manual Model Monitorjob that uses the most recent production data.
contents.zh: 启动一个使用最新生产数据的手动Model Monitor任务。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a new baseline from the latest dataset.Update Model Monitor to use the new baseline for evaluations.

contents.en: Create a new baseline from the latest dataset.Update Model Monitor to use the new baseline for evaluations.
contents.zh: 使用最新数据集创建一个新的基线。更新Model Monitor以使用新基线进行评估。

options.label: D
options.content: Include additional data in the existing training set for the model.Retrain and redeploy the model.

contents.en: Include additional data in the existing training set for the model.Retrain and redeploy the model.
contents.zh: 在模型现有的训练集中包含额外数据。重新训练并重新部署模型。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Model Monitor 会把实时推理数据与基于模型训练数据生成的统计信息和约束基线进行比较。模型更新后，预期的输入分布已经改变，旧基线会产生虚假的数据质量违规；用最新数据集创建新基线并让监控计划使用它，即可解决问题。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 数据质量违规反映的是输入数据与基线不匹配，而不是模型超参数问题，调参无法解决。
  • B: 用过期的基线再跑一次监控作业只会再次报出同样的违规。
  • D: 用更多数据重新训练既没必要又耗时，模型刚刚更新过，问题在于过期的基线而不是模型本身。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Model Monitor 会把实时推理数据与基于模型训练数据生成的统计信息和约束基线进行比较。模型更新后，预期的输入分布已经改变，旧基线会产生虚假的数据质量违规；用最新数据集创建新基线并让监控计划使用它，即可解决问题。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 数据质量违规反映的是输入数据与基线不匹配，而不是模型超参数问题，调参无法解决。
  • B: 用过期的基线再跑一次监控作业只会再次报出同样的违规。
  • D: 用更多数据重新训练既没必要又耗时，模型刚刚更新过，问题在于过期的基线而不是模型本身。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Model Monitor compares live inference data against a baseline of statistics and constraints generated from the data the model was trained on. After the model is updated, the expected input distribution changes, so the old baseline produces false data quality violations; creating a new baseline from the latest dataset and pointing the monitoring schedule at it resolves the issue.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Data quality violations reflect a mismatch between incoming data and the baseline, not model hyperparameters, so tuning the model does not resolve them.
  • B: Running another monitoring job against the stale baseline simply reports the same violations again.
  • D: Retraining with more data is unnecessary and slow; the model was just updated and the problem is the outdated baseline, not the model itself.

contents.en:
A company has used Amazon SageMaker to deploy a predictive ML modelin production.The company is using SageMaker Model Monitoron the model.After a model update, an ML engineer notices data quality issues in the Model Monitor checks.

What should the ML engineer do to mitigate the data quality issues that Model Monitor has identified?

options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker and the BlazingText algorithm.Apply custom pre-processing steps for stemming and removal of stop words. Calculate term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) scores to identify and extract relevant keywords.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker and the BlazingText algorithm.Apply custom pre-processing steps for stemming and removal of stop words. Calculate term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) scores to identify and extract relevant keywords.

options.content: Store the documents in an Amazon S3 bucket.Create AWS Lambda functions to process the documents and to run Python scripts for stemming and removal of stop words.Use bigram and trigram techniques to identify and extract relevant keywords.

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：Amazon Comprehend 是全托管的 NLP 服务，其 key phrase extraction API 可以返回文档中有意义的名词短语，custom entity recognition 还能识别特定领域的术语。无需搭建基础设施、预处理管道或训练模型，运营开销最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 在 Amazon EC2 上运行 NLTK 和 LDA 需要管理服务器、编写预处理代码并调优主题模型，而 LDA 产出的是主题而不是关键词。
  • B: BlazingText 用于生成词向量或文本分类，不产出关键词，自定义词干提取和 TF-IDF 代码还会增加开发和维护工作。
  • C: 用自定义 Lambda 函数和 n-gram 脚本意味着自行编写和维护 NLP 管道，而不是使用托管 API。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Amazon Comprehend is a fully managed NLP service whose key phrase extraction API returns the meaningful noun phrases in a document, and custom entity recognition can identify domain-specific terms. There is no infrastructure, preprocessing pipeline, or model to build, so it has the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Running NLTK and LDA on Amazon EC2 requires managing servers, writing preprocessing code, and tuning a topic model that produces topics rather than keywords.
  • B: BlazingText produces word embeddings or text classification, not keywords, and custom stemming and TF-IDF code adds development and maintenance effort.
  • C: Custom Lambda functions with n-gram scripts require writing and maintaining your own NLP pipeline instead of using a managed API.

The ML engineers must not be allowed to access training data from other business groups. The company uses a single AWS account and stores ll the training data in Amazon S3 buckets.All ML model training occurs in Amazon SageMaker.

Which solution will provide the ML engineers with the appropriate access?

options.label: A
options.content: Enable S3 bucket versioning.

contents.en: Enable S3 bucket versioning.
contents.zh: 启用S3存储桶版本控制。

options.label: B
options.content: Configure S3 Object Lock settings for each user.

contents.en: Configure S3 Object Lock settings for each user.
contents.zh: 为每个用户配置S3对象锁定设置。

options.label: C
options.content: Add cross-origin resource sharing(CORS) policies to the S3 buckets.

contents.en: Add cross-origin resource sharing(CORS) policies to the S3 buckets.
contents.zh: 向S3存储桶添加跨域资源共享（CORS）策略。

options.label: D
options.content: Create IAM policies.Attach the policies to IAM users or IAM roles.

contents.en: Create IAM policies.Attach the policies to IAM users or IAM roles.
contents.zh: 创建IAM策略，并将这些策略附加到IAM用户或IAM角色上。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：在单个 AWS 账户中，S3 对象的访问由 IAM 控制。创建 IAM 策略，只允许每个业务组访问自己的存储桶或前缀，并把策略附加到 IAM 用户或用于训练的 SageMaker 执行角色，就能实现训练数据的按组隔离。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: S3 版本控制用于保留对象版本以便恢复，不能控制谁可以读取数据。
  • B: S3 Object Lock 用于合规保留、防止对象被删除或覆盖，不是按用户的访问控制机制。
  • C: CORS 策略决定哪些 Web 源可以从浏览器向存储桶发起请求，不能限制 IAM 主体。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：在单个 AWS 账户中，S3 对象的访问由 IAM 控制。创建 IAM 策略，只允许每个业务组访问自己的存储桶或前缀，并把策略附加到 IAM 用户或用于训练的 SageMaker 执行角色，就能实现训练数据的按组隔离。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: S3 版本控制用于保留对象版本以便恢复，不能控制谁可以读取数据。
  • B: S3 Object Lock 用于合规保留、防止对象被删除或覆盖，不是按用户的访问控制机制。
  • C: CORS 策略决定哪些 Web 源可以从浏览器向存储桶发起请求，不能限制 IAM 主体。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: In a single AWS account, access to S3 objects is governed by IAM. Creating IAM policies that allow each business group access only to its own buckets or prefixes and attaching them to the IAM users or the SageMaker execution roles used for training enforces group-level isolation of the training data.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: S3 Versioning preserves object versions for recovery; it does not control who can read the data.
  • B: S3 Object Lock prevents objects from being deleted or overwritten for compliance retention and is not a per-user access control mechanism.
  • C: CORS policies govern which web origins can make browser requests to a bucket; they do not restrict IAM principals.

contents.zh: 通过使用AWS Lambda安排亚马逊SageMaker批量转换作业。

options.content: Configure an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to use scheduled scaling.

contents.en: Configure an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to use scheduled scaling.
contents.zh: 配置一个亚马逊EC2实例的自动缩放组，以使用计划缩放。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：带 Provisioned Concurrency 的 SageMaker Serverless Inference 会保持指定数量的预热工作实例，消除冷启动，让调用得到快速响应；还可以通过 Application Auto Scaling 按计划在每天的 2 小时窗口提高预置并发。底层基础设施和扩展全部由 AWS 管理。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Batch transform 用于离线处理数据集，不能为多次需要快速响应的交互式调用提供服务。
  • B: EC2 Auto Scaling 组要求公司自行管理实例、服务软件和扩展配置。
  • D: 运行在 EC2 上并带 Pod 自动缩放的 Amazon EKS 仍需公司自行管理集群、节点和 Kubernetes，而不是由 AWS 托管。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：带 Provisioned Concurrency 的 SageMaker Serverless Inference 会保持指定数量的预热工作实例，消除冷启动，让调用得到快速响应；还可以通过 Application Auto Scaling 按计划在每天的 2 小时窗口提高预置并发。底层基础设施和扩展全部由 AWS 管理。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Batch transform 用于离线处理数据集，不能为多次需要快速响应的交互式调用提供服务。
  • B: EC2 Auto Scaling 组要求公司自行管理实例、服务软件和扩展配置。
  • D: 运行在 EC2 上并带 Pod 自动缩放的 Amazon EKS 仍需公司自行管理集群、节点和 Kubernetes，而不是由 AWS 托管。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: SageMaker Serverless Inference with Provisioned Concurrency keeps a configured number of warm workers ready, eliminating cold starts so invocations get quick responses, and the provisioned concurrency can be raised on a schedule with Application Auto Scaling for the daily 2-hour window. AWS manages all of the underlying infrastructure and scaling.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Batch transform processes a dataset offline and does not serve multiple interactive invocations that require quick responses.
  • B: An EC2 Auto Scaling group requires the company to manage the instances, the serving software, and the scaling configuration itself.
  • D: Amazon EKS on EC2 with pod auto scaling leaves cluster, node, and Kubernetes management to the company rather than AWS.

options.label: A
options.content: Use SageMaker Model Monitor on the deployed model.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Model Monitor on the deployed model.
contents.zh: 在已部署的模型上使用SageMaker Model Monitor。

options.label: B
options.content: Use SageMaker Clarify on the deployed model.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Clarify on the deployed model.
contents.zh: 在已部署的模型上使用SageMaker Clarify。

options.label: C
options.content: Show the distribution of inferences from A/B testing in Amazon CloudWatch.

contents.en: Show the distribution of inferences from A/B testing in Amazon CloudWatch.
contents.zh: 在亚马逊CloudWatch中展示A/B测试推理的分布情况。

options.content: Add a shadow endpoint.Analyze prediction differences on samples.

contents.en: Add a shadow endpoint.Analyze prediction differences on samples.
contents.zh: 添加一个影子端点，分析样本上的预测差异。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Clarify 提供模型可解释性，通过基于 SHAP 的特征归因展示每个输入词元或特征对预测的贡献，并且可以通过在线可解释性或计划的可解释性作业在已部署的端点上运行。这正是向利益相关者解释预测所需的内容。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Model Monitor 用于检测数据质量、模型质量、偏差和特征归因随时间的漂移，本身并不解释单个预测。
  • C: CloudWatch 中的 A/B 测试分布只是比较不同模型变体之间的流量，不能说明预测的原因。
  • D: 影子端点用于把新模型输出与生产输出进行比较以做验证，不提供预测逻辑的解释。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Clarify 提供模型可解释性，通过基于 SHAP 的特征归因展示每个输入词元或特征对预测的贡献，并且可以通过在线可解释性或计划的可解释性作业在已部署的端点上运行。这正是向利益相关者解释预测所需的内容。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Model Monitor 用于检测数据质量、模型质量、偏差和特征归因随时间的漂移，本身并不解释单个预测。
  • C: CloudWatch 中的 A/B 测试分布只是比较不同模型变体之间的流量，不能说明预测的原因。
  • D: 影子端点用于把新模型输出与生产输出进行比较以做验证，不提供预测逻辑的解释。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: SageMaker Clarify provides model explainability by computing SHAP-based feature attributions that show how each input token or feature contributed to a prediction, and it can run on a deployed endpoint through online explainability or a scheduled explainability job. This produces the explanations stakeholders need.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SageMaker Model Monitor detects drift in data quality, model quality, bias, and feature attribution over time, but it does not by itself explain individual predictions.
  • C: An A/B test distribution in CloudWatch compares traffic between model variants; it says nothing about why a prediction was made.
  • D: A shadow endpoint compares a new model's outputs with production outputs for validation and provides no explanation of prediction logic.

正确答案 C：分布式训练实例需要频繁交换梯度，把它们放在同一个 VPC 子网（因此也在同一个可用区）可获得最低的节点间延迟；把训练数据存放在相同的区域和可用区，则避免了跨可用区和跨区域的数据传输延迟与费用。两者结合才能最大程度减少通信开销。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 从另一个 AWS 区域读取训练数据会给每个 epoch 增加显著的网络延迟和数据传输费用。
  • B: 一个子网只属于一个可用区，同一子网中的实例不可能跨多个可用区，而且跨区域访问数据还会增加延迟。
  • D: 把数据放在不同的可用区会让每次读取都产生跨可用区流量，比同可用区存放延迟更高。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：分布式训练实例需要频繁交换梯度，把它们放在同一个 VPC 子网（因此也在同一个可用区）可获得最低的节点间延迟；把训练数据存放在相同的区域和可用区，则避免了跨可用区和跨区域的数据传输延迟与费用。两者结合才能最大程度减少通信开销。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 从另一个 AWS 区域读取训练数据会给每个 epoch 增加显著的网络延迟和数据传输费用。
  • B: 一个子网只属于一个可用区，同一子网中的实例不可能跨多个可用区，而且跨区域访问数据还会增加延迟。
  • D: 把数据放在不同的可用区会让每次读取都产生跨可用区流量，比同可用区存放延迟更高。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Distributed training instances exchange gradients constantly, so keeping them in the same VPC subnet (and therefore the same Availability Zone) gives the lowest inter-node latency, and keeping the training data in the same Region and Availability Zone avoids cross-AZ and cross-Region data transfer latency and costs. Both choices together MINIMIZE communication overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Reading training data from a different AWS Region adds significant network latency and data transfer cost to every epoch.
  • B: A subnet belongs to exactly one Availability Zone, so instances in one subnet cannot span multiple AZs, and cross-Region data access adds latency.
  • D: Storing data in a different Availability Zone forces cross-AZ traffic for every read, which adds latency compared with keeping data in the same AZ.

contents.en:

What should the ML engineerdo to MINIMIZE the communication overhead between the instances?

options.label: B

explanations.zh:

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 内置算法会替换掉自定义的 PyTorch 模型，丢弃脚本中蕴含的独特领域知识。
  • C: 构建并维护自定义容器比 script mode 工作量更大，只有在预构建框架镜像无法满足需求时才有必要。

explanations.en:

  • C: Building and maintaining a custom container is more work than script mode and is only necessary when the prebuilt framework images do not meet the requirements.
  • D: Marketplace models are generic and cannot reproduce the company's proprietary, domain-specific models.

options.label: A
options.content: Transfer the data to a new S3 bucket that provides S3 Express One Zone storage.Adjust the training job to use the new S3 bucket.

options.content: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Link the file system to the existing S3 bucket.Adjust the training job to read from the file system.

contents.en: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Link the file system to the existing S3 bucket.Adjust the training job to read from the file system.
contents.zh: 创建一个亚马逊FSx for Lustre文件系统，将该文件系统链接到现有的S3存储桶，调整训练任务以从该文件系统读取数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Create an Amazon Elastic File System(Amazon EFS)file system. Transfer the existing data to the file system.Adjust the training job to read from the file system.

contents.en: Create an Amazon Elastic File System(Amazon EFS)file system. Transfer the existing data to the file system.Adjust the training job to read from the file system.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：Amazon FSx for Lustre 可以直接链接到现有 S3 存储桶，并在首次访问时按需加载对象，把数百万个文件呈现为 SageMaker 训练作业可挂载的高吞吐、低延迟 POSIX 文件系统。无需批量迁移数据，因此能在最短时间内提升训练性能。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: S3 Express One Zone 延迟更低，但把数百万个文件复制到新桶需要漫长的传输过程，才能获得收益。
  • C: Amazon EFS 同样需要先迁移全部数据，而且在 ML 训练负载下吞吐量低于 FSx for Lustre。
  • D: ElastiCache (Redis OSS) 是内存键值存储，不能链接到 S3 存储桶，也不是 SageMaker 训练作业可以读取的数据源。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：Amazon FSx for Lustre 可以直接链接到现有 S3 存储桶，并在首次访问时按需加载对象，把数百万个文件呈现为 SageMaker 训练作业可挂载的高吞吐、低延迟 POSIX 文件系统。无需批量迁移数据，因此能在最短时间内提升训练性能。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: S3 Express One Zone 延迟更低，但把数百万个文件复制到新桶需要漫长的传输过程，才能获得收益。
  • C: Amazon EFS 同样需要先迁移全部数据，而且在 ML 训练负载下吞吐量低于 FSx for Lustre。
  • D: ElastiCache (Redis OSS) 是内存键值存储，不能链接到 S3 存储桶，也不是 SageMaker 训练作业可以读取的数据源。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Amazon FSx for Lustre can be linked directly to the existing S3 bucket and lazily loads objects on first access, presenting the millions of files as a high-throughput, low-latency POSIX file system that SageMaker training jobs can mount. No bulk data migration is needed, so training performance improves in the LEAST amount of time.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: S3 Express One Zone offers lower latency, but copying millions of files into a new bucket is a lengthy transfer before any benefit is realized.
  • C: Amazon EFS also requires transferring all the data first and delivers lower throughput than FSx for Lustre for ML training workloads.
  • D: ElastiCache (Redis OSS) is an in-memory key-value store; it cannot be linked to an S3 bucket and is not a data source SageMaker training jobs can read from.

options.content: Use Amazon Made to categorize the sensitive data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Made to categorize the sensitive data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊Made对敏感数据进行分类。

options.label: B
options.content: Prepare the data by using AWS Glue DataBrew.

contents.en: Prepare the data by using AWS Glue DataBrew.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Glue DataBrew准备数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Run an AWS Batch job to change the sensitive data to random values.

contents.en: Run an AWS Batch job to change the sensitive data to random values.

options.label: D
options.content: Run an Amazon EMR job to change the sensitive data to random values.

contents.en: Run an Amazon EMR job to change the sensitive data to random values.
contents.zh: 运行一个亚马逊EMR作业将敏感数据更改为随机值。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：AWS Glue DataBrew 是可视化数据准备服务，可以检测个人身份信息（PII），并对敏感列应用内置的掩码、哈希、确定性加密等转换。这些转换在隐藏原始值的同时保留列本身及其有意义的顺序，无需编写代码即可在另一团队开始建模之前完成脱敏。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon Macie 只负责发现和分类 Amazon S3 中的敏感数据，并不会对数据进行掩码或转换。
  • C: AWS Batch 作业需要自行编写代码，而且把敏感值替换成随机值会破坏特征原有的有意义顺序。
  • D: Amazon EMR 作业同样需要自定义 Spark 程序，随机替换也会丢弃必须保留的顺序信息。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：AWS Glue DataBrew 是可视化数据准备服务，可以检测个人身份信息（PII），并对敏感列应用内置的掩码、哈希、确定性加密等转换。这些转换在隐藏原始值的同时保留列本身及其有意义的顺序，无需编写代码即可在另一团队开始建模之前完成脱敏。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon Macie 只负责发现和分类 Amazon S3 中的敏感数据，并不会对数据进行掩码或转换。
  • C: AWS Batch 作业需要自行编写代码，而且把敏感值替换成随机值会破坏特征原有的有意义顺序。
  • D: Amazon EMR 作业同样需要自定义 Spark 程序，随机替换也会丢弃必须保留的顺序信息。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: AWS Glue DataBrew is a visual data preparation service that can detect personally identifiable information and apply built-in transformations such as masking, hashing, and deterministic encryption to the sensitive columns. These transformations obscure the values while keeping the columns and their meaningful ordering intact, so the data is masked before the other team starts modeling, with no custom code.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon Macie discovers and classifies sensitive data in Amazon S3 but does not mask or transform it.
  • C: An AWS Batch job requires custom code, and replacing values with random data destroys the meaningful order of the features.
  • D: An Amazon EMR job likewise needs a custom Spark application, and random replacement discards the ordering information that must be preserved.

  • C: 在 Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate 上托管需要自行实现批量推理逻辑，而 Amazon EventBridge 只负责路由事件，不会度量数据质量。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：Amazon SageMaker batch transform 可以对存放在 Amazon S3 中的大型数据集进行异步推理，无需常驻端点。SageMaker Model Monitor 支持 batch transform 作业，能够按计划运行数据质量监控并与基线对比，把违规项和 Amazon CloudWatch 指标发出来，在数据质量变化时触发告警。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Glue 作业是 ETL 作业而不是模型部署方式，单靠 CloudWatch 告警无法基于基线计算数据质量统计。
  • B: AWS CloudTrail 记录 API 活动用于审计，无法评估推理数据的统计质量。
  • C: 在 Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate 上托管需要自行实现批量推理逻辑，而 Amazon EventBridge 只负责路由事件，不会度量数据质量。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Amazon SageMaker batch transform runs asynchronous inference over large datasets stored in Amazon S3 without a persistent endpoint. SageMaker Model Monitor supports batch transform jobs and can run scheduled data quality monitoring against a baseline, emitting violations and Amazon CloudWatch metrics that trigger alerts when data quality changes.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: AWS Glue jobs are ETL jobs rather than a model deployment option, and CloudWatch alarms alone cannot compute data quality statistics against a baseline.
  • B: AWS CloudTrail records API activity for auditing and has no capability to evaluate the statistical quality of inference data.
  • C: Hosting on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate requires building your own batch inference logic, and Amazon EventBridge only routes events rather than measuring data quality.

contents.en: Apply statistics from a well-known dataset to normalize the production samples.
contents.zh: 应用来自知名数据集的统计数据对生产样本进行归一化。

options.label: B
options.content: Keep the min-max normalization statistics from the training set.Use these values to normalize the production samples.

contents.en: Keep the min-max normalization statistics from the training set.Use these values to normalize the production samples.
contents.zh: 保留训练集的最小-最大归一化统计数据。使用这些值对生产样本进行归一化。

options.label: C
options.content: Calculate a new set of min-max normalization statistics from a batch of production samples.Use these values to normalize l the production samples.

正确答案 B：模型是基于用训练集最小值和最大值缩放后的特征学习的，因此生产推理数据必须用同一组保存下来的统计值进行转换。保留训练集的 min-max 统计值并应用到每个生产样本，才能保证特征尺度一致，避免训练与推理之间的偏差。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 来自无关数据集的统计值会产生与模型训练时不同的尺度，从而扭曲预测结果。
  • C: 按每批生产样本重新计算统计值会让缩放随批次漂移，并与训练时的尺度不一致。
  • D: 单个样本的最小值和最大值相同，按样本计算的统计值没有定义，无法进行有意义的归一化。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：模型是基于用训练集最小值和最大值缩放后的特征学习的，因此生产推理数据必须用同一组保存下来的统计值进行转换。保留训练集的 min-max 统计值并应用到每个生产样本，才能保证特征尺度一致，避免训练与推理之间的偏差。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 来自无关数据集的统计值会产生与模型训练时不同的尺度，从而扭曲预测结果。
  • C: 按每批生产样本重新计算统计值会让缩放随批次漂移，并与训练时的尺度不一致。
  • D: 单个样本的最小值和最大值相同，按样本计算的统计值没有定义，无法进行有意义的归一化。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: The model learned from features scaled with the training set's minimum and maximum values, so production inference data must be transformed with those same saved statistics. Persisting the min-max values from the training set and applying them to every production sample keeps the feature scale consistent and avoids training-serving skew.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Statistics from an unrelated dataset produce a different scale from the one the model was trained on, distorting the predictions.
  • C: Recomputing statistics from each production batch makes the scaling shift from batch to batch and differ from the training scale.
  • D: A single sample has identical minimum and maximum values, so per-sample statistics are undefined and cannot normalize anything meaningfully.

contents.en:

questions.content:
A company is planing to use Amazon SageMaker to make classification ratings that are based on images.The company has 6TB of training data that is stored on an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP system vitual machine (SVM).The SVM is in the same VPC as SageMaker. An MLengineer must make the training data accessible for ML models that are in the SageMaker environment.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Mount the FSx for ONTAP file system as a volume to the SageMaker Instance.

contents.en: Mount the FSx for ONTAP file system as a volume to the SageMaker Instance.
contents.zh: 将FSx for ONTAP文件系统挂载为SageMaker实例的一个卷。

options.label: B
options.content: Create an Amazon S3 bucket.Use Mountpoint for Amazon S3 to link the S3 bucket to the FSx for ONTAP file system.

contents.en: Create an Amazon S3 bucket.Use Mountpoint for Amazon S3 to link the S3 bucket to the FSx for ONTAP file system.
contents.zh: 创建一个亚马逊S3存储桶。使用亚马逊S3的挂载点（Mountpoint for Amazon S3）将S3存储桶与FSx for ONTAP文件系统相链接。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a catalog connection from SageMaker Data Wrangler to the FSx for ONTAP file system.

contents.en: Create a catalog connection from SageMaker Data Wrangler to the FSx for ONTAP file system.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker Data Wrangler与FSx for ONTAP文件系统之间创建一个目录连接。

options.label: D
options.content: Create a direct connection from SageMaker Data Wrangler to the FSx for ONTAP file system.

contents.en: Create a direct connection from SageMaker Data Wrangler to the FSx for ONTAP file system.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker Data Wrangler与FSx for ONTAP文件系统之间创建直接连接。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 通过 NFS 提供文件共享，而 SVM 与 SageMaker 位于同一 VPC，因此可以把该文件系统直接挂载为 SageMaker 实例上的卷。训练代码由此可以直接以文件方式访问 6 TB 图像数据，无需复制数据。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 是把 S3 存储桶挂载到计算实例上的文件系统客户端，不能把存储桶链接到 FSx for ONTAP 文件系统。
  • C: SageMaker Data Wrangler 没有针对 FSx for ONTAP 的目录连接类型，其数据源是 Amazon S3、Athena、Redshift、Snowflake、Databricks 和 Amazon EMR。
  • D: Data Wrangler 是数据准备工具，无法直接连接 FSx for ONTAP，也不是把训练数据暴露给模型的方式。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 通过 NFS 提供文件共享，而 SVM 与 SageMaker 位于同一 VPC，因此可以把该文件系统直接挂载为 SageMaker 实例上的卷。训练代码由此可以直接以文件方式访问 6 TB 图像数据，无需复制数据。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 是把 S3 存储桶挂载到计算实例上的文件系统客户端，不能把存储桶链接到 FSx for ONTAP 文件系统。
  • C: SageMaker Data Wrangler 没有针对 FSx for ONTAP 的目录连接类型，其数据源是 Amazon S3、Athena、Redshift、Snowflake、Databricks 和 Amazon EMR。
  • D: Data Wrangler 是数据准备工具，无法直接连接 FSx for ONTAP，也不是把训练数据暴露给模型的方式。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP exposes NFS file shares, and because the SVM is in the same VPC as SageMaker, the file system can be mounted directly as a volume on the SageMaker instance. This gives the training code direct file access to the 6 TB of images without copying the data.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 mounts an S3 bucket onto a compute instance as a file system; it cannot link a bucket to an FSx for ONTAP file system.
  • C: SageMaker Data Wrangler has no catalog connection type for FSx for ONTAP; its sources are Amazon S3, Athena, Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, and Amazon EMR.
  • D: Data Wrangler is a data preparation tool that cannot connect directly to FSx for ONTAP and is not a way to expose training data to models.

contents.en:
A company is planing to use Amazon SageMaker to make classification ratings that are based on images.The company has 6TB of training data that is stored on an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP system vitual machine (SVM).The SVM is in the same VPC as SageMaker. An MLengineer must make the training data accessible for ML models that are in the SageMaker environment.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh: 一家公司计划使用亚马逊SageMaker基于图像进行分类评级。该公司有6TB的训练数据，存储在亚马逊FSx for NetApp ONTAP系统虚拟机（SVM）上。该SVM与SageMaker位于同一个虚拟私有云（VPC）中。一位机器学习工程师必须使SageMaker环境中的机器学习模型能够访问这些训练数据。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

questions.content:
A company regularly receives new training data from the vendor of an ML model. The vendor delivers cleaned and prepared data to the company's Amazon S3 bucket every 3-4 days. The company has an Amazon SageMaker pipeline to retrain the model.An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to run the pipeline when new data is uploaded tothe S3 bucket.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.label: A
options.content: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to transfer the data to the SageMaker training instance and to initiate training.

contents.en: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to transfer the data to the SageMaker training instance and to initiate training.
contents.zh: 创建一个S3生命周期规则，将数据传输到SageMaker训练实例并启动训练。

options.label: B
options.content: Create an AWS Lambda function that scans the S3 bucket.Program the Lambda function to initiate the pipeline when new data is uploaded.

contents.en: Create an AWS Lambda function that scans the S3 bucket.Program the Lambda function to initiate the pipeline when new data is uploaded.
contents.zh: 创建一个AWS Lambda函数来扫描S3存储桶。对该Lambda函数进行编程，使其在新数据上传时启动管道。

options.label: C
options.content: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has an event pattern that matches the S3 upload. Configure the pipeline as the target of the rule.

contents.en: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has an event pattern that matches the S3 upload. Configure the pipeline as the target of the rule.
contents.zh: 创建一个亚马逊EventBridge规则，其事件模式与S3上传相匹配。将管道配置为该规则的目标。

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow(Amazon MWAA) to orchestrate the pipeline when new data is uploaded.

contents.en: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow(Amazon MWAA) to orchestrate the pipeline when new data is uploaded.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊托管的用于Apache Airflow的工作流（Amazon MWAA），在新数据上传时编排管道。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Amazon EventBridge 可以接收 Amazon S3 的对象创建事件，并原生支持把 SageMaker Pipelines 作为规则目标。用事件模式匹配上传事件的规则即可自动启动管道，无需编写代码也无需维护基础设施，运营工作量最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: S3 生命周期规则只能在存储类别之间转换或过期删除对象，无法把数据传到实例或启动训练。
  • B: 用 Lambda 函数扫描存储桶属于自定义轮询代码，需要编写、调度和维护，比原生事件规则费力。
  • D: Amazon MWAA 需要预置 Airflow 环境并编写 DAG，对一个简单触发来说运营开销过大。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Amazon EventBridge 可以接收 Amazon S3 的对象创建事件，并原生支持把 SageMaker Pipelines 作为规则目标。用事件模式匹配上传事件的规则即可自动启动管道，无需编写代码也无需维护基础设施，运营工作量最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: S3 生命周期规则只能在存储类别之间转换或过期删除对象，无法把数据传到实例或启动训练。
  • B: 用 Lambda 函数扫描存储桶属于自定义轮询代码，需要编写、调度和维护，比原生事件规则费力。
  • D: Amazon MWAA 需要预置 Airflow 环境并编写 DAG，对一个简单触发来说运营开销过大。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Amazon EventBridge receives Amazon S3 object-created events and supports SageMaker Pipelines as a native rule target. A rule whose event pattern matches the upload starts the pipeline automatically with no code and no infrastructure to maintain, which is the LEAST operational effort.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: S3 Lifecycle rules only transition or expire objects between storage classes and cannot move data to an instance or start training.
  • B: A Lambda function that scans the bucket is custom polling code that must be written, scheduled, and maintained, which is more effort than a native event rule.
  • D: Amazon MWAA requires provisioning an Airflow environment and authoring DAGs, adding significant operational overhead for a simple trigger.

A company regularly receives new training data from the vendor of an ML model. The vendor delivers cleaned and prepared data to the company's Amazon S3 bucket every 3-4 days. The company has an Amazon SageMaker pipeline to retrain the model.An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to run the pipeline when new data is uploaded tothe S3 bucket.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?
contents.zh: 一家公司定期从机器学习模型的供应商那里接收新的训练数据。供应商每隔3 - 4天会将清理和准备好的数据传送到该公司的亚马逊S3存储桶中。该公司有一个亚马逊SageMaker管道用于重新训练模型。一位机器学习工程师需要实施一种解决方案，以便在新数据上传到S3存储桶时运行该管道。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营工作量满足这些要求？

questions.content:
An ML engineer is developing a fraud detection model by using the Amazon SageMaker XGBoost algorithm.The model classifies transactions as either fraudulent or legitimate. During testing,the model excels at identifying fraud inthe training dataset. However, the model is inefficient at identifying fraud in new and unseen transactions.

What should the ML engineer do to improve the fraud detection for new transactions?

options.label: A
options.content: Increase the learning rate.

contents.en: Increase the learning rate.
contents.zh: 提高学习率。

options.label: B
options.content: Remove some irelevant features from the training dataset.

contents.en: Remove some irelevant features from the training dataset.
contents.zh: 从训练数据集中移除一些不相关的特征。

options.label: C
options.content: Increase the value of the max_depth hyperparameter.

contents.en: Increase the value of the max_depth hyperparameter.
contents.zh: 增加最大深度（max_depth）超参数的值。

options.label: D
options.content: Decrease the value of the max_depth hyperparameter.

contents.en: Decrease the value of the max_depth hyperparameter.
contents.zh: 降低最大深度（max_depth）超参数的值。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：在训练数据上表现出色却在未见过的交易上表现不佳，是典型的过拟合。XGBoost 的 max_depth 控制每棵树能长多深，减小它可以限制模型复杂度，让树学习到一般性的欺诈模式而不是记住训练集，从而提升对新数据的泛化能力。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 提高学习率只会放大每一步提升的幅度，不能降低造成过拟合的模型复杂度，还可能让训练不稳定。
  • B: 去掉少量不相关特征并不能解决记住了训练数据的过深树的问题，也不是针对这种症状的主要手段。
  • C: 增大 max_depth 会让树更复杂，使过拟合更严重。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：在训练数据上表现出色却在未见过的交易上表现不佳，是典型的过拟合。XGBoost 的 max_depth 控制每棵树能长多深，减小它可以限制模型复杂度，让树学习到一般性的欺诈模式而不是记住训练集，从而提升对新数据的泛化能力。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 提高学习率只会放大每一步提升的幅度，不能降低造成过拟合的模型复杂度，还可能让训练不稳定。
  • B: 去掉少量不相关特征并不能解决记住了训练数据的过深树的问题，也不是针对这种症状的主要手段。
  • C: 增大 max_depth 会让树更复杂，使过拟合更严重。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Excellent results on the training data but poor results on unseen transactions indicate overfitting. In XGBoost, max_depth controls how deep each tree can grow; decreasing it limits model complexity so the trees capture general fraud patterns instead of memorizing the training set, which improves generalization to new data.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Increasing the learning rate makes each boosting step larger and does not reduce the complexity that causes overfitting; it can even destabilize training.
  • B: Removing a few irrelevant features does not address the deep trees that memorized the training data and is not the primary lever for this symptom.
  • C: Increasing max_depth makes the trees more complex and worsens overfitting.

An ML engineer is developing a fraud detection model by using the Amazon SageMaker XGBoost algorithm.The model classifies transactions as either fraudulent or legitimate. During testing,the model excels at identifying fraud inthe training dataset. However, the model is inefficient at identifying fraud in new and unseen transactions.

What should the ML engineer do to improve the fraud detection for new transactions?

questions.content:
A company has a binary classification model in production.An ML engineer needs to develop a new version of the model. The new model version must maximize correct predictions of positive labels and negative labels.The ML engineer must use a metric to recalibrate the model to meet these requirements.

Which metric should the MLengineer use for the model recalibration?

options.label: A
options.content: Accuracy

contents.en: Accuracy
contents.zh: 准确率（Accuracy）

options.label: B
options.content: Precision

contents.en: Precision
contents.zh: 精确率（Precision）

options.label: C
options.content: Recall

contents.en: Recall
contents.zh: 召回率（Recall）

options.label: D
options.content: Specificity

contents.en: Specificity
contents.zh: 特异度（Specificity）

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Accuracy（准确率）是所有预测中判断正确的比例，同时计入真正例和真负例。题目要求同时最大化正标签和负标签的正确预测，准确率正是直接度量这一目标的指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Precision 只衡量预测为正的样本中有多少真正为正，忽略了负类预测。
  • C: Recall 只衡量实际为正的样本中有多少被找出来，不涉及负标签。
  • D: Specificity 只衡量实际为负的样本中有多少被正确识别，忽略了正标签。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Accuracy（准确率）是所有预测中判断正确的比例，同时计入真正例和真负例。题目要求同时最大化正标签和负标签的正确预测，准确率正是直接度量这一目标的指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Precision 只衡量预测为正的样本中有多少真正为正，忽略了负类预测。
  • C: Recall 只衡量实际为正的样本中有多少被找出来，不涉及负标签。
  • D: Specificity 只衡量实际为负的样本中有多少被正确识别，忽略了正标签。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Accuracy is the proportion of all predictions that are correct, counting both true positives and true negatives. Because the requirement is to maximize correct predictions of both the positive and negative labels, accuracy is the metric that directly measures that goal.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Precision measures only how many predicted positives are truly positive and ignores negative predictions.
  • C: Recall measures only the share of actual positives that are found and says nothing about negative labels.
  • D: Specificity measures only the share of actual negatives that are correctly identified and ignores positive labels.

contents.en:
A company has a binary classification model in production.An ML engineer needs to develop a new version of the model. The new model version must maximize correct predictions of positive labels and negative labels.The ML engineer must use a metric to recalibrate the model to meet these requirements.

Which solution will meet these requirements with theLEAST development effort?

options.label: A
options.content: Create code to evaluate each instance's memory and compute usage.

options.content: Add cost allocation tags to the resources.Activate the tags in AWS Biling and Cost Management.

  • B: 成本分配标签只能在 AWS Billing and Cost Management 中对支出分类，不能识别低效资源，也不会生成建议。
  • C: AWS CloudTrail 记录的是谁在何时创建了资源，没有利用率数据或成本建议。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：AWS Compute Optimizer 会分析 Amazon EC2 实例、AWS Lambda 函数、Amazon ECS on Fargate 服务和 Amazon EBS 卷的利用率指标，并生成降低成本的合理调整建议。它是托管服务，覆盖题目中所有资源类型且无需编写代码，开发工作量最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

explanations.en:

It is a managed service that covers every resource type in the question with no code to write, which is the LEAST development effort.

  • B: Cost allocation tags only categorize spend in AWS Billing and Cost Management; they do not identify inefficient resources or produce recommendations.
  • C: AWS CloudTrail records who created resources and when; it has no utilization data or cost recommendations.

options.label: B
options.content: Create a new AWS account with a new ECR repository as the central catalog.Configure ECR cross-account replication between the initia ECR repositories and the central catalog.

contents.en: Create a new AWS account with a new ECR repository as the central catalog.Configure ECR cross-account replication between the initia ECR repositories and the central catalog.

options.label: C
options.content: Use the Amazon SageMaker Model Registry to create a model group for models hosted in Amazon ECR.Create a new AWS account.In the new account, use the SageMaker Model Registry as the central catalog.Attach a croSS- account resource policy to each model group inl the initial AWS accounts.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Amazon SageMaker Model Registry 以模型组中带版本的模型包来编目模型，包括推理容器存放在 Amazon ECR 中的模型。在专用账户中使用 Model Registry，并为原始账户中的每个模型组附加跨账户资源策略，就能形成一个包含模型元数据、版本和审批状态的跨账户中央目录。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 把镜像复制到一个中央 ECR 存储库只是集中了镜像，ECR 是镜像仓库，不是带版本、元数据和审批流程的模型目录。
  • D: AWS Glue Data Catalog 存储的是表和 schema 元数据，Glue 爬虫无法爬取 ECR 存储库，也不能存储模型。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Amazon SageMaker Model Registry 以模型组中带版本的模型包来编目模型，包括推理容器存放在 Amazon ECR 中的模型。在专用账户中使用 Model Registry，并为原始账户中的每个模型组附加跨账户资源策略，就能形成一个包含模型元数据、版本和审批状态的跨账户中央目录。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: ECR 跨账户复制会把容器镜像复制到每个账户，形成的是重复镜像而不是单一中央目录。
  • B: 把镜像复制到一个中央 ECR 存储库只是集中了镜像，ECR 是镜像仓库，不是带版本、元数据和审批流程的模型目录。
  • D: AWS Glue Data Catalog 存储的是表和 schema 元数据，Glue 爬虫无法爬取 ECR 存储库，也不能存储模型。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Amazon SageMaker Model Registry catalogs models as versioned model packages within model groups, including models whose inference containers are stored in Amazon ECR. Placing the registry in a dedicated account and attaching cross-account resource policies to the model groups in the originating accounts makes the registry a central catalog with model metadata, versions, and approval status across accounts.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: ECR cross-account replication copies container images into every account; it creates duplicated images rather than a single central catalog.
  • B: Replicating images into one central ECR repository consolidates images, but ECR is an image store, not a model catalog with versions, metadata, and an approval workflow.
  • D: The AWS Glue Data Catalog stores table and schema metadata; Glue crawlers cannot crawl ECR repositories or store models.

questions.content:
A company has developed a new MLmodel.The company requires online model validation on 10? the traffic before the company fully releases the model in production.The company uses an Amazon SageMaker endpoint behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB)to serve the model.

Which solution will set up the required online validation with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Use production variants to add the new model to the existing SageMaker endpoint. Set the variant weight to 0.1 for the new model. Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch.

contents.en: Use production variants to add the new model to the existing SageMaker endpoint. Set the variant weight to 0.1 for the new model. Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch.
contents.zh: 使用生产变体将新模型添加到现有的SageMaker端点。将新模型的变体权重设置为0.1。通过亚马逊CloudWatch监控调用次数。

options.label: B
options.content: Use production variants to add the new model tothe existing SageMaker endpoint. Set the variant weight to 1 for the new model. Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch.

contents.en: Use production variants to add the new model tothe existing SageMaker endpoint. Set the variant weight to 1 for the new model. Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch.
contents.zh: 使用生产变体将新模型添加到现有的SageMaker端点。将新模型的变体权重设置为1。通过亚马逊CloudWatch监控调用次数。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a new SageMaker endpoint. Use production variants to add the new model to the new endpoint.Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch.

contents.en: Create a new SageMaker endpoint. Use production variants to add the new model to the new endpoint.Monitor the number of invocations by using Amazon CloudWatch.
contents.zh: 创建一个新的SageMaker端点。使用生产变体将新模型添加到新端点。通过亚马逊CloudWatch监控调用次数。

options.label: D
options.content: Configure the ALB to route 10% the traffic to the new model at the existing SageMaker endpoint.Monitor the number of invocations by using AWS CloudTrail.

contents.en: Configure the ALB to route 10% the traffic to the new model at the existing SageMaker endpoint.Monitor the number of invocations by using AWS CloudTrail.
contents.zh: 配置ALB将10%的流量路由到现有SageMaker端点上的新模型。通过AWS CloudTrail监控调用次数。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker 生产变体允许多个模型共享同一个端点，并按变体权重的相对比例分配流量。把新模型作为变体加入现有端点并将权重设为 0.1，相对现有变体即可把约 10% 的请求路由给它，Amazon CloudWatch 会按变体发布调用次数指标以供验证，整个过程无需改动端点、ALB 或客户端代码，运营开销最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 权重设为 1 会让新变体获得与现有变体相同份额的流量，而不是 10%。
  • C: 新建独立端点需要重新配置 ALB 和客户端来分流，还多了一个要运维的端点。
  • D: ALB 无法把流量定向到 SageMaker 端点内部的某个变体，而且 AWS CloudTrail 记录的是 API 调用而不是调用次数指标。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker 生产变体允许多个模型共享同一个端点，并按变体权重的相对比例分配流量。把新模型作为变体加入现有端点并将权重设为 0.1，相对现有变体即可把约 10% 的请求路由给它，Amazon CloudWatch 会按变体发布调用次数指标以供验证，整个过程无需改动端点、ALB 或客户端代码，运营开销最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 权重设为 1 会让新变体获得与现有变体相同份额的流量，而不是 10%。
  • C: 新建独立端点需要重新配置 ALB 和客户端来分流，还多了一个要运维的端点。
  • D: ALB 无法把流量定向到 SageMaker 端点内部的某个变体，而且 AWS CloudTrail 记录的是 API 调用而不是调用次数指标。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker production variants let multiple models share one endpoint, and traffic is split by the relative variant weights. Adding the new model as a variant with a weight of 0.1 against the existing variant routes about 10% of requests to it, and Amazon CloudWatch publishes per-variant invocation metrics for validation, all without changing the endpoint, the ALB, or client code, which is the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: A weight of 1 gives the new variant an equal share of traffic, not 10%.
  • C: A separate endpoint requires the ALB and clients to be reconfigured to split traffic and adds a second endpoint to operate.
  • D: An ALB cannot target an individual variant inside a SageMaker endpoint, and AWS CloudTrail logs API calls rather than invocation counts.

options.label: A
options.content: Image classification

contents.en: Image classification
contents.zh: 图像分类

options.label: B
options.content: XGBoost

contents.en: XGBoost
contents.zh: 极限梯度提升（XGBoost）

options.label: C
options.content: Object detection

contents.en: Object detection
contents.zh: 目标检测

options.label: D
options.content: K-nearest neighbors (k-NN)

contents.en: K-nearest neighbors (k-NN)
contents.zh: k近邻算法（k-NN）

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Amazon SageMaker 的 Object Detection 算法能识别图像中的物体，并为每个物体返回带类别和置信度的边界框，因此既能识别物品又能给出其位置。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Image Classification 只为整张图像打标签，不会返回物体的位置。
  • B: XGBoost 是面向表格数据的梯度提升树算法，不用于图像分析。
  • D: k-NN 基于数值特征向量做分类或回归，无法在图像中定位物体。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Amazon SageMaker 的 Object Detection 算法能识别图像中的物体，并为每个物体返回带类别和置信度的边界框，因此既能识别物品又能给出其位置。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Image Classification 只为整张图像打标签，不会返回物体的位置。
  • B: XGBoost 是面向表格数据的梯度提升树算法，不用于图像分析。
  • D: k-NN 基于数值特征向量做分类或回归，无法在图像中定位物体。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: The Amazon SageMaker Object Detection algorithm identifies objects in an image and returns a bounding box with a class and confidence score for each one, so it both recognizes the item and provides its location.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Image Classification assigns labels to the whole image and does not return the position of the object.
  • B: XGBoost is a gradient boosted tree algorithm for tabular data, not for image analysis.
  • D: k-NN classifies or regresses on numeric feature vectors and cannot localize an object within an image.

contents.zh: 按每种文件类型将数据分离到不同的文件夹中。使用DataBrew分别处理每个文件夹。将输出存储为AWS Glue Parquet格式。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：AWS Glue DataBrew 的数据集必须由同一种格式的文件组成，所以混在一起的 CSV、JSON、XLSX 和 Parquet 文件要先按类型拆分到各自的文件夹，再作为独立的 DataBrew 数据集和作业分别处理。输出写成 Apache Parquet 这种开放列式格式，AWS Glue 爬虫和作业可以直接读取。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: DataBrew 无法把同一文件夹中四种不同格式的文件当作一个数据集正确解析。
  • B: 同样是把混合文件夹当成一个数据集处理，而且 AWS Glue Parquet 是 Glue 专用的优化写入器，不是这里应选的标准交换格式。
  • D: 拆分文件夹的做法正确，但输出应当是 Glue 和其他消费者都能原生读取的标准 Apache Parquet，而不是 Glue 专用变体。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：AWS Glue DataBrew 的数据集必须由同一种格式的文件组成，所以混在一起的 CSV、JSON、XLSX 和 Parquet 文件要先按类型拆分到各自的文件夹，再作为独立的 DataBrew 数据集和作业分别处理。输出写成 Apache Parquet 这种开放列式格式，AWS Glue 爬虫和作业可以直接读取。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: DataBrew 无法把同一文件夹中四种不同格式的文件当作一个数据集正确解析。
  • B: 同样是把混合文件夹当成一个数据集处理，而且 AWS Glue Parquet 是 Glue 专用的优化写入器，不是这里应选的标准交换格式。
  • D: 拆分文件夹的做法正确，但输出应当是 Glue 和其他消费者都能原生读取的标准 Apache Parquet，而不是 Glue 专用变体。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: An AWS Glue DataBrew dataset must consist of files that share a single format, so the mixed CSV, JSON, XLSX, and Parquet files must first be separated into one folder per type and processed as separate DataBrew datasets and jobs. Writing the output as Apache Parquet produces an open columnar format that AWS Glue crawlers and jobs consume directly.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: DataBrew cannot correctly parse a single dataset that mixes four different file formats in one folder.
  • B: This also processes the mixed folder as one dataset, and AWS Glue Parquet is a Glue-specific optimized writer rather than the standard interchange format to target here.
  • D: Separating the folders is right, but the output should be standard Apache Parquet, the open format that Glue and other consumers read natively, not the Glue-specific variant.

contents.en: A company has an Amazon S3 bucket that contains 1 TB of files from different sources. The S3 bucket contains the following file types in the same S3 folder: CSV, JSON, XLSX, and Apache Parquet. An ML engineer must implement a solution that uses AWS Glue DataBrew to process the data. The ML engineer also must store the final output in Amazon S3 so that AWS Glue can consume the output in the future. Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh: 一家公司有一个亚马逊S3存储桶，其中包含来自不同来源的1太字节（TB）文件。该S3存储桶在同一个S3文件夹中包含以下文件类型：CSV、JSON、XLSX和Apache Parquet。一名机器学习工程师必须实施一个使用AWS Glue DataBrew来处理数据的解决方案。该机器学习工程师还必须将最终输出存储在亚马逊S3中，以便AWS Glue在未来能够使用这些输出。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

questions.content: A manufacturing company uses an ML model to determine whether products meet a standard for quality. The model produces an output of "Passed" or "Failed." Robots separate the products into the two categories by using the model to analyze photos on the assembly line. Which metrics should the company use to evaluate the model's performance? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.content: Precision and recall

contents.en: Precision and recall
contents.zh: 精确率和召回率

options.label: B
options.content: Root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE)

contents.en: Root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE)
contents.zh: 均方根误差（RMSE）和平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）

options.label: C
options.content: Accuracy and F1 score

contents.en: Accuracy and F1 score
contents.zh: 准确率和F1分数

options.label: D
options.content: Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) score

contents.en: Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) score
contents.zh: 双语评估辅助（BLEU）分数

options.label: E
options.content: Perplexity

contents.en: Perplexity
contents.zh: 困惑度

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A、C：该模型执行的是二分类，把每件产品标记为通过或失败。Precision 和 recall 分别衡量预测为失败的产品中有多少确实不合格、以及实际不合格的产品有多少被找出；accuracy 和 F1 score 则概括整体正确率以及精确率与召回率的平衡，这些都是评估分类模型的恰当指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: RMSE 和 MAPE 衡量回归与预测任务的数值误差，不适用于类别预测。
  • D: BLEU 用于对照参考文本评估机器翻译和文本生成质量。
  • E: Perplexity 评估语言模型预测词元序列的能力，不适用于分类器。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A、C：该模型执行的是二分类，把每件产品标记为通过或失败。Precision 和 recall 分别衡量预测为失败的产品中有多少确实不合格、以及实际不合格的产品有多少被找出；accuracy 和 F1 score 则概括整体正确率以及精确率与召回率的平衡，这些都是评估分类模型的恰当指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: RMSE 和 MAPE 衡量回归与预测任务的数值误差，不适用于类别预测。
  • D: BLEU 用于对照参考文本评估机器翻译和文本生成质量。
  • E: Perplexity 评估语言模型预测词元序列的能力，不适用于分类器。
explanations.en:
Correct answers A and C: The model performs binary classification, labeling each product as Passed or Failed. Precision and recall measure how many predicted failures are real and how many real failures are caught, while accuracy and F1 score summarize overall correctness and the balance between precision and recall, so these are the appropriate classification metrics.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: RMSE and MAPE measure numeric error for regression and forecasting, not categorical predictions.
  • D: BLEU scores machine translation and text generation quality against reference text.
  • E: Perplexity evaluates how well a language model predicts token sequences and does not apply to a classifier.

contents.en: A manufacturing company uses an ML model to determine whether products meet a standard for quality. The model produces an output of "Passed" or "Failed." Robots separate the products into the two categories by using the model to analyze photos on the assembly line. Which metrics should the company use to evaluate the model's performance? (Choose two.)
contents.zh: 一家制造公司使用一个机器学习模型来判断产品是否符合质量标准。该模型输出“通过”或“失败”。机器人通过使用该模型分析装配线上的照片，将产品分为这两类。该公司应该使用哪些指标来评估模型的性能？（选择两项）

questions.content: An ML engineer needs to encrypt all data in transit when an ML training job runs. The ML engineer must ensure that encryption in transit is applied to processes that Amazon SageMaker uses during the training job. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Encrypt communication between nodes for batch processing.

contents.en: Encrypt communication between nodes for batch processing.
contents.zh: 对用于批处理的节点之间的通信进行加密。

options.label: B
options.content: Encrypt communication between nodes in a training cluster.

contents.en: Encrypt communication between nodes in a training cluster.
contents.zh: 对训练集群中节点之间的通信进行加密。

options.label: C
options.content: Specify an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key during creation of the training job request.

contents.en: Specify an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key during creation of the training job request.
contents.zh: 在创建训练作业请求期间指定一个AWS密钥管理服务（AWS KMS）密钥。

options.label: D
options.content: Specify an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key during creation of the SageMaker domain.

contents.en: Specify an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key during creation of the SageMaker domain.
contents.zh: 在创建SageMaker域期间指定一个AWS密钥管理服务（AWS KMS）密钥。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：在分布式训练作业中，SageMaker 会在训练集群的节点之间传输数据。为训练作业启用容器间流量加密可以对这些节点间通信进行传输中加密，这正是覆盖 SageMaker 在训练过程中自身所用进程的设置。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 批处理节点指的是 batch transform 推理，而不是训练作业所使用的进程。
  • C: 在训练作业请求中指定 KMS 密钥加密的是 ML 存储卷和输出工件的静态数据，而不是传输中的数据。
  • D: 在 SageMaker 域上指定 KMS 密钥加密的是 Studio 的 EFS 卷静态数据，对训练流量没有影响。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：在分布式训练作业中，SageMaker 会在训练集群的节点之间传输数据。为训练作业启用容器间流量加密可以对这些节点间通信进行传输中加密，这正是覆盖 SageMaker 在训练过程中自身所用进程的设置。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 批处理节点指的是 batch transform 推理，而不是训练作业所使用的进程。
  • C: 在训练作业请求中指定 KMS 密钥加密的是 ML 存储卷和输出工件的静态数据，而不是传输中的数据。
  • D: 在 SageMaker 域上指定 KMS 密钥加密的是 Studio 的 EFS 卷静态数据，对训练流量没有影响。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: During a distributed training job, SageMaker moves data between the nodes of the training cluster. Enabling inter-container traffic encryption for the training job encrypts this node-to-node communication in transit, which is the setting that covers the processes SageMaker itself uses while training.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Batch processing nodes refer to batch transform inference, not the processes used by a training job.
  • C: A KMS key on the training job request encrypts the ML storage volumes and output artifacts at rest, not data in transit.
  • D: A KMS key on the SageMaker domain encrypts the Studio EFS volume at rest and has no effect on training traffic.

contents.en: An ML engineer needs to encrypt all data in transit when an ML training job runs. The ML engineer must ensure that encryption in transit is applied to processes that Amazon SageMaker uses during the training job. Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh: 一名机器学习工程师需要在机器学习训练作业运行时对所有传输中的数据进行加密。该机器学习工程师必须确保对亚马逊SageMaker在训练作业期间使用的进程应用传输中加密。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

questions.content: An ML engineer needs to use metrics to assess the quality of a time-series forecasting model. Which metrics apply to this model? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.content: Recall

contents.en: Recall
contents.zh: 召回率

options.label: B
options.content: LogLoss

contents.en: LogLoss
contents.zh: 对数损失（LogLoss）

options.label: C
options.content: Root mean square error (RMSE)

contents.en: Root mean square error (RMSE)
contents.zh: 均方根误差（RMSE）

options.label: D
options.content: InferenceLatency

contents.en: InferenceLatency
contents.zh: 推理延迟（InferenceLatency）

options.label: E
options.content: Average weighted quantile loss (wQL)

contents.en: Average weighted quantile loss (wQL)
contents.zh: 平均加权分位数损失（wQL）

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C、E：时间序列预测输出的是连续数值，其质量要用误差指标来衡量。Root mean square error (RMSE) 量化点预测误差的平均幅度，average weighted quantile loss (wQL) 评估概率预测在指定分位数上的准确性，也是 Amazon Forecast 和 SageMaker Canvas 为预测模型报告的指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Recall 是统计检出正例数量的分类指标，不适用于数值预测。
  • B: LogLoss 评估的是分类任务中预测的类别概率，而不是预测值。
  • D: InferenceLatency 衡量返回预测的速度，是运行指标，与预测质量无关。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C、E：时间序列预测输出的是连续数值，其质量要用误差指标来衡量。Root mean square error (RMSE) 量化点预测误差的平均幅度，average weighted quantile loss (wQL) 评估概率预测在指定分位数上的准确性，也是 Amazon Forecast 和 SageMaker Canvas 为预测模型报告的指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Recall 是统计检出正例数量的分类指标，不适用于数值预测。
  • B: LogLoss 评估的是分类任务中预测的类别概率，而不是预测值。
  • D: InferenceLatency 衡量返回预测的速度，是运行指标，与预测质量无关。
explanations.en:
Correct answers C and E: Time-series forecasting predicts continuous values, so its quality is measured with error metrics. Root mean square error (RMSE) quantifies the average magnitude of point-forecast errors, and average weighted quantile loss (wQL) evaluates the accuracy of probabilistic forecasts at specified quantiles, the metric Amazon Forecast and SageMaker Canvas report for forecasting models.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Recall is a classification metric that counts detected positives and does not apply to numeric forecasts.
  • B: LogLoss scores predicted class probabilities for classification, not forecast values.
  • D: InferenceLatency measures how quickly predictions are returned, an operational metric that says nothing about forecast quality.

contents.en: An ML engineer needs to use metrics to assess the quality of a time-series forecasting model. Which metrics apply to this model? (Choose two.)
contents.zh: 一名机器学习工程师需要使用指标来评估时间序列预测模型的质量。哪些指标适用于这个模型？（选择两项）

questions.content: A company runs Amazon SageMaker ML models that use accelerated instances. The models require real-time responses. Each model has different scaling requirements. The company must not allow a cold start for the models. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint for each model. Use provisioned concurrency for the endpoints.

contents.en: Create a SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint for each model. Use provisioned concurrency for the endpoints.
contents.zh: 为每个模型创建一个SageMaker无服务器推理终端节点。为这些终端节点使用预配置的并发。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint for each model. Create an auto scaling policy for each endpoint.

contents.en: Create a SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint for each model. Create an auto scaling policy for each endpoint.
contents.zh: 为每个模型创建一个SageMaker异步推理终端节点。为每个终端节点创建一个自动缩放策略。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a SageMaker endpoint. Create an inference component for each model. In the inference component settings, specify the newly created endpoint. Create an auto scaling policy for each inference component. Set the parameter for the minimum number of copies to at least 1.

contents.en: Create a SageMaker endpoint. Create an inference component for each model. In the inference component settings, specify the newly created endpoint. Create an auto scaling policy for each inference component. Set the parameter for the minimum number of copies to at least 1.
contents.zh: 创建一个SageMaker终端节点。为每个模型创建一个推理组件。在推理组件设置中，指定新创建的终端节点。为每个推理组件创建一个自动缩放策略。将最小副本数量参数设置为至少1。

options.label: D
options.content: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Store all the model artifacts in the S3 bucket. Create a SageMaker multi-model endpoint. Point the endpoint to the S3 bucket. Create an auto scaling policy for the endpoint. Set the parameter for the minimum number of copies to at least 1.

contents.en: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Store all the model artifacts in the S3 bucket. Create a SageMaker multi-model endpoint. Point the endpoint to the S3 bucket. Create an auto scaling policy for the endpoint. Set the parameter for the minimum number of copies to at least 1.
contents.zh: 创建一个亚马逊S3存储桶。将所有模型工件存储在该S3存储桶中。创建一个SageMaker多模型终端节点。将该终端节点指向S3存储桶。为该终端节点创建一个自动缩放策略。将最小副本数量参数设置为至少1。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker 推理组件允许多个模型共享一个运行在加速实例上的实时端点，而每个组件都有自己的副本、资源和自动扩缩策略，满足各模型不同的扩缩要求。把最小副本数设为至少 1，可以让每个模型始终保持加载状态，任何请求都不会遇到冷启动。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Serverless Inference 只运行在 CPU 上，不支持加速实例。
  • B: Asynchronous Inference 把请求排队并稍后返回结果，无法提供实时响应。
  • D: 多模型端点按需从 Amazon S3 加载模型，未在内存中的模型会产生冷启动延迟，而且它按整个端点而不是按模型扩缩。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker 推理组件允许多个模型共享一个运行在加速实例上的实时端点，而每个组件都有自己的副本、资源和自动扩缩策略，满足各模型不同的扩缩要求。把最小副本数设为至少 1，可以让每个模型始终保持加载状态，任何请求都不会遇到冷启动。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Serverless Inference 只运行在 CPU 上，不支持加速实例。
  • B: Asynchronous Inference 把请求排队并稍后返回结果，无法提供实时响应。
  • D: 多模型端点按需从 Amazon S3 加载模型，未在内存中的模型会产生冷启动延迟，而且它按整个端点而不是按模型扩缩。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: SageMaker inference components let several models share one real-time endpoint on accelerated instances while each component has its own copies, resources, and auto scaling policy, satisfying the different scaling requirements per model. Setting the minimum copy count to at least 1 keeps every model loaded at all times, so no request encounters a cold start.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SageMaker Serverless Inference runs on CPU only and does not support accelerated instances.
  • B: Asynchronous Inference queues requests and returns results later, so it does not deliver real-time responses.
  • D: A multi-model endpoint loads models from Amazon S3 on demand, which causes cold-start latency for models not in memory, and it scales the whole endpoint rather than each model.

contents.zh: 一家公司运行使用加速实例的亚马逊SageMaker机器学习模型。这些模型需要实时响应。每个模型都有不同的缩放要求。该公司不允许模型出现冷启动情况。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

questions.content: A company uses Amazon SageMaker for its ML process. A compliance audit discovers that an Amazon S3 bucket for training data uses server-side encryption with S3 managed keys (SSE-S3). The company requires customer managed keys. An ML engineer changes the S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). The ML engineer makes no other configuration changes. After the change to the encryption settings, SageMaker training jobs start to fail with AccessDenied errors. What should the ML engineer do to resolve this problem?

options.label: A
options.content: Update the IAM policy that is attached to the execution role for the training jobs. Include the s3:ListBucket and s3:GetObject permissions.

contents.en: Update the IAM policy that is attached to the execution role for the training jobs. Include the s3:ListBucket and s3:GetObject permissions.
contents.zh: 更新附加到训练作业执行角色的IAM策略。包括s3:ListBucket和s3:GetObject权限。

options.label: B
options.content: Update the S3 bucket policy that is attached to the S3 bucket. Set the value of the aws:SecureTransport condition key to True.

contents.en: Update the S3 bucket policy that is attached to the S3 bucket. Set the value of the aws:SecureTransport condition key to True.
contents.zh: 更新附加到S3存储桶的S3存储桶策略。将aws:SecureTransport条件键的值设置为True。

options.label: C
options.content: Update the IAM policy that is attached to the execution role for the training jobs. Include the kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt permissions.

contents.en: Update the IAM policy that is attached to the execution role for the training jobs. Include the kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt permissions.
contents.zh: 更新附加到训练作业执行角色的IAM策略。包括kms:Encrypt和kms:Decrypt权限。

options.label: D
options.content: Update the IAM policy that is attached to the user that created the training jobs. Include the kms:CreateGrant permission.

contents.en: Update the IAM policy that is attached to the user that created the training jobs. Include the kms:CreateGrant permission.
contents.zh: 更新附加到创建训练作业的用户的IAM策略。包括kms:CreateGrant权限。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：使用 SSE-KMS 后，每次读取对象都需要调用方用客户托管密钥解密数据密钥，每次写入都需要加密。训练作业以 SageMaker 执行角色运行，此前在 SSE-S3 下只需要 S3 权限，因此为执行角色添加针对该密钥的 kms:Decrypt 和 kms:Encrypt（以及 kms:GenerateDataKey 等相关权限）即可解决 AccessDenied 错误。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 加密更改之前作业能正常运行，说明角色已经具备 S3 权限，失败出在 KMS 而不是 S3。
  • B: aws:SecureTransport 条件用于强制 HTTPS，与密钥权限无关。
  • D: 训练作业使用执行角色而不是用户身份访问数据，而且 S3 SSE-KMS 读取所需的并不是 kms:CreateGrant。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：使用 SSE-KMS 后，每次读取对象都需要调用方用客户托管密钥解密数据密钥，每次写入都需要加密。训练作业以 SageMaker 执行角色运行，此前在 SSE-S3 下只需要 S3 权限，因此为执行角色添加针对该密钥的 kms:Decrypt 和 kms:Encrypt（以及 kms:GenerateDataKey 等相关权限）即可解决 AccessDenied 错误。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 加密更改之前作业能正常运行，说明角色已经具备 S3 权限，失败出在 KMS 而不是 S3。
  • B: aws:SecureTransport 条件用于强制 HTTPS，与密钥权限无关。
  • D: 训练作业使用执行角色而不是用户身份访问数据，而且 S3 SSE-KMS 读取所需的并不是 kms:CreateGrant。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: With SSE-KMS, every read of an object requires the caller to decrypt the data key with the customer managed key, and every write requires encrypting it. The training jobs run under the SageMaker execution role, which previously needed only S3 permissions under SSE-S3, so adding kms:Decrypt and kms:Encrypt (with related permissions such as kms:GenerateDataKey) for that key to the execution role resolves the AccessDenied errors.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: The role already had the S3 permissions because the jobs worked before the encryption change; the failure is on KMS, not S3.
  • B: The aws:SecureTransport condition enforces HTTPS and is unrelated to key permissions.
  • D: The training job accesses the data with the execution role, not the user's identity, and kms:CreateGrant is not what S3 SSE-KMS reads require.

contents.en: A company uses Amazon SageMaker for its ML process. A compliance audit discovers that an Amazon S3 bucket for training data uses server-side encryption with S3 managed keys (SSE-S3). The company requires customer managed keys. An ML engineer changes the S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). The ML engineer makes no other configuration changes. After the change to the encryption settings, SageMaker training jobs start to fail with AccessDenied errors. What should the ML engineer do to resolve this problem?

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Amazon Athena 是无服务器交互式查询服务，可直接用标准 SQL 查询存放在 Amazon S3 中的数据，因此是用于探索和分析历史交易数据的服务。本组题中每个服务各用一次：Amazon S3 存储数据，AWS Glue 转换数据，Athena 查询数据。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: AWS Glue 是用于转换和编目数据的 ETL 服务，不是交互式查询工具。
  • C: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 用于摄取实时流数据，处理静态历史数据时用不到。
  • D: Amazon S3 是存放数据的对象存储，自身不执行查询。

explanations.zh:

  • C: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 用于摄取实时流数据，处理静态历史数据时用不到。
  • D: Amazon S3 是存放数据的对象存储，自身不执行查询。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Amazon Athena is a serverless, interactive query service that runs standard SQL directly on data stored in Amazon S3, making it the service for exploring and analyzing the historical transaction data. Each service is used once in this set: Amazon S3 stores the data, AWS Glue transforms it, and Athena queries it.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: AWS Glue is the ETL service for transforming and cataloging data, not an interactive query tool.
  • C: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams ingests real-time streaming data and is not needed for historical data at rest.
  • D: Amazon S3 is object storage for the data and does not execute queries on its own.

questions.content: A company deployed an ML model that uses the XGBoost algorithm to predict product failures. The model is hosted on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint and is trained on normal operating data. An AWS Lambda function provides the predictions to the company's application. An ML engineer must implement a solution that uses incoming live data to detect decreased model accuracy over time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon CloudWatch to create a dashboard that monitors real-time inference data and model predictions. Use the dashboard to detect drift.

contents.en: Use Amazon CloudWatch to create a dashboard that monitors real-time inference data and model predictions. Use the dashboard to detect drift.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊CloudWatch创建一个监控实时推理数据和模型预测的仪表板。使用该仪表板检测漂移。

options.label: B
options.content: Modify the Lambda function to calculate model drift by using real-time inference data and model predictions. Program the Lambda function to send alerts.

contents.en: Modify the Lambda function to calculate model drift by using real-time inference data and model predictions. Program the Lambda function to send alerts.
contents.zh: 修改Lambda函数，通过使用实时推理数据和模型预测来计算模型漂移。对Lambda函数进行编程以发送警报。

options.label: C
options.content: Schedule a monitoring job in SageMaker Model Monitor. Use the job to detect drift by analyzing the live data against a baseline of the training data statistics and constraints.

contents.en: Schedule a monitoring job in SageMaker Model Monitor. Use the job to detect drift by analyzing the live data against a baseline of the training data statistics and constraints.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker模型监控器中安排一个监控作业。使用该作业通过将实时数据与训练数据统计信息和约束的基线进行对比来检测漂移。

options.label: D
options.content: Schedule a monitoring job in SageMaker Debugger. Use the job to detect drift by analyzing the live data against a baseline of the training data statistics and constraints.

contents.en: Schedule a monitoring job in SageMaker Debugger. Use the job to detect drift by analyzing the live data against a baseline of the training data statistics and constraints.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker调试器中安排一个监控作业。使用该作业通过将实时数据与训练数据统计信息和约束的基线进行对比来检测漂移。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Model Monitor 捕获端点的实时请求和预测，并按计划运行监控作业，把它们与基于训练数据生成的统计信息和约束基线进行比较。发现的违规项揭示了会随时间降低模型准确性的数据漂移，并可触发 Amazon CloudWatch 告警，整个过程都是托管能力。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CloudWatch 仪表板只能可视化指标，无法对照训练基线计算漂移。
  • B: 在 Lambda 函数中实现漂移检测意味着自定义统计代码，会给推理路径增加延迟和维护负担。
  • D: SageMaker Debugger 检查训练作业期间的张量和资源利用率，不监控已部署的端点。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Model Monitor 捕获端点的实时请求和预测，并按计划运行监控作业，把它们与基于训练数据生成的统计信息和约束基线进行比较。发现的违规项揭示了会随时间降低模型准确性的数据漂移，并可触发 Amazon CloudWatch 告警，整个过程都是托管能力。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CloudWatch 仪表板只能可视化指标，无法对照训练基线计算漂移。
  • B: 在 Lambda 函数中实现漂移检测意味着自定义统计代码，会给推理路径增加延迟和维护负担。
  • D: SageMaker Debugger 检查训练作业期间的张量和资源利用率，不监控已部署的端点。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: SageMaker Model Monitor captures the live requests and predictions from the endpoint and runs scheduled monitoring jobs that compare them with a baseline of statistics and constraints generated from the training data. Violations reveal data drift that degrades model accuracy over time and can raise Amazon CloudWatch alerts, all as a managed capability.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A CloudWatch dashboard visualizes metrics but cannot compute drift against a training baseline.
  • B: Building drift detection into the Lambda function means custom statistical code that adds latency and maintenance to the inference path.
  • D: SageMaker Debugger inspects tensors and resource utilization during training jobs; it does not monitor deployed endpoints.

Which solution will provide this level of analysis?

options.content: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor network metrics and CPU metrics for resource optimization during model training.

contents.en: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor network metrics and CPU metrics for resource optimization during model training.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊CloudWatch监控网络指标和CPU指标，以便在模型训练期间进行资源优化。

options.label: B
options.content: Create AWS Glue DataBrew recipes to correct the data based on statistics from the model output.

contents.en: Create AWS Glue DataBrew recipes to correct the data based on statistics from the model output.
contents.zh: 创建AWS Glue DataBrew配方，根据模型输出的统计信息来纠正数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Clarify to evaluate the model and training data for underlying patterns that might affect accuracy.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Clarify to evaluate the model and training data for underlying patterns that might affect accuracy.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Clarify评估模型和训练数据，以查找可能影响准确性的潜在模式。

options.label: D

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Amazon SageMaker Clarify 可以针对人口统计群体等分面，在输入数据上计算训练前偏差指标，在模型预测上计算训练后偏差指标，并提供解释预测的特征归因。这正是发现会在不同人群间扭曲模型表现的趋势所需要的分析。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CloudWatch 的网络和 CPU 指标关注的是基础设施利用率，而不是数据或预测中的偏差。
  • B: DataBrew 配方用于转换数据，不会分析预测结果在人群间的偏差。
  • D: Lambda 预处理只能标准化输入，无法评估预测在不同群体间的差异。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Amazon SageMaker Clarify 可以针对人口统计群体等分面，在输入数据上计算训练前偏差指标，在模型预测上计算训练后偏差指标，并提供解释预测的特征归因。这正是发现会在不同人群间扭曲模型表现的趋势所需要的分析。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CloudWatch 的网络和 CPU 指标关注的是基础设施利用率，而不是数据或预测中的偏差。
  • B: DataBrew 配方用于转换数据，不会分析预测结果在人群间的偏差。
  • D: Lambda 预处理只能标准化输入，无法评估预测在不同群体间的差异。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Amazon SageMaker Clarify computes pre-training bias metrics on the input data and post-training bias metrics on the model predictions across facets such as demographic groups, and it provides feature attributions that explain the predictions. This is exactly the analysis needed to find trends that skew performance across demographics.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: CloudWatch network and CPU metrics concern infrastructure utilization, not bias in data or predictions.
  • B: DataBrew recipes transform data; they do not analyze predictions for demographic bias.
  • D: Lambda preprocessing standardizes inputs but provides no evaluation of how predictions vary across groups.
