questions.content: A company uses 10 Reserved Instances of accelerated instance types to serve the current version of an ML model. An ML engineer needs to deploy a new version of the model to an Amazon SageMaker real-time inference endpoint. The solution must use the original 10 instances to serve both versions of the model. The solution also must include one additional Reserved Instance that is available to use in the deployment process. The transition between versions must occur with no downtime or service interruptions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure a blue/green deployment with all-at-once traffic shifting.

contents.en: Configure a blue/green deployment with all-at-once traffic shifting.
contents.zh: 配置具有一次性流量转移的蓝绿部署。

options.label: B
options.content: Configure a blue/green deployment with canary traffic shifting and a size of 10%.

contents.en: Configure a blue/green deployment with canary traffic shifting and a size of 10%.
contents.zh: 配置具有10%金丝雀流量转移的蓝绿部署。

options.label: C
options.content: Configure a shadow test with a traffic sampling percentage of 10%.

contents.en: Configure a shadow test with a traffic sampling percentage of 10%.
contents.zh: 配置流量采样百分比为10%的影子测试。

options.label: D
options.content: Configure a rolling deployment with a rolling batch size of 1.

contents.en: Configure a rolling deployment with a rolling batch size of 1.
contents.zh: 配置滚动批次大小为1的滚动部署。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 滚动部署按批次更新端点：先预置一批新版本实例，把流量切换过去，再终止相同数量的旧实例。批次大小为 1 时，任一时刻只需要一个额外实例，因此原来的 10 个预留实例在过渡期间同时服务两个版本，第 11 个预留实例承担额外容量，流量始终不中断。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 蓝绿部署会在一次性切换流量之前预置一整套 10 个实例的新集群，超出了只有一个额外实例的限制。
  • B: 金丝雀切换同样要求完整的绿色集群与蓝色集群并存，只有流量比例是渐进的。
  • C: 影子测试把流量副本发送到运行在独立实例上的影子变体做对比，并不会把生产流量过渡到新版本。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 滚动部署按批次更新端点：先预置一批新版本实例，把流量切换过去，再终止相同数量的旧实例。批次大小为 1 时，任一时刻只需要一个额外实例，因此原来的 10 个预留实例在过渡期间同时服务两个版本，第 11 个预留实例承担额外容量，流量始终不中断。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 蓝绿部署会在一次性切换流量之前预置一整套 10 个实例的新集群，超出了只有一个额外实例的限制。
  • B: 金丝雀切换同样要求完整的绿色集群与蓝色集群并存，只有流量比例是渐进的。
  • C: 影子测试把流量副本发送到运行在独立实例上的影子变体做对比，并不会把生产流量过渡到新版本。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: A SageMaker rolling deployment updates the endpoint in batches, provisioning a batch of new-version instances, shifting traffic to them, then terminating the same number of old instances. With a batch size of 1, only one extra instance is needed at any moment, so the 10 Reserved Instances serve both versions during the transition, the eleventh Reserved Instance absorbs the extra capacity, and traffic never drops.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Blue/green deployments provision a full second fleet of 10 instances before shifting all traffic at once, which exceeds the single additional instance.
  • B: Canary shifting still requires the complete green fleet to exist alongside the blue fleet; only the traffic percentage is gradual.
  • C: A shadow test sends a copy of traffic to a shadow variant on its own instances for comparison and does not transition production traffic to the new version.

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) for message delivery.

contents.en: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) for message delivery.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊CloudWatch监控性能指标。使用亚马逊简单队列服务（Amazon SQS）进行消息传递。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) for message delivery.

contents.en: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) for message delivery.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊CloudWatch监控性能指标。使用亚马逊简单通知服务（Amazon SNS）进行消息传递。

options.label: C

options.label: D

contents.en: Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor performance metrics. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) for message delivery.
contents.zh: 使用AWS CloudTrail监控性能指标。使用亚马逊简单通知服务（Amazon SNS）进行消息传递。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker 训练作业会把算法指标和系统指标发布到 Amazon CloudWatch，工程师可以在其中比较不同超参数的训练运行。Amazon SNS 支持 SMS 作为投递协议，因此在训练完成时通过 CloudWatch 或 EventBridge 触发通知即可给工程师发送短信。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon SQS 是用于解耦应用的消息队列，无法发送 SMS 短信。
  • C: AWS CloudTrail 记录 API 调用用于审计，不提供训练性能指标，而且 SQS 不能发送短信。
  • D: 尽管 SNS 可以发送短信，但 CloudTrail 并不采集训练指标。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker 训练作业会把算法指标和系统指标发布到 Amazon CloudWatch，工程师可以在其中比较不同超参数的训练运行。Amazon SNS 支持 SMS 作为投递协议，因此在训练完成时通过 CloudWatch 或 EventBridge 触发通知即可给工程师发送短信。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon SQS 是用于解耦应用的消息队列，无法发送 SMS 短信。
  • C: AWS CloudTrail 记录 API 调用用于审计，不提供训练性能指标，而且 SQS 不能发送短信。
  • D: 尽管 SNS 可以发送短信，但 CloudTrail 并不采集训练指标。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: SageMaker training jobs publish algorithm and system metrics to Amazon CloudWatch, where engineers can compare runs with different hyperparameters. Amazon SNS supports SMS as a delivery protocol, so a CloudWatch or EventBridge notification on training completion can text the engineers.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon SQS is a message queue for decoupling applications and cannot deliver SMS text messages.
  • C: AWS CloudTrail records API calls for auditing, not training performance metrics, and SQS cannot send SMS.
  • D: CloudTrail does not capture training metrics even though SNS could deliver the SMS.

questions.content: A company is working on an ML project that will include Amazon SageMaker notebook instances. An ML engineer must ensure that the SageMaker notebook instances do not allow root access. Which solution will prevent the deployment of notebook instances that allow root access?

options.label: A
options.content: Use IAM condition keys to stop deployments of SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.

contents.en: Use IAM condition keys to stop deployments of SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.
contents.zh: 使用IAM条件键来阻止部署允许root访问的SageMaker笔记本实例。

options.label: B
options.content: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to stop deployments of SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.

contents.en: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to stop deployments of SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.
contents.zh: 使用AWS密钥管理服务（AWS KMS）密钥来阻止部署允许root访问的SageMaker笔记本实例。

options.label: C
options.content: Monitor resource creation by using Amazon EventBridge events. Create an AWS Lambda function that deletes all deployed SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.

contents.en: Monitor resource creation by using Amazon EventBridge events. Create an AWS Lambda function that deletes all deployed SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊EventBridge事件监控资源创建情况。创建一个AWS Lambda函数，删除所有已部署的允许root访问的SageMaker笔记本实例。

options.label: D
options.content: Monitor resource creation by using AWS CloudFormation events. Create an AWS Lambda function that deletes all deployed SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.

contents.en: Monitor resource creation by using AWS CloudFormation events. Create an AWS Lambda function that deletes all deployed SageMaker notebook instances that allow root access.
contents.zh: 使用AWS CloudFormation事件监控资源创建情况。创建一个AWS Lambda函数，删除所有已部署的允许root访问的SageMaker笔记本实例。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：IAM 为 CreateNotebookInstance 操作提供了 sagemaker:RootAccess 条件键。编写一条在该键为 Enabled 时拒绝该操作的策略，就能阻止任何创建允许 root 访问的笔记本实例的尝试，是在部署前预防而不是事后补救。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: AWS KMS 密钥用于加密笔记本存储卷，无法控制 root 访问设置。
  • C: 在 EventBridge 报告创建事件后再删除实例属于事后响应，不合规的实例已经先被部署了。
  • D: CloudFormation 事件只覆盖通过 CloudFormation 创建的堆栈，而且事后删除并不能阻止部署。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：IAM 为 CreateNotebookInstance 操作提供了 sagemaker:RootAccess 条件键。编写一条在该键为 Enabled 时拒绝该操作的策略，就能阻止任何创建允许 root 访问的笔记本实例的尝试，是在部署前预防而不是事后补救。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: AWS KMS 密钥用于加密笔记本存储卷，无法控制 root 访问设置。
  • C: 在 EventBridge 报告创建事件后再删除实例属于事后响应，不合规的实例已经先被部署了。
  • D: CloudFormation 事件只覆盖通过 CloudFormation 创建的堆栈，而且事后删除并不能阻止部署。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: IAM supports the sagemaker:RootAccess condition key for the CreateNotebookInstance action. A policy that denies the action when the key is Enabled blocks any attempt to create a notebook instance with root access, preventing the deployment rather than reacting to it.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: AWS KMS keys encrypt the notebook storage volume and have no control over the root access setting.
  • C: Deleting instances after EventBridge reports their creation is reactive; the non-compliant instance is still deployed first.
  • D: CloudFormation events only cover stacks created through CloudFormation, and deleting after the fact does not prevent deployment.

questions.content: A company is using Amazon SageMaker to develop ML models. The company stores sensitive training data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The model training must have network isolation from the internet. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Run the SageMaker training jobs in private subnets. Create a NAT gateway. Route traffic for training through the NAT gateway.

contents.en: Run the SageMaker training jobs in private subnets. Create a NAT gateway. Route traffic for training through the NAT gateway.
contents.zh: 在私有子网中运行SageMaker训练作业。创建一个NAT网关。将训练流量通过NAT网关进行路由。

options.label: B
options.content: Run the SageMaker training jobs in private subnets. Create an S3 gateway VPC endpoint. Route traffic for training through the S3 gateway VPC endpoint.

contents.en: Run the SageMaker training jobs in private subnets. Create an S3 gateway VPC endpoint. Route traffic for training through the S3 gateway VPC endpoint.
contents.zh: 在私有子网中运行SageMaker训练作业。创建一个S3网关VPC终端节点。将训练流量通过S3网关VPC终端节点进行路由。

options.label: C
options.content: Run the SageMaker training jobs in public subnets that have an attached security group. In the security group, use inbound rules to limit traffic from the internet. Encrypt SageMaker instance storage by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).

contents.en: Run the SageMaker training jobs in public subnets that have an attached security group. In the security group, use inbound rules to limit traffic from the internet. Encrypt SageMaker instance storage by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
contents.zh: 在附有安全组的公共子网中运行SageMaker训练作业。在安全组中，使用入站规则限制来自互联网的流量。使用AWS KMS密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）对SageMaker实例存储进行加密。

options.label: D
options.content: Encrypt traffic to Amazon S3 by using a bucket policy that includes a value of True for the aws:SecureTransport condition key. Use default at-rest encryption for Amazon S3. Encrypt SageMaker instance storage by using server- side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).

contents.en: Encrypt traffic to Amazon S3 by using a bucket policy that includes a value of True for the aws:SecureTransport condition key. Use default at-rest encryption for Amazon S3. Encrypt SageMaker instance storage by using server- side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
contents.zh: 通过使用一个存储桶策略对发往亚马逊S3的流量进行加密，该策略中aws:SecureTransport条件键的值为True。对亚马逊S3使用默认的静态数据加密。使用AWS KMS密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）对SageMaker实例存储进行加密。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：在没有互联网路由的私有子网中运行训练作业，并创建 Amazon S3 网关 VPC 终端节点，可以让访问训练数据的所有流量都留在 AWS 网络内部。作业通过该终端节点访问 S3 存储桶，同时与互联网完全隔离。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: NAT 网关为私有子网提供出站互联网访问，违背了隔离要求。
  • C: 公有子网有通往互联网网关的路由，安全组规则和卷加密并不能实现网络隔离。
  • D: 强制 HTTPS 和加密数据只能保护机密性，流量仍然会经过公共互联网路径。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：在没有互联网路由的私有子网中运行训练作业，并创建 Amazon S3 网关 VPC 终端节点，可以让访问训练数据的所有流量都留在 AWS 网络内部。作业通过该终端节点访问 S3 存储桶，同时与互联网完全隔离。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: NAT 网关为私有子网提供出站互联网访问，违背了隔离要求。
  • C: 公有子网有通往互联网网关的路由，安全组规则和卷加密并不能实现网络隔离。
  • D: 强制 HTTPS 和加密数据只能保护机密性，流量仍然会经过公共互联网路径。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Running the training jobs in private subnets with no internet route and adding an Amazon S3 gateway VPC endpoint keeps all traffic to the training data on the AWS network. The jobs reach the S3 bucket through the endpoint while remaining fully isolated from the internet.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A NAT gateway provides outbound internet access from private subnets, which breaks the isolation requirement.
  • C: Public subnets have a route to an internet gateway; security group rules and volume encryption do not isolate the network.
  • D: Enforcing HTTPS and encrypting data protect confidentiality, but the traffic still traverses the public internet path.

options.label: A

questions.explanation:

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon ECR 用于存储和管理容器镜像的版本，而不是训练好的 ML 模型及其元数据。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：Amazon SageMaker Model Registry 将模型编目到模型包组（model package group）中，每当有模型注册到组里时会自动分配递增的版本号，并记录元数据和审批状态，因此模型创建时即可自动生成版本。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon ECR 用于存储和管理容器镜像的版本，而不是训练好的 ML 模型及其元数据。
  • B: SageMaker Marketplace 的模型包是可订阅的第三方模型，不能为公司自己的模型创建版本。
  • C: SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking 记录工作流中工件、操作和上下文之间的关系，并不会创建模型版本。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Amazon SageMaker Model Registry catalogs models in model package groups and automatically assigns an incrementing version to every model that is registered into a group, so new versions are created as models are produced, together with their metadata and approval status.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon ECR stores and versions container images, not trained ML models and their metadata.
  • B: SageMaker Marketplace model packages are third-party models you subscribe to; they do not version your own models.
  • C: SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking records the relationships between artifacts, actions, and contexts of a workflow; it does not create model versions.

questions.content: A company needs to use Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to supplement an open source large language model (LLM) that runs on Amazon Bedrock. The company's data for RAG is a set of documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. The documents consist of .csv files and .docx files. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a pipeline in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines to generate a new model. Call the new model from Amazon Bedrock to perform RAG queries.

contents.en: Create a pipeline in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines to generate a new model. Call the new model from Amazon Bedrock to perform RAG queries.
contents.zh: 在亚马逊 SageMaker 管道中创建一个管道来生成一个新模型。从亚马逊 Bedrock 调用新模型以执行 RAG 查询。

options.label: B
options.content: Convert the data into vectors. Store the data in an Amazon Neptune database. Connect the database to Amazon Bedrock. Call the Amazon Bedrock API to perform RAG queries.

contents.en: Convert the data into vectors. Store the data in an Amazon Neptune database. Connect the database to Amazon Bedrock. Call the Amazon Bedrock API to perform RAG queries.
contents.zh: 将数据转换为向量。将数据存储在亚马逊 Neptune 数据库中。将该数据库连接到亚马逊 Bedrock。调用亚马逊Bedrock API 以执行 RAG 查询。

options.label: C
options.content: Fine-tune an existing LLM by using an AutoML job in Amazon SageMaker. Configure the S3 bucket as a data source for the AutoML job. Deploy the LLM to a SageMaker endpoint. Use the endpoint to perform RAG queries.

contents.en: Fine-tune an existing LLM by using an AutoML job in Amazon SageMaker. Configure the S3 bucket as a data source for the AutoML job. Deploy the LLM to a SageMaker endpoint. Use the endpoint to perform RAG queries.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 SageMaker 中的自动机器学习（AutoML）作业对现有的大语言模型进行微调。将 S3 存储桶配置为AutoML 作业的数据源。将大语言模型部署到一个 SageMaker 终端节点。使用该终端节点执行 RAG 查询。

options.label: D
options.content: Create a knowledge base for Amazon Bedrock. Configure a data source that references the S3 bucket. Use the Amazon Bedrock API to perform RAG queries.

contents.en: Create a knowledge base for Amazon Bedrock. Configure a data source that references the S3 bucket. Use the Amazon Bedrock API to perform RAG queries.
contents.zh: 为亚马逊 Bedrock 创建一个知识库。配置一个引用 S3 存储桶的数据源。使用亚马逊 Bedrock API 执行 RAG 查询。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases 是全托管的 RAG 能力：只需配置一个指向 S3 存储桶的数据源，Bedrock 就会自动摄取受支持的 .csv 和 .docx 文件、分块、生成嵌入向量并存入向量库，然后通过 Bedrock API 执行 RAG 查询，无需管理任何管道或基础设施。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Pipelines 用于构建和训练模型，并不实现对文档的检索，而且这样训练出的模型也不能从 Bedrock 调用。
  • B: 手动生成向量并维护 Neptune 数据库需要编写自定义代码和额外运维，而这些工作 Bedrock Knowledge Bases 会自动完成。
  • C: 使用 AutoML 作业微调是把数据写入模型权重，而不是在查询时检索文档，这不是 RAG，还需要管理 SageMaker 终端节点。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases 是全托管的 RAG 能力：只需配置一个指向 S3 存储桶的数据源，Bedrock 就会自动摄取受支持的 .csv 和 .docx 文件、分块、生成嵌入向量并存入向量库，然后通过 Bedrock API 执行 RAG 查询，无需管理任何管道或基础设施。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Pipelines 用于构建和训练模型，并不实现对文档的检索，而且这样训练出的模型也不能从 Bedrock 调用。
  • B: 手动生成向量并维护 Neptune 数据库需要编写自定义代码和额外运维，而这些工作 Bedrock Knowledge Bases 会自动完成。
  • C: 使用 AutoML 作业微调是把数据写入模型权重，而不是在查询时检索文档，这不是 RAG，还需要管理 SageMaker 终端节点。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases is a fully managed RAG capability: you point a data source at the S3 bucket, and Bedrock ingests the supported .csv and .docx files, chunks them, generates embeddings, stores them in a vector store, and answers RAG queries through the Bedrock API with no pipeline or infrastructure to manage.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SageMaker Pipelines builds and trains models; it does not implement retrieval over documents, and a model trained this way is not called from Bedrock.
  • B: Manually generating embeddings and managing a Neptune database adds custom code and operational work that Bedrock Knowledge Bases handles automatically.
  • C: Fine-tuning with an AutoML job bakes data into model weights rather than retrieving documents at query time, so it is not RAG and it requires managing a SageMaker endpoint.

questions.content: A company plans to deploy an ML model for production inference on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. The average inference payload size will vary from 100 MB to 300 MB. Inference requests must be processed in 60 minutes or less. Which SageMaker inference option will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Serverless inference

contents.en: Serverless inference
contents.zh: 无服务器推理

options.label: B
options.content: Asynchronous inference

contents.en: Asynchronous inference
contents.zh: 异步推理

options.label: C
options.content: Real-time inference

contents.en: Real-time inference
contents.zh: 实时推理

options.label: D
options.content: Batch transform

contents.en: Batch transform
contents.zh: 批量转换

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Asynchronous Inference 会把请求放入队列，支持最大 1 GB 的负载和最长一小时的处理时间，是唯一能在 60 分钟内处理 100 MB 到 300 MB 负载的终端节点推理选项。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Serverless Inference 的负载上限为 4 MB，处理时间上限为 60 秒。
  • C: 实时推理的负载上限为 6 MB，处理时间上限为 60 秒。
  • D: Batch transform 以离线方式处理 S3 中的整个数据集，不使用 SageMaker 终端节点，其单个请求负载上限也只有 100 MB。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Asynchronous Inference 会把请求放入队列，支持最大 1 GB 的负载和最长一小时的处理时间，是唯一能在 60 分钟内处理 100 MB 到 300 MB 负载的终端节点推理选项。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Serverless Inference 的负载上限为 4 MB，处理时间上限为 60 秒。
  • C: 实时推理的负载上限为 6 MB，处理时间上限为 60 秒。
  • D: Batch transform 以离线方式处理 S3 中的整个数据集，不使用 SageMaker 终端节点，其单个请求负载上限也只有 100 MB。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: SageMaker Asynchronous Inference queues incoming requests and supports payloads up to 1 GB and processing times up to one hour, so it is the only endpoint option that handles 100 MB to 300 MB payloads within the 60-minute processing requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Serverless Inference limits payloads to 4 MB and processing time to 60 seconds.
  • C: Real-time inference limits payloads to 6 MB and processing time to 60 seconds.
  • D: Batch transform processes whole datasets from S3 offline and does not use a SageMaker endpoint; its per-request payload limit is also 100 MB.

contents.en: A company plans to deploy an ML model for production inference on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint. The average inference payload size will vary from 100 MB to 300 MB. Inference requests must be processed in 60 minutes or less. Which SageMaker inference option will meet these requirements?

questions.content: An ML engineer notices class imbalance in an image classification training job. What should the ML engineer do to resolve this issue?

options.label: A
options.content: Reduce the size of the dataset.

contents.en: Reduce the size of the dataset.
contents.zh: 减小数据集的规模。

options.label: B
options.content: Transform some of the images in the dataset.

contents.en: Transform some of the images in the dataset.
contents.zh: 对数据集中的一些图像进行转换。

options.label: C
options.content: Apply random oversampling on the dataset.

contents.en: Apply random oversampling on the dataset.
contents.zh: 对数据集应用随机过采样。

options.label: D
options.content: Apply random data splitting on the dataset.

contents.en: Apply random data splitting on the dataset.
contents.zh: 对数据集应用随机数据分割。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：随机过采样会复制少数类样本直到各类别分布均衡，直接纠正类别不平衡，使分类器不会偏向多数类。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 减小数据集规模会丢失信息，并且不会改变各类别之间的比例。
  • B: 对部分图像做变换属于用于提升泛化能力的数据增强，对任意图像做变换并不能重新平衡类别分布。
  • D: 随机数据分割只是划分训练、验证和测试集，每个子集中仍保留原有的不平衡。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：随机过采样会复制少数类样本直到各类别分布均衡，直接纠正类别不平衡，使分类器不会偏向多数类。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 减小数据集规模会丢失信息，并且不会改变各类别之间的比例。
  • B: 对部分图像做变换属于用于提升泛化能力的数据增强，对任意图像做变换并不能重新平衡类别分布。
  • D: 随机数据分割只是划分训练、验证和测试集，每个子集中仍保留原有的不平衡。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Random oversampling duplicates samples from the minority classes until the class distribution is balanced, which directly corrects class imbalance so the classifier is not biased toward the majority class.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Reducing the dataset size discards information and does not change the ratio between classes.
  • B: Transforming some images is data augmentation for generalization; applied to arbitrary images it does not rebalance the class distribution.
  • D: Random data splitting creates training, validation, and test sets and preserves the existing imbalance in each split.

contents.en: An ML engineer notices class imbalance in an image classification training job. What should the ML engineer do to resolve this issue?
contents.zh: 一名机器学习工程师注意到图像分类训练作业中存在类别不平衡问题。该机器学习工程师应该怎么做来解决这个问题？

questions.content: A company receives daily .csv files about customer interactions with its ML model. The company stores the files in Amazon S3 and uses the files to retrain the model. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to mask credit card numbers in the files before the model is retrained. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a discovery job in Amazon Macie. Configure the job to find and mask sensitive data.

contents.en: Create a discovery job in Amazon Macie. Configure the job to find and mask sensitive data.
contents.zh: 在亚马逊 Macie 中创建一个发现作业。配置该作业以查找并掩码敏感数据。

options.label: B
options.content: Create Apache Spark code to run on an AWS Glue job. Use the Sensitive Data Detection functionality in AWS Glue to find and mask sensitive data.

contents.en: Create Apache Spark code to run on an AWS Glue job. Use the Sensitive Data Detection functionality in AWS Glue to find and mask sensitive data.
contents.zh: 创建要在 AWS Glue 作业上运行的 Apache Spark 代码。使用 AWS Glue 中的敏感数据检测功能来查找并掩码敏感数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Create Apache Spark code to run on an AWS Glue job. Program the code to perform a regex operation to find and mask sensitive data.

contents.en: Create Apache Spark code to run on an AWS Glue job. Program the code to perform a regex operation to find and mask sensitive data.
contents.zh: 创建要在 AWS Glue 作业上运行的 Apache Spark 代码。对代码进行编程以执行正则表达式操作来查找并掩码敏感数据。

options.label: D
options.content: Create Apache Spark code to run on an Amazon EC2 instance. Program the code to perform an operation to find and mask sensitive data.

contents.en: Create Apache Spark code to run on an Amazon EC2 instance. Program the code to perform an operation to find and mask sensitive data.
contents.zh: 创建要在亚马逊 EC2 实例上运行的 Apache Spark 代码。对代码进行编程以执行操作来查找并掩码敏感数据。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：AWS Glue 的 Sensitive Data Detection 是内置转换，可识别信用卡号等预定义实体类型并直接对其进行遮蔽或编辑，因此 Glue 作业几乎无需自定义代码，还能以无服务器方式处理 S3 中每日到达的 .csv 文件。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon Macie 只能发现并报告 S3 中的敏感数据，不会修改或遮蔽文件内容。
  • C: 自行编写并维护匹配信用卡格式的正则表达式，比使用内置检测转换需要更多开发工作。
  • D: 在 EC2 上运行 Spark 需要自行预置和管理集群，并且所有检测逻辑都要手工编写。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：AWS Glue 的 Sensitive Data Detection 是内置转换，可识别信用卡号等预定义实体类型并直接对其进行遮蔽或编辑，因此 Glue 作业几乎无需自定义代码，还能以无服务器方式处理 S3 中每日到达的 .csv 文件。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon Macie 只能发现并报告 S3 中的敏感数据，不会修改或遮蔽文件内容。
  • C: 自行编写并维护匹配信用卡格式的正则表达式，比使用内置检测转换需要更多开发工作。
  • D: 在 EC2 上运行 Spark 需要自行预置和管理集群，并且所有检测逻辑都要手工编写。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: AWS Glue Sensitive Data Detection is a built-in transform that recognizes predefined entity types such as credit card numbers and can redact or mask them in place, so the Glue job needs almost no custom code and runs serverlessly against the daily .csv files in S3.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon Macie discovers and reports sensitive data in S3 but does not modify or mask the contents of the files.
  • C: Writing and maintaining regex logic for credit card formats is more development effort than using the built-in detection transform.
  • D: Running Spark on EC2 requires provisioning and managing the cluster and writing all detection logic by hand.

contents.en: A company receives daily .csv files about customer interactions with its ML model. The company stores the files in Amazon S3 and uses the files to retrain the model. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to mask credit card numbers in the files before the model is retrained. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?
contents.zh: 一家公司每天都会收到关于客户与机器学习模型交互情况的 .csv 文件。该公司将这些文件存储在亚马逊 S3 中，并使用这些文件对模型进行重新训练。一名机器学习工程师需要实施一个解决方案，在重新训练模型之前对文件中的信用卡号码进行掩码处理。哪种解决方案能以最少的开发工作量满足这一需求？

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker to build a recurrent neural network (RNN) to summarize the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker to build a recurrent neural network (RNN) to summarize the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 SageMaker 构建一个循环神经网络（RNN）来总结数据。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to summarize the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to summarize the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Comprehend Medical 来总结数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon Kendra to create a quick-search tool to query the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Kendra to create a quick-search tool to query the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Kendra 创建一个快速搜索工具来查询数据。

options.label: D
options.content: Use the Amazon SageMaker Sequence-to-Sequence (seq2seq) algorithm to create a text summary from the data.

contents.en: Use the Amazon SageMaker Sequence-to-Sequence (seq2seq) algorithm to create a text summary from the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 SageMaker 序列到序列（seq2seq）算法从数据中创建文本摘要。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：Amazon Comprehend Medical 是预训练的医学 NLP 服务，只需调用 API 即可从非结构化的英文临床文本和患者自述中提取病症、药物、检查、治疗及其关系，无需构建或训练模型即可获得患者洞察。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 在 SageMaker 上构建 RNN 需要设计、训练并托管自定义模型，开发工作量远高于托管服务。
  • C: Amazon Kendra 是企业搜索服务，只能帮助用户查找文档，不能从文本中提取医学洞察。
  • D: SageMaker 的 seq2seq 算法需要准备训练数据并训练自定义摘要模型。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：Amazon Comprehend Medical 是预训练的医学 NLP 服务，只需调用 API 即可从非结构化的英文临床文本和患者自述中提取病症、药物、检查、治疗及其关系，无需构建或训练模型即可获得患者洞察。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 在 SageMaker 上构建 RNN 需要设计、训练并托管自定义模型，开发工作量远高于托管服务。
  • C: Amazon Kendra 是企业搜索服务，只能帮助用户查找文档，不能从文本中提取医学洞察。
  • D: SageMaker 的 seq2seq 算法需要准备训练数据并训练自定义摘要模型。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Amazon Comprehend Medical is a pre-trained NLP service that extracts medical conditions, medications, tests, treatments, and their relationships from unstructured English clinical text and patient notes through a simple API call, so the company gains patient insights without building or training a model.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Building an RNN on SageMaker requires designing, training, and hosting a custom model, which is far more development effort.
  • C: Amazon Kendra is an enterprise search service; it lets users find documents but does not extract medical insights from the text.
  • D: The SageMaker seq2seq algorithm requires assembling training data and training a custom summarization model.

contents.en: A medical company is using AWS to build a tool to recommend treatments for patients. The company has obtained health records and self-reported textual information in English from patients. The company needs to use this information to gain insight about the patients. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?

questions.content: A company needs to extract entities from a PDF document to build a classifier model. Which solution will extract and store the entities in the LEAST amount of time?

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon Comprehend to extract the entities. Store the output in Amazon S3.

contents.en: Use Amazon Comprehend to extract the entities. Store the output in Amazon S3.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Comprehend 提取实体。将输出存储在亚马逊 S3 中。

options.label: B
options.content: Use an open source AI optical character recognition (OCR) tool on Amazon SageMaker to extract the entities. Store the output in Amazon S3.

contents.en: Use an open source AI optical character recognition (OCR) tool on Amazon SageMaker to extract the entities. Store the output in Amazon S3.
contents.zh: 在亚马逊 SageMaker 上使用一个开源人工智能光学字符识别（OCR）工具来提取实体。将输出存储在亚马逊 S3 中。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon Textract to extract the entities. Use Amazon Comprehend to convert the entities to text. Store the output in Amazon S3.

contents.en: Use Amazon Textract to extract the entities. Use Amazon Comprehend to convert the entities to text. Store the output in Amazon S3.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Textract 提取实体。使用亚马逊 Comprehend 将实体转换为文本。将输出存储在亚马逊 S3 中。

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon Textract integrated with Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) to extract the entities. Store the output in Amazon S3.

contents.en: Use Amazon Textract integrated with Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) to extract the entities. Store the output in Amazon S3.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Amazon Comprehend 可在单个托管步骤中完成实体检测，其分析作业能直接接受 PDF 文档，并把结果直接写入 Amazon S3，无需搭建模型，也不用增加额外的转换或人工审核环节。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 在 SageMaker 上搭建开源 OCR 工具耗时，而且它只能输出文本，实体提取仍需另行完成。
  • C: Amazon Textract 提取的是文本而不是实体，Comprehend 也不负责把实体转换为文本，这条链路既不正确又比单次 Comprehend 调用更慢。
  • D: 加入 Amazon A2I 会在流程中插入人工审核，反而增加处理时间。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Amazon Comprehend 可在单个托管步骤中完成实体检测，其分析作业能直接接受 PDF 文档，并把结果直接写入 Amazon S3，无需搭建模型，也不用增加额外的转换或人工审核环节。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 在 SageMaker 上搭建开源 OCR 工具耗时，而且它只能输出文本，实体提取仍需另行完成。
  • C: Amazon Textract 提取的是文本而不是实体，Comprehend 也不负责把实体转换为文本，这条链路既不正确又比单次 Comprehend 调用更慢。
  • D: 加入 Amazon A2I 会在流程中插入人工审核，反而增加处理时间。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Amazon Comprehend detects entities in a single managed step, accepts PDF documents directly in its analysis jobs, and writes the results straight to Amazon S3, so no model has to be set up and no extra conversion or review step is added.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Setting up an open source OCR tool on SageMaker takes time and still only produces text, so entity extraction would remain to be done.
  • C: Amazon Textract extracts text, not entities, and Comprehend does not convert entities to text, so the chain is both wrong and slower than a single Comprehend call.
  • D: Adding Amazon A2I inserts human review into the workflow, which increases processing time.

contents.en: A company needs to extract entities from a PDF document to build a classifier model. Which solution will extract and store the entities in the LEAST amount of time?

questions.content: A company shares Amazon SageMaker Studio notebooks that are accessible through a VPN. The company must enforce access controls to prevent malicious actors from exploiting presigned URLs to access the notebooks. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Set up Studio client IP validation by using the aws:sourceIp IAM policy condition.

contents.en: Set up Studio client IP validation by using the aws:sourceIp IAM policy condition.
contents.zh: 使用 aws:sourceIp IAM 策略条件设置 Studio 客户端 IP 验证。

options.label: B
options.content: Set up Studio client VPC validation by using the aws:sourceVpc IAM policy condition.

contents.en: Set up Studio client VPC validation by using the aws:sourceVpc IAM policy condition.
contents.zh: 使用 aws:sourceVpc IAM 策略条件设置 Studio 客户端 VPC 验证。

options.label: C
options.content: Set up Studio client role endpoint validation by using the aws:PrimaryTag IAM policy condition.

contents.en: Set up Studio client role endpoint validation by using the aws:PrimaryTag IAM policy condition.
contents.zh: 使用 aws:PrimaryTag IAM 策略条件设置 Studio 客户端角色终端节点验证。

options.label: D
options.content: Set up Studio client user endpoint validation by using the aws:PrincipalTag IAM policy condition.

contents.en: Set up Studio client user endpoint validation by using the aws:PrincipalTag IAM policy condition.
contents.zh: 使用 aws:PrincipalTag IAM 策略条件设置 Studio 客户端用户终端节点验证。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：预签名的 Studio URL 一旦泄露，任何拿到它的人都能使用，因此推荐的控制方式是在 CreatePresignedDomainUrl 操作的 IAM 策略中加入 aws:sourceIp 条件，把 Studio 访问限制在 VPN 的 IP 地址范围内；来自其他客户端地址的请求即使持有 URL 也会被拒绝。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: aws:sourceVpc 只对从 VPC 内部经 VPC 终端节点发出的请求生效，无法描述通过 VPN 从客户端地址接入的用户。
  • C: aws:PrimaryTag 不是有效的 IAM 条件键。
  • D: aws:PrincipalTag 匹配的是调用者 IAM 主体上的标签，与请求来源位置无关。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：预签名的 Studio URL 一旦泄露，任何拿到它的人都能使用，因此推荐的控制方式是在 CreatePresignedDomainUrl 操作的 IAM 策略中加入 aws:sourceIp 条件，把 Studio 访问限制在 VPN 的 IP 地址范围内；来自其他客户端地址的请求即使持有 URL 也会被拒绝。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: aws:sourceVpc 只对从 VPC 内部经 VPC 终端节点发出的请求生效，无法描述通过 VPN 从客户端地址接入的用户。
  • C: aws:PrimaryTag 不是有效的 IAM 条件键。
  • D: aws:PrincipalTag 匹配的是调用者 IAM 主体上的标签，与请求来源位置无关。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: A presigned Studio URL can be used by anyone who obtains it, so the recommended control is an IAM policy on the CreatePresignedDomainUrl action with an aws:sourceIp condition that limits Studio access to the VPN's IP address range; requests from any other client address are denied even if the URL leaks.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: aws:sourceVpc only applies to requests that arrive through a VPC endpoint from inside a VPC, which does not describe users connecting over a VPN from their client addresses.
  • C: aws:PrimaryTag is not a valid IAM condition key.
  • D: aws:PrincipalTag matches tags attached to the calling IAM principal and says nothing about where the request comes from.

contents.en: A company shares Amazon SageMaker Studio notebooks that are accessible through a VPN. The company must enforce access controls to prevent malicious actors from exploiting presigned URLs to access the notebooks. Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh: 一家公司共享可通过 VPN 访问的亚马逊 SageMaker Studio 笔记本。该公司必须实施访问控制，以防止恶意行为者利用预签名 URL 访问这些笔记本。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

questions.content: An ML engineer needs to merge and transform data from two sources to retrain an existing ML model. One data source consists of .csv files that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. Each .csv file consists of millions of records. The other data source is an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. The result of the merge process must be written to a second S3 bucket. The ML engineer needs to perform this merge-and-transform task every week. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a transient Amazon EMR cluster every week. Use the cluster to run an Apache Spark job to merge and transform the data.

contents.en: Create a transient Amazon EMR cluster every week. Use the cluster to run an Apache Spark job to merge and transform the data.
contents.zh: 每周创建一个临时的亚马逊 EMR 集群。使用该集群运行一个 Apache Spark 作业来合并并转换数据。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a weekly AWS Glue job that uses the Apache Spark engine. Use DynamicFrame native operations to merge and transform the data.

contents.en: Create a weekly AWS Glue job that uses the Apache Spark engine. Use DynamicFrame native operations to merge and transform the data.
contents.zh: 创建一个每周执行的 AWS Glue 作业，该作业使用 Apache Spark 引擎。使用 DynamicFrame 原生操作来合并并转换数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs Apache Spark code every week to merge and transform the data. Configure the Lambda function to connect to the initial S3 bucket and the DB cluster.

contents.en: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs Apache Spark code every week to merge and transform the data. Configure the Lambda function to connect to the initial S3 bucket and the DB cluster.
contents.zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数每周运行 Apache Spark 代码来合并并转换数据。将 Lambda 函数配置为连接到初始 S3 存储桶和数据库集群。

options.label: D
options.content: Create an AWS Batch job that runs Apache Spark code on Amazon EC2 instances every week. Configure the Spark code to save the data from the EC2 instances to the second S3 bucket.

contents.en: Create an AWS Batch job that runs Apache Spark code on Amazon EC2 instances every week. Configure the Spark code to save the data from the EC2 instances to the second S3 bucket.
contents.zh: 创建一个 AWS Batch 作业，该作业每周在亚马逊 EC2 实例上运行 Apache Spark 代码。将 Spark 代码配置为将数据从 EC2 实例保存到第二个 S3 存储桶。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：AWS Glue 是无服务器的 Spark 服务，可读取 S3 中的 .csv 文件并通过 JDBC 连接读取 Aurora 集群，用 Join、ApplyMapping 等 DynamicFrame 原生操作完成合并与转换后写入第二个存储桶，并可用每周调度触发器自动运行，无需管理任何集群或服务器。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 临时 EMR 集群仍然需要每周预置、配置和编排集群。
  • C: AWS Lambda 无法运行 Apache Spark，其 15 分钟超时和内存限制也不适合处理数百万条记录。
  • D: 在 EC2 上使用 AWS Batch 需要自行管理 Spark 安装、容器镜像和计算环境。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：AWS Glue 是无服务器的 Spark 服务，可读取 S3 中的 .csv 文件并通过 JDBC 连接读取 Aurora 集群，用 Join、ApplyMapping 等 DynamicFrame 原生操作完成合并与转换后写入第二个存储桶，并可用每周调度触发器自动运行，无需管理任何集群或服务器。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 临时 EMR 集群仍然需要每周预置、配置和编排集群。
  • C: AWS Lambda 无法运行 Apache Spark，其 15 分钟超时和内存限制也不适合处理数百万条记录。
  • D: 在 EC2 上使用 AWS Batch 需要自行管理 Spark 安装、容器镜像和计算环境。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: AWS Glue is a serverless Spark service that reads the S3 .csv files and the Aurora cluster through a JDBC connection, merges and transforms them with native DynamicFrame operations such as Join and ApplyMapping, writes to the second bucket, and runs on a weekly schedule trigger with no cluster or servers to manage.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A transient EMR cluster still requires provisioning, configuring, and orchestrating the cluster every week.
  • C: AWS Lambda cannot run Apache Spark, and its 15-minute timeout and memory limits are unsuitable for millions of records.
  • D: AWS Batch on EC2 requires managing Spark installation, container images, and compute environments yourself.

Each .csv file consists of millions of records. The other data source is an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. The result of the merge process must be written to a second S3 bucket. questions.content: An ML engineer has deployed an Amazon SageMaker model to a serverless endpoint in production. The model is invoked by the InvokeEndpoint API operation. The model's latency in production is higher than the baseline latency in the test environment. The ML engineer thinks that the increase in latency is because of model startup time. What should the ML engineer do to confirm or deny this hypothesis?

options.label: A
options.content: Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job. Observe metrics about model quality.

contents.en: Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job. Observe metrics about model quality.
contents.zh: 安排一个 SageMaker 模型监控器作业。观察有关模型质量的指标。

options.label: B
options.content: Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job with Amazon CloudWatch metrics enabled.

contents.en: Schedule a SageMaker Model Monitor job with Amazon CloudWatch metrics enabled.
contents.zh: 安排一个启用了亚马逊 CloudWatch 指标的 SageMaker 模型监控器作业。

options.label: C
options.content: Enable Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Observe the ModelSetupTime metric in the SageMaker namespace.

contents.en: Enable Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Observe the ModelSetupTime metric in the SageMaker namespace.
contents.zh: 启用亚马逊 CloudWatch 指标。观察 SageMaker 命名空间中的 ModelSetupTime 指标。

options.label: D
options.content: Enable Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Observe the ModelLoadingWaitTime metric in the SageMaker namespace.

contents.en: Enable Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Observe the ModelLoadingWaitTime metric in the SageMaker namespace.
contents.zh: 启用亚马逊 CloudWatch 指标。观察 SageMaker 命名空间中的 ModelLoadingWaitTime 指标。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Serverless Inference 端点会在 AWS/SageMaker 命名空间中发布 ModelSetupTime 指标，它衡量启动计算资源、下载模型并启动容器所花的时间，把它与调用延迟对比就能直接确认或排除冷启动开销。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Model Monitor 的模型质量任务比较预测与真实标签，评估的是准确性，而不是端点延迟或启动时间。
  • B: 即便启用 CloudWatch 指标，Model Monitor 报告的仍是数据和模型质量统计，不包含无服务器端点的启动时间。
  • D: ModelLoadingWaitTime 是多模型端点在从 S3 加载模型到实例时发出的指标，无服务器端点不会发布它。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Serverless Inference 端点会在 AWS/SageMaker 命名空间中发布 ModelSetupTime 指标，它衡量启动计算资源、下载模型并启动容器所花的时间，把它与调用延迟对比就能直接确认或排除冷启动开销。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Model Monitor 的模型质量任务比较预测与真实标签，评估的是准确性，而不是端点延迟或启动时间。
  • B: 即便启用 CloudWatch 指标，Model Monitor 报告的仍是数据和模型质量统计，不包含无服务器端点的启动时间。
  • D: ModelLoadingWaitTime 是多模型端点在从 S3 加载模型到实例时发出的指标，无服务器端点不会发布它。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Serverless Inference endpoints publish the ModelSetupTime metric in the AWS/SageMaker namespace, which measures the time spent launching compute, downloading the model and starting the container before a request is served, so comparing it with the invocation latency directly confirms or rules out cold-start overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Model Monitor model-quality jobs evaluate prediction accuracy against ground truth, not endpoint latency or startup time.
  • B: Scheduling Model Monitor with CloudWatch metrics still reports data and model quality statistics, not the time a serverless endpoint needs to start.
  • D: ModelLoadingWaitTime is emitted by multi-model endpoints when a model must be loaded from S3 into an instance; it is not published for serverless endpoints.

The model's latency in production is higher than the baseline latency in the test environment. The ML engineer thinks that the increase in latency is because of model startup time. questions.content: An ML engineer needs to ensure that a dataset complies with regulations for personally identifiable information (PII). The ML engineer will use the data to train an ML model on Amazon SageMaker instances. SageMaker must not use any of the PII. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.label: A
options.content: Use the Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities API call to redact the PII from the data. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Access the S3 bucket from the SageMaker instances for model training.

contents.en: Use the Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities API call to redact the PII from the data. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Access the S3 bucket from the SageMaker instances for model training.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Comprehend 的 DetectPiiEntities API 调用从数据中编辑掉 PII。将数据存储在亚马逊 S3 存储桶中。从SageMaker 实例访问 S3 存储桶以进行模型训练。

options.label: B
options.content: Use the Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities API call to redact the PII from the data. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system to the SageMaker instances for model training.

contents.en: Use the Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities API call to redact the PII from the data. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system to the SageMaker instances for model training.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Comprehend 的 DetectPiiEntities API 调用从数据中编辑掉 PII。将数据存储在亚马逊弹性文件系统（Amazon EFS）中。将 EFS 文件系统挂载到 SageMaker 实例以进行模型训练。

options.label: C
options.content: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to cleanse the dataset of PII. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system to the SageMaker instances for model training.

contents.en: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to cleanse the dataset of PII. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system to the SageMaker instances for model training.
contents.zh: 使用 AWS Glue DataBrew 清除数据集中的 PII。将数据存储在亚马逊弹性文件系统（Amazon EFS）中。将 EFS 文件系统挂载到 SageMaker 实例以进行模型训练。

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon Macie for automatic discovery of PII in the data. Remove the PII. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Mount the S3 bucket to the SageMaker instances for model training.

contents.en: Use Amazon Macie for automatic discovery of PII in the data. Remove the PII. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Mount the S3 bucket to the SageMaker instances for model training.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Macie 自动发现数据中的 PII。移除 PII。将数据存储在亚马逊 S3 存储桶中。将 S3 存储桶挂载到SageMaker 实例以进行模型训练。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：Amazon Comprehend 的 DetectPiiEntities API 能识别 PII 以便在训练前编辑掉，而 Amazon S3 是 SageMaker 训练作业的原生输入源，编辑后的数据集可以直接使用，无需预置或挂载任何文件系统。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 编辑 PII 的做法正确，但把数据存入 Amazon EFS 并挂载，比直接从 S3 读取多出一个需要预置和管理的文件系统。
  • C: AWS Glue DataBrew 需要构建并运行配方作业，再加上 EFS 挂载，运维工作更多。
  • D: Amazon Macie 只能发现 PII 而不能移除，需要额外的手动删除步骤，而且 SageMaker 是通过输入通道读取 S3 数据而不是挂载。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Amazon Comprehend 的 DetectPiiEntities API 能识别 PII 以便在训练前编辑掉，而 Amazon S3 是 SageMaker 训练作业的原生输入源，编辑后的数据集可以直接使用，无需预置或挂载任何文件系统。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 编辑 PII 的做法正确，但把数据存入 Amazon EFS 并挂载，比直接从 S3 读取多出一个需要预置和管理的文件系统。
  • C: AWS Glue DataBrew 需要构建并运行配方作业，再加上 EFS 挂载，运维工作更多。
  • D: Amazon Macie 只能发现 PII 而不能移除，需要额外的手动删除步骤，而且 SageMaker 是通过输入通道读取 S3 数据而不是挂载。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: The Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities API identifies PII so it can be redacted before training, and Amazon S3 is the native input source for SageMaker training jobs, so the redacted dataset can be consumed directly without provisioning or mounting any file system.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Redaction is correct, but storing the data in Amazon EFS and mounting it adds a file system to provision and manage compared with reading directly from S3.
  • C: AWS Glue DataBrew requires building and running recipe jobs, and the EFS mount adds further operational work.
  • D: Amazon Macie discovers PII but does not remove it, so a separate manual removal step is needed, and S3 data is read by SageMaker through input channels rather than mounted.

questions.content: A company must install a custom script on any newly created Amazon SageMaker notebook instances. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a lifecycle configuration script to install the custom script when a new SageMaker notebook is created. Attach the lifecycle configuration to every new SageMaker notebook as part of the creation steps.

contents.en: Create a lifecycle configuration script to install the custom script when a new SageMaker notebook is created. Attach the lifecycle configuration to every new SageMaker notebook as part of the creation steps.
contents.zh: 创建一个生命周期配置脚本，以便在创建新的 SageMaker 笔记本时安装自定义脚本。在创建新的 SageMaker 笔记本的步骤中，将生命周期配置附加到每个新笔记本上。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a custom Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) image that contains the custom script. Push the ECR image to a Docker registry. Attach the Docker image to a SageMaker Studio domain. Select the kernel to run as part of the SageMaker notebook.

contents.en: Create a custom Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) image that contains the custom script. Push the ECR image to a Docker registry. Attach the Docker image to a SageMaker Studio domain. Select the kernel to run as part of the SageMaker notebook.
contents.zh: 创建一个包含自定义脚本的自定义亚马逊弹性容器注册表（Amazon ECR）镜像。将 ECR 镜像推送到 Docker 注册表。将 Docker 镜像附加到 SageMaker Studio 域。选择要作为 SageMaker 笔记本一部分运行的内核。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a custom package index repository. Use AWS CodeArtifact to manage the installation of the custom script. Set up AWS PrivateLink endpoints to connect CodeArtifact to the SageMaker instance. Install the script.

contents.en: Create a custom package index repository. Use AWS CodeArtifact to manage the installation of the custom script. Set up AWS PrivateLink endpoints to connect CodeArtifact to the SageMaker instance. Install the script.
contents.zh: 创建一个自定义包索引存储库。使用 AWS CodeArtifact 管理自定义脚本的安装。设置 AWS 私有链接终端节点，将CodeArtifact 连接到 SageMaker 实例。安装脚本。

options.label: D
options.content: Store the custom script in Amazon S3. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the custom script on new SageMaker notebooks. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function when a new SageMaker notebook is initialized.

contents.en: Store the custom script in Amazon S3. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the custom script on new SageMaker notebooks. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function when a new SageMaker notebook is initialized.
contents.zh: 将自定义脚本存储在亚马逊 S3 中。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于在新的 SageMaker 笔记本上安装自定义脚本。配置亚马逊 EventBridge 在初始化新的 SageMaker 笔记本时调用 Lambda 函数。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker 笔记本实例的生命周期配置是 SageMaker 在笔记本实例创建或启动时自动执行的 shell 脚本，在创建时附加它即可安装自定义脚本，无需构建或维护任何额外基础设施。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 附加到 Studio 域的自定义镜像适用于 SageMaker Studio 而不是笔记本实例，还需要构建和维护容器镜像。
  • C: AWS CodeArtifact 是软件包仓库，搭建仓库和 PrivateLink 终端节点比一个生命周期脚本复杂得多。
  • D: EventBridge 规则和 Lambda 函数无法直接在笔记本实例内部执行命令，需要额外编写编排逻辑，而这正是生命周期配置已经提供的能力。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker 笔记本实例的生命周期配置是 SageMaker 在笔记本实例创建或启动时自动执行的 shell 脚本，在创建时附加它即可安装自定义脚本，无需构建或维护任何额外基础设施。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 附加到 Studio 域的自定义镜像适用于 SageMaker Studio 而不是笔记本实例，还需要构建和维护容器镜像。
  • C: AWS CodeArtifact 是软件包仓库，搭建仓库和 PrivateLink 终端节点比一个生命周期脚本复杂得多。
  • D: EventBridge 规则和 Lambda 函数无法直接在笔记本实例内部执行命令，需要额外编写编排逻辑，而这正是生命周期配置已经提供的能力。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker notebook instance lifecycle configurations are shell scripts that SageMaker runs automatically when a notebook instance is created or started, so attaching one at creation installs the custom script with no additional infrastructure to build or maintain.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Custom images attached to a Studio domain apply to SageMaker Studio, not to notebook instances, and require building and maintaining container images.
  • C: AWS CodeArtifact is a package repository; setting up repositories and PrivateLink endpoints is far more work than a lifecycle script.
  • D: An EventBridge rule and Lambda function cannot directly execute commands inside a notebook instance and would need custom orchestration that lifecycle configurations already provide.

contents.zh: 一家公司必须在任何新创建的亚马逊 SageMaker 笔记本实例上安装一个自定义脚本。哪种解决方案能以最少的运维开销满足这一需求？

questions.content: A company is building a real-time data processing pipeline for an ecommerce application. The application generates a high volume of clickstream data that must be ingested, processed, and visualized in near real time. The company needs a solution that supports SQL for data processing and Jupyter notebooks for interactive analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon Data Firehose to ingest the data. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the data. Store the processed data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Data Firehose to ingest the data. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the data. Store the processed data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Data Firehose 摄取数据。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来处理数据。将处理后的数据存储在亚马逊 S3中。使用亚马逊 QuickSight 可视化数据。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the data. Use Amazon Data Firehose to transform the data. Use Amazon Athena to process the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the data. Use Amazon Data Firehose to transform the data. Use Amazon Athena to process the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊 Kinesis 数据流摄取数据。使用亚马逊 Data Firehose 转换数据。使用亚马逊 Athena 处理数据。使用亚马逊 QuickSight 可视化数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to ingest the data. Use AWS Glue with PySpark to process the data. Store the processed data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to ingest the data. Use AWS Glue with PySpark to process the data. Store the processed data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊托管的 Apache Kafka 流服务（Amazon MSK）摄取数据。使用带有 PySpark 的 AWS Glue 处理数据。将处理后的数据存储在亚马逊 S3 中。使用亚马逊 QuickSight 可视化数据。

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to ingest the data. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to process the data. Use the built-in Flink dashboard to visualize the data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to ingest the data. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to process the data. Use the built-in Flink dashboard to visualize the data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊托管的 Apache Kafka 流服务（Amazon MSK）摄取数据。使用亚马逊托管的 Apache Flink 服务处理数据。使用内置的 Flink 仪表板可视化数据。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Amazon MSK 负责摄取大量点击流数据，AWS Glue 流式作业通过 PySpark 使用 Spark SQL 近实时处理数据，Glue 交互式会话和 Glue Studio 笔记本提供基于 Jupyter 的交互式分析，处理结果存入 Amazon S3 后由 Amazon QuickSight 可视化，满足全部要求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 用 AWS Lambda 处理数据既不提供基于 SQL 的数据处理，也没有 Jupyter 笔记本可做交互式分析。
  • B: Amazon Data Firehose 只能通过 Lambda 转换记录，Amazon Athena 查询的是 S3 中的静态数据，而不是近实时处理流数据。
  • D: Managed Service for Apache Flink 的 Studio 笔记本基于 Apache Zeppelin 而不是 Jupyter，Flink 仪表板用于监控作业状态而不是可视化业务数据。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Amazon MSK 负责摄取大量点击流数据，AWS Glue 流式作业通过 PySpark 使用 Spark SQL 近实时处理数据，Glue 交互式会话和 Glue Studio 笔记本提供基于 Jupyter 的交互式分析，处理结果存入 Amazon S3 后由 Amazon QuickSight 可视化，满足全部要求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 用 AWS Lambda 处理数据既不提供基于 SQL 的数据处理，也没有 Jupyter 笔记本可做交互式分析。
  • B: Amazon Data Firehose 只能通过 Lambda 转换记录，Amazon Athena 查询的是 S3 中的静态数据，而不是近实时处理流数据。
  • D: Managed Service for Apache Flink 的 Studio 笔记本基于 Apache Zeppelin 而不是 Jupyter，Flink 仪表板用于监控作业状态而不是可视化业务数据。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Amazon MSK ingests high-volume clickstream data, AWS Glue streaming jobs with PySpark process it in near real time using Spark SQL, Glue interactive sessions and Glue Studio notebooks provide Jupyter-based interactive analysis, and the results in Amazon S3 are visualized with Amazon QuickSight, covering every stated requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: AWS Lambda processing offers neither SQL-based data processing nor Jupyter notebooks for interactive analysis.
  • B: Amazon Data Firehose can only transform records through Lambda, and Amazon Athena queries data at rest in S3 rather than processing the stream in near real time.
  • D: Managed Service for Apache Flink Studio notebooks are based on Apache Zeppelin, not Jupyter, and the Flink dashboard monitors job health rather than visualizing business data.

contents.en: A company is building a real-time data processing pipeline for an ecommerce application. The application generates a high volume of clickstream data that must be ingested, processed, and visualized in near real time. The company needs a solution that supports SQL for data processing and Jupyter notebooks for interactive analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh: 一家公司正在为一个电子商务应用程序构建一个实时数据处理管道。该应用程序会生成大量的点击流数据，这些数据必须近乎实时地进行摄取、处理和可视化。该公司需要一个支持使用 SQL 进行数据处理、使用 Jupyter 笔记本进行交互式分析的解决方案。哪种解决方案能满足这些需求？

questions.content: A medical company needs to store clinical data. The data includes personally identifiable information (PII) and protected health information (PHI). An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to ensure that the PII and PHI are not used to train ML models. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Store the clinical data in Amazon S3 buckets. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training.

contents.en: Store the clinical data in Amazon S3 buckets. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training.
contents.zh: 将临床数据存储在亚马逊 S3 存储桶中。在将数据用于模型训练之前，使用 AWS Glue DataBrew 对 PII 和 PHI 进行掩码处理。

options.label: B
options.content: Upload the clinical data to an Amazon Redshift database. Use built-in SQL stored procedures to automatically classify and mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training.

contents.en: Upload the clinical data to an Amazon Redshift database. Use built-in SQL stored procedures to automatically classify and mask the PII and PHI before the data is used for model training.
contents.zh: 将临床数据上传到亚马逊 Redshift 数据库。在将数据用于模型训练之前，使用内置的 SQL 存储过程自动对 PII 和 PHI进行分类和掩码处理。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon Comprehend to detect and mask the PII before the data is used for model training. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to detect and mask the PHI before the data is used for model training.

contents.en: Use Amazon Comprehend to detect and mask the PII before the data is used for model training. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to detect and mask the PHI before the data is used for model training.
contents.zh: 在将数据用于模型训练之前，使用亚马逊 Comprehend 检测并掩码 PII。在将数据用于模型训练之前，使用亚马逊Comprehend Medical 检测并掩码 PHI信息。

options.label: D
options.content: Create an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the PII and PHI. Program the Lambda function to save the encrypted data to an Amazon S3 bucket for model training.

contents.en: Create an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the PII and PHI. Program the Lambda function to save the encrypted data to an Amazon S3 bucket for model training.
contents.zh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来加密 PII 和 PHI。对 Lambda 函数进行编程，将加密后的数据保存到亚马逊 S3 存储桶中用于模型训练。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Amazon Comprehend 的 PII 检测可识别并编辑姓名、地址、身份标识等通用 PII，Amazon Comprehend Medical 的 DetectPHI 可识别临床文本中的受保护健康信息，两者结合即可在数据进入模型训练前遮蔽这两类信息。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Glue DataBrew 能遮蔽标准 PII 类别，但不具备识别临床文本中医学 PHI 的能力。
  • B: Amazon Redshift 没有能自动分类并遮蔽 PII 和 PHI 的内置存储过程，遮蔽策略需要手工编写。
  • D: 加密只能保护静态数据，无法识别哪些字段属于 PII 或 PHI，也不会把它们从训练数据中移除。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Amazon Comprehend 的 PII 检测可识别并编辑姓名、地址、身份标识等通用 PII，Amazon Comprehend Medical 的 DetectPHI 可识别临床文本中的受保护健康信息，两者结合即可在数据进入模型训练前遮蔽这两类信息。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Glue DataBrew 能遮蔽标准 PII 类别，但不具备识别临床文本中医学 PHI 的能力。
  • B: Amazon Redshift 没有能自动分类并遮蔽 PII 和 PHI 的内置存储过程，遮蔽策略需要手工编写。
  • D: 加密只能保护静态数据，无法识别哪些字段属于 PII 或 PHI，也不会把它们从训练数据中移除。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Amazon Comprehend PII detection identifies and redacts general PII such as names, addresses, and identifiers, and Amazon Comprehend Medical DetectPHI identifies protected health information in clinical text, so combining the two masks both categories before the data reaches model training.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: AWS Glue DataBrew can mask standard PII categories but has no capability to recognize medical PHI in clinical text.
  • B: Amazon Redshift has no built-in stored procedures that automatically classify and mask PII and PHI; masking policies would have to be written by hand.
  • D: Encrypting data protects it at rest but does not identify which fields are PII or PHI or remove them from the training data.

contents.en: A medical company needs to store clinical data. The data includes personally identifiable information (PII) and protected health information (PHI). An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to ensure that the PII and PHI are not used to train ML models. Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh: 一家医疗公司需要存储临床数据。这些数据包含个人身份信息（PII）和受保护的健康信息（PHI）。一名机器学习工程师需要实施一个解决方案，以确保 PII 和 PHI 不被用于训练机器学习模型。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

questions.content: An ML engineer is developing a classification model. The ML engineer needs to use custom libraries in processing jobs, training jobs, and pipelines in Amazon SageMaker. Which solution will provide this functionality with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.label: A
options.content: Manually install the libraries in the SageMaker containers.

contents.en: Manually install the libraries in the SageMaker containers.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker容器中手动安装这些库。

options.label: B
options.content: Build a custom Docker container that includes the required libraries. Host the container in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Use the ECR image in the SageMaker jobs and pipelines.

contents.en: Build a custom Docker container that includes the required libraries. Host the container in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Use the ECR image in the SageMaker jobs and pipelines.
contents.zh: 构建包含所需库的自定义Docker容器。将容器托管在Amazon弹性容器 registry（Amazon ECR）中。在SageMaker作业和管道中使用ECR镜像。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a SageMaker notebook instance to host the jobs. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the libraries on the notebook instance when the notebook instance starts. Configure the SageMaker jobs and pipelines to run on the notebook instance.

contents.en: Create a SageMaker notebook instance to host the jobs. Create an AWS Lambda function to install the libraries on the notebook instance when the notebook instance starts. Configure the SageMaker jobs and pipelines to run on the notebook instance.
contents.zh: 创建一个SageMaker笔记本实例来托管作业。创建一个AWS Lambda函数，在笔记本实例启动时在该实例上安装库。配置SageMaker作业和管道在笔记本实例上运行。

options.label: D
options.content: Run code for the libraries externally on Amazon EC2 instances. Store the results in Amazon S3. Import the results into the SageMaker jobs and pipelines.

contents.en: Run code for the libraries externally on Amazon EC2 instances. Store the results in Amazon S3. Import the results into the SageMaker jobs and pipelines.
contents.zh: 在Amazon EC2实例上外部运行库的代码。将结果存储在Amazon S3中。将结果导入SageMaker作业和管道。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：构建一个包含所需库的自定义 Docker 镜像，推送到 Amazon ECR，再在 SageMaker 处理作业、训练作业和管道步骤中引用该镜像 URI，这是官方支持的自带容器（BYOC）模式，只需构建一次即可在所有地方一致地使用这些库。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 每个 SageMaker 作业都从全新容器启动，手动安装不会持久保留，每次作业都要重复安装。
  • C: 处理作业、训练作业和管道运行在托管的 SageMaker 基础设施上，无法配置为在笔记本实例上运行。
  • D: 在 EC2 上外部运行库代码再导入结果，违背了在 SageMaker 内使用这些库的目标，还增加了自定义集成工作。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：构建一个包含所需库的自定义 Docker 镜像，推送到 Amazon ECR，再在 SageMaker 处理作业、训练作业和管道步骤中引用该镜像 URI，这是官方支持的自带容器（BYOC）模式，只需构建一次即可在所有地方一致地使用这些库。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 每个 SageMaker 作业都从全新容器启动，手动安装不会持久保留，每次作业都要重复安装。
  • C: 处理作业、训练作业和管道运行在托管的 SageMaker 基础设施上，无法配置为在笔记本实例上运行。
  • D: 在 EC2 上外部运行库代码再导入结果，违背了在 SageMaker 内使用这些库的目标，还增加了自定义集成工作。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Building one custom Docker image with the required libraries, pushing it to Amazon ECR, and referencing that image URI in SageMaker processing jobs, training jobs, and pipeline steps is the supported bring-your-own-container pattern, so the libraries are available consistently everywhere with a single build.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Each SageMaker job starts from a fresh container, so manual installations do not persist and would have to be repeated for every job.
  • C: Processing jobs, training jobs, and pipelines run on managed SageMaker infrastructure and cannot be configured to run on a notebook instance.
  • D: Running library code externally on EC2 and importing results defeats the goal of using the libraries inside SageMaker and adds custom integration work.

options.label: B

options.label: D
options.content: Configure a data flow in SageMaker Data Wrangler. Integrate Data Wrangler with Amazon CloudWatch to provide alerts.

contents.en: Configure a data flow in SageMaker Data Wrangler. Integrate Data Wrangler with Amazon CloudWatch to provide alerts.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker Data Wrangler中配置数据流。将Data Wrangler与Amazon CloudWatch集成以提供警报。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Model Monitor 会捕获终端节点的请求数据，按计划运行数据质量监控作业并与基线比较，然后把违规指标发布到 Amazon CloudWatch，由 CloudWatch 告警在生产中出现数据质量问题时通知工程师。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 如果没有 Model Monitor 生成数据质量指标，单靠 CloudWatch 告警没有可评估的指标。
  • B: SageMaker Clarify 处理作业用于按需分析偏差和可解释性，不会持续监控终端节点的数据质量。
  • D: SageMaker Data Wrangler 是数据准备工具，不监控生产终端节点，也不发送告警。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Model Monitor 会捕获终端节点的请求数据，按计划运行数据质量监控作业并与基线比较，然后把违规指标发布到 Amazon CloudWatch，由 CloudWatch 告警在生产中出现数据质量问题时通知工程师。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 如果没有 Model Monitor 生成数据质量指标，单靠 CloudWatch 告警没有可评估的指标。
  • B: SageMaker Clarify 处理作业用于按需分析偏差和可解释性，不会持续监控终端节点的数据质量。
  • D: SageMaker Data Wrangler 是数据准备工具，不监控生产终端节点，也不发送告警。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: SageMaker Model Monitor captures endpoint request data, runs scheduled data quality monitoring jobs that compare it against a baseline, and publishes violation metrics to Amazon CloudWatch, where alarms can notify the engineer when data quality issues appear in production.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A CloudWatch alarm alone has no data quality metrics to evaluate unless Model Monitor generates them.
  • B: SageMaker Clarify processing jobs analyze bias and explainability on demand; they do not continuously monitor endpoint data quality.
  • D: SageMaker Data Wrangler is a data preparation tool and does not monitor production endpoints or emit alerts.

questions.content: A company needs to use Amazon SageMaker to train a model on more than 300 GB of data. The training data is composed of files that are 200 MB in size. The data is stored in Amazon S3 Standard storage and feeds a dashboard tool. Which SageMaker training ingestion mechanism is the MOST cost-effective solution for this scenario?

options.label: A
options.content: Amazon ElasticFile System (Amazon EFS) file system

contents.en: Amazon ElasticFile System (Amazon EFS) file system
contents.zh: Amazon ElasticFile System（Amazon EFS）文件系统

options.label: B
options.content: Amazon FSx for Lustre file system

contents.en: Amazon FSx for Lustre file system
contents.zh: Amazon FSx for Lustre文件系统

options.label: C
options.content: Amazon S3 in fast file mode while using S3 Express One Zone

contents.en: Amazon S3 in fast file mode while using S3 Express One Zone
contents.zh: 使用S3 Express One Zone的S3快速文件模式

options.label: D
options.content: Amazon S3 in fast file mode without using S3 Express One Zone

contents.en: Amazon S3 in fast file mode without using S3 Express One Zone
contents.zh: 不使用S3 Express One Zone的S3快速文件模式

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：快速文件模式会在训练作业读取时直接从现有的 S3 Standard 存储桶流式传输数据，训练无需先完整下载，也不必为 300 GB 数据集创建并付费保存第二份副本；200 MB 的文件非常适合这种模式，仪表板工具也能继续使用同一份数据。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon EFS 需要把数据复制到单独计费的文件系统中，其每 GB 价格高于 S3 Standard。
  • B: Amazon FSx for Lustre 吞吐量最高但也最昂贵，对 300 GB、单文件 200 MB 的数据来说并无必要。
  • C: S3 Express One Zone 需要把数据复制到目录存储桶中且存储单价更高，在没有对应需求的情况下只会增加成本。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：快速文件模式会在训练作业读取时直接从现有的 S3 Standard 存储桶流式传输数据，训练无需先完整下载，也不必为 300 GB 数据集创建并付费保存第二份副本；200 MB 的文件非常适合这种模式，仪表板工具也能继续使用同一份数据。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon EFS 需要把数据复制到单独计费的文件系统中，其每 GB 价格高于 S3 Standard。
  • B: Amazon FSx for Lustre 吞吐量最高但也最昂贵，对 300 GB、单文件 200 MB 的数据来说并无必要。
  • C: S3 Express One Zone 需要把数据复制到目录存储桶中且存储单价更高，在没有对应需求的情况下只会增加成本。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Fast file mode streams training data directly from the existing S3 Standard bucket as the job reads it, so training starts without a full download and no second copy of the 300 GB dataset has to be created or paid for; 200 MB files are well suited to this mode, and the dashboard tool keeps using the same data.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon EFS requires copying the data into a separately billed file system with a higher per-GB price than S3 Standard.
  • B: Amazon FSx for Lustre delivers the highest throughput but is the most expensive option and is unnecessary for 300 GB of 200 MB files.
  • C: S3 Express One Zone would require duplicating the data into a directory bucket at a higher storage price, adding cost without a matching need.

questions.content: A company has an ML model that is deployed to an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time inference. The company needs to deploy a new model. The company must compare the new model’s performance to the currently deployed model’s performance before shifting all traffic to the new model. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.label: A
options.content: Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Manually split traffic between the two endpoints.

contents.en: Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Manually split traffic between the two endpoints.
contents.zh: 将新模型部署到单独的端点。手动在两个端点之间分配流量。

options.label: B
options.content: Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute traffic between the two endpoints.

contents.en: Deploy the new model to a separate endpoint. Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute traffic between the two endpoints.
contents.zh: 将新模型部署到单独的端点。使用Amazon CloudFront在两个端点之间分配流量。

options.label: C
options.content: Deploy the new model as a shadow variant on the same endpoint as the current model. Route a portion of live traffic to the shadow model for evaluation.

contents.en: Deploy the new model as a shadow variant on the same endpoint as the current model. Route a portion of live traffic to the shadow model for evaluation.
contents.zh: 将新模型作为影子变体部署在与当前模型相同的端点上。将一部分实时流量路由到影子模型进行评估。

options.label: D
options.content: Use AWS Lambda functions with custom logic to route traffic between the current model and the new model.

contents.en: Use AWS Lambda functions with custom logic to route traffic between the current model and the new model.
contents.zh: 使用带有自定义逻辑的AWS Lambda函数在当前模型和新模型之间路由流量。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker 影子测试可把新模型作为影子变体部署在现有终端节点上，自动把一部分实时请求镜像给它，记录其响应但不返回给调用方，并可在推广前并排比较延迟和错误指标，整个过程是托管功能，无需自定义路由。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 手动在两个终端节点之间分配流量需要自定义客户端逻辑和持续的运维工作。
  • B: Amazon CloudFront 是内容分发网络，不提供在 SageMaker 终端节点之间按权重分配推理流量的能力。
  • D: 自定义 Lambda 路由逻辑需要编写、部署和维护，比内置的影子变体功能运维工作量更大。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker 影子测试可把新模型作为影子变体部署在现有终端节点上，自动把一部分实时请求镜像给它，记录其响应但不返回给调用方，并可在推广前并排比较延迟和错误指标，整个过程是托管功能，无需自定义路由。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 手动在两个终端节点之间分配流量需要自定义客户端逻辑和持续的运维工作。
  • B: Amazon CloudFront 是内容分发网络，不提供在 SageMaker 终端节点之间按权重分配推理流量的能力。
  • D: 自定义 Lambda 路由逻辑需要编写、部署和维护，比内置的影子变体功能运维工作量更大。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: SageMaker shadow testing deploys the new model as a shadow variant on the existing endpoint, automatically mirrors a configurable portion of live requests to it, logs its responses without returning them to callers, and lets you compare latency and error metrics side by side before promoting it, all as a managed feature with no custom routing.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Manually splitting traffic between two endpoints requires custom client logic and ongoing operational work.
  • B: Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network and does not provide weighted distribution of inference traffic between SageMaker endpoints.
  • D: Custom Lambda routing logic must be written, deployed, and maintained, which is more operational effort than the built-in shadow variant feature.

The company must compare the new model’s performance to the currently deployed model’s performance before shifting all traffic to the new model. questions.content: A company runs an ML model on Amazon SageMaker. The company uses an automatic process that makes API calls to create training jobs for the model. The company has new compliance rules that prohibit the collection of aggregated metadata from training jobs. Which solution will prevent SageMaker from collecting metadata from the training jobs?

options.label: A
options.content: Opt out of metadata tracking for any training job that is submitted.

contents.en: Opt out of metadata tracking for any training job that is submitted.
contents.zh: 选择退出任何提交的训练作业的元数据跟踪。

options.label: B
options.content: Ensure that training jobs are running in a private subnet in a custom VPC.

contents.en: Ensure that training jobs are running in a private subnet in a custom VPC.
contents.zh: 确保训练作业在自定义VPC的私有子网中运行。

options.label: C
options.content: Encrypt the training data with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.

contents.en: Encrypt the training data with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）客户管理的密钥加密训练数据。

options.label: D
options.content: Reconfigure the training jobs to use only AWS Nitro instances.

contents.en: Reconfigure the training jobs to use only AWS Nitro instances.
contents.zh: 重新配置训练作业以仅使用AWS Nitro实例。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker 默认会收集训练作业的聚合元数据，唯一能停止这种收集的方法是显式选择退出，例如在自动流程使用的 SageMaker SDK 配置中设置遥测退出（telemetry opt-out），使每个提交的训练作业都在禁用元数据跟踪的情况下创建。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 在私有子网中运行只隔离了作业的网络流量，并不会改变 SageMaker 记录的作业元数据。
  • C: 使用 KMS 密钥加密训练数据只保护静态数据，对元数据收集没有任何影响。
  • D: Nitro 实例提供的是硬件级别的计算隔离，不会禁用 SageMaker 的元数据跟踪。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker 默认会收集训练作业的聚合元数据，唯一能停止这种收集的方法是显式选择退出，例如在自动流程使用的 SageMaker SDK 配置中设置遥测退出（telemetry opt-out），使每个提交的训练作业都在禁用元数据跟踪的情况下创建。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 在私有子网中运行只隔离了作业的网络流量，并不会改变 SageMaker 记录的作业元数据。
  • C: 使用 KMS 密钥加密训练数据只保护静态数据，对元数据收集没有任何影响。
  • D: Nitro 实例提供的是硬件级别的计算隔离，不会禁用 SageMaker 的元数据跟踪。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker collects aggregated metadata about training jobs by default, and the only way to stop that collection is to explicitly opt out, for example by setting the telemetry opt-out in the SageMaker SDK configuration used by the automated process so that every submitted training job is created with metadata tracking disabled.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Running in a private subnet isolates the job's network traffic but does not change what metadata SageMaker records about the job.
  • C: Encrypting the training data with a KMS key protects the data at rest and has no effect on metadata collection.
  • D: Nitro instances provide hardware-level isolation of the compute but do not disable SageMaker's metadata tracking.

The company has new compliance rules that prohibit the collection of aggregated metadata from training jobs. Which solution will prevent SageMaker from collecting metadata from the training jobs?

questions.content: A company is exploring generative AI and wants to add a new product feature. An ML engineer is making API calls from existing Amazon EC2 instances to Amazon Bedrock. The EC2 instances are in a private subnet and must remain private during the implementation. The EC2 instances have an assigned security group that allows access to all IP addresses in the private subnet. What should the ML engineer do to establish a connection between the EC2 instances and Amazon Bedrock?

options.label: A
options.content: Modify the security group to allow inbound and outbound traffic to and from Amazon Bedrock.

contents.en: Modify the security group to allow inbound and outbound traffic to and from Amazon Bedrock.
contents.zh: 修改安全组以允许与Amazon Bedrock之间的入站和出站流量。

options.label: B
options.content: Use AWS PrivateLink to access Amazon Bedrock through an interface VPC endpoint.

contents.en: Use AWS PrivateLink to access Amazon Bedrock through an interface VPC endpoint.
contents.zh: 使用AWS PrivateLink通过接口VPC端点访问Amazon Bedrock。

options.label: C
options.content: Configure Amazon Bedrock to use the private subnet where the EC2 instances are deployed.

contents.en: Configure Amazon Bedrock to use the private subnet where the EC2 instances are deployed.
contents.zh: 配置Amazon Bedrock使用EC2实例所在的私有子网。

options.label: D
options.content: Link the existing VPC to Amazon Bedrock by using an AWS Direct Connect connection.

contents.en: Link the existing VPC to Amazon Bedrock by using an AWS Direct Connect connection.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Direct Connect连接将现有VPC链接到Amazon Bedrock。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：为 Bedrock 运行时服务创建由 AWS PrivateLink 提供支持的接口 VPC 终端节点，会在 EC2 实例所在子网中提供一个可供调用的私有 IP 地址，Bedrock API 流量始终不离开 AWS 网络，实例无需互联网网关或 NAT 网关即可保持私有。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 安全组规则不会创建网络路径，私有子网中的实例依然没有通往 Bedrock 公共终端节点的路由。
  • C: Amazon Bedrock 是托管服务，不能部署到客户自己的子网中。
  • D: AWS Direct Connect 用于把本地网络连接到 AWS，不能把 VPC 连接到某个 AWS 服务。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：为 Bedrock 运行时服务创建由 AWS PrivateLink 提供支持的接口 VPC 终端节点，会在 EC2 实例所在子网中提供一个可供调用的私有 IP 地址，Bedrock API 流量始终不离开 AWS 网络，实例无需互联网网关或 NAT 网关即可保持私有。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 安全组规则不会创建网络路径，私有子网中的实例依然没有通往 Bedrock 公共终端节点的路由。
  • C: Amazon Bedrock 是托管服务，不能部署到客户自己的子网中。
  • D: AWS Direct Connect 用于把本地网络连接到 AWS，不能把 VPC 连接到某个 AWS 服务。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: An interface VPC endpoint powered by AWS PrivateLink for the Bedrock runtime service gives the EC2 instances a private IP address inside their subnet that they can call, so Bedrock API traffic never leaves the AWS network and the instances stay private without an internet or NAT gateway.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A security group rule does not create a network path; instances in a private subnet still have no route to the public Bedrock endpoint.
  • C: Amazon Bedrock is a managed service and cannot be placed into a customer's subnet.
  • D: AWS Direct Connect links an on-premises network to AWS; it does not connect a VPC to an AWS service.

The EC2 instances are in a private subnet and must remain private during the implementation. questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：把每条评论归入正面、中性或负面这几个固定标签是文本分类问题，因此应选择 FMEval 的分类评估任务，它会基于带标签的类别计算准确率、精确率、召回率和平衡准确率。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 开放式生成评估的是自由文本输出，不适用于预测固定标签。
  • C: 问答评估的是模型根据给定上下文回答问题的准确性，而不是对文本进行分类。
  • D: 文本摘要评估的是模型压缩长文本的忠实程度，与情感标注无关。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：把每条评论归入正面、中性或负面这几个固定标签是文本分类问题，因此应选择 FMEval 的分类评估任务，它会基于带标签的类别计算准确率、精确率、召回率和平衡准确率。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 开放式生成评估的是自由文本输出，不适用于预测固定标签。
  • C: 问答评估的是模型根据给定上下文回答问题的准确性，而不是对文本进行分类。
  • D: 文本摘要评估的是模型压缩长文本的忠实程度，与情感标注无关。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Assigning each review to one of the fixed labels positive, neutral, or negative is a text classification problem, so the FMEval classification evaluation task, which scores accuracy, precision, recall, and balanced accuracy against labeled categories, is the correct choice.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Open-ended generation evaluates free-form text output and is not designed for predicting a fixed label.
  • C: Question answering evaluates how accurately the model answers a question from provided context, not how it categorizes text.
  • D: Text summarization evaluates how faithfully a model condenses a longer passage, which is not what sentiment labeling requires.

options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker JumpStart to deploy the LLM.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker JumpStart to deploy the LLM.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon SageMaker JumpStart部署LLM。

options.label: B
options.content: Download the LLM as a .zip file. Deploy the LLM on a GPU-based Amazon EC2 instance.

contents.zh: 将LLM下载为.zip文件。在基于GPU的Amazon EC2实例上部署LLM。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a frontend HTML interface that uses an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API with AWS Lambda functions to handle the user interaction.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A、C：Amazon SageMaker JumpStart 只需几次点击或一次 SDK 调用就能把流行的开源 LLM 部署到托管的 SageMaker 终端节点，而基于 Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API 和 AWS Lambda 函数构建的无服务器前端可以把用户提问转发到该终端节点并流式返回结果，模型托管和界面都无需管理服务器。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 下载 LLM 并在 GPU EC2 实例上运行，意味着要自行为实例和推理服务栈打补丁、扩缩容和运维。
  • D: Amazon QuickSight 是商业智能仪表板服务，不能作为与 LLM 对话的界面。
  • E: Amazon Lex 用于构建基于意图和槽位的聊天机器人，需要定义机器人和履行逻辑，而不是把自由形式的问题直接交给 LLM。
