为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 下载 LLM 并在 GPU EC2 实例上运行，意味着要自行为实例和推理服务栈打补丁、扩缩容和运维。
  • D: Amazon QuickSight 是商业智能仪表板服务，不能作为与 LLM 对话的界面。
  • E: Amazon Lex 用于构建基于意图和槽位的聊天机器人，需要定义机器人和履行逻辑，而不是把自由形式的问题直接交给 LLM。
explanations.en:
Correct answers A and C: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart deploys popular open source LLMs to a managed SageMaker endpoint with a few clicks or one SDK call, and a serverless frontend built on an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API with AWS Lambda functions forwards user prompts to that endpoint and streams responses back, so neither the model host nor the interface requires servers to manage.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Downloading the LLM and running it on a GPU EC2 instance means patching, scaling, and operating the instance and the serving stack yourself.
  • D: Amazon QuickSight is a business intelligence dashboard service and cannot serve as a conversational interface to an LLM.
  • E: Amazon Lex builds intent-and-slot chatbots and would require defining bots and fulfillment logic rather than passing free-form questions to the LLM.

questions.content: A company wants to build a real-time analytics application that uses streaming data from social media. An ML engineer must implement a solution that ingests and transforms 5 GB of data each minute. The solution also must load the data into a data store that supports fast queries for the real-time analytics. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon EventBridge to ingest the social media data. Use AWS Glue to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon ElastiCache (Memcached).

contents.en: Use Amazon EventBridge to ingest the social media data. Use AWS Glue to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon ElastiCache (Memcached).
contents.zh: 使用Amazon EventBridge摄入社交媒体数据。使用AWS Glue转换数据。将转换后的数据存储在Amazon ElastiCache（Memcached）中。

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to ingest the social media data. Use AWS Lambda to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon S3.

contents.en: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to ingest the social media data. Use AWS Lambda to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon S3.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）摄入社交媒体数据。使用AWS Lambda转换数据。将转换后的数据存储在Amazon S3中。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to ingest the social media data. Use Amazon EMR to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon RDS.

contents.en: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to ingest the social media data. Use Amazon EMR to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon RDS.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）摄入社交媒体数据。使用Amazon EMR转换数据。将转换后的数据存储在Amazon RDS中。

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the social media data. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon DynamoDB.

contents.en: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the social media data. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to transform the data. Store the transformed data in Amazon DynamoDB.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon Kinesis Data Streams摄入社交媒体数据。使用Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink转换数据。将转换后的数据存储在Amazon DynamoDB中。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 可通过分片扩展来摄取每分钟 5 GB 的社交媒体流数据，Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink 对流数据进行实时转换，Amazon DynamoDB 在任意规模下都能提供个位数毫秒级的读取延迟，正是实时分析应用所需的快速查询数据存储。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon EventBridge 是用于路由离散事件的事件总线，不是高吞吐的数据流摄取服务，Amazon ElastiCache 是缓存而不是持久的分析存储。
  • B: Amazon SQS 和 AWS Lambda 并非为如此规模的持续流转换而设计，Amazon S3 也不能为实时分析提供快速交互式查询。
  • C: Amazon SNS 是发布/订阅通知服务，Amazon EMR 处理流数据需要管理集群，Amazon RDS 也不适合高速实时摄取和分析查询。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 可通过分片扩展来摄取每分钟 5 GB 的社交媒体流数据，Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink 对流数据进行实时转换，Amazon DynamoDB 在任意规模下都能提供个位数毫秒级的读取延迟，正是实时分析应用所需的快速查询数据存储。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon EventBridge 是用于路由离散事件的事件总线，不是高吞吐的数据流摄取服务，Amazon ElastiCache 是缓存而不是持久的分析存储。
  • B: Amazon SQS 和 AWS Lambda 并非为如此规模的持续流转换而设计，Amazon S3 也不能为实时分析提供快速交互式查询。
  • C: Amazon SNS 是发布/订阅通知服务，Amazon EMR 处理流数据需要管理集群，Amazon RDS 也不适合高速实时摄取和分析查询。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams scales by shards to ingest 5 GB per minute of streaming social media data, Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink transforms the stream in real time, and Amazon DynamoDB provides single-digit millisecond reads at any scale, which is the fast-query data store the real-time analytics application needs.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon EventBridge is an event bus for routing discrete events, not a high-throughput data stream ingestion service, and Amazon ElastiCache is a cache rather than a durable analytics store.
  • B: Amazon SQS and AWS Lambda are not designed for continuous stream transformation at this volume, and Amazon S3 does not provide fast interactive queries for real-time analytics.
  • C: Amazon SNS is a pub/sub notification service, Amazon EMR requires cluster management for stream processing, and Amazon RDS is not optimized for high-velocity real-time ingestion and analytics queries.

questions.content: A company stores training data as a .csv file in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must encrypt the data and must control which applications have access to the encryption key. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a new SSH access key. Use the AWS Encryption CLI with a reference to the new access key to encrypt the file.

contents.en: Create a new SSH access key. Use the AWS Encryption CLI with a reference to the new access key to encrypt the file.
contents.zh: 创建一个新的SSH访问密钥。使用AWS Encryption CLI并引用新的访问密钥来加密文件。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a new API key by using the Amazon API Gateway CreateApiKey API operation. Use the AWS CLI with a reference to the new API key to encrypt the file.

contents.en: Create a new API key by using the Amazon API Gateway CreateApiKey API operation. Use the AWS CLI with a reference to the new API key to encrypt the file.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon API Gateway CreateApiKey API操作创建一个新的API密钥。使用AWS CLI并引用新的API密钥来加密文件。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a new IAM role. Attach a policy that allows the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) GenerateDataKey action. Use the role to encrypt the file.

contents.en: Create a new IAM role. Attach a policy that allows the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) GenerateDataKey action. Use the role to encrypt the file.
contents.zh: 创建一个新的IAM角色。附加一个允许AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）GenerateDataKey操作的策略。使用该角色加密文件。

options.label: D
options.content: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Use the AWS Encryption CLI with a reference to the new KMS key to encrypt the file.

contents.en: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Use the AWS Encryption CLI with a reference to the new KMS key to encrypt the file.
contents.zh: 创建一个新的AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）密钥。使用AWS Encryption CLI并引用新的KMS密钥来加密文件。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：创建客户托管的 AWS KMS 密钥后，公司可以通过密钥策略和 IAM 策略精确控制哪些应用程序和角色可以使用该密钥，再用 AWS Encryption CLI 以该 KMS 密钥作为封装密钥在客户端加密 .csv 文件，然后存入 S3。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SSH 密钥用于实例登录认证，AWS Encryption CLI 无法引用它来加密数据。
  • B: API Gateway 的 API 密钥用于标识客户端以进行用量计划和限流，不是加密密钥。
  • C: 拥有 GenerateDataKey 权限的 IAM 角色仍需要一个 KMS 密钥才能操作，角色本身既不能加密文件，也不能定义哪些应用程序可以使用密钥。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：创建客户托管的 AWS KMS 密钥后，公司可以通过密钥策略和 IAM 策略精确控制哪些应用程序和角色可以使用该密钥，再用 AWS Encryption CLI 以该 KMS 密钥作为封装密钥在客户端加密 .csv 文件，然后存入 S3。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SSH 密钥用于实例登录认证，AWS Encryption CLI 无法引用它来加密数据。
  • B: API Gateway 的 API 密钥用于标识客户端以进行用量计划和限流，不是加密密钥。
  • C: 拥有 GenerateDataKey 权限的 IAM 角色仍需要一个 KMS 密钥才能操作，角色本身既不能加密文件，也不能定义哪些应用程序可以使用密钥。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Creating a customer managed AWS KMS key lets the company control exactly which applications and roles can use the key through its key policy and IAM policies, and the AWS Encryption CLI encrypts the .csv file client-side using that KMS key as the wrapping key before it is stored in S3.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SSH keys authenticate access to instances and cannot be referenced by the AWS Encryption CLI to encrypt data.
  • B: API Gateway API keys identify clients for usage plans and throttling; they are not encryption keys.
  • C: An IAM role with GenerateDataKey permission needs a KMS key to act on, and a role by itself does not encrypt the file or define which applications can use the key.

options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker Feature Processing to process and ingest the data. Use SageMaker Feature Store to manage and store the features.

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to transform the data and to ingest the data directly into Amazon SageMaker Feature Store. Use Feature Store to manage and store the features.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Feature Processing 允许把特征工程、聚合和数据准备逻辑定义为可调度的托管管道，并把生成的特征直接摄入 SageMaker Feature Store，后者通过在线和离线存储对特征进行管理、版本化和提供服务。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: SageMaker Model Monitor 用于监控已部署模型的漂移，不负责摄入或转换特征数据，普通的 S3 存储桶也无法管理特征。
  • C: Managed Service for Apache Flink 没有面向 SageMaker Feature Store 的原生输出连接器，直接摄入需要编写自定义连接器代码。
  • D: SageMaker 批量转换作业是对已训练模型执行推理而不是做特征工程，DynamoDB 也缺少 Feature Store 的特征组、谱系和离线存储能力。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Feature Processing 允许把特征工程、聚合和数据准备逻辑定义为可调度的托管管道，并把生成的特征直接摄入 SageMaker Feature Store，后者通过在线和离线存储对特征进行管理、版本化和提供服务。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: SageMaker Model Monitor 用于监控已部署模型的漂移，不负责摄入或转换特征数据，普通的 S3 存储桶也无法管理特征。
  • C: Managed Service for Apache Flink 没有面向 SageMaker Feature Store 的原生输出连接器，直接摄入需要编写自定义连接器代码。
  • D: SageMaker 批量转换作业是对已训练模型执行推理而不是做特征工程，DynamoDB 也缺少 Feature Store 的特征组、谱系和离线存储能力。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker Feature Processing lets you define feature engineering, aggregation, and preparation logic that runs as managed, schedulable pipelines and ingests the resulting features directly into SageMaker Feature Store, which then manages, versions, and serves them through its online and offline stores.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: SageMaker Model Monitor monitors deployed models for drift; it does not ingest or transform feature data, and a plain S3 bucket does not manage features.
  • C: Managed Service for Apache Flink has no native sink for SageMaker Feature Store, so direct ingestion would require custom connector code.
  • D: SageMaker batch transform runs inference on trained models rather than feature engineering, and DynamoDB lacks Feature Store's feature groups, lineage, and offline store.

questions.content: A company is developing a new online application to gather information from customers. An ML engineer has developed a new ML model that will determine a score for each customer. The model will use the score to determine which product to display to the customer. The ML engineer needs to minimize response-time latency for the model. How should the ML engineer deploy the application in Amazon SageMaker to meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure batch transform.

contents.en: Configure batch transform.
contents.zh: 配置批量转换。

options.label: B
options.content: Configure a real-time inference endpoint.

contents.en: Configure a real-time inference endpoint.
contents.zh: 配置实时推理端点。

options.label: C
options.content: Configure a serverless inference endpoint.

contents.en: Configure a serverless inference endpoint.
contents.zh: 配置无服务器推理端点。

options.label: D
options.content: Configure an asynchronous inference endpoint.

contents.en: Configure an asynchronous inference endpoint.
contents.zh: 配置异步推理端点。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker 实时推理端点将模型加载在常驻实例上，以毫秒级同步返回预测结果，正是需要最小化响应延迟的交互式在线应用所需的部署方式。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 批量转换（Batch Transform）是离线作业，处理存放在 Amazon S3 中的整批数据，无法实时响应单个客户请求。
  • C: Serverless Inference 会缩容到零，流量到来时存在冷启动延迟，无法保证最低延迟。
  • D: Asynchronous Inference 将请求排队并稍后把结果写入 Amazon S3，适用于长时间运行的请求，而不是追求最低延迟。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker 实时推理端点将模型加载在常驻实例上，以毫秒级同步返回预测结果，正是需要最小化响应延迟的交互式在线应用所需的部署方式。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 批量转换（Batch Transform）是离线作业，处理存放在 Amazon S3 中的整批数据，无法实时响应单个客户请求。
  • C: Serverless Inference 会缩容到零，流量到来时存在冷启动延迟，无法保证最低延迟。
  • D: Asynchronous Inference 将请求排队并稍后把结果写入 Amazon S3，适用于长时间运行的请求，而不是追求最低延迟。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: A SageMaker real-time inference endpoint keeps the model loaded on always-on instances and returns predictions synchronously in milliseconds, which is exactly what an interactive online application that must minimize response-time latency needs.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Batch transform is an offline job that processes whole datasets stored in Amazon S3 and cannot answer individual customer requests in real time.
  • C: Serverless Inference scales to zero and suffers cold-start delays when traffic arrives, so it cannot guarantee the lowest latency.
  • D: Asynchronous Inference queues requests and delivers results to Amazon S3 later, which is designed for long-running requests, not minimal latency.

questions.content: A company is using Amazon EMR. The company has a large dataset in Amazon S3 that needs to be ingested into Amazon SageMaker Feature Store. The dataset contains historical data and real-time streaming data. The company must ensure that the Feature Store online store is updated with the most recent data as soon as the data becomes available. The company also must maintain a complete Feature Store offline store for batch processing. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use the PutRecord API in Feature Store Runtime to ingest all the data into the online store.

contents.en: Use the PutRecord API in Feature Store Runtime to ingest all the data into the online store.
contents.zh: 使用Feature Store Runtime中的PutRecord API将所有数据摄入在线存储。

options.label: B
options.content: Use the PutRecord API in Feature Store Runtime to ingest all the data into the offline store.

contents.en: Use the PutRecord API in Feature Store Runtime to ingest all the data into the offline store.
contents.zh: 使用Feature Store Runtime中的PutRecord API将所有数据摄入离线存储。

options.label: C
options.content: Use the Feature Store Spark connector to ingest the data as Spark DataFrames with the online store and offline store enabled.

contents.en: Use the Feature Store Spark connector to ingest the data as Spark DataFrames with the online store and offline store enabled.
contents.zh: 使用Feature Store Spark连接器将数据作为Spark DataFrames摄入，同时启用在线存储和离线存储。

options.label: D
options.content: Use the Feature Store Spark connector to ingest the data as Spark DataFrames with only the online store enabled.

contents.en: Use the Feature Store Spark connector to ingest the data as Spark DataFrames with only the online store enabled.
contents.zh: 使用Feature Store Spark连接器将数据作为Spark DataFrames摄入，仅启用在线存储。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Feature Store Spark 连接器可直接在 Amazon EMR 上运行，以 Spark DataFrame 的形式大规模摄入数据；同时启用在线存储和离线存储后，每条记录会立即写入在线存储并复制到 Amazon S3 中的离线存储，既满足低延迟的数据新鲜度要求，也保留了批处理所需的完整历史。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 逐条调用 PutRecord 对 EMR 上的大型数据集效率很低，而且只写入在线存储就没有可用于批处理的离线存储。
  • B: 只写入离线存储意味着在线存储永远不会用最新数据更新。
  • D: 只启用在线存储虽然数据是最新的，却无法维护批处理所需的完整离线存储。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Feature Store Spark 连接器可直接在 Amazon EMR 上运行，以 Spark DataFrame 的形式大规模摄入数据；同时启用在线存储和离线存储后，每条记录会立即写入在线存储并复制到 Amazon S3 中的离线存储，既满足低延迟的数据新鲜度要求，也保留了批处理所需的完整历史。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 逐条调用 PutRecord 对 EMR 上的大型数据集效率很低，而且只写入在线存储就没有可用于批处理的离线存储。
  • B: 只写入离线存储意味着在线存储永远不会用最新数据更新。
  • D: 只启用在线存储虽然数据是最新的，却无法维护批处理所需的完整离线存储。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: The SageMaker Feature Store Spark connector runs natively on Amazon EMR and ingests Spark DataFrames at scale; with both the online store and offline store enabled, each record is written to the online store immediately and replicated to the offline store in Amazon S3, satisfying both the low-latency freshness requirement and the complete batch-processing history requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Calling PutRecord one record at a time is inefficient for a large EMR dataset, and targeting only the online store leaves no offline store for batch processing.
  • B: Writing only to the offline store means the online store is never updated with the most recent data.
  • D: Enabling only the online store provides fresh data but does not maintain the complete offline store that batch processing requires.

contents.en: A company is using Amazon EMR. The company has a large dataset in Amazon S3 that needs to be ingested into Amazon SageMaker Feature Store. The dataset contains historical data and real-time streaming data. The company must ensure that the Feature Store online store is updated with the most recent data as soon as the data becomes available. The company also must maintain a complete Feature Store offline store for batch processing. Which solution will meet these requirements?
contents.zh: 一家公司正在使用Amazon EMR。该公司在Amazon S3中有一个大型数据集，需要摄入到Amazon SageMaker Feature Store中。该数据集包含历史数据和实时流数据。公司必须确保Feature Store在线存储会在数据可用后立即用最新数据更新。公司还必须维护一个完整的Feature Store离线存储用于批处理。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

questions.content: An ML engineer needs to deploy four ML models in an Amazon SageMaker inference pipeline. The models were built with different frameworks. The ML engineer also needs to give clients the ability to use the invoke_endpoint call to perform inference for each model. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a SageMaker multi-model endpoint.

contents.en: Create a SageMaker multi-model endpoint.
contents.zh: 创建一个SageMaker多模型端点。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a SageMaker multi-container endpoint.

contents.en: Create a SageMaker multi-container endpoint.
contents.zh: 创建一个SageMaker多容器端点。

options.label: C
options.content: Create multiple SageMaker single-model endpoints.

contents.en: Create multiple SageMaker single-model endpoints.
contents.zh: 创建多个SageMaker单模型端点。

options.label: D
options.content: Run a SparkML job to generate multiple endpoints.

contents.en: Run a SparkML job to generate multiple endpoints.
contents.zh: 运行SparkML作业以生成多个端点。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker 多容器端点可在同一组实例上托管最多 15 个基于不同框架构建的容器，通过直接调用模式，客户端在 invoke_endpoint 中指定 TargetContainerHostname 参数即可访问任一模型，因此四个异构模型可共享一个端点的成本。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 多模型端点要求所有模型使用同一个框架容器，四个不同框架的模型无法满足这一条件。
  • C: 四个独立的单模型端点需要运行四组实例，托管成本翻了四倍。
  • D: SparkML 是训练和处理框架，不是创建 SageMaker 端点的机制。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker 多容器端点可在同一组实例上托管最多 15 个基于不同框架构建的容器，通过直接调用模式，客户端在 invoke_endpoint 中指定 TargetContainerHostname 参数即可访问任一模型，因此四个异构模型可共享一个端点的成本。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 多模型端点要求所有模型使用同一个框架容器，四个不同框架的模型无法满足这一条件。
  • C: 四个独立的单模型端点需要运行四组实例，托管成本翻了四倍。
  • D: SparkML 是训练和处理框架，不是创建 SageMaker 端点的机制。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: A SageMaker multi-container endpoint hosts up to 15 containers built on different frameworks on a single set of instances, and with direct invocation clients call invoke_endpoint with the TargetContainerHostname parameter to reach any one model, so four heterogeneous models share one endpoint's cost.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A multi-model endpoint requires all models to use the same framework container, which the four different-framework models cannot satisfy.
  • C: Four separate single-model endpoints run four sets of instances, quadrupling hosting cost.
  • D: SparkML is a training and processing framework, not a mechanism for creating SageMaker endpoints.

contents.en: An ML engineer needs to deploy four ML models in an Amazon SageMaker inference pipeline. The models were built with different frameworks. The ML engineer also needs to give clients the ability to use the invoke_endpoint call to perform inference for each model. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

questions.content: An ML engineer wants an Amazon SageMaker notebook to automatically stop running after 1 hour of idle time. How can the ML engineer accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a lifecycle configuration in SageMaker. Copy the auto-stop-idle script from GitHub to the Start Notebook section.

contents.en: Create a lifecycle configuration in SageMaker. Copy the auto-stop-idle script from GitHub to the Start Notebook section.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker中创建一个生命周期配置。将GitHub上的自动停止闲置脚本复制到"启动笔记本"部分。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a lifecycle configuration in SageMaker. Copy the auto-stop-idle script from GitHub to the Create Notebook section.

contents.en: Create a lifecycle configuration in SageMaker. Copy the auto-stop-idle script from GitHub to the Create Notebook section.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker中创建一个生命周期配置。将GitHub上的自动停止闲置脚本复制到"创建笔记本"部分。

options.label: C
options.content: Track the notebook's CPU metric by using Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Invoke an AWS Lambda function from CloudWatch Logs to shut down the notebook instance if CPU utilization becomes zero.

contents.en: Track the notebook's CPU metric by using Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Invoke an AWS Lambda function from CloudWatch Logs to shut down the notebook instance if CPU utilization becomes zero.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon CloudWatch Logs跟踪笔记本的CPU指标。如果CPU利用率变为零，从CloudWatch Logs调用AWS Lambda函数来关闭笔记本实例。

options.label: D
options.content: Track the notebook's memory metric by using Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Invoke an AWS Lambda function from CloudWatch Logs to shut down the notebook instance if memory utilization becomes zero.

contents.en: Track the notebook's memory metric by using Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Invoke an AWS Lambda function from CloudWatch Logs to shut down the notebook instance if memory utilization becomes zero.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon CloudWatch Logs跟踪笔记本的内存指标。如果内存利用率变为零，从CloudWatch Logs调用AWS Lambda函数来关闭笔记本实例。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker 笔记本实例的生命周期配置可在实例上运行 shell 脚本，AWS GitHub 示例仓库中的 auto-stop-idle 脚本会安装一个 cron 任务，在可配置的闲置时间（1 小时即 3600 秒）后停止实例。该脚本应放在"启动笔记本"（on-start）部分，因为根卷在每次停止和启动时都会重置，cron 任务必须在每次实例启动时重新创建。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: "创建笔记本"（on-create）脚本只在实例首次创建时运行一次，实例停止再启动后闲置停止的 cron 任务就会丢失。
  • C: CloudWatch Logs 并不跟踪 CPU 指标，CPU 利用率为零也不是"闲置 1 小时"的可靠定义，还需要维护自定义 Lambda 代码。
  • D: 运行中的实例内存利用率永远不会降到零，CloudWatch Logs 也不跟踪该指标，这种方案永远不会触发。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker 笔记本实例的生命周期配置可在实例上运行 shell 脚本，AWS GitHub 示例仓库中的 auto-stop-idle 脚本会安装一个 cron 任务，在可配置的闲置时间（1 小时即 3600 秒）后停止实例。该脚本应放在"启动笔记本"（on-start）部分，因为根卷在每次停止和启动时都会重置，cron 任务必须在每次实例启动时重新创建。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: "创建笔记本"（on-create）脚本只在实例首次创建时运行一次，实例停止再启动后闲置停止的 cron 任务就会丢失。
  • C: CloudWatch Logs 并不跟踪 CPU 指标，CPU 利用率为零也不是"闲置 1 小时"的可靠定义，还需要维护自定义 Lambda 代码。
  • D: 运行中的实例内存利用率永远不会降到零，CloudWatch Logs 也不跟踪该指标，这种方案永远不会触发。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker notebook instance lifecycle configurations run shell scripts on the instance, and the auto-stop-idle sample script from the AWS GitHub samples repository installs a cron job that stops the instance after a configurable idle time (3600 seconds for 1 hour). The script belongs in the Start Notebook (on-start) section because the root volume is reset on every stop and start, so the cron job must be re-created each time the instance starts.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: The Create Notebook (on-create) script runs only once when the instance is first created, so the idle-stop cron job would be lost after the instance is stopped and restarted.
  • C: CloudWatch Logs does not track CPU metrics, and zero CPU utilization is not a reliable definition of 1 hour of idle time; this also adds custom Lambda code to maintain.
  • D: Memory utilization never drops to zero on a running instance and CloudWatch Logs does not track it, so this approach would never trigger.

contents.en: An ML engineer wants an Amazon SageMaker notebook to automatically stop running after 1 hour of idle time. How can the ML engineer accomplish this goal?
contents.zh: 一名机器学习工程师希望Amazon SageMaker笔记本在闲置1小时后自动停止运行。该工程师如何实现此目标？

questions.content: A company wants to provide services to help other businesses label images. The company wants its labeling specialists to complete human labeling tasks on AWS. How should the company register the labeling specialists to receive tasks on AWS?

options.label: A
options.content: Use AWS Data Exchange.

contents.en: Use AWS Data Exchange.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Data Exchange。

options.label: B
options.content: Create and use an internal workforce in Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth.

contents.en: Create and use an internal workforce in Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth.
contents.zh: 在Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth中创建并使用内部劳动力。

options.label: C
options.content: Create and use Amazon Mechanical Turk entities in an Amazon SageMaker human loop.

contents.en: Create and use Amazon Mechanical Turk entities in an Amazon SageMaker human loop.
contents.zh: 在Amazon SageMaker人工循环中创建并使用Amazon Mechanical Turk实体。

options.label: D
options.content: Use the Amazon Mechanical Turk website.

contents.en: Use the Amazon Mechanical Turk website.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon Mechanical Turk网站。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth 允许公司通过 Amazon Cognito 或 OIDC 身份提供商注册自己的工作人员，创建私有（内部）劳动力；注册后的标注专家登录标注门户，即可直接在 AWS 上接收人工标注任务。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Data Exchange 是查找和订阅第三方数据集的市场，不是注册人工工作人员的途径。
  • C: Amazon Mechanical Turk 是匿名的公共众包人群，无法用来注册公司自己的专家，而人工循环（human loop）属于 Amazon A2I，与工作人员注册无关。
  • D: Mechanical Turk 网站是任何人都能领取任务的公共众包市场，无法让公司把工作分配给指定的专家。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth 允许公司通过 Amazon Cognito 或 OIDC 身份提供商注册自己的工作人员，创建私有（内部）劳动力；注册后的标注专家登录标注门户，即可直接在 AWS 上接收人工标注任务。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Data Exchange 是查找和订阅第三方数据集的市场，不是注册人工工作人员的途径。
  • C: Amazon Mechanical Turk 是匿名的公共众包人群，无法用来注册公司自己的专家，而人工循环（human loop）属于 Amazon A2I，与工作人员注册无关。
  • D: Mechanical Turk 网站是任何人都能领取任务的公共众包市场，无法让公司把工作分配给指定的专家。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth lets a company create a private (internal) workforce by registering its own workers through Amazon Cognito or an OIDC identity provider; the registered labeling specialists then sign in to a labeling portal and receive human labeling tasks directly on AWS.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: AWS Data Exchange is a marketplace for finding and subscribing to third-party datasets, not a way to register human workers.
  • C: Amazon Mechanical Turk is an anonymous public crowd, so it cannot be used to register the company's own specialists, and human loops belong to Amazon A2I rather than worker registration.
  • D: The Mechanical Turk website is a public crowdsourcing marketplace where anyone can pick up tasks, which does not let the company assign work to its designated specialists.

questions.content: A company wants to use Amazon SageMaker to host an ML model that runs on CPU for real-time predictions. The model will have intermittent traffic during business hours and will have periods of no trafficafter business hours. The company needs a solution that will serve inference requests in the most cost-effective manner. Which hosting option will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Deploy the model to a SageMaker real-time endpoint. Add a schedule-based auto scaling policy to handle traffic surges during business hours.

contents.en: Deploy the model to a SageMaker real-time endpoint. Add a schedule-based auto scaling policy to handle traffic surges during business hours.
contents.zh: 将模型部署到SageMaker实时端点。添加基于 schedule 的自动扩展策略，以处理营业时间内的流量高峰。

options.label: B
options.content: Deploy the model to a SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint. Configure increased provisioned concurrency during business hours.

contents.en: Deploy the model to a SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint. Configure increased provisioned concurrency during business hours.
contents.zh: 将模型部署到SageMaker无服务器推理端点。在营业时间配置增加的预置并发。

options.label: C
options.content: Deploy the model to a SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint. Configure an auto scaling policy that scales in to zero outside business hours.

contents.en: Deploy the model to a SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint. Configure an auto scaling policy that scales in to zero outside business hours.
contents.zh: 将模型部署到SageMaker异步推理端点。配置一个自动扩展策略，在营业时间外缩减到零。

options.label: D
options.content: Deploy the model to a SageMaker real-time endpoint. Create a scheduled AWS Lambda function that activates the endpoint during business hours only.

contents.en: Deploy the model to a SageMaker real-time endpoint. Create a scheduled AWS Lambda function that activates the endpoint during business hours only.
contents.zh: 将模型部署到SageMaker实时端点。创建一个定时AWS Lambda函数，仅在营业时间激活端点。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Serverless Inference 专为间歇性 CPU 工作负载设计：无流量时缩容到零，营业时间之后不产生费用，仅按每次请求消耗的计算量计费；在营业时间提高 Provisioned Concurrency 可保持实例预热、避免冷启动延迟，因此是最具成本效益的选项。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 实时端点必须全天候至少运行一个实例，无流量期间公司仍需为闲置容量付费。
  • C: Asynchronous Inference 将请求排队并把结果写入 Amazon S3，虽然可以缩容到零，但不符合实时预测的需求。
  • D: 端点没有"激活/停用"操作，Lambda 函数只能每天删除并重建端点，这会增加运维复杂度和数分钟的启动延迟。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Serverless Inference 专为间歇性 CPU 工作负载设计：无流量时缩容到零，营业时间之后不产生费用，仅按每次请求消耗的计算量计费；在营业时间提高 Provisioned Concurrency 可保持实例预热、避免冷启动延迟，因此是最具成本效益的选项。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 实时端点必须全天候至少运行一个实例，无流量期间公司仍需为闲置容量付费。
  • C: Asynchronous Inference 将请求排队并把结果写入 Amazon S3，虽然可以缩容到零，但不符合实时预测的需求。
  • D: 端点没有"激活/停用"操作，Lambda 函数只能每天删除并重建端点，这会增加运维复杂度和数分钟的启动延迟。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: SageMaker Serverless Inference is built for intermittent CPU workloads: it scales to zero when there is no traffic so nothing is billed after business hours, it charges only for the compute consumed per request, and Provisioned Concurrency can be raised during business hours to keep instances warm and avoid cold-start latency, making it the most cost-effective option.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A real-time endpoint must keep at least one instance running 24/7, so the company pays for idle capacity throughout the periods of no traffic.
  • C: Asynchronous Inference queues requests and returns results to Amazon S3, which does not fit the real-time prediction requirement even though it can scale to zero.
  • D: There is no activate or deactivate operation for an endpoint; a Lambda function would have to delete and recreate the endpoint daily, which adds operational complexity and multi-minute startup delays.

questions.content: An ML engineer needs to train a supervised deep learning model. The available dataset is a large number of unlabeled images that only employees should access. The ML engineer needs to implement a solution that labels the dataset with the highest possible accuracy. Which combination of steps should the ML engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon Rekognition to automatically label the dataset.

contents.en: Use Amazon Rekognition to automatically label the dataset.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon Rekognition自动标记数据集。

options.label: B
options.content: Train the deep learning model directly on the raw data. Let the model infer the labels by itself.

contents.en: Train the deep learning model directly on the raw data. Let the model infer the labels by itself.
contents.zh: 直接在原始数据上训练深度学习模型。让模型自行推断标签。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to create an annotation job that specifies the labeling task and requirements.

contents.en: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to create an annotation job that specifies the labeling task and requirements.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth创建一个标注作业，指定标记任务和要求。

options.label: D
options.content: Set up workforce teams to access a private workforce to run and review the annotation job created by Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth.

contents.en: Set up workforce teams to access a private workforce to run and review the annotation job created by Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth.
contents.zh: 建立员工队伍以访问私有员工队伍，运行和审查由Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth创建的标注作业。

options.label: E
options.content: Use Amazon Mechanical Turk to complete the annotation job created by Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth.

contents.en: Use Amazon Mechanical Turk to complete the annotation job created by Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon Mechanical Turk完成由Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth创建的标注作业。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C、D：Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth 是生成高质量标注训练数据的托管服务：工程师创建标注作业来定义任务、说明和质量设置；由于只有员工可以访问这些图像，作业必须分派给由公司自有工作团队组成的私有劳动力，由他们完成标注并复核，从而获得最高的准确性。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon Rekognition 返回的是通用预训练标签，未必匹配所需的自定义类别，也无法达到人工复核所能提供的最高准确性。
  • B: 有监督模型无法在未标注数据上训练，让模型自行推断标签并不可行。
  • E: Amazon Mechanical Turk 是由匿名工作者组成的公共众包人群，违反了"只有员工可以访问图像"的要求。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C、D：Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth 是生成高质量标注训练数据的托管服务：工程师创建标注作业来定义任务、说明和质量设置；由于只有员工可以访问这些图像，作业必须分派给由公司自有工作团队组成的私有劳动力，由他们完成标注并复核，从而获得最高的准确性。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon Rekognition 返回的是通用预训练标签，未必匹配所需的自定义类别，也无法达到人工复核所能提供的最高准确性。
  • B: 有监督模型无法在未标注数据上训练，让模型自行推断标签并不可行。
  • E: Amazon Mechanical Turk 是由匿名工作者组成的公共众包人群，违反了"只有员工可以访问图像"的要求。
explanations.en:
Correct answers C and D: Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth is the managed service for producing high-quality labeled training data: the ML engineer creates a labeling (annotation) job that defines the task, instructions, and quality settings, and because only employees may access the images, the job must be routed to a private workforce made up of the company's own work teams, who label and review the annotations for the highest accuracy.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon Rekognition returns generic pre-trained labels that may not match the custom classes needed and cannot deliver the highest possible accuracy that human review provides.
  • B: A supervised model cannot be trained on unlabeled data, so letting the model infer its own labels is not a valid approach.
  • E: Amazon Mechanical Turk is a public crowd of anonymous workers, which violates the requirement that only employees access the images.

The ML engineer needs to implement a solution that labels the dataset with the highest possible accuracy. Which combination of steps should the ML engineer take to meet these requirements? questions.content: A company is using an Amazon S3 bucket to collect data that will be used for ML workflows. The company needs to use AWS Glue DataBrew to clean and normalize the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a DataBrew dataset by using the S3 path. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew profile job.

contents.en: Create a DataBrew dataset by using the S3 path. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew profile job.
contents.zh: 使用S3路径创建一个DataBrew数据集。使用DataBrew配置文件作业清理和标准化数据。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a DataBrew dataset by using the S3 path. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew recipe job.

contents.en: Create a DataBrew dataset by using the S3 path. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew recipe job.
contents.zh: 使用S3路径创建一个DataBrew数据集。使用DataBrew配方作业清理和标准化数据。

options.label: C
options.content: Create a DataBrew dataset by using a Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) driver to connect to the S3 bucket. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew profile job.

contents.en: Create a DataBrew dataset by using a Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) driver to connect to the S3 bucket. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew profile job.
contents.zh: 使用Java Database Connectivity（JDBC）驱动程序连接到S3存储桶，创建一个DataBrew数据集。使用DataBrew配置文件作业清理和标准化数据。

options.label: D
options.content: Create a DataBrew dataset by using a Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) driver to connect to the S3 bucket. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew recipe job.

contents.en: Create a DataBrew dataset by using a Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) driver to connect to the S3 bucket. Clean and normalize the data by using a DataBrew recipe job.
contents.zh: 使用Java Database Connectivity（JDBC）驱动程序连接到S3存储桶，创建一个DataBrew数据集。使用DataBrew配方作业清理和标准化数据。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：AWS Glue DataBrew 可通过 S3 路径创建数据集直接连接 Amazon S3 中的数据，配方作业（recipe job）会执行 DataBrew 配方中定义的清理和标准化转换步骤，并把转换后的结果写回 S3。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: DataBrew 配置文件作业（profile job）只计算数据集的统计信息和数据质量摘要，不会转换、清理或标准化数据。
  • C: JDBC 驱动用于将 DataBrew 连接到关系型数据库而不是 S3 存储桶，而且配置文件作业不做转换。
  • D: 配方作业是正确的作业类型，但访问 S3 应使用 S3 路径而不是 JDBC 连接。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：AWS Glue DataBrew 可通过 S3 路径创建数据集直接连接 Amazon S3 中的数据，配方作业（recipe job）会执行 DataBrew 配方中定义的清理和标准化转换步骤，并把转换后的结果写回 S3。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: DataBrew 配置文件作业（profile job）只计算数据集的统计信息和数据质量摘要，不会转换、清理或标准化数据。
  • C: JDBC 驱动用于将 DataBrew 连接到关系型数据库而不是 S3 存储桶，而且配置文件作业不做转换。
  • D: 配方作业是正确的作业类型，但访问 S3 应使用 S3 路径而不是 JDBC 连接。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: AWS Glue DataBrew connects directly to data in Amazon S3 by creating a dataset from the S3 path, and a recipe job applies the cleaning and normalization transformation steps defined in a DataBrew recipe and writes the transformed output back to S3.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A DataBrew profile job only computes statistics and data-quality summaries about the dataset; it does not transform, clean, or normalize the data.
  • C: JDBC drivers connect DataBrew to relational databases, not to S3 buckets, and a profile job does not transform data.
  • D: Although a recipe job is the right job type, S3 is accessed through an S3 path rather than a JDBC connection.

questions.content: A company is developing a new ML model that uses the XGBoost algorithm. The company will train the model on data that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data is in a nested JSON format. An ML engineer needs to convert the JSON files into a tabular format. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Create an AWS Glue PySpark job that uses the Relationalize transform to convert the files.

contents.en: Create an AWS Glue PySpark job that uses the Relationalize transform to convert the files.
contents.zh: 创建一个AWS Glue PySpark作业，使用Relationalize转换来转换文件。

options.label: B
options.content: Write custom Scala code to convert the files. Use Amazon EMR Serverless to run the Scala code.

contents.en: Write custom Scala code to convert the files. Use Amazon EMR Serverless to run the Scala code.
contents.zh: 编写自定义Scala代码来转换文件。使用Amazon EMR Serverless运行Scala代码。

options.label: C
options.content: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses a Python runtime and invokes the reduce() function to convert the files. Invoke the Lambda function.

contents.en: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses a Python runtime and invokes the reduce() function to convert the files. Invoke the Lambda function.
contents.zh: 创建一个使用Python运行时的AWS Lambda函数，并调用reduce()函数来转换文件。调用该Lambda函数。

options.label: D
options.content: Create an Amazon Athena database that is based on the JSON files. Use the Athena flatten function to convert the data.

contents.en: Create an Amazon Athena database that is based on the JSON files. Use the Athena flatten function to convert the data.
contents.zh: 基于JSON文件创建一个Amazon Athena数据库。使用Athena的flatten函数转换数据。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：AWS Glue 的 Relationalize 转换专门用于把嵌套 JSON 展平为一个或多个扁平的表格式 DynamicFrame，无需自定义解析代码；Glue 本身是完全托管的无服务器 Spark 服务，因此以最少的运维开销完成 S3 文件的转换。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 在 Amazon EMR Serverless 上编写并维护自定义 Scala 展平代码，比使用内置转换需要多得多的开发和运维工作。
  • C: 使用手写 reduce() 逻辑的 Lambda 函数属于自定义代码，还受 15 分钟超时和内存上限制约，不适合大数据集。
  • D: Athena 只是就地查询数据，并没有可以重写文件的 flatten 函数；要生成表格式训练文件仍需定义嵌套 schema 并编写额外的 CTAS 或 UNNEST 逻辑。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：AWS Glue 的 Relationalize 转换专门用于把嵌套 JSON 展平为一个或多个扁平的表格式 DynamicFrame，无需自定义解析代码；Glue 本身是完全托管的无服务器 Spark 服务，因此以最少的运维开销完成 S3 文件的转换。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 在 Amazon EMR Serverless 上编写并维护自定义 Scala 展平代码，比使用内置转换需要多得多的开发和运维工作。
  • C: 使用手写 reduce() 逻辑的 Lambda 函数属于自定义代码，还受 15 分钟超时和内存上限制约，不适合大数据集。
  • D: Athena 只是就地查询数据，并没有可以重写文件的 flatten 函数；要生成表格式训练文件仍需定义嵌套 schema 并编写额外的 CTAS 或 UNNEST 逻辑。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: The AWS Glue Relationalize transform is purpose-built to flatten nested JSON into one or more flat, tabular DynamicFrames without custom parsing code, and Glue is a fully managed serverless Spark service, so it converts the S3 files with the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Writing and maintaining custom Scala flattening code on Amazon EMR Serverless requires significantly more development and operational effort than a built-in transform.
  • C: A Lambda function with hand-written reduce() logic is custom code that is also constrained by the 15-minute timeout and memory limits for large datasets.
  • D: Athena queries data in place and has no flatten function that rewrites files; producing tabular training files would still require defining nested schemas and additional CTAS or UNNEST logic.

questions.content: A medical company ingests streams of data from devices that monitor patients’ vital signs. The company uses Amazon SageMaker and plans to prepare ML models to predict adverse events for patients. The dataset is large with thousands of features. An ML engineer needs to run several hundred training iterations with different sets of features, different algorithms, and many potential parameters. The ML engineer must implement a solution to log the characteristics and results of each training iteration. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.label: A
options.content: Use Amazon CloudWatch to create custom metrics for the characteristics of each iteration.

contents.en: Use Amazon CloudWatch to create custom metrics for the characteristics of each iteration.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon CloudWatch为每次迭代的特征创建自定义指标。

options.label: B
options.content: Write the characteristics of each iteration to logs in Amazon S3. Use AWS Glue and Amazon Athena to search the logs.

contents.en: Write the characteristics of each iteration to logs in Amazon S3. Use AWS Glue and Amazon Athena to search the logs.
contents.zh: 将每次迭代的特征写入Amazon S3中的日志。使用AWS Glue和Amazon Athena搜索日志。

options.label: C
options.content: Use the SageMaker Model Registry to track the characteristics and results of each iteration.

contents.en: Use the SageMaker Model Registry to track the characteristics and results of each iteration.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker模型注册表跟踪每次迭代的特征和结果。

options.label: D
options.content: Use SageMaker Experiments to track the characteristics and results of each iteration.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Experiments to track the characteristics and results of each iteration.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker实验跟踪每次迭代的特征和结果。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：Amazon SageMaker Experiments 是托管的实验跟踪功能，可自动记录每次训练运行的参数、输入数据集、特征集、算法、指标和产物，并支持对数百次运行进行并排比较，因此能以最少的实施工作量记录每次迭代。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CloudWatch 自定义指标需要编写代码发布每个特征，也不适合在多次运行之间比较参数集和特征列表。
  • B: 把日志写入 Amazon S3 再用 AWS Glue 和 Athena 查询，意味着要自行构建和维护一套跟踪系统。
  • C: SageMaker Model Registry 用于对已训练模型进行版本管理和部署审批，并非用于跟踪实验性训练迭代的参数和指标。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：Amazon SageMaker Experiments 是托管的实验跟踪功能，可自动记录每次训练运行的参数、输入数据集、特征集、算法、指标和产物，并支持对数百次运行进行并排比较，因此能以最少的实施工作量记录每次迭代。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CloudWatch 自定义指标需要编写代码发布每个特征，也不适合在多次运行之间比较参数集和特征列表。
  • B: 把日志写入 Amazon S3 再用 AWS Glue 和 Athena 查询，意味着要自行构建和维护一套跟踪系统。
  • C: SageMaker Model Registry 用于对已训练模型进行版本管理和部署审批，并非用于跟踪实验性训练迭代的参数和指标。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Amazon SageMaker Experiments is the managed experiment-tracking capability that automatically records the parameters, input datasets, feature sets, algorithms, metrics, and artifacts of every training run and lets you compare hundreds of runs side by side, so it captures each iteration with the LEAST implementation effort.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: CloudWatch custom metrics require writing code to publish every characteristic and are poorly suited to comparing parameter sets and feature lists across runs.
  • B: Writing logs to Amazon S3 and querying them with AWS Glue and Athena means building and maintaining a custom tracking system.
  • C: The SageMaker Model Registry versions and approves trained models for deployment; it is not designed to track the parameters and metrics of experimental training iterations.

questions.content: A company is planning to create an internal-only chat interface to help employees handle customer queries. Currently, the employees need to refer to a massive knowledge base of internal documents to address customer issues. The new solution must be serverless. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Set up Amazon Bedrock with the Anthropic Claude foundation model.

contents.en: Set up Amazon Bedrock with the Anthropic Claude foundation model.

options.label: B
options.content: Set up Amazon SageMaker JumpStart with the Llama foundation model.

contents.en: Set up Amazon SageMaker JumpStart with the Llama foundation model.
contents.zh: 使用Llama基础模型设置Amazon SageMaker JumpStart。

options.label: C
options.content: Use Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon API Gateway to invoke the model API.

contents.en: Use Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon API Gateway to invoke the model API.
contents.zh: 使用带有Amazon API Gateway的Amazon EC2实例调用模型API。

options.label: D
options.content: Use AWS Lambda functions with Amazon API Gateway to invoke the model API.

contents.en: Use AWS Lambda functions with Amazon API Gateway to invoke the model API.
contents.zh: 使用带有Amazon API Gateway的AWS Lambda函数调用模型API。

options.label: E
options.content: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store vector database dumps and embeddings.

contents.en: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store vector database dumps and embeddings.
contents.zh: 使用Amazon S3存储桶存储向量数据库转储和嵌入。

options.label: F

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A、D：Amazon Bedrock 以完全无服务器的 API 提供 Anthropic Claude 基础模型，无需管理任何基础设施；Amazon API Gateway 后面的 AWS Lambda 函数为内部聊天界面提供按需调用模型 API 的无服务器后端，整个方案保持无服务器。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: SageMaker JumpStart 会把 Llama 模型部署到运行在预置实例上的 SageMaker 实时端点，并非无服务器。
  • C: Amazon EC2 实例是需要公司自行预置、打补丁和扩缩的服务器，违反无服务器要求。
  • E: Amazon S3 是对象存储，无法执行向量存储所需的相似度搜索，嵌入应存放在 Amazon OpenSearch Serverless 之类的向量数据库中。
  • F: Amazon RDS for MySQL 是基于实例的数据库，既不是无服务器，也没有原生的向量相似度搜索。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A、D：Amazon Bedrock 以完全无服务器的 API 提供 Anthropic Claude 基础模型，无需管理任何基础设施；Amazon API Gateway 后面的 AWS Lambda 函数为内部聊天界面提供按需调用模型 API 的无服务器后端，整个方案保持无服务器。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: SageMaker JumpStart 会把 Llama 模型部署到运行在预置实例上的 SageMaker 实时端点，并非无服务器。
  • C: Amazon EC2 实例是需要公司自行预置、打补丁和扩缩的服务器，违反无服务器要求。
  • E: Amazon S3 是对象存储，无法执行向量存储所需的相似度搜索，嵌入应存放在 Amazon OpenSearch Serverless 之类的向量数据库中。
  • F: Amazon RDS for MySQL 是基于实例的数据库，既不是无服务器，也没有原生的向量相似度搜索。
explanations.en:
Correct answers A and D: Amazon Bedrock provides the Anthropic Claude foundation model as a fully serverless API with no infrastructure to manage, and AWS Lambda functions behind Amazon API Gateway give the internal chat interface a serverless backend that invokes the model API on demand, so the entire solution stays serverless.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: SageMaker JumpStart deploys the Llama model to a SageMaker real-time endpoint that runs on provisioned instances, which is not serverless.
  • C: Amazon EC2 instances are servers the company must provision, patch, and scale, violating the serverless requirement.
  • E: Amazon S3 is object storage and cannot perform the similarity search that a vector store needs; embeddings must live in a vector database such as Amazon OpenSearch Serverless.
  • F: Amazon RDS for MySQL is an instance-based database that is not serverless and has no native vector similarity search.

Which deployment solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Deploy the model to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.

contents.en: Deploy the model to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.

options.label: B
options.content: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker real-time endpoint.

contents.en: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker real-time endpoint.

options.content: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint.

contents.en: Deploy the model to an Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference 是专为此类场景设计的全托管选项：支持最大 1 GB 的请求负载、最长一小时的处理时间，会将请求排队并把结果写入 Amazon S3，还能自动缩容到零，因此能以最少的运维开销处理耗时数分钟、输入达 100 MB 的遗传算法预测。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 应用负载均衡器后的 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例需要工程师自行管理 AMI、补丁、服务软件和扩缩策略。
  • B: SageMaker 实时端点的负载上限为 6 MB，且 60 秒即超时，无法处理耗时数分钟的 100 MB 请求。
  • D: 在 EC2 实例上的 Amazon ECS 中运行容器，意味着要自行管理集群、容器编排和扩缩。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference 是专为此类场景设计的全托管选项：支持最大 1 GB 的请求负载、最长一小时的处理时间，会将请求排队并把结果写入 Amazon S3，还能自动缩容到零，因此能以最少的运维开销处理耗时数分钟、输入达 100 MB 的遗传算法预测。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 应用负载均衡器后的 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例需要工程师自行管理 AMI、补丁、服务软件和扩缩策略。
  • B: SageMaker 实时端点的负载上限为 6 MB，且 60 秒即超时，无法处理耗时数分钟的 100 MB 请求。
  • D: 在 EC2 实例上的 Amazon ECS 中运行容器，意味着要自行管理集群、容器编排和扩缩。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference is a fully managed option designed for exactly this profile: it accepts request payloads up to 1 GB, allows processing times of up to one hour, queues incoming requests, delivers results to Amazon S3, and can auto scale to zero, so the several-minute genetic-algorithm predictions on 100 MB inputs are handled with the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer require the engineer to manage AMIs, patching, serving software, and scaling policies.
  • B: A SageMaker real-time endpoint limits payloads to 6 MB and times out after 60 seconds, so it cannot handle 100 MB requests that take minutes.
  • D: Running containers on Amazon ECS with EC2 instances means managing the cluster, container orchestration, and scaling yourself.

questions.content: An ML engineer wants to use a set of survey responses as training data for an ML classifier. All the survey responses are either “yes” or “no.” The ML engineer needs to convert the responses into a feature that will produce better model training results. The ML engineer must not increase the dimensionality of the dataset. Which methods will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.content: Binary encoding

contents.en: Binary encoding

options.label: B
options.content: Label encoding

contents.en: Label encoding
contents.zh: 标签编码

options.content: One-hot encoding

contents.en: One-hot encoding
contents.zh: 独热编码

options.label: D
options.content: Statistical imputation

contents.en: Statistical imputation
contents.zh: 统计插补

options.label: E
options.content: Tokenization

contents.en: Tokenization
contents.zh: 令牌化

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A、B：二进制编码和标签编码都把"是/否"两个类别值映射到单个数值列（例如 1 和 0），为分类器提供可用的数值特征，同时数据集的列数保持不变，不会增加维度。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • C: 独热编码为每个类别创建一个单独的指示列，会把一个特征扩展成两列，增加了维度。
  • D: 统计插补用均值、中位数或众数填补缺失值，并不能把类别型回复转换为数值特征。
  • E: 令牌化用于把自由文本拆分为词或子词以供 NLP 流程使用，不是对二值类别特征进行编码的技术。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A、B：二进制编码和标签编码都把"是/否"两个类别值映射到单个数值列（例如 1 和 0），为分类器提供可用的数值特征，同时数据集的列数保持不变，不会增加维度。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • C: 独热编码为每个类别创建一个单独的指示列，会把一个特征扩展成两列，增加了维度。
  • D: 统计插补用均值、中位数或众数填补缺失值，并不能把类别型回复转换为数值特征。
  • E: 令牌化用于把自由文本拆分为词或子词以供 NLP 流程使用，不是对二值类别特征进行编码的技术。
explanations.en:
Correct answers A and B: Both binary encoding and label encoding map the two categorical values yes and no to a single numeric column (for example 1 and 0), giving the classifier a usable numeric feature while keeping the dataset at exactly the same number of columns, so dimensionality does not increase.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • C: One-hot encoding creates a separate indicator column for each category, expanding one feature into two columns and increasing dimensionality.
  • D: Statistical imputation fills in missing values with a mean, median, or mode; it does not convert categorical responses into numeric features.
  • E: Tokenization splits free text into words or subwords for NLP pipelines and is not a technique for encoding a two-value categorical feature.

为什么其他选项错误：

explanations.zh:

  • B: 语义分割算法对图像的每个像素进行分类，与文本处理无关。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: The SageMaker Sequence-to-Sequence (seq2seq) built-in algorithm takes a sequence of tokens as input and generates a new sequence of tokens as output, which is the model family used for abstractive text summarization such as condensing a research paper.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Random Cut Forest is an unsupervised anomaly-detection algorithm for numeric data and cannot generate text.
  • B: The semantic segmentation algorithm classifies every pixel of an image and has nothing to do with text.

questions.content: A company is planning to use an Amazon SageMaker prebuilt algorithm to create a recommendation model. The algorithm must be able to make predictions on high-dimensional sparse data. Which SageMaker algorithm should the company choose for the recommendation model?

options.label: A

contents.en: K-nearest neighbors (k-NN)

options.label: B
options.content: Factorization Machines

contents.en: Factorization Machines
contents.zh: 因子分解机

options.label: C
options.content: Principal component analysis (PCA)

contents.en: Principal component analysis (PCA)
contents.zh: 主成分分析（PCA）

options.label: D
options.content: Sequence-to-Sequence (seq2seq)

contents.en: Sequence-to-Sequence (seq2seq)

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker 内置的 Factorization Machines 算法专为高维稀疏数据集设计，通过低秩分解建模特征之间的两两交互，因此是推荐系统和点击预测（每个用户只与极少数物品有交互）的标准选择。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: k-NN 依赖距离计算，在高维稀疏空间中效果急剧下降，也不是专门的推荐算法。
  • C: PCA 是无监督的降维技术，本身不做预测。
  • D: Sequence-to-Sequence 是用于翻译、摘要等任务的文本生成算法，不用于推荐。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker 内置的 Factorization Machines 算法专为高维稀疏数据集设计，通过低秩分解建模特征之间的两两交互，因此是推荐系统和点击预测（每个用户只与极少数物品有交互）的标准选择。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: k-NN 依赖距离计算，在高维稀疏空间中效果急剧下降，也不是专门的推荐算法。
  • C: PCA 是无监督的降维技术，本身不做预测。
  • D: Sequence-to-Sequence 是用于翻译、摘要等任务的文本生成算法，不用于推荐。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: The SageMaker Factorization Machines built-in algorithm is designed specifically for high-dimensional sparse datasets, modeling pairwise feature interactions through low-rank factorization, which is why it is the standard choice for recommendation systems and click prediction where each user has interacted with only a tiny fraction of items.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: k-NN relies on distance computations that degrade badly in high-dimensional sparse spaces and is not a purpose-built recommendation algorithm.
  • C: PCA is an unsupervised dimensionality-reduction technique that does not make predictions.
  • D: Sequence-to-Sequence is a text-generation algorithm for tasks such as translation and summarization, not for recommendations.

questions.content: A company has several teams that have developed separate prediction models on their own laptops. The teams developed the models by using Python with scikit-learn and TensorFlow frameworks. The company must rebuild the models and must integrate the models into an ML infrastructure that the company manages by using Amazon SageMaker. The company also must incorporate the models into a model registry. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Export the models from the laptops to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an Amazon API Gateway REST API and AWS Lambda functions with SageMaker endpoints to access the models. Register the models in the SageMaker Model Registry.

contents.en: Export the models from the laptops to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an Amazon API Gateway REST API and AWS Lambda functions with SageMaker endpoints to access the models. Register the models in the SageMaker Model Registry.
contents.zh: 将模型从笔记本电脑导出到Amazon S3存储桶。使用Amazon API Gateway REST API和AWS Lambda函数以及SageMaker端点访问模型。在SageMaker模型注册表中注册模型。

options.label: B
options.content: Import the models into the SageMaker Model Registry. Use SageMaker to run the imported models.

contents.en: Import the models into the SageMaker Model Registry. Use SageMaker to run the imported models.
contents.zh: 将模型导入SageMaker模型注册表。使用SageMaker运行导入的模型。

options.label: C
options.content: Use code from the laptops to create containers for the models. Use the bring your own container (BYOC) functionality of SageMaker to import and use the models. Register the models in the SageMaker Model Registry.

contents.en: Use code from the laptops to create containers for the models. Use the bring your own container (BYOC) functionality of SageMaker to import and use the models. Register the models in the SageMaker Model Registry.
contents.zh: 使用笔记本电脑中的代码为模型创建容器。使用SageMaker的自带容器（BYOC）功能导入和使用模型。在SageMaker模型注册表中注册模型。

options.label: D
options.content: Import the Python-based models into SageMaker. Rebuild the scikit-learn and TensorFlow models in SageMaker. Register all the models in the SageMaker Model Registry.

contents.en: Import the Python-based models into SageMaker. Rebuild the scikit-learn and TensorFlow models in SageMaker. Register all the models in the SageMaker Model Registry.
contents.zh: 将基于Python的模型导入SageMaker。在SageMaker中重新构建scikit-learn和TensorFlow模型。在SageMaker模型注册表中注册所有模型。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 为 scikit-learn 和 TensorFlow 提供预构建的托管框架容器，各团队可以把 Python 代码带入 SageMaker，以 SageMaker 训练作业的方式重新构建和训练模型而无需编写任何容器代码，再把生成的模型产物注册为 SageMaker Model Registry 中的版本，以最少的运维开销同时满足"重建模型"和"纳入模型注册表"两项要求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 增加 API Gateway REST API 和 Lambda 函数引入了额外需要运维的组件，而且仅导出笔记本电脑上的产物并没有在托管的 SageMaker 基础设施上重建模型。
  • B: Model Registry 只能存储和版本化模型包，不能运行模型，该选项还跳过了在 SageMaker 中重建模型这一必要步骤。
  • C: 自带容器（BYOC）需要构建、加固并维护自定义 Docker 镜像，而 SageMaker 已提供托管的 scikit-learn 和 TensorFlow 容器，这是不必要的开销。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 为 scikit-learn 和 TensorFlow 提供预构建的托管框架容器，各团队可以把 Python 代码带入 SageMaker，以 SageMaker 训练作业的方式重新构建和训练模型而无需编写任何容器代码，再把生成的模型产物注册为 SageMaker Model Registry 中的版本，以最少的运维开销同时满足"重建模型"和"纳入模型注册表"两项要求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 增加 API Gateway REST API 和 Lambda 函数引入了额外需要运维的组件，而且仅导出笔记本电脑上的产物并没有在托管的 SageMaker 基础设施上重建模型。
  • B: Model Registry 只能存储和版本化模型包，不能运行模型，该选项还跳过了在 SageMaker 中重建模型这一必要步骤。
  • C: 自带容器（BYOC）需要构建、加固并维护自定义 Docker 镜像，而 SageMaker 已提供托管的 scikit-learn 和 TensorFlow 容器，这是不必要的开销。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker provides prebuilt, managed framework containers for scikit-learn and TensorFlow, so the teams can bring their Python code into SageMaker, rebuild and retrain the models as SageMaker training jobs without writing any container code, and register the resulting model artifacts as versions in the SageMaker Model Registry, meeting the rebuild and registry requirements with the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Adding an API Gateway REST API and Lambda functions introduces extra components to operate, and simply exporting laptop artifacts does not rebuild the models on the managed SageMaker infrastructure.
  • B: The Model Registry stores and versions model packages but cannot run models, and this option skips the required rebuild of the models in SageMaker.
  • C: Bring your own container requires building, securing, and maintaining custom Docker images, which is unnecessary overhead when SageMaker already offers managed scikit-learn and TensorFlow containers.

questions.content: A company is training a large language model (LLM) by using on-premises infrastructure. A live conversational engine uses the LLM to help customers find real-time insights in credit card data. An ML engineer must implement a solution to train and deploy the LLM on Amazon SageMaker. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use SageMaker Training Compiler to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker real-time inference.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Training Compiler to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker real-time inference.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker训练编译器训练LLM。使用SageMaker实时推理部署LLM。

options.label: B
options.content: Use SageMaker with deep learning containers for large model inference to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker real-time inference.

contents.en: Use SageMaker with deep learning containers for large model inference to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker real-time inference.
contents.zh: 使用带有大型模型推理深度学习容器的SageMaker训练LLM。使用SageMaker实时推理部署LLM。

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Notebook Jobs to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker Asynchronous Inference.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Notebook Jobs to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker Asynchronous Inference.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker笔记本作业训练LLM。使用SageMaker异步推理部署LLM。

options.label: D
options.content: Use SageMaker Studio to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker batch transform.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Studio to train the LLM. Deploy the LLM by using SageMaker batch transform.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Studio训练LLM。使用SageMaker批量转换部署LLM。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Training Compiler 可优化 GPU 实例上的深度学习训练作业，加速并降低在 SageMaker 上训练大型语言模型的成本；SageMaker 实时推理则提供实时对话引擎所需的低延迟同步响应。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 大模型推理（LMI）深度学习容器是用来部署和提供 LLM 服务的，不是用来训练 LLM 的。
  • C: SageMaker Notebook Jobs 用于调度笔记本执行而非大规模 LLM 训练，Asynchronous Inference 会把请求排队，不适合实时对话引擎。
  • D: SageMaker Studio 是 IDE 而不是训练机制，批量转换是离线批量评分方式，无法支撑实时对话。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Training Compiler 可优化 GPU 实例上的深度学习训练作业，加速并降低在 SageMaker 上训练大型语言模型的成本；SageMaker 实时推理则提供实时对话引擎所需的低延迟同步响应。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 大模型推理（LMI）深度学习容器是用来部署和提供 LLM 服务的，不是用来训练 LLM 的。
  • C: SageMaker Notebook Jobs 用于调度笔记本执行而非大规模 LLM 训练，Asynchronous Inference 会把请求排队，不适合实时对话引擎。
  • D: SageMaker Studio 是 IDE 而不是训练机制，批量转换是离线批量评分方式，无法支撑实时对话。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker Training Compiler optimizes deep learning training jobs on GPU instances, accelerating and reducing the cost of training large language models on SageMaker, and SageMaker real-time inference provides the low-latency synchronous responses that a live conversational engine requires.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: The large model inference (LMI) deep learning containers are built for serving LLMs, not for training them.
  • C: SageMaker Notebook Jobs schedule notebook executions rather than large-scale LLM training, and Asynchronous Inference queues requests, which does not suit a live conversational engine.
  • D: SageMaker Studio is an IDE, not a training mechanism, and batch transform is an offline bulk-scoring option that cannot serve real-time conversations.

questions.content: A company has an existing Amazon SageMaker model (v1) on a production endpoint. The company develops a new model version (v2) and needs to test v2 in production before substituting v2 for v1. The company needs to implement a solution to minimize the risk of v2 generating incorrect output in production. The solution must prevent any disruption of production traffic during the change to v2. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 1% of the traffic to v2 and 99% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2.

contents.en: Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 1% of the traffic to v2 and 99% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2.
contents.zh: 为v2创建第二个生产变体。将1%的流量分配给v2，99%的流量分配给v1。将v2的所有输出收集到Amazon S3存储桶中。如果v2表现符合预期，将所有流量切换到v2。

options.label: B
options.content: Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 10% of the traffic to v2 and 90% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2.

contents.en: Create a second production variant for v2. Assign 10% of the traffic to v2 and 90% of the traffic to v1. Collect all the output of v2 in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, switch all the traffic to v2.
contents.zh: 为v2创建第二个生产变体。将10%的流量分配给v2，90%的流量分配给v1。将v2的所有输出收集到Amazon S3存储桶中。如果v2表现符合预期，将所有流量切换到v2。

options.label: C
options.content: Deploy v2 to a new endpoint. Turn on data capturing for the production endpoint. Write a script to pass 100% of input data to v2. If v2 performs as expected, deactivate the v1 endpoint and direct the traffic to v2.

contents.en: Deploy v2 to a new endpoint. Turn on data capturing for the production endpoint. Write a script to pass 100% of input data to v2. If v2 performs as expected, deactivate the v1 endpoint and direct the traffic to v2.
contents.zh: 将v2部署到新的端点。开启生产端点的数据捕获。编写一个脚本将100%的输入数据传递给v2。如果v2表现符合预期，停用v1端点并将流量定向到v2。

options.label: D
options.content: Deploy v2 into a shadow variant that samples 100% of the inference requests. Collect all the output in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, promote v2 to production.

contents.en: Deploy v2 into a shadow variant that samples 100% of the inference requests. Collect all the output in an Amazon S3 bucket. If v2 performs as expected, promote v2 to production.
contents.zh: 将v2部署为影子变体，采样100%的推理请求。将所有输出收集到Amazon S3存储桶中。如果v2表现符合预期，将v2推广到生产。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 影子变体（shadow variant）接收 100% 生产请求的副本，但只有生产变体（v1）的响应会返回给调用方；v2 的输出被捕获到 Amazon S3 供对比，因此可以在真实生产流量上验证 v2，且其可能错误的预测绝不会到达用户，后续推广也不会中断流量。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 把 1% 流量分给 v2 生产变体意味着 1% 的客户会收到 v2 的响应，错误输出仍可能进入生产。
  • B: 把 10% 流量路由给 v2 会让更多客户暴露于可能错误的预测。
  • C: 部署单独端点并编写自定义回放脚本增加了运维工作，测试的是延迟而非实时的流量，切换端点还带来中断风险。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 影子变体（shadow variant）接收 100% 生产请求的副本，但只有生产变体（v1）的响应会返回给调用方；v2 的输出被捕获到 Amazon S3 供对比，因此可以在真实生产流量上验证 v2，且其可能错误的预测绝不会到达用户，后续推广也不会中断流量。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 把 1% 流量分给 v2 生产变体意味着 1% 的客户会收到 v2 的响应，错误输出仍可能进入生产。
  • B: 把 10% 流量路由给 v2 会让更多客户暴露于可能错误的预测。
  • C: 部署单独端点并编写自定义回放脚本增加了运维工作，测试的是延迟而非实时的流量，切换端点还带来中断风险。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: A SageMaker shadow variant receives a copy of 100% of the production requests while only the production variant (v1) returns responses to callers; the outputs of v2 are captured to Amazon S3 for comparison, so v2 is validated on real production traffic with zero risk of its possibly incorrect predictions reaching users and no disruption when it is later promoted.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Sending 1% of traffic to a v2 production variant means 1% of customers receive the responses of v2, so incorrect output can still reach production.
  • B: Routing 10% of traffic to v2 exposes even more customers to potentially incorrect predictions.
  • C: Deploying a separate endpoint and writing a custom replay script adds operational effort, tests v2 on delayed rather than live traffic, and switching endpoints introduces a disruption risk.

The company develops a new model version (v2) and needs to test v2 in production before substituting v2 for v1. questions.content: A company is building an ML model by using Amazon SageMaker, AWS owned libraries, and open source libraries. The company must ensure that SageMaker does not collect metadata about usage and errors during training. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Associate the SageMaker domain with a custom IAM role. Attach the role to a policy that denies Amazon CloudWatch service usage logs.

contents.en: Associate the SageMaker domain with a custom IAM role. Attach the role to a policy that denies Amazon CloudWatch service usage logs.
contents.zh: 将SageMaker域与自定义IAM角色关联。将该角色附加到一个拒绝Amazon CloudWatch服务使用日志的策略。

options.label: B
options.content: Add an IAM role to the SageMaker domain to deny Amazon CloudWatch the permission to report metadata.

contents.en: Add an IAM role to the SageMaker domain to deny Amazon CloudWatch the permission to report metadata.
contents.zh: 向SageMaker域添加一个IAM角色，以拒绝Amazon CloudWatch报告元数据的权限。

options.label: C
options.content: Turn off the setting in the SageMaker domain to share metadata for console jobs. Opt out of metadata collection for each training job that is submitted through the AWS CLI or AWS SDKs.

contents.en: Turn off the setting in the SageMaker domain to share metadata for console jobs. Opt out of metadata collection for each training job that is submitted through the AWS CLI or AWS SDKs.
contents.zh: 关闭SageMaker域中共享控制台作业元数据的设置。选择退出通过AWS CLI或AWS SDK提交的每个训练作业的元数据收集。

options.label: D
options.content: Set a parameter to opt out of metadata collection for each training job that is submitted through the AWS CLI, Boto3, or the SageMaker Python SDK.

contents.en: Set a parameter to opt out of metadata collection for each training job that is submitted through the AWS CLI, Boto3, or the SageMaker Python SDK.
contents.zh: 为通过AWS CLI、Boto3或SageMaker Python SDK提交的每个训练作业设置一个参数，选择退出元数据收集。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 会收集训练作业中所使用的 AWS 自有库和开源库的使用情况与错误元数据，唯一受支持的退出方式是按训练作业在 Environment 参数中把 OPT_OUT_TRACKING 环境变量设为 true，可通过 AWS CLI、Boto3 或 SageMaker Python SDK 完成。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 元数据收集并不经过 CloudWatch，拒绝 CloudWatch 使用的 IAM 策略只会破坏作业的正常日志记录，无法阻止遥测。
  • B: IAM 角色控制作业可以调用哪些 AWS API，并不能控制 SageMaker 内部的元数据收集。
  • C: SageMaker 域中不存在共享或关闭控制台作业元数据的设置，退出选项只以按作业参数的形式存在。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 会收集训练作业中所使用的 AWS 自有库和开源库的使用情况与错误元数据，唯一受支持的退出方式是按训练作业在 Environment 参数中把 OPT_OUT_TRACKING 环境变量设为 true，可通过 AWS CLI、Boto3 或 SageMaker Python SDK 完成。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 元数据收集并不经过 CloudWatch，拒绝 CloudWatch 使用的 IAM 策略只会破坏作业的正常日志记录，无法阻止遥测。
  • B: IAM 角色控制作业可以调用哪些 AWS API，并不能控制 SageMaker 内部的元数据收集。
  • C: SageMaker 域中不存在共享或关闭控制台作业元数据的设置，退出选项只以按作业参数的形式存在。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker collects usage and error metadata from the AWS owned and open source libraries used inside training jobs, and the only supported way to opt out is per training job by setting the OPT_OUT_TRACKING environment variable to true in the job's Environment parameter, which can be done through the AWS CLI, Boto3, or the SageMaker Python SDK.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Metadata collection is not performed through CloudWatch, so an IAM policy denying CloudWatch usage would break normal job logging without stopping the telemetry.
  • B: IAM roles govern which AWS APIs the job is allowed to call; they do not control SageMaker's internal metadata collection.
  • C: There is no SageMaker domain setting to share or disable metadata for console jobs; the opt-out exists only as a per-job parameter.

questions.content: An ML engineer is training an ML model to identify people’s health risk based on 20 features and 1 target. The target class has two values: •Likely to have health risk (positive class) • Unlikely to have health risk (negative class) The age range of people in the dataset is 30 years old to 60 years old. Age is one of the features. The ML engineer analyzes the features. For the positive class, the difference in proportions of labels (DPL) value is (+0.9) for the age range of 40 to 45 compared with all other age ranges. What should the ML engineer do to correct this data imbalance?

options.label: A
options.content: Oversample the positive class for the age range of 40 to 45.

contents.en: Oversample the positive class for the age range of 40 to 45.
contents.zh: 对40到45岁年龄范围的正类进行过采样。

options.label: B
options.content: Undersample the positive class for the age range of 40 to 45.

contents.en: Undersample the positive class for the age range of 40 to 45.
contents.zh: 对40到45岁年龄范围的正类进行欠采样。

options.label: C
options.content: Undersample the positive class for all age ranges except 40 to 45.

contents.en: Undersample the positive class for all age ranges except 40 to 45.
contents.zh: 对除40到45岁之外的所有年龄范围的正类进行欠采样。

options.label: D
options.content: Oversample the negative class for all age ranges except 40 to 45.

contents.en: Oversample the negative class for all age ranges except 40 to 45.
contents.zh: 对除40到45岁之外的所有年龄范围的负类进行过采样。

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：DPL 为 +0.9 表示 40 到 45 岁分面中正类（有健康风险）标签的比例远高于其他所有年龄段，即正类在该年龄组中严重过度代表；对 40 到 45 岁的正类进行欠采样可以降低该比例，使各年龄组之间的标签分布重新平衡。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 对 40 到 45 岁的正类过采样会给本已过度代表的分面添加更多正类标签，使 DPL 进一步升高。
  • C: 对其他年龄段的正类欠采样会降低它们的正类比例，拉大与 40 到 45 岁组的差距。
  • D: 对其他年龄段的负类过采样同样会降低它们的正类比例，反而加剧而非纠正 DPL 不平衡。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：DPL 为 +0.9 表示 40 到 45 岁分面中正类（有健康风险）标签的比例远高于其他所有年龄段，即正类在该年龄组中严重过度代表；对 40 到 45 岁的正类进行欠采样可以降低该比例，使各年龄组之间的标签分布重新平衡。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 对 40 到 45 岁的正类过采样会给本已过度代表的分面添加更多正类标签，使 DPL 进一步升高。
  • C: 对其他年龄段的正类欠采样会降低它们的正类比例，拉大与 40 到 45 岁组的差距。
  • D: 对其他年龄段的负类过采样同样会降低它们的正类比例，反而加剧而非纠正 DPL 不平衡。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: A DPL of +0.9 means the proportion of positive (health-risk) labels in the 40 to 45 age facet is far higher than in all other age ranges, so the positive class is heavily over-represented in that group; undersampling the positive class for ages 40 to 45 reduces that proportion and brings the label distribution across age groups back into balance.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Oversampling positives in the 40 to 45 range adds even more positive labels to the already over-represented facet and pushes DPL higher.
  • C: Undersampling positives in the other age ranges lowers their positive proportion, widening the gap with the 40 to 45 group.
  • D: Oversampling negatives in the other age ranges also lowers their positive proportion, which increases rather than corrects the DPL imbalance.

questions.content: A company is building an Amazon SageMaker AI pipeline for an ML model. The pipeline uses distributed processing and training. An ML engineer needs to encrypt network communication between instances that run distributed jobs. The ML engineer configures the distributed jobs to run in a private VPC. What should the ML engineer do to meet the encryption requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Enable network isolation.

contents.en: Enable network isolation.
contents.zh: 启用网络隔离

options.label: B
options.content: Configure traffic encryption by using security groups.

contents.en: Configure traffic encryption by using security groups.
contents.zh: 通过安全组配置流量加密

options.label: C
options.content: Enable inter-container traffic encryption.

contents.en: Enable inter-container traffic encryption.
contents.zh: 启用容器间流量加密

options.label: D
options.content: Enable VPC flow logs.

contents.en: Enable VPC flow logs.
contents.zh: 启用虚拟私有云（VPC）流量日志

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker 为训练和处理作业提供 EnableInterContainerTrafficEncryption 选项，开启后分布式作业各实例（容器）之间的全部网络流量都会在传输过程中加密，这正是针对该需求的专用控制项。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 网络隔离会阻止容器发起任何出站网络调用，它限制的是连通性，并不会加密分布式实例之间交换的流量。
  • B: 安全组是有状态防火墙，只能允许或拒绝流量，没有加密能力。
  • D: VPC 流日志只记录 IP 流量的元数据用于监控，不会加密任何内容。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker 为训练和处理作业提供 EnableInterContainerTrafficEncryption 选项，开启后分布式作业各实例（容器）之间的全部网络流量都会在传输过程中加密，这正是针对该需求的专用控制项。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 网络隔离会阻止容器发起任何出站网络调用，它限制的是连通性，并不会加密分布式实例之间交换的流量。
  • B: 安全组是有状态防火墙，只能允许或拒绝流量，没有加密能力。
  • D: VPC 流日志只记录 IP 流量的元数据用于监控，不会加密任何内容。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: SageMaker offers the EnableInterContainerTrafficEncryption option for training and processing jobs; when it is turned on, all network traffic between the instances (containers) of a distributed job is encrypted in transit, which is the specific control for this requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Network isolation blocks the containers from making any outbound network calls; it restricts connectivity but does not encrypt the traffic that distributed instances exchange.
  • B: Security groups are stateful firewalls that allow or deny traffic; they have no encryption capability.
  • D: VPC flow logs only record metadata about IP traffic for monitoring and do not encrypt anything.

An ML engineer needs to encrypt network communication between instances that run distributed jobs. The ML engineer configures the distributed jobs to run in a private VPC.
