questions.content: An ML model is deployed in production. The model has performed well and has met its metric thresholds for months. An ML engineer who is monitoring the model observes a sudden degradation. The performance metrics of the model are now below the thresholds. What could be the cause of the performance degradation?

options.label: A
options.content: Lack of training data

contents.en: Lack of training data
contents.zh: 训练数据不足

options.label: B
options.content: Drift in production data distribution

contents.en: Drift in production data distribution
contents.zh: 生产数据分布发生漂移

options.label: C
options.content: Compute resource constraints

contents.en: Compute resource constraints
contents.zh: 计算资源受限

options.label: D
options.content: Model overfitting

contents.en: Model overfitting
contents.zh: 模型过拟合

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：一个连续数月达到阈值的模型突然性能下降，是数据漂移的典型症状：生产环境实时输入的分布已经偏离模型训练时的数据分布，学到的模式不再适用，导致指标跌破阈值。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 训练数据不足会从部署第一天起就表现不佳，而不是在数月良好表现之后才出现问题。
  • C: 计算资源受限影响的是延迟、吞吐量或可用性，而不是模型返回预测的准确度。
  • D: 过拟合是训练时就已确定的特性，会在部署后立刻表现为泛化能力差，而不是之后突然下降。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：一个连续数月达到阈值的模型突然性能下降，是数据漂移的典型症状：生产环境实时输入的分布已经偏离模型训练时的数据分布，学到的模式不再适用，导致指标跌破阈值。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 训练数据不足会从部署第一天起就表现不佳，而不是在数月良好表现之后才出现问题。
  • C: 计算资源受限影响的是延迟、吞吐量或可用性，而不是模型返回预测的准确度。
  • D: 过拟合是训练时就已确定的特性，会在部署后立刻表现为泛化能力差，而不是之后突然下降。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: A model that met its thresholds for months and then suddenly degraded is the classic symptom of data drift: the distribution of the live production inputs has shifted away from the distribution the model was trained on, so the learned patterns no longer apply and metrics fall below their thresholds.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Insufficient training data would have produced poor performance from the first day of deployment, not after months of good results.
  • C: Compute constraints affect latency, throughput, or availability, not the accuracy of the predictions the model returns.
  • D: Overfitting is a property fixed at training time and would show up as weak generalization immediately after deployment, not as a sudden later drop.

contents.en: An ML model is deployed in production. The model has performed well and has met its metric thresholds for months. An ML engineer who is monitoring the model observes a sudden degradation. The performance metrics of the model are now below the thresholds. What could be the cause of the performance degradation?
contents.zh: 一个机器学习模型已部署至生产环境，在过去数月中表现良好，各项指标均达到阈值要求。负责监控该模型的机器学习工程师发现，模型性能突然出现下降，当前各项性能指标均低于阈值。导致该模型性能下降的原因可能是什么？

questions.content: An ML engineer is using AWS Glue to transform proprietary data from a third-party vendor to a format that the ML engineer intends to use with the Amazon SageMaker DeepAR forecasting algorithm. The data includes several similar time series data files that the ML engineer must convert to the appropriate format. The ML engineer must compress the files to optimize storage costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use Snappy to convert the files to RecordIO-Protobuf and to compress the files.

contents.en: Use Snappy to convert the files to RecordIO-Protobuf and to compress the files.
contents.zh: 使用Snappy算法将文件转换为RecordIO-Protobuf格式并完成压缩

options.label: B
options.content: Use XZ to convert the files to RecordIO-Protobuf and to compress the files.

contents.en: Use XZ to convert the files to RecordIO-Protobuf and to compress the files.
contents.zh: 使用XZ算法将文件转换为RecordIO-Protobuf格式并完成压缩

options.label: C
options.content: Use XZ to convert the files to Apache Parquet format and to compress the files.

contents.en: Use XZ to convert the files to Apache Parquet format and to compress the files.
contents.zh: 使用XZ算法将文件转换为Apache Parquet格式并完成压缩

options.label: D
options.content: Use gzip to convert the files to Apache Parquet and to compress the files.

contents.en: Use gzip to convert the files to Apache Parquet and to compress the files.
contents.zh: 使用gzip算法将文件转换为Apache Parquet格式并完成压缩

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker DeepAR 算法接受 JSON Lines 或 Apache Parquet 格式的训练数据，因此这些相似的时间序列文件应转换为 Parquet（而非 RecordIO-Protobuf）；XZ 的压缩率高于 gzip，能最大程度减少存储占用，从而最优地降低存储成本。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: DeepAR 不接受 RecordIO-Protobuf 输入，转换成该格式后数据将无法被算法使用。
  • B: 无论使用哪种压缩算法，RecordIO-Protobuf 都不是 DeepAR 支持的输入格式。
  • D: Parquet 格式是正确的，但 gzip 的压缩率不如 XZ，无法同样有效地优化存储成本。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker DeepAR 算法接受 JSON Lines 或 Apache Parquet 格式的训练数据，因此这些相似的时间序列文件应转换为 Parquet（而非 RecordIO-Protobuf）；XZ 的压缩率高于 gzip，能最大程度减少存储占用，从而最优地降低存储成本。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: DeepAR 不接受 RecordIO-Protobuf 输入，转换成该格式后数据将无法被算法使用。
  • B: 无论使用哪种压缩算法，RecordIO-Protobuf 都不是 DeepAR 支持的输入格式。
  • D: Parquet 格式是正确的，但 gzip 的压缩率不如 XZ，无法同样有效地优化存储成本。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: The SageMaker DeepAR algorithm accepts training data as JSON Lines or Apache Parquet, so the similar time series files must be converted to Parquet (not RecordIO-Protobuf), and XZ provides a higher compression ratio than gzip, which minimizes the storage footprint and therefore best optimizes storage costs.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: DeepAR does not accept RecordIO-Protobuf input, so converting to that format would make the data unusable for the algorithm.
  • B: RecordIO-Protobuf is not a supported DeepAR input format regardless of the compression codec applied.
  • D: Parquet is the right format, but gzip compresses less tightly than XZ and therefore does not optimize storage costs as well.

Data transformation scripts and queries are now taking much longer than they used to take. An ML engineer must implement a solution to optimize the data for query performance. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure an AWS Lambda function to split the .csv files into smaller objects in the S3 bucket.

contents.en: Configure an AWS Lambda function to split the .csv files into smaller objects in the S3 bucket.

options.label: B
options.content: Configure an AWS Glue job to drop columns that have string type values and to save the results to the S3 bucket.

contents.en: Configure an AWS Glue job to drop columns that have string type values and to save the results to the S3 bucket.
contents.zh: 配置AWS Glue任务，删除包含字符串类型值的列，并将处理结果保存至S3存储桶

options.label: C
options.content: Configure an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the .csv files to Apache Parquet format.

contents.en: Configure an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the .csv files to Apache Parquet format.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：使用无服务器的 AWS Glue ETL 作业把 .csv 文件转换为 Apache Parquet，可将按行存储的文本变为带内嵌统计信息的压缩列式格式，查询只需扫描所需的列和行组，速度大幅提升；Glue 的托管、低代码转换方式使运维开销最低。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 把 .csv 文件拆分为更小的对象，数据仍是未压缩的行式格式，依然需要全量扫描。
  • B: 删除字符串列会破坏可能有价值的数据，也没有解决 .csv 格式本身低效的问题。
  • D: 预置并运维 Amazon EMR 集群相比无服务器的 Glue 作业增加了大量管理开销。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：使用无服务器的 AWS Glue ETL 作业把 .csv 文件转换为 Apache Parquet，可将按行存储的文本变为带内嵌统计信息的压缩列式格式，查询只需扫描所需的列和行组，速度大幅提升；Glue 的托管、低代码转换方式使运维开销最低。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 把 .csv 文件拆分为更小的对象，数据仍是未压缩的行式格式，依然需要全量扫描。
  • B: 删除字符串列会破坏可能有价值的数据，也没有解决 .csv 格式本身低效的问题。
  • D: 预置并运维 Amazon EMR 集群相比无服务器的 Glue 作业增加了大量管理开销。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Converting the .csv files to Apache Parquet with a serverless AWS Glue ETL job turns row-oriented text into a compressed, columnar format with embedded statistics, so queries scan only the columns and row groups they need and run far faster, and the managed, code-light Glue conversion delivers this with the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Splitting .csv files into smaller objects leaves the data in an uncompressed row-based format that still must be fully scanned.
  • B: Dropping string columns destroys potentially valuable data and does not address the underlying inefficiency of the .csv format.
  • D: Provisioning and operating an Amazon EMR cluster adds significant management overhead compared with a serverless Glue job.

questions.content: An ML engineer is analyzing a classification dataset before training a model in Amazon SageMaker AI. The ML engineer suspects that the dataset has a significant imbalance between class labels that could lead to biased model predictions. To confirm class imbalance, the ML engineer needs to select an appropriate pre-training bias metric. Which metric will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Mean square error (MSE)

contents.en: Mean square error (MSE)
contents.zh: 均方误差（MSE）

options.label: B
options.content: Difference in proportions of labels (DPL)

contents.en: Difference in proportions of labels (DPL)
contents.zh: 标签比例差异（DPL）

options.label: C
options.content: Silhouette score

contents.en: Silhouette score
contents.zh: 轮廓系数

options.label: D
options.content: Structural similarity index measure (SSIM)

contents.en: Structural similarity index measure (SSIM)
contents.zh: 结构相似性指数（SSIM）

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：标签比例差异（DPL）是 SageMaker Clarify 的训练前偏差指标之一，它在训练任何模型之前衡量数据集各分面之间正类标签比例的差异，能直接确认类别标签是否存在可能导致预测偏差的不平衡。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 均方误差是需要模型预测结果的回归评估指标，无法反映训练数据中的标签分布。
  • C: 轮廓系数用于评估无监督聚类的聚类质量，与标签不平衡无关。
  • D: SSIM 衡量两张图像之间的感知相似度，不是偏差或不平衡指标。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：标签比例差异（DPL）是 SageMaker Clarify 的训练前偏差指标之一，它在训练任何模型之前衡量数据集各分面之间正类标签比例的差异，能直接确认类别标签是否存在可能导致预测偏差的不平衡。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 均方误差是需要模型预测结果的回归评估指标，无法反映训练数据中的标签分布。
  • C: 轮廓系数用于评估无监督聚类的聚类质量，与标签不平衡无关。
  • D: SSIM 衡量两张图像之间的感知相似度，不是偏差或不平衡指标。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Difference in proportions of labels (DPL) is one of the SageMaker Clarify pre-training bias metrics; it measures the difference in the proportion of positive labels between facets of the dataset before any model is trained, so it directly confirms whether the class labels are imbalanced in a way that could bias predictions.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Mean square error is a regression evaluation metric that requires model predictions and says nothing about the label distribution in the training data.
  • C: Silhouette score evaluates the quality of clusters in unsupervised clustering and is unrelated to label imbalance.
  • D: SSIM measures the perceptual similarity between two images and is not a bias or imbalance metric.

questions.content: An ML engineer uses one ML framework to train multiple ML models. The ML engineer needs to optimize the inference costs and host the models on Amazon SageMaker AI. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a multi-container inference endpoint for direct invocation.

contents.en: Create a multi-container inference endpoint for direct invocation.
contents.zh: 创建多容器推理端点，用于直接调用模型

options.label: B
options.content: Create a multi-model inference endpoint for all the models.

contents.en: Create a multi-model inference endpoint for all the models.
contents.zh: 为所有模型创建多模型推理端点

options.label: C
options.content: Create a multi-container inference endpoint for sequential invocation.

contents.en: Create a multi-container inference endpoint for sequential invocation.
contents.zh: 创建多容器推理端点，用于按顺序调用模型

options.label: D
options.content: Create multiple single-model inference endpoint for each model.

contents.en: Create multiple single-model inference endpoint for each model.
contents.zh: 为每个模型分别创建独立的单模型推理端点

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker multi-model endpoint 可以在一个端点上托管多个使用相同 ML 框架和服务容器的模型，并按需从 Amazon S3 将模型加载到内存。所有模型共享同一组实例，是成本效益最高的托管方式。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 直接调用模式的 multi-container endpoint 面向使用不同框架、需要各自容器的模型，会同时运行多个容器，成本高于共享一个容器。
  • C: 顺序调用模式的 multi-container endpoint 构成推理管道，各容器依次处理同一请求，不适合托管相互独立的模型，也不会降低成本。
  • D: 为每个模型创建单独端点意味着每个模型都占用专用实例，是最昂贵的托管模式。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker multi-model endpoint 可以在一个端点上托管多个使用相同 ML 框架和服务容器的模型，并按需从 Amazon S3 将模型加载到内存。所有模型共享同一组实例，是成本效益最高的托管方式。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 直接调用模式的 multi-container endpoint 面向使用不同框架、需要各自容器的模型，会同时运行多个容器，成本高于共享一个容器。
  • C: 顺序调用模式的 multi-container endpoint 构成推理管道，各容器依次处理同一请求，不适合托管相互独立的模型，也不会降低成本。
  • D: 为每个模型创建单独端点意味着每个模型都占用专用实例，是最昂贵的托管模式。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: A SageMaker multi-model endpoint hosts many models that share the same ML framework and serving container on one endpoint, loading models from Amazon S3 into memory on demand. Sharing one set of instances across all the models is the MOST cost-effective way to serve them.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A multi-container endpoint with direct invocation is for models built with different frameworks that need their own containers, so it runs several containers at once and costs more than sharing one container.
  • C: Sequential invocation of a multi-container endpoint builds an inference pipeline where each container processes the request in turn, which does not fit hosting independent models and does not reduce cost.
  • D: One endpoint per model means dedicated instances for every model, which is the most expensive hosting pattern.

An ML engineer must implement a solution that decreases the labeling time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.content: Use SageMaker Ground Truth to annotate the video frames.

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to create a data workflow. Use the workflow to optimize the labeling process.

contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Data Wrangler创建数据工作流，通过该工作流优化标注流程

options.label: D
options.content: Use the labeling interface of Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) with Amazon Rekognition to label the video frames.

contents.en: Use the labeling interface of Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) with Amazon Rekognition to label the video frames.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Ground Truth 是专门的数据标注服务：其视频帧目标检测与跟踪任务允许标注人员标注一帧后自动把标签传播到后续帧，自动标注还能用模型预先打标，可大幅缩短原本 4 个月的人工标注时间，生成的清单文件还能直接接入现有的 SageMaker 训练工作流。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: JumpStart 提供预训练模型和解决方案模板，但据此再开发一个标注模型属于开发项目，并不是加快标注的托管方式。
  • C: Data Wrangler 用于为训练准备和转换表格及图像数据，没有视频帧的标注工作流。
  • D: Amazon A2I 用于把低置信度预测交给人工复核，其内置的 Rekognition 集成仅限图像审核，不是用来标注整个视频数据集的工具。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Ground Truth 是专门的数据标注服务：其视频帧目标检测与跟踪任务允许标注人员标注一帧后自动把标签传播到后续帧，自动标注还能用模型预先打标，可大幅缩短原本 4 个月的人工标注时间，生成的清单文件还能直接接入现有的 SageMaker 训练工作流。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: JumpStart 提供预训练模型和解决方案模板，但据此再开发一个标注模型属于开发项目，并不是加快标注的托管方式。
  • C: Data Wrangler 用于为训练准备和转换表格及图像数据，没有视频帧的标注工作流。
  • D: Amazon A2I 用于把低置信度预测交给人工复核，其内置的 Rekognition 集成仅限图像审核，不是用来标注整个视频数据集的工具。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker Ground Truth is the purpose-built data labeling service: its video frame object detection and tracking tasks let annotators label one frame and automatically propagate labels across subsequent frames, and automated data labeling can pre-label with a model, which sharply cuts the 4-month manual effort while producing manifests that feed the existing SageMaker training workflow directly.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: JumpStart provides pre-trained models and solution templates, but building a separate labeling model from them is a development project, not a managed way to label frames faster.
  • C: Data Wrangler prepares and transforms tabular and image data for training; it has no annotation workflow for video frames.
  • D: Amazon A2I routes low-confidence predictions to human reviewers, and its built-in Rekognition integration is limited to image moderation; it is not a tool for labeling a whole video dataset.

The company needs a long-term and automated solution to mitigate the performance degradation. Which solution will meet these requirements?

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Clarify 与 SageMaker Model Monitor 集成，可以按计划持续监控生产端点的偏差漂移和特征归因漂移，将实时流量与基线对比并输出 Amazon CloudWatch 指标。这些告警可以触发自动重新训练，是应对客户行为变化导致性能下降的长期自动化方案。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Debugger 用于在训练任务期间检查张量和系统资源，不监控生产端点随时间的表现。
  • B: AWS X-Ray 用于跟踪应用请求和延迟，无法洞察 ML 预测质量或数据漂移。
  • C: 用 SageMaker Ground Truth 整理数据集并重新训练一次是手动的一次性修复，不是自动化的长期方案。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Clarify 与 SageMaker Model Monitor 集成，可以按计划持续监控生产端点的偏差漂移和特征归因漂移，将实时流量与基线对比并输出 Amazon CloudWatch 指标。这些告警可以触发自动重新训练，是应对客户行为变化导致性能下降的长期自动化方案。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Debugger 用于在训练任务期间检查张量和系统资源，不监控生产端点随时间的表现。
  • B: AWS X-Ray 用于跟踪应用请求和延迟，无法洞察 ML 预测质量或数据漂移。
  • C: 用 SageMaker Ground Truth 整理数据集并重新训练一次是手动的一次性修复，不是自动化的长期方案。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker Clarify integrates with SageMaker Model Monitor to continuously monitor a deployed endpoint for bias drift and feature attribution drift, comparing live traffic against a baseline on a schedule and emitting Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Those alerts can trigger automated retraining, which is the long-term, automated way to counter degradation caused by changing customer behavior.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SageMaker Debugger inspects tensors and system resources during training jobs, not the behavior of a production endpoint over time.
  • B: AWS X-Ray traces application requests and latency and has no insight into ML prediction quality or data drift.
  • C: Curating a dataset with SageMaker Ground Truth and retraining once is a manual, one-time fix rather than an automated long-term solution.

explanations.zh:

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 在 Amazon EC2 上自建 Kubernetes 集群意味着公司必须自行运维控制平面，这正是公司不希望做的。

options.label: B
options.content: Apply ML techniques such as cross-validation and regularization. Use Amazon SageMaker Experiments to track and compare different model versions and their performance metrics.

contents.en: Apply ML techniques such as cross-validation and regularization. Use Amazon SageMaker Experiments to track and compare different model versions and their performance metrics.

options.label: C

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：训练准确率高但在未见数据上表现差，是过拟合的典型表现。正则化（L1 或 L2）会惩罚过大的系数，交叉验证能可靠估计泛化能力，而 Amazon SageMaker Experiments 可以跟踪并比较各模型版本及其指标，帮助工程师选出泛化最好的模型。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 增加模型复杂度会让模型更贴合训练数据，从而加剧过拟合，而且 SageMaker Debugger 针对的是收敛和资源问题，不是泛化能力。
  • C: 把过拟合的模型直接部署到生产环境会让用户承受糟糕的预测，SageMaker Clarify 用于解释预测而不是解决泛化问题。
  • D: 增加数据量可能有帮助，但本身无法弥补缺少正则化的问题，而且混淆矩阵适用于分类而不是回归模型。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：训练准确率高但在未见数据上表现差，是过拟合的典型表现。正则化（L1 或 L2）会惩罚过大的系数，交叉验证能可靠估计泛化能力，而 Amazon SageMaker Experiments 可以跟踪并比较各模型版本及其指标，帮助工程师选出泛化最好的模型。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 增加模型复杂度会让模型更贴合训练数据，从而加剧过拟合，而且 SageMaker Debugger 针对的是收敛和资源问题，不是泛化能力。
  • C: 把过拟合的模型直接部署到生产环境会让用户承受糟糕的预测，SageMaker Clarify 用于解释预测而不是解决泛化问题。
  • D: 增加数据量可能有帮助，但本身无法弥补缺少正则化的问题，而且混淆矩阵适用于分类而不是回归模型。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: High training accuracy with poor performance on unseen data is overfitting. Regularization (L1 or L2) penalizes large coefficients and cross-validation gives a reliable estimate of generalization, while Amazon SageMaker Experiments tracks and compares the resulting model versions and their metrics so the engineer can pick the one that generalizes best.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Increasing model complexity makes the model fit the training data even more closely and worsens overfitting, and SageMaker Debugger targets convergence and resource issues, not generalization.
  • C: Deploying an overfit model to production exposes users to poor predictions, and SageMaker Clarify explains predictions rather than fixing generalization.
  • D: More data can help, but it does not address the regularization gap by itself, and a confusion matrix applies to classification, not to a regression model.

options.label: A

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 影子测试会把生产请求复制一份发送到托管新模型的影子变体，而只把生产变体的响应返回给用户。流量采样比例设为 100% 时，新模型可在每一条真实请求上评估延迟和准确率，同时完全不影响现有用户。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 蓝绿部署的线性流量切换会逐步把真实用户流量导向新模型，用户会受到影响。
  • B: 金丝雀流量切换同样会在全面上线前让一部分真实用户由新模型提供服务，从而影响这些用户。
  • C: 滚动部署每次用新模型替换一半实例，真实用户会收到新模型的响应。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker 影子测试会把生产请求复制一份发送到托管新模型的影子变体，而只把生产变体的响应返回给用户。流量采样比例设为 100% 时，新模型可在每一条真实请求上评估延迟和准确率，同时完全不影响现有用户。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 蓝绿部署的线性流量切换会逐步把真实用户流量导向新模型，用户会受到影响。
  • B: 金丝雀流量切换同样会在全面上线前让一部分真实用户由新模型提供服务，从而影响这些用户。
  • C: 滚动部署每次用新模型替换一半实例，真实用户会收到新模型的响应。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker shadow testing sends a copy of production requests to a shadow variant that hosts the new model, while only the production variant's responses are returned to users. With 100% traffic sampling the new model is evaluated on every real request for latency and accuracy without affecting existing users.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Linear traffic shifting in a blue/green deployment gradually routes real user traffic to the new model, so users are exposed to it.
  • B: Canary traffic shifting also serves a portion of live users from the new model before full rollout, which affects those users.
  • C: A rolling deployment replaces half of the fleet with the new model at a time, so real users receive its responses.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：AWS Glue 是无服务器 ETL 服务，其爬虫和作业能自动推断 Amazon S3 中数据的架构，并把表定义和元数据存入 AWS Glue Data Catalog。一个托管服务就完成了架构发现、ETL 和元数据存储，手动操作最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: SageMaker Data Wrangler 是交互式数据准备工具，不运行架构发现 ETL 作业，也不会在 S3 中维护元数据目录。
  • C: Athena 只负责查询数据而不会自动发现架构，用 AWS Step Functions 编排还需要自行构建和维护管道。
  • D: 管理 EC2 实例并编写 scikit-learn 代码来做 ETL 和向 Amazon Redshift 存元数据，完全是手工工作。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：AWS Glue 是无服务器 ETL 服务，其爬虫和作业能自动推断 Amazon S3 中数据的架构，并把表定义和元数据存入 AWS Glue Data Catalog。一个托管服务就完成了架构发现、ETL 和元数据存储，手动操作最少。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: SageMaker Data Wrangler 是交互式数据准备工具，不运行架构发现 ETL 作业，也不会在 S3 中维护元数据目录。
  • C: Athena 只负责查询数据而不会自动发现架构，用 AWS Step Functions 编排还需要自行构建和维护管道。
  • D: 管理 EC2 实例并编写 scikit-learn 代码来做 ETL 和向 Amazon Redshift 存元数据，完全是手工工作。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: AWS Glue is a serverless ETL service whose crawlers and jobs infer the schema of data in Amazon S3 and store the table definitions and metadata in the AWS Glue Data Catalog automatically. One managed service handles discovery, ETL, and metadata storage, so it requires the LEAST manual effort.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: SageMaker Data Wrangler is an interactive data preparation tool, and it does not run schema-discovery ETL jobs or maintain a metadata catalog in S3.
  • C: Athena queries data but does not discover schemas on its own, and orchestrating it with AWS Step Functions requires building and maintaining a custom pipeline.
  • D: Managing an EC2 instance and writing scikit-learn code for ETL and metadata storage in Amazon Redshift is entirely manual work.

questions.content: An ML engineer is building an ML pipeline. The pipeline must process a dataset in two ways by using Amazon Athena. The pipeline must use batch processing to perform large-scale data transformations and for model training. The pipeline must also use near real-time processing to perform low-latency queries for inference and analytics. Which file format will provide the LEAST latency for both types of processing?

options.label: A
options.content: CSV

contents.en: CSV
contents.zh: CSV

options.label: B
options.content: Apache Parquet

contents.en: Apache Parquet
contents.zh: Apache Parquet

options.label: C
options.content: Nested JSON

contents.en: Nested JSON
contents.zh: 嵌套JSON

options.label: D
options.content: Deserialized JSON

contents.en: Deserialized JSON
contents.zh: 反序列化JSON

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：Apache Parquet 是列式、压缩、可拆分的格式，内嵌架构和统计信息，Amazon Athena 只需扫描所需列并跳过无关的行组。因此无论是大规模批处理转换还是低延迟的点查询，它都比任何基于行的文本格式更快、更省钱。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CSV 是基于行的文本格式，每次查询都迫使 Athena 扫描每一行的全部字节，两类工作负载的延迟都会增加。
  • C: 嵌套 JSON 必须逐行完整解析且无法做列裁剪，查询速度慢于 Parquet。
  • D: 反序列化 JSON 仍是冗长的面向行的文本，没有列裁剪或谓词下推，也不是 Athena 可以优化的存储格式。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：Apache Parquet 是列式、压缩、可拆分的格式，内嵌架构和统计信息，Amazon Athena 只需扫描所需列并跳过无关的行组。因此无论是大规模批处理转换还是低延迟的点查询，它都比任何基于行的文本格式更快、更省钱。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CSV 是基于行的文本格式，每次查询都迫使 Athena 扫描每一行的全部字节，两类工作负载的延迟都会增加。
  • C: 嵌套 JSON 必须逐行完整解析且无法做列裁剪，查询速度慢于 Parquet。
  • D: 反序列化 JSON 仍是冗长的面向行的文本，没有列裁剪或谓词下推，也不是 Athena 可以优化的存储格式。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Apache Parquet is a columnar, compressed, splittable format with embedded schema and statistics, so Amazon Athena scans only the needed columns and skips irrelevant row groups. That makes both large batch transformations and low-latency point queries faster and cheaper than any row-based text format.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: CSV is a row-based text format that forces Athena to scan every byte of every row for each query, which increases latency for both workloads.
  • C: Nested JSON must be fully parsed row by row and cannot be column-pruned, so queries are slower than on Parquet.
  • D: Deserialized JSON is still verbose row-oriented text with no column pruning or predicate pushdown, and it is not a storage format Athena can optimize.

questions.content: A company uses an Amazon SageMaker AI ML model to make real-time inferences. The company has configured auto scaling for the Amazon EC2 instances that SageMaker AI uses for the inferences. During times of peak usage, new instances launch before existing instances are fully ready. As a result, the model experiences inefficiencies and delays. Which solution will optimize the scaling process without affecting response times?

options.label: A
options.content: Change to a multi-model endpoint configuration in SageMaker AI.

contents.en: Change to a multi-model endpoint configuration in SageMaker AI.
contents.zh: 在SageMaker人工智能平台中切换为多模型端点配置

options.label: B
options.content: Integrate Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to manage invocations of the SageMaker AI inference endpoint.

contents.en: Integrate Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to manage invocations of the SageMaker AI inference endpoint.
contents.zh: 将亚马逊API网关与AWS Lambda集成，管理SageMaker人工智能推理端点的调用请求

options.label: C
options.content: Decrease the cooldown period for scale-in activities. Increase the maximum number of instances.

contents.en: Decrease the cooldown period for scale-in activities. Increase the maximum number of instances.
contents.zh: 缩短实例缩容活动的冷却时间，同时提高实例数量上限

options.label: D
options.content: Increase the cooldown period after scale-out activities.

contents.en: Increase the cooldown period after scale-out activities.
contents.zh: 延长实例扩容活动后的冷却时间

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：扩容冷却时间是 SageMaker 自动扩缩容在添加实例后、再次评估指标并继续扩容前的等待时间。延长该时间可以让新启动的实例完成初始化并开始服务后再触发下一次扩容，从而消除浪费性的过早启动，同时不影响已在服务中的实例的响应时间。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: multi-model endpoint 改变的是模型在实例上的打包方式，与扩缩容活动的时序无关。
  • B: 在端点前加上 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 会增加延迟和成本，并不会改变端点的扩缩容行为。
  • C: 缩短缩容冷却时间会让端点更快地移除容量，而提高实例上限只会允许更多过早启动，而不是阻止它们。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：扩容冷却时间是 SageMaker 自动扩缩容在添加实例后、再次评估指标并继续扩容前的等待时间。延长该时间可以让新启动的实例完成初始化并开始服务后再触发下一次扩容，从而消除浪费性的过早启动，同时不影响已在服务中的实例的响应时间。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: multi-model endpoint 改变的是模型在实例上的打包方式，与扩缩容活动的时序无关。
  • B: 在端点前加上 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 会增加延迟和成本，并不会改变端点的扩缩容行为。
  • C: 缩短缩容冷却时间会让端点更快地移除容量，而提高实例上限只会允许更多过早启动，而不是阻止它们。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: The scale-out cooldown period is the time SageMaker auto scaling waits after adding instances before it evaluates the metric again and launches more. Increasing it gives newly launched instances time to finish initializing and start serving before another scale-out is triggered, which removes the wasteful premature launches without slowing the responses of the instances already in service.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A multi-model endpoint changes how models are packed on an instance and does nothing about the timing of scaling activities.
  • B: Placing Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda in front of the endpoint adds latency and cost and does not change how the endpoint scales.
  • C: Decreasing the scale-in cooldown makes the endpoint remove capacity faster, and a higher maximum only allows more premature launches rather than preventing them.

questions.content: A company deployed an Amazon SageMaker AI ML model to an endpoint by calling the CreateModel API operation. The network that was established with the API call includes two private subnets and one security group. The model must download data from an Amazon S3 bucket and must upload data to the S3 bucket. The traffic to the S3 bucket must not travel across the internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a NAT gateway. Configure the security group to allow outbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the NAT gateway.

contents.en: Create a NAT gateway. Configure the security group to allow outbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the NAT gateway.
contents.zh: 创建网络地址转换（NAT）网关，配置安全组以允许出站连接，同时配置路由表，将所有发往S3存储桶的流量重定向至该NAT网关

options.label: B
options.content: Create a gateway VPC endpoint. Configure an endpoint policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.

contents.en: Create a gateway VPC endpoint. Configure an endpoint policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.
contents.zh: 创建网关型虚拟私有云（VPC）端点，配置端点策略以限制对目标S3存储桶的访问，同时配置路由表，将所有发往S3存储桶的流量重定向至该端点

options.label: C
options.content: Create an interface VPC endpoint. Verify that the security group allows only inbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.

contents.en: Create an interface VPC endpoint. Verify that the security group allows only inbound connections. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.
contents.zh: 创建接口型虚拟私有云（VPC）端点，确认安全组仅允许入站连接，同时配置路由表，将所有发往S3存储桶的流量重定向至该端点

options.label: D
options.content: Create a Gateway Load Balancer VPC endpoint. Configure an IAM policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.

contents.en: Create a Gateway Load Balancer VPC endpoint. Configure an IAM policy that restricts access to the S3 bucket. Configure route tables to redirect any traffic to the S3 bucket through the endpoint.
contents.zh: 创建网关负载均衡器型虚拟私有云（VPC）端点，配置身份与访问管理（IAM）策略以限制对目标S3存储桶的访问，同时配置路由表，将所有发往S3存储桶的流量重定向至该端点

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：Amazon S3 的网关型 VPC 端点会在私有子网的路由表中添加路由，使发往 S3 的流量走 AWS 内部网络而不是公网。端点策略可以把访问限制在指定存储桶，位于两个私有子网中的 SageMaker 模型即可私密地下载和上传数据。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: NAT 网关会把发往 S3 的流量经由公网转发，违反了要求。
  • C: S3 的接口型端点通过私有 IP 地址而不是路由表条目工作，而只允许入站连接的安全组会阻断模型对 S3 的出站请求。
  • D: Gateway Load Balancer 端点用于把流量转发到第三方虚拟设备，不用于连接 Amazon S3。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：Amazon S3 的网关型 VPC 端点会在私有子网的路由表中添加路由，使发往 S3 的流量走 AWS 内部网络而不是公网。端点策略可以把访问限制在指定存储桶，位于两个私有子网中的 SageMaker 模型即可私密地下载和上传数据。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: NAT 网关会把发往 S3 的流量经由公网转发，违反了要求。
  • C: S3 的接口型端点通过私有 IP 地址而不是路由表条目工作，而只允许入站连接的安全组会阻断模型对 S3 的出站请求。
  • D: Gateway Load Balancer 端点用于把流量转发到第三方虚拟设备，不用于连接 Amazon S3。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: A gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 adds a route in the private subnets' route tables that sends S3 traffic over the AWS network instead of the internet. An endpoint policy can restrict the endpoint to the specific bucket, and the SageMaker model in the two private subnets can then download and upload data privately.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A NAT gateway routes traffic to S3 through the public internet, which violates the requirement.
  • C: Interface endpoints for S3 use private IP addresses rather than route table entries, and a security group that allows only inbound connections would block the model's outbound requests to S3.
  • D: A Gateway Load Balancer endpoint is for routing traffic to third-party virtual appliances, not for connecting to Amazon S3.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：按偿还贷款的可能性对客户排序是一个基于表格数据的监督学习问题，SageMaker 内置的 XGBoost 算法会为每位客户输出还款概率，按概率排序即可得到排名。XGBoost 是在结构化特征上做信用风险评分的标准内置算法。

  • D: Neural Topic Model 用于发现文本文档中的主题，与对表格化客户记录评分无关。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：按偿还贷款的可能性对客户排序是一个基于表格数据的监督学习问题，SageMaker 内置的 XGBoost 算法会为每位客户输出还款概率，按概率排序即可得到排名。XGBoost 是在结构化特征上做信用风险评分的标准内置算法。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: K-means 是无监督聚类算法，只能把相似客户分组，不会学习或评估还款可能性。
  • C: PCA 是降维技术，不产生任何预测或排名。
  • D: Neural Topic Model 用于发现文本文档中的主题，与对表格化客户记录评分无关。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Ranking customers by likelihood of repaying a loan is a supervised problem on tabular data, and the SageMaker built-in XGBoost algorithm outputs a repayment probability for each customer that can be sorted to produce the ranking. XGBoost is the standard built-in choice for credit-risk scoring on structured features.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: K-means is an unsupervised clustering algorithm that groups similar customers but does not learn or score repayment likelihood.
  • C: PCA is a dimensionality-reduction technique and produces no prediction or ranking.
  • D: Neural Topic Model discovers topics in text documents and is unrelated to scoring tabular customer records.

options.label: A
options.content: Use an AWS Glue crawler and an AWS Glue extract, transform and load (ETL) job to detect data drift. Use AWS Glue triggers to automate the re-training job.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Model Monitor 是专门用于捕获端点流量、按计划与基线对比并把数据漂移违规以 Amazon CloudWatch 指标形式上报的服务。基于这些指标的 CloudWatch 告警可以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来启动 SageMaker 管道或训练任务，在检测到漂移时实现完全自动的重新训练。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Glue 爬虫和 ETL 作业用于编目和转换数据，不会针对模型基线计算统计漂移。
  • B: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink 是流处理引擎，需要自行编写漂移检测逻辑，而不是使用 SageMaker 的原生功能。
  • D: Amazon QuickSight 异常检测是商业智能可视化功能，并非为监控 ML 特征分布或驱动训练管道而设计。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Model Monitor 是专门用于捕获端点流量、按计划与基线对比并把数据漂移违规以 Amazon CloudWatch 指标形式上报的服务。基于这些指标的 CloudWatch 告警可以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来启动 SageMaker 管道或训练任务，在检测到漂移时实现完全自动的重新训练。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS Glue 爬虫和 ETL 作业用于编目和转换数据，不会针对模型基线计算统计漂移。
  • B: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink 是流处理引擎，需要自行编写漂移检测逻辑，而不是使用 SageMaker 的原生功能。
  • D: Amazon QuickSight 异常检测是商业智能可视化功能，并非为监控 ML 特征分布或驱动训练管道而设计。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: SageMaker Model Monitor is the purpose-built service that captures endpoint traffic, compares it with a baseline on a schedule, and reports data drift violations as Amazon CloudWatch metrics. A CloudWatch alarm on those metrics can invoke an AWS Lambda function that starts the SageMaker pipeline or training job, giving fully automatic retraining when drift is detected.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: AWS Glue crawlers and ETL jobs catalog and transform data; they do not compute statistical drift against a model baseline.
  • B: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink is a stream-processing engine and would require custom-built drift detection logic instead of using the native SageMaker feature.
  • D: Amazon QuickSight anomaly detection is a business-intelligence visualization feature and is not designed to monitor ML feature distributions or feed a training pipeline.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Model Registry 以模型组的形式登记模型版本、审批状态和血缘，满足版本跟踪的要求。SageMaker Inference Recommender 会在候选实例类型上对模型做负载测试，并推荐满足延迟和成本目标的实例类型和配置，正是首次在 SageMaker 上托管模型的团队所需要的。

  • A: Amazon ECR 存储的是容器镜像而不是模型版本，AWS Compute Optimizer 只能分析现有 EC2 的利用率，无法为从未托管过的模型推荐实例类型。
  • B: SageMaker Autopilot 用于构建 AutoML 模型，不推荐托管实例类型。
  • D: Amazon ECR 不跟踪模型版本，SageMaker Experiments 跟踪的是训练运行和指标，而不是部署实例推荐。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker Model Registry 以模型组的形式登记模型版本、审批状态和血缘，满足版本跟踪的要求。SageMaker Inference Recommender 会在候选实例类型上对模型做负载测试，并推荐满足延迟和成本目标的实例类型和配置，正是首次在 SageMaker 上托管模型的团队所需要的。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon ECR 存储的是容器镜像而不是模型版本，AWS Compute Optimizer 只能分析现有 EC2 的利用率，无法为从未托管过的模型推荐实例类型。
  • B: SageMaker Autopilot 用于构建 AutoML 模型，不推荐托管实例类型。
  • D: Amazon ECR 不跟踪模型版本，SageMaker Experiments 跟踪的是训练运行和指标，而不是部署实例推荐。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: The SageMaker Model Registry catalogs model versions in model groups with approval status and lineage, which meets the version-tracking requirement. SageMaker Inference Recommender runs load tests of the model on candidate instance types and recommends the instance type and configuration that meet latency and cost targets, which is exactly what a team hosting on SageMaker for the first time needs.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon ECR stores container images rather than model versions, and AWS Compute Optimizer analyzes existing EC2 utilization and cannot recommend instance types for a model that has never been hosted.
  • B: SageMaker Autopilot builds AutoML models; it does not recommend hosting instance types.
  • D: Amazon ECR does not track model versions, and SageMaker Experiments tracks training runs and metrics, not deployment instance recommendations.

questions.content: A company is using Amazon SageMaker AI to develop a credit risk assessment model. During model validation, the company finds that the model achieves 82% accuracy on the validation data. However, the model achieved 99% accuracy on the training data. The company needs to address the model accuracy issue before deployment. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Add more dense layers to increase model complexity. Implement batch normalization. Use early stopping during training.

contents.en: Add more dense layers to increase model complexity. Implement batch normalization. Use early stopping during training.
contents.zh: 添加更多全连接层以增加模型复杂度，实施批量归一化，并在训练过程中使用早停法

options.label: B
options.content: Implement dropout layers. Use L1 or L2 regularization. Perform k-fold cross-validation.

contents.en: Implement dropout layers. Use L1 or L2 regularization. Perform k-fold cross-validation.
contents.zh: 引入丢弃层（Dropout），使用L1或L2正则化，执行K折交叉验证

options.label: C
options.content: Use principal component analysis (PCA) to reduce the feature dimensionality. Decrease model layers. Implement cross-entropy loss functions.

contents.en: Use principal component analysis (PCA) to reduce the feature dimensionality. Decrease model layers. Implement cross-entropy loss functions.
contents.zh: 使用主成分分析（PCA）降低特征维度，减少模型层数，并采用交叉熵损失函数

options.label: D
options.content: Augment the training dataset. Remove duplicate records from the training dataset. Implement stratified sampling.

contents.en: Augment the training dataset. Remove duplicate records from the training dataset. Implement stratified sampling.
contents.zh: 扩充训练数据集，删除训练数据集中的重复记录，并实施分层抽样

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：训练准确率 99% 而验证准确率只有 82%，说明模型过拟合。Dropout 层和 L1 或 L2 正则化会约束模型，使其不再死记训练记录，K 折交叉验证则能在部署前可靠地评估正则化后模型的泛化能力。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 增加全连接层会提升模型容量并加剧过拟合，仅靠批量归一化和早停无法抵消增加的复杂度。
  • C: PCA 和减少层数不是解决信贷模型过拟合的标准手段，选择交叉熵只是损失函数的决定，无法弥补泛化差距。
  • D: 数据增强、去重和分层抽样属于数据准备步骤，不能直接对过拟合模型进行正则化。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：训练准确率 99% 而验证准确率只有 82%，说明模型过拟合。Dropout 层和 L1 或 L2 正则化会约束模型，使其不再死记训练记录，K 折交叉验证则能在部署前可靠地评估正则化后模型的泛化能力。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 增加全连接层会提升模型容量并加剧过拟合，仅靠批量归一化和早停无法抵消增加的复杂度。
  • C: PCA 和减少层数不是解决信贷模型过拟合的标准手段，选择交叉熵只是损失函数的决定，无法弥补泛化差距。
  • D: 数据增强、去重和分层抽样属于数据准备步骤，不能直接对过拟合模型进行正则化。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: A 99% training accuracy versus 82% validation accuracy gap is overfitting. Dropout layers and L1 or L2 regularization constrain the model so it stops memorizing training records, and k-fold cross-validation gives a robust estimate of how the regularized model generalizes before deployment.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Adding dense layers increases capacity and worsens overfitting; batch normalization and early stopping alone do not offset that added complexity.
  • C: PCA and fewer layers are not the standard remedy for overfitting on a credit model, and choosing cross-entropy is a loss-function decision that does not address the generalization gap.
  • D: Augmenting data, removing duplicates, and stratified sampling are data-preparation steps that do not directly regularize an overfitting model.

questions.content: A company collects customer data every day. The company stores the data as compressed files in an Amazon S3 bucket that is partitioned by date. Every month, analysts download the data, process the data to check the data quality, and then upload the data to Amazon QuickSight dashboards. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to automatically check the data quality before the data is sent to QuickSight. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use AWS Glue Data Quality rules to check the data quality.

contents.en: Run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use AWS Glue Data Quality rules to check the data quality.
contents.zh: 每月运行一次AWS Glue爬虫以更新AWS Glue数据目录，使用AWS Glue数据质量规则检查数据质量

options.label: B
options.content: Use an AWS Glue trigger to run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Create an AWS Glue job that loads the data into a PySpark DataFrame. Configure the job to apply custom functions and to evaluate the data quality.

contents.en: Use an AWS Glue trigger to run an AWS Glue crawler every month to update the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Create an AWS Glue job that loads the data into a PySpark DataFrame. Configure the job to apply custom functions and to evaluate the data quality.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Glue触发器每月运行一次AWS Glue爬虫以更新AWS Glue数据目录，创建一个AWS Glue任务，将数据加载至PySpark数据帧（DataFrame），并配置该任务通过自定义函数评估数据质量

options.label: C
options.content: Run Python scripts on an AWS Lambda function every month to evaluate data quality. Configure the S3 bucket to invoke the Lambda function when objects are added to the S3 bucket.

contents.en: Run Python scripts on an AWS Lambda function every month to evaluate data quality. Configure the S3 bucket to invoke the Lambda function when objects are added to the S3 bucket.
contents.zh: 每月运行部署在AWS Lambda函数中的Python脚本评估数据质量，配置S3存储桶在有对象添加时触发该Lambda函数

options.label: D
options.content: Configure the S3 bucket to send event notifications to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when objects are uploaded. Use Amazon CloudWatch insights every month for the SQS queue to evaluate the data quality.

contents.en: Configure the S3 bucket to send event notifications to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when objects are uploaded. Use Amazon CloudWatch insights every month for the SQS queue to evaluate the data quality.
contents.zh: 配置S3存储桶在有对象上传时向亚马逊简单队列服务（SQS）发送事件通知，每月通过亚马逊CloudWatch Insights分析该SQS队列，评估数据质量

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：AWS Glue Data Quality 允许工程师定义声明式规则（完整性、唯一性、取值范围等），并以托管方式对 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中的表执行评估。用计划运行的爬虫刷新目录并应用内置规则，无需编写任何自定义代码，运维开销最低。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 在 Glue 作业中编写并维护自定义 PySpark 函数来评估质量，比使用托管的 Data Quality 规则工作量更大。
  • C: Lambda 中的自定义 Python 代码需要编写和维护，而且每次上传对象都触发与每月检查一次的需求相冲突。
  • D: Amazon SQS 通知和 CloudWatch Logs Insights 只能反映事件和日志，无法检查数据文件内容的质量。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：AWS Glue Data Quality 允许工程师定义声明式规则（完整性、唯一性、取值范围等），并以托管方式对 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中的表执行评估。用计划运行的爬虫刷新目录并应用内置规则，无需编写任何自定义代码，运维开销最低。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 在 Glue 作业中编写并维护自定义 PySpark 函数来评估质量，比使用托管的 Data Quality 规则工作量更大。
  • C: Lambda 中的自定义 Python 代码需要编写和维护，而且每次上传对象都触发与每月检查一次的需求相冲突。
  • D: Amazon SQS 通知和 CloudWatch Logs Insights 只能反映事件和日志，无法检查数据文件内容的质量。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: AWS Glue Data Quality lets the engineer define declarative rules (completeness, uniqueness, value ranges, and more) that run as managed evaluations against tables in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Refreshing the catalog with a scheduled crawler and applying built-in rules needs no custom code, so it has the LEAST operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Writing and maintaining custom PySpark functions in a Glue job to evaluate quality is more work than using the managed Data Quality rules.
  • C: Custom Python in Lambda must be written and maintained, and invoking it on every object upload conflicts with the monthly check.
  • D: Amazon SQS notifications and CloudWatch Logs Insights only report on events and logs; they cannot inspect the content of the data files for quality.

questions.content: A company has an ML model in Amazon SageMaker AI. An ML engineer needs to implement a monitoring solution to automatically detect changes in the input data distribution of model features. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a data quality baseline. Ensure that the emit_metrics option is enabled in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in specific metrics that are related to data quality.

contents.en: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a data quality baseline. Ensure that the emit_metrics option is enabled in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in specific metrics that are related to data quality.
contents.zh: 配置SageMaker模型监控器，建立数据质量基线，确保基线约束文件中启用了emit_metrics选项，配置亚马逊CloudWatch警报，在相关数据质量指标发生变化时向公司发送通知

options.label: B
options.content: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a model quality baseline. Ensure that the comparison_method option is set to Robust in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in model quality metrics.

contents.en: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor. Establish a model quality baseline. Ensure that the comparison_method option is set to Robust in the baseline constraints file. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the company about changes in model quality metrics.
contents.zh: 配置SageMaker模型监控器，建立模型质量基线，确保基线约束文件中的comparison_method选项设置为Robust，配置亚马逊CloudWatch警报，在模型质量指标发生变化时向公司发送通知

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Debugger with custom rules to track shifts in feature distributions. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to notify the company when the rules detect significant changes.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Debugger with custom rules to track shifts in feature distributions. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to notify the company when the rules detect significant changes.
contents.zh: 使用带有自定义规则的SageMaker Debugger跟踪特征分布的变化，配置亚马逊CloudWatch警报，在规则检测到显著变化时向公司发送通知

options.label: D
options.content: Use Amazon CloudWatch to directly observe the SageMaker AI endpoint’s performance metrics. Manually analyze the CloudWatch logs for indicators of data drift or shifts in feature distribution.

contents.en: Use Amazon CloudWatch to directly observe the SageMaker AI endpoint’s performance metrics. Manually analyze the CloudWatch logs for indicators of data drift or shifts in feature distribution.
contents.zh: 直接通过亚马逊CloudWatch监控SageMaker人工智能端点的性能指标，手动分析CloudWatch日志，以发现数据漂移或特征分布变化的迹象

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：特征输入分布的变化属于数据质量漂移，SageMaker Model Monitor 会把捕获的端点输入与数据质量基线进行比较来检测它。在约束文件中启用 emit_metrics 会把漂移统计发布到 Amazon CloudWatch，由告警自动通知公司，无需任何自定义代码。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 模型质量基线衡量的是预测结果相对真实标签的准确性，而不是输入特征分布的变化。
  • C: SageMaker Debugger 作用于训练任务，为其编写自定义规则比使用内置的数据质量监控工作量大得多。
  • D: 端点性能指标并不描述特征分布，而手动分析日志与低运维开销的要求背道而驰。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：特征输入分布的变化属于数据质量漂移，SageMaker Model Monitor 会把捕获的端点输入与数据质量基线进行比较来检测它。在约束文件中启用 emit_metrics 会把漂移统计发布到 Amazon CloudWatch，由告警自动通知公司，无需任何自定义代码。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 模型质量基线衡量的是预测结果相对真实标签的准确性，而不是输入特征分布的变化。
  • C: SageMaker Debugger 作用于训练任务，为其编写自定义规则比使用内置的数据质量监控工作量大得多。
  • D: 端点性能指标并不描述特征分布，而手动分析日志与低运维开销的要求背道而驰。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Changes in the input distribution of features are data quality drift, which SageMaker Model Monitor detects by comparing captured endpoint inputs with a data quality baseline. Enabling emit_metrics in the constraints file publishes the drift statistics to Amazon CloudWatch, where an alarm can notify the company automatically with no custom code.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: A model quality baseline measures prediction accuracy against ground truth labels, not shifts in the input feature distribution.
  • C: SageMaker Debugger operates on training jobs, and writing custom rules for it is far more work than using the built-in data quality monitor.
  • D: Endpoint performance metrics do not describe feature distributions, and manual log analysis is the opposite of low operational overhead.

Traffic is variable throughout the day. The company needs to create an inference endpoint for the model. Which type of inference endpoint will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.label: A
options.content: Batch transform inference endpoint

contents.en: Batch transform inference endpoint
contents.zh: 批量转换推理端点

options.label: B
options.content: Asynchronous inference endpoint

contents.en: Asynchronous inference endpoint
contents.zh: 异步推理端点

options.label: C
options.content: Real-time inference endpoint

contents.en: Real-time inference endpoint
contents.zh: 实时推理端点

options.label: D
options.content: Serverless inference endpoint

contents.en: Serverless inference endpoint
contents.zh: 无服务器推理端点

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Serverless Inference 会为每个请求自动配置并伸缩计算资源，空闲时缩减到零，公司只需为调用期间实际使用的计算付费。对于要响应实时网站交互、且流量全天波动的推荐模型，这是成本效益最高的端点类型。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 批量转换处理的是离线数据集，不提供可响应实时网站交互的端点。
  • B: 异步推理面向排队处理的大负载和长耗时请求，不适合网站上的低延迟推荐。
  • C: 实时端点会全天保持已配置实例运行，在低流量时段公司仍要为闲置容量付费。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Serverless Inference 会为每个请求自动配置并伸缩计算资源，空闲时缩减到零，公司只需为调用期间实际使用的计算付费。对于要响应实时网站交互、且流量全天波动的推荐模型，这是成本效益最高的端点类型。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 批量转换处理的是离线数据集，不提供可响应实时网站交互的端点。
  • B: 异步推理面向排队处理的大负载和长耗时请求，不适合网站上的低延迟推荐。
  • C: 实时端点会全天保持已配置实例运行，在低流量时段公司仍要为闲置容量付费。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker Serverless Inference automatically provisions and scales compute for each request and scales to zero when idle, so the company pays only for compute used during invocations. For a recommendation model that responds to live website interactions with traffic that varies through the day, this is the MOST cost-effective endpoint type.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Batch transform processes offline datasets and does not provide an endpoint that can respond to live website interactions.
  • B: Asynchronous inference is designed for large payloads and long-running requests that are queued, not for low-latency recommendations on a website.
  • C: A real-time endpoint keeps provisioned instances running around the clock, so the company pays for idle capacity during low-traffic periods.

Recently, the company discovered suspicious traffic to the domain from a specific IP address. The company needs to block traffic from the specific IP address. Which update to the network configuration will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Create a security group inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the security group to the domain.

contents.en: Create a security group inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the security group to the domain.
contents.zh: 创建一条安全组入站规则，拒绝来自该特定IP地址的流量，并将该安全组关联至该域

options.label: B
options.content: Create a network ACL inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the rule to the default network ACL for the subnet where the domain is located.

contents.en: Create a network ACL inbound rule to deny traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the rule to the default network ACL for the subnet where the domain is located.
contents.zh: 创建一条网络访问控制列表（NACL）入站规则，拒绝来自该特定IP地址的流量，并将该规则添加至该域所在子网的默认网络访问控制列表（NACL）

options.label: C
options.content: Create a shadow variant for the domain. Configure SageMaker Inference Recommender to send traffic from the specific IP address to the shadow endpoint.

contents.en: Create a shadow variant for the domain. Configure SageMaker Inference Recommender to send traffic from the specific IP address to the shadow endpoint.
contents.zh: 为该域创建一个影子变体，配置SageMaker推理推荐器将来自该特定IP地址的流量发送至影子端点

options.label: D
options.content: Create a VPC route table to deny inbound traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the route table to the domain.

contents.en: Create a VPC route table to deny inbound traffic from the specific IP address. Assign the route table to the domain.
contents.zh: 创建一个虚拟私有云（VPC）路由表，拒绝来自该特定IP地址的入站流量，并将该路由表关联至该域

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：网络 ACL 是 VPC 中唯一支持显式拒绝规则的网络控制，它在子网边界过滤流量。在承载 SageMaker AI 域的公有子网的网络 ACL 中添加针对该 IP 地址的入站拒绝规则，即可阻止该来源，同时不影响其他访问。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 安全组只支持允许规则并隐式拒绝其余流量，无法为单个 IP 地址创建拒绝规则。
  • C: 影子变体和 SageMaker Inference Recommender 用于测试推理端点，与阻止访问域的网络流量无关。
  • D: 路由表决定出站流量的去向，不能拒绝来自某个源地址的入站流量。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：网络 ACL 是 VPC 中唯一支持显式拒绝规则的网络控制，它在子网边界过滤流量。在承载 SageMaker AI 域的公有子网的网络 ACL 中添加针对该 IP 地址的入站拒绝规则，即可阻止该来源，同时不影响其他访问。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 安全组只支持允许规则并隐式拒绝其余流量，无法为单个 IP 地址创建拒绝规则。
  • C: 影子变体和 SageMaker Inference Recommender 用于测试推理端点，与阻止访问域的网络流量无关。
  • D: 路由表决定出站流量的去向，不能拒绝来自某个源地址的入站流量。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Network ACLs are the only VPC network control that supports explicit deny rules, and they filter traffic at the subnet boundary. Adding an inbound deny rule for the specific IP address to the network ACL of the public subnet that hosts the SageMaker AI domain blocks that source while leaving all other access unchanged.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Security groups support only allow rules and implicitly deny everything else, so a deny rule for one IP address cannot be created.
  • C: Shadow variants and SageMaker Inference Recommender relate to testing inference endpoints and have nothing to do with blocking network traffic to a domain.
  • D: Route tables decide where outbound traffic is sent and cannot deny inbound traffic from a source address.

questions.content: A company’s ML engineer is creating a classification model. The ML engineer explores the dataset and notices a column that is named day_of_week. The column’s data consists of the following values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Which technique should the ML engineer use to convert this column’s data to binary values?

options.label: A
options.content: Binary encoding

contents.en: Binary encoding
contents.zh: 二进制编码

options.label: B
options.content: Label encoding

contents.en: Label encoding
contents.zh: 标签编码

options.label: C
options.content: One-hot encoding

contents.en: One-hot encoding
contents.zh: 独热编码

options.label: D
options.content: Tokenization

contents.en: Tokenization
contents.zh: 标记化

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：独热编码会为七个星期值各创建一个二进制列，对应的星期置为 1，其余置为 0。它把名义类别表示为二进制值且不暗示任何顺序，正是分类模型所需要的。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 二进制编码先给每个类别分配整数，再把其二进制表示拆到多列，多个类别会共享比特位，而不是为每一天生成一个清晰的指示列。
  • B: 标签编码把每一天映射为 0 到 6 的单个整数而不是二进制值，并且会引入虚假的顺序关系。
  • D: 标记化用于把文本切分成词元以进行 NLP 处理，不会产生二进制特征值。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：独热编码会为七个星期值各创建一个二进制列，对应的星期置为 1，其余置为 0。它把名义类别表示为二进制值且不暗示任何顺序，正是分类模型所需要的。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 二进制编码先给每个类别分配整数，再把其二进制表示拆到多列，多个类别会共享比特位，而不是为每一天生成一个清晰的指示列。
  • B: 标签编码把每一天映射为 0 到 6 的单个整数而不是二进制值，并且会引入虚假的顺序关系。
  • D: 标记化用于把文本切分成词元以进行 NLP 处理，不会产生二进制特征值。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: One-hot encoding creates one binary column for each of the seven weekday values and sets it to 1 for the matching day and 0 otherwise. This represents a nominal category as binary values without implying any ordering, which is what a classification model needs.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Binary encoding first assigns each category an integer and then splits its base-2 representation across columns, which packs several categories into shared bits rather than producing one clean indicator per day.
  • B: Label encoding maps each day to a single integer from 0 to 6, not to binary values, and implies a false ordinal relationship.
  • D: Tokenization splits text into tokens for NLP processing and does not produce binary feature values.

options.label: A
options.content: Use SageMaker Clarify to impute categorical features with the mean value.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Clarify to impute categorical features with the mean value.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Clarify，以均值填充类别特征的缺失值

options.label: B
options.content: Use SageMaker Clarity to impute categorical features with the mode value.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Clarity to impute categorical features with the mode value.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Clarify，以众数填充类别特征的缺失值

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to impute categorical features with the mean value.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to impute categorical features with the mean value.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Data Wrangler，以均值填充类别特征的缺失值

options.label: D
options.content: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to impute categorical features with the mode value.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to impute categorical features with the mode value.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Data Wrangler，以众数填充类别特征的缺失值

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Data Wrangler 内置 Handle missing 转换，可以用最频繁出现的值（众数）填充类别列。众数是类别数据在统计上有效的填充值，因为它本身就是一个真实的类别标签，因此可以直接在 SageMaker AI 中解决问题。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Clarify 用于偏差检测和可解释性，不做缺失值填充，而且均值对类别数据没有意义。
  • B: SageMaker Clarify（选项中误写为 Clarity）不是数据准备工具，不提供填充转换，尽管众数本身是正确的统计量。
  • C: Data Wrangler 是正确的工具，但均值只能对数值特征计算，无法填充类别值。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker Data Wrangler 内置 Handle missing 转换，可以用最频繁出现的值（众数）填充类别列。众数是类别数据在统计上有效的填充值，因为它本身就是一个真实的类别标签，因此可以直接在 SageMaker AI 中解决问题。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Clarify 用于偏差检测和可解释性，不做缺失值填充，而且均值对类别数据没有意义。
  • B: SageMaker Clarify（选项中误写为 Clarity）不是数据准备工具，不提供填充转换，尽管众数本身是正确的统计量。
  • C: Data Wrangler 是正确的工具，但均值只能对数值特征计算，无法填充类别值。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker Data Wrangler includes a built-in Handle missing transform that can impute categorical columns with the most frequent value (the mode). The mode is the statistically valid fill for categorical data because it is an actual category label, so this solves the problem directly inside SageMaker AI.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SageMaker Clarify performs bias detection and explainability and does not impute missing values; the mean is also meaningless for categorical data.
  • B: SageMaker Clarify (spelled Clarity in the option) is not a data preparation tool and offers no imputation transforms, even though the mode is the right statistic.
  • C: Data Wrangler is the right tool, but a mean can only be computed for numeric features and cannot fill categorical values.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：在训练所在的 VPC 中为 Amazon S3 创建网关型 VPC 端点，可以让访问账户 A 存储桶的全部流量通过私有 IP 地址留在 AWS 网络内，跨账户访问由存储桶策略授权。把 SageMaker Python SDK 的环境变量 OPT_OUT_TRACKING 设为 1 会关闭 SDK 遥测，避免训练元数据被发送给 AWS。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • D: 预签名 URL 通过公共 S3 端点访问，违反仅使用私有 IP 的要求，而且在 10 天的训练期间会过期。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：在训练所在的 VPC 中为 Amazon S3 创建网关型 VPC 端点，可以让访问账户 A 存储桶的全部流量通过私有 IP 地址留在 AWS 网络内，跨账户访问由存储桶策略授权。把 SageMaker Python SDK 的环境变量 OPT_OUT_TRACKING 设为 1 会关闭 SDK 遥测，避免训练元数据被发送给 AWS。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon S3 是位于 VPC 之外的区域级服务，VPC 对等连接无法提供通往它的私有路径，而且 SDK 遥测也没有邮件退出流程。
  • C: 安全组无法关联到 S3 存储桶，而人工智能服务退出策略管的是 Amazon Rekognition 等 AI 服务对内容的使用，不是 SageMaker SDK 的元数据。
  • D: 预签名 URL 通过公共 S3 端点访问，违反仅使用私有 IP 的要求，而且在 10 天的训练期间会过期。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: A gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the training VPC keeps all traffic to the bucket in Account A on the AWS network using private IP addresses, with cross-account access granted by the bucket policy. Setting the SageMaker Python SDK environment variable OPT_OUT_TRACKING to 1 disables the SDK telemetry that would otherwise send training metadata to AWS.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon S3 is a regional service outside any VPC, so VPC peering does not provide a private path to it, and there is no email opt-out process for SDK telemetry.
  • C: Security groups cannot be attached to S3 buckets, and AI services opt-out policies govern content use by AI services such as Amazon Rekognition, not SageMaker SDK metadata.
  • D: Presigned URLs are accessed over public S3 endpoints, which violates the private-IP-only requirement, and they would expire during a 10-day training run.

questions.content: A music streaming company constantly streams song ratings from an application to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use the ratings as an input for training and inference of an Amazon SageMaker AI model. The company has an AWS Glue Data Catalog that is configured with the S3 bucket as the source. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to create a repository for this data. The solution must ensure that the data stays synchronized during batch training and real-time inference. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Ingest data into SageMaker Feature Store from the S3 bucket. Apply tags and indexes.

contents.en: Ingest data into SageMaker Feature Store from the S3 bucket. Apply tags and indexes.
contents.zh: 将S3存储桶中的数据导入SageMaker特征存储，为数据添加标签和索引

options.label: B
options.content: Use Amazon Athena. Create tables by using CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS) queries to group data.

contents.en: Use Amazon Athena. Create tables by using CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS) queries to group data.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊Athena，通过CREATE TABLE AS SELECT（CTAS）查询创建表以对数据进行分组

options.label: C
options.content: Use AWS Lake Formation. Apply tag-based control on the data.

contents.en: Use AWS Lake Formation. Apply tag-based control on the data.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Lake Formation，对数据实施基于标签的访问控制

options.label: D
options.content: Use the Generate Data Insights function in SageMaker Data Wrangler.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Feature Store 是专为 ML 特征设计的存储库，包含用于批量训练的离线存储和用于实时推理的低延迟在线存储，写入特征组的特征会同步到两个存储中，从而保持一致。把 S3 中的评分数据导入并添加标签和索引后，特征在训练和推理中都可被发现且保持同步。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Athena CTAS 查询创建的是用于分析的静态表，无法为实时端点提供同步的低延迟特征。
  • C: AWS Lake Formation 管理数据湖权限和基于标签的访问控制，不是用于训练和推理的特征存储库。
  • D: Data Wrangler 的生成数据洞察功能只产出一次性的数据质量报告，不会为推理存储任何数据。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Feature Store 是专为 ML 特征设计的存储库，包含用于批量训练的离线存储和用于实时推理的低延迟在线存储，写入特征组的特征会同步到两个存储中，从而保持一致。把 S3 中的评分数据导入并添加标签和索引后，特征在训练和推理中都可被发现且保持同步。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Athena CTAS 查询创建的是用于分析的静态表，无法为实时端点提供同步的低延迟特征。
  • C: AWS Lake Formation 管理数据湖权限和基于标签的访问控制，不是用于训练和推理的特征存储库。
  • D: Data Wrangler 的生成数据洞察功能只产出一次性的数据质量报告，不会为推理存储任何数据。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker Feature Store is a purpose-built repository for ML features with an offline store for batch training and a low-latency online store for real-time inference, and features written to a feature group are replicated to both stores so they stay synchronized. Ingesting the ratings from S3 and adding tags and indexes makes the features discoverable and consistent across training and inference.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Athena CTAS queries create static tables for analytics and cannot serve synchronized low-latency features to a real-time endpoint.
  • C: AWS Lake Formation manages data lake permissions and tag-based access control; it is not a feature repository for training and inference.
  • D: The Data Wrangler Generate Data Insights function produces a one-time data quality report and stores nothing for inference.

contents.en: A music streaming company constantly streams song ratings from an application to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use the ratings as an input for training and inference of an Amazon SageMaker AI model. options.label: B
options.content: Create an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the metrics for processing steps in the nightly batch inference job. Compare the baseline resource metrics. Share the dashboard link.

contents.en: Create an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the metrics for processing steps in the nightly batch inference job. Compare the baseline resource metrics. Share the dashboard link.

options.label: C
options.content: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to create a custom recipe job that uses the Numerical Statistics data quality check for the model file. Generate the results.

contents.en: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to create a custom recipe job that uses the Numerical Statistics data quality check for the model file. Generate the results.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Model Monitor 既支持监控端点，也支持为批量转换任务调度监控作业，对捕获的推理数据执行数据质量和模型质量分析，并生成违规报告和指标。在每晚的批处理之后调度每日监控作业，即可得到所需的数据质量与模型性能日报。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 包含处理步骤和资源指标的 CloudWatch 仪表板只反映任务健康状况，不能反映输入数据的统计质量或预测准确性。
  • C: AWS Glue DataBrew 用于对数据集做画像，对模型文件运行数值统计检查并不能衡量模型性能。
  • D: SageMaker Pipelines 中的 QualityCheck 步骤在构建管道中计算基线和执行漂移检查，不是对每晚推理输出进行周期性监控报告的机制。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Model Monitor 既支持监控端点，也支持为批量转换任务调度监控作业，对捕获的推理数据执行数据质量和模型质量分析，并生成违规报告和指标。在每晚的批处理之后调度每日监控作业，即可得到所需的数据质量与模型性能日报。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 包含处理步骤和资源指标的 CloudWatch 仪表板只反映任务健康状况，不能反映输入数据的统计质量或预测准确性。
  • C: AWS Glue DataBrew 用于对数据集做画像，对模型文件运行数值统计检查并不能衡量模型性能。
  • D: SageMaker Pipelines 中的 QualityCheck 步骤在构建管道中计算基线和执行漂移检查，不是对每晚推理输出进行周期性监控报告的机制。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker Model Monitor supports scheduled monitoring jobs for batch transform jobs as well as endpoints, running data quality and model quality analyses against captured inference data and producing violation reports and metrics. Scheduling a daily monitoring job after the nightly batch run delivers the required daily report on data quality and model performance.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: A CloudWatch dashboard of processing-step and resource metrics shows job health, not the statistical quality of the input data or the accuracy of the predictions.
  • C: AWS Glue DataBrew profiles datasets; running a numerical statistics check on the model file does not measure model performance.
  • D: The QualityCheck step in SageMaker Pipelines computes baselines and drift checks as part of a build pipeline and is not the mechanism for recurring monitoring reports on nightly inference output.

The ingested data must always be up to date with the latest changes in the source systems. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use direct connections to import data from the data sources into Data Wrangler.

contents.en: Use direct connections to import data from the data sources into Data Wrangler.
contents.zh: 使用直接连接，将数据从数据源导入Data Wrangler

options.label: B
options.content: Use cataloged connections to import data from the data sources into Data Wrangler.

contents.en: Use cataloged connections to import data from the data sources into Data Wrangler.
contents.zh: 使用编目连接，将数据从数据源导入Data Wrangler

options.label: C
options.content: Use AWS Glue to extract data from the data sources. Use AWS Glue also to import the data directly into Data Wrangler.

contents.en: Use AWS Glue to extract data from the data sources. Use AWS Glue also to import the data directly into Data Wrangler.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Glue从数据源提取数据，并直接将数据导入Data Wrangler

options.label: D
options.content: Use AWS Lambda to extract data from the data sources. Use Lambda also to import the data directly into Data Wrangler.

contents.en: Use AWS Lambda to extract data from the data sources. Use Lambda also to import the data directly into Data Wrangler.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Lambda从数据源提取数据，并直接将数据导入Data Wrangler

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：编目连接把 Amazon S3、Amazon Redshift 和 Snowflake 数据源注册到 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中，Data Wrangler 每次运行流程时都会直接查询源系统，因此始终使用最新数据。而直接导入只是拉取某一时刻的副本，随着源数据变化会过时。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 直接连接在导入时获取的是数据快照，流程无法反映源系统之后的变更。
  • C: AWS Glue 可以抽取和转换数据，但无法把数据直接推送进 Data Wrangler，后者只能自行从受支持的数据源读取。
  • D: AWS Lambda 没有向 Data Wrangler 加载数据的集成，需要自写代码实现编目连接原生就能完成的事情。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：编目连接把 Amazon S3、Amazon Redshift 和 Snowflake 数据源注册到 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中，Data Wrangler 每次运行流程时都会直接查询源系统，因此始终使用最新数据。而直接导入只是拉取某一时刻的副本，随着源数据变化会过时。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 直接连接在导入时获取的是数据快照，流程无法反映源系统之后的变更。
  • C: AWS Glue 可以抽取和转换数据，但无法把数据直接推送进 Data Wrangler，后者只能自行从受支持的数据源读取。
  • D: AWS Lambda 没有向 Data Wrangler 加载数据的集成，需要自写代码实现编目连接原生就能完成的事情。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Cataloged connections register the Amazon S3, Amazon Redshift, and Snowflake sources through the AWS Glue Data Catalog, so Data Wrangler queries the source system each time the flow runs and always works with the latest data. A direct import instead pulls a point-in-time copy that goes stale as the sources change.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A direct connection imports a snapshot of the data at import time, so the flow does not reflect later changes in the source systems.
  • C: AWS Glue can extract and transform data, but it cannot push data directly into Data Wrangler, which reads from its supported sources itself.
  • D: AWS Lambda has no integration to load data into Data Wrangler and would require custom code for what a cataloged connection handles natively.

options.label: A
options.content: Accuracy

contents.en: Accuracy
contents.zh: 准确率（Accuracy）

options.label: B
options.content: InferenceLatency

contents.en: InferenceLatency
contents.zh: 推理延迟（InferenceLatency）

options.label: C
options.content: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC)

contents.en: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC)
contents.zh: 受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）

options.label: D
options.content: Root mean square error (RMSE)

contents.en: Root mean square error (RMSE)
contents.zh: 均方根误差（RMSE）

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：预测连续数值属于回归问题，均方根误差（RMSE）以目标变量自身的单位衡量预测值与真实值之间差异的平均幅度。SageMaker Canvas 会为数值预测模型报告 RMSE，因此它是评估该模型的正确指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 准确率统计的是类别标签预测的对错，不适用于连续预测。
  • B: InferenceLatency 衡量模型响应耗时，不反映预测质量。
  • C: AUC 评估二分类器区分正负类的能力，对回归问题没有定义。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：预测连续数值属于回归问题，均方根误差（RMSE）以目标变量自身的单位衡量预测值与真实值之间差异的平均幅度。SageMaker Canvas 会为数值预测模型报告 RMSE，因此它是评估该模型的正确指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 准确率统计的是类别标签预测的对错，不适用于连续预测。
  • B: InferenceLatency 衡量模型响应耗时，不反映预测质量。
  • C: AUC 评估二分类器区分正负类的能力，对回归问题没有定义。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Predicting a continuous numeric value is a regression problem, and root mean square error (RMSE) measures the average magnitude of the difference between predicted and actual values in the target's own units. SageMaker Canvas reports RMSE for numeric prediction models, so it is the right metric to judge this model.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Accuracy counts correct versus incorrect class labels and does not apply to continuous predictions.
  • B: InferenceLatency measures how long the model takes to respond and says nothing about prediction quality.
  • C: AUC evaluates how well a binary classifier separates positive and negative classes and is not defined for regression.

questions.content:
A company has built, trained, and tuned two new ML models:

  • Model A detects if a transaction is fraudulent based on the IP address, location, and user credentials. This model

will be accessed every time a transaction occurs.

  • Model B forecasts sales totals for the next month based on historical sales data. This model will be accessed one

time each month. The company must deploy both models to production by using Amazon SageMaker AI. Which hosting solution for the models should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Host both models in one container behind one real-time endpoint.

contents.en: Host both models in one container behind one real-time endpoint.
contents.zh: 将两个模型部署在同一个容器中，共用一个实时端点

options.label: B
options.content: Host Model A with an asynchronous endpoint. Host Model B with a real-time endpoint.

contents.en: Host Model A with an asynchronous endpoint. Host Model B with a real-time endpoint.
contents.zh: 为模型A配置异步端点，为模型B配置实时端点

options.label: C
options.content: Host Model A with a real-time endpoint. Use batch transform for Model B

contents.en: Host Model A with a real-time endpoint. Use batch transform for Model B
contents.zh: 为模型A配置实时端点，为模型B使用批量转换功能

options.label: D
options.content: Use batch transform for Model A Host Model B with an asynchronous endpoint.

contents.en: Use batch transform for Model A Host Model B with an asynchronous endpoint.
contents.zh: 为模型A使用批量转换功能，为模型B配置异步端点

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：模型 A 必须在每次交易发生时同步返回欺诈判定，正是 SageMaker 实时端点提供的低延迟、始终可用的模式。模型 B 每月只基于历史数据运行一次，用批量转换任务在运行时临时启动计算并在完成后释放，是合适且经济的选择。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 把两个模型放在同一个实时端点后面会让每月才用一次的预测模型全天候运行，并把两个无关的工作负载耦合在一起。
  • B: 异步推理会把请求排队并稍后返回结果，不适合逐笔交易的欺诈检测，而为每月一次的预测保留实时端点会浪费闲置成本。
  • D: 批量转换无法实时响应单笔交易，而每月运行一次的任务也不需要异步端点。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：模型 A 必须在每次交易发生时同步返回欺诈判定，正是 SageMaker 实时端点提供的低延迟、始终可用的模式。模型 B 每月只基于历史数据运行一次，用批量转换任务在运行时临时启动计算并在完成后释放，是合适且经济的选择。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 把两个模型放在同一个实时端点后面会让每月才用一次的预测模型全天候运行，并把两个无关的工作负载耦合在一起。
  • B: 异步推理会把请求排队并稍后返回结果，不适合逐笔交易的欺诈检测，而为每月一次的预测保留实时端点会浪费闲置成本。
  • D: 批量转换无法实时响应单笔交易，而每月运行一次的任务也不需要异步端点。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Model A must return a fraud decision synchronously every time a transaction occurs, which is exactly the low-latency, always-available pattern a SageMaker real-time endpoint provides. Model B runs once a month on a set of historical data, so a batch transform job that spins up compute only for that run and then shuts down is the appropriate and economical choice.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Packing both models behind one real-time endpoint keeps the monthly forecast model running around the clock and couples two unrelated workloads.
  • B: Asynchronous inference queues requests and returns results later, which is unsuitable for per-transaction fraud checks, and a real-time endpoint wastes money idling for a once-a-month forecast.
  • D: Batch transform cannot respond to individual transactions in real time, and an asynchronous endpoint is unnecessary for a job that runs once a month.

contents.en:
A company has built, trained, and tuned two new ML models:

  • Model A detects if a transaction is fraudulent based on the IP address, location, and user credentials. This model

will be accessed every time a transaction occurs.

questions.content: A bank needs to use Amazon SageMaker AI to create an ML model to determine which customers qualify for a new product. The bank must use algorithms that SageMaker AI directly supports. The model must be explainable to the bank’s regulators. Which modeling approach will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Train the model by using the Object2Vec algorithm.

contents.en: Train the model by using the Object2Vec algorithm.
contents.zh: 使用Object2Vec算法训练模型

options.label: B
options.content: Train the model by using the linear learner algorithm.

contents.en: Train the model by using the linear learner algorithm.
contents.zh: 使用线性学习器算法训练模型

options.label: C
options.content: Train a neural network.

contents.en: Train a neural network.
contents.zh: 训练一个神经网络模型

options.label: D
options.content: Train the model by using the k-means algorithm.

contents.en: Train the model by using the k-means algorithm.
contents.zh: 使用K均值算法训练模型

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker 内置的 linear learner 算法训练线性回归或逻辑回归模型，其系数直接反映每个特征对资格判定的贡献。这使模型天然可解释、便于向监管机构说明，同时使用的是 SageMaker AI 原生支持的算法。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Object2Vec 学习的是成对对象的稠密嵌入向量，无法用业务特征向监管机构解释。
  • C: 神经网络是黑盒模型，决策难以归因到单个输入，不满足可解释性要求。
  • D: K-means 是无监督聚类算法，无法从带标签的样本中学习哪些客户符合资格。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker 内置的 linear learner 算法训练线性回归或逻辑回归模型，其系数直接反映每个特征对资格判定的贡献。这使模型天然可解释、便于向监管机构说明，同时使用的是 SageMaker AI 原生支持的算法。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Object2Vec 学习的是成对对象的稠密嵌入向量，无法用业务特征向监管机构解释。
  • C: 神经网络是黑盒模型，决策难以归因到单个输入，不满足可解释性要求。
  • D: K-means 是无监督聚类算法，无法从带标签的样本中学习哪些客户符合资格。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: The SageMaker built-in linear learner algorithm trains linear or logistic regression models whose coefficients directly show how each feature contributes to the qualification decision. That makes the model inherently interpretable for regulators while using an algorithm SageMaker AI supports natively.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Object2Vec learns dense embeddings for pairs of objects, and embedding vectors cannot be explained to regulators in terms of business features.
  • C: A neural network is a black-box model whose decisions are hard to attribute to individual inputs, which does not meet the explainability requirement.
  • D: K-means is an unsupervised clustering algorithm and cannot learn from labeled examples which customers qualify.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Model Monitor to create data quality rules. Use SageMaker Clarify to detect bias.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Data Wrangler 提供内置转换来删除重复项和处理缺失值，其 Data Quality and Insights 报告可以为从未用于训练的数据集定义数据质量检查。SageMaker Clarify 则负责在准备好的数据集上计算类别不平衡等训练前偏差指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Clarify 用于检测偏差和解释预测，不能创建数据质量规则；SageMaker Model Monitor 监控的是已部署的端点，而不是全新的训练数据集。
  • C: SageMaker Debugger 检查的是训练作业运行中的张量和系统指标，而不是原始输入数据的质量。
  • D: SageMaker Model Monitor 需要已部署的模型和捕获的推理数据才能运行数据质量检查，不适用于尚未用于训练的数据。

explanations.zh:

为什么其他选项错误：

explanations.en:
Correct answer B: SageMaker Data Wrangler provides built-in transforms to drop duplicates and handle missing values, and its Data Quality and Insights report lets you define data quality checks on a dataset that has never been used for training. SageMaker Clarify is the service that computes pre-training bias metrics such as class imbalance on the prepared dataset.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SageMaker Clarify detects bias and explains predictions but does not create data quality rules, and SageMaker Model Monitor monitors deployed endpoints rather than a brand-new training dataset.
  • C: SageMaker Debugger inspects tensors and system metrics of running training jobs, not the quality of raw input data.
  • D: SageMaker Model Monitor requires a deployed model and captured inference data to run data quality checks, so it does not apply to data that has not yet been used for training.

questions.content: An ML engineer is building a model to predict house and apartment prices. The model uses three features: Square Meters, Price, and Age of Building. The dataset has 10,000 data rows. The data includes data points for one large mansion and one extremely small apartment. The ML engineer must perform preprocessing on the dataset to ensure that the model produces accurate predictions for the typical house or apartment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Remove the outliers and perform a log transformation on the Square Meters variable.

contents.en: Remove the outliers and perform a log transformation on the Square Meters variable.
contents.zh: 移除异常值，并对建筑面积变量执行对数变换

options.label: B
options.content: Keep the outliers and perform normalization on the Square Meters variable.

contents.en: Keep the outliers and perform normalization on the Square Meters variable.
contents.zh: 保留异常值，并对建筑面积变量执行归一化处理

options.label: C
options.content: Remove the outliers and perform one-hot encoding on the Square Meters variable.

contents.en: Remove the outliers and perform one-hot encoding on the Square Meters variable.
contents.zh: 移除异常值，并对建筑面积变量执行独热编码

options.label: D
options.content: Keep the outliers and perform one-hot encoding on the Square Meters variable.

contents.en: Keep the outliers and perform one-hot encoding on the Square Meters variable.
contents.zh: 保留异常值，并对建筑面积变量执行独热编码

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：那栋豪宅和那套极小公寓是异常值，会把回归拉向非典型房产，移除它们可以让模型专注于普通住宅或公寓。建筑面积是右偏的连续变量，对数变换可以压缩其取值范围，使剩余的较大值不会主导拟合。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 保留异常值并做最小-最大归一化时，极端值决定了取值范围，会把所有普通值挤压到很窄的区间内。
  • C: 独热编码适用于类别变量，对连续的建筑面积做独热编码会产生成千上万个二元列。
  • D: 保留异常值会让偏态问题继续存在，且独热编码不适用于数值特征。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：那栋豪宅和那套极小公寓是异常值，会把回归拉向非典型房产，移除它们可以让模型专注于普通住宅或公寓。建筑面积是右偏的连续变量，对数变换可以压缩其取值范围，使剩余的较大值不会主导拟合。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 保留异常值并做最小-最大归一化时，极端值决定了取值范围，会把所有普通值挤压到很窄的区间内。
  • C: 独热编码适用于类别变量，对连续的建筑面积做独热编码会产生成千上万个二元列。
  • D: 保留异常值会让偏态问题继续存在，且独热编码不适用于数值特征。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: The single mansion and the extremely small apartment are outliers that would pull the regression toward atypical properties, so removing them keeps the model focused on the typical house or apartment. Square Meters is a right-skewed continuous variable, and a log transformation compresses its range so that the remaining large values do not dominate the fit.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Keeping the outliers and applying min-max normalization squeezes all typical values into a narrow band because the extreme values define the range.
  • C: One-hot encoding is for categorical variables and would turn a continuous Square Meters value into thousands of binary columns.
  • D: Keeping the outliers leaves the skew in place, and one-hot encoding is not applicable to a numeric feature.
