options.label: A
options.content: Capture AWS CloudTrail metrics from SageMaker Clarify.

contents.en: Capture AWS CloudTrail metrics from SageMaker Clarify.
contents.zh: 从SageMaker Clarify捕获AWS CloudTrail指标

options.label: B
options.content: Capture Amazon CloudWatch metrics from SageMaker Clarify.

contents.en: Capture Amazon CloudWatch metrics from SageMaker Clarify.
contents.zh: 从SageMaker Clarify捕获亚马逊CloudWatch指标

options.label: C
options.content: Capture SageMaker Model Monitor metrics from Amazon EventBridge.

contents.en: Capture SageMaker Model Monitor metrics from Amazon EventBridge.
contents.zh: 从亚马逊EventBridge捕获SageMaker Model Monitor指标

options.label: D
options.content: Capture SageMaker Model Monitor metrics from Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).

contents.en: Capture SageMaker Model Monitor metrics from Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).
contents.zh: 从亚马逊简单通知服务（SNS）捕获SageMaker Model Monitor指标

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Clarify 偏差监控任务通过 SageMaker Model Monitor 运行，并将每个偏差指标发布到 Amazon CloudWatch 的 aws/sagemaker/Endpoints/bias-metrics 命名空间。CloudWatch 指标可以直接在 CloudWatch 仪表板上绘制，这是可视化偏差漂移的受支持方式。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS CloudTrail 记录用于审计的 API 调用，并不包含偏差指标数值。
  • C: Amazon EventBridge 传递的是监控任务状态变化等事件，而不是仪表板所需的数值型偏差指标。
  • D: Amazon SNS 向订阅者发送通知，并不是指标的来源。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Clarify 偏差监控任务通过 SageMaker Model Monitor 运行，并将每个偏差指标发布到 Amazon CloudWatch 的 aws/sagemaker/Endpoints/bias-metrics 命名空间。CloudWatch 指标可以直接在 CloudWatch 仪表板上绘制，这是可视化偏差漂移的受支持方式。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: AWS CloudTrail 记录用于审计的 API 调用，并不包含偏差指标数值。
  • C: Amazon EventBridge 传递的是监控任务状态变化等事件，而不是仪表板所需的数值型偏差指标。
  • D: Amazon SNS 向订阅者发送通知，并不是指标的来源。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: A SageMaker Clarify bias monitoring job runs through SageMaker Model Monitor and publishes each bias metric to Amazon CloudWatch in the aws/sagemaker/Endpoints/bias-metrics namespace. CloudWatch metrics can be graphed directly on a CloudWatch dashboard, which is the supported way to visualize bias drift.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: AWS CloudTrail records API calls for auditing and does not carry bias metric values.
  • C: Amazon EventBridge delivers events such as monitoring job status changes, not the numeric bias metrics needed for a dashboard.
  • D: Amazon SNS delivers notifications to subscribers and is not a source of metrics.

questions.content: A company is using an Amazon SageMaker AI ML model to predict traffic accidents that potholes cause. An ML engineer has configured SageMaker Model Monitor to run as part of a SageMaker AI pipeline. In the MonitoringExecution output, the ML engineer observes several baseline_drift_check violations that are failing the pipeline. What should the ML engineer do to resolve this issue?

options.label: A
options.content: Retrain the model by using a new SageMaker AI training job. Check for errors by using SageMaker Debugger.

contents.en: Retrain the model by using a new SageMaker AI training job. Check for errors by using SageMaker Debugger.
contents.zh: 通过新的SageMaker AI训练任务重新训练模型，使用SageMaker Debugger检查错误

options.label: B
options.content: Retrain the model with new training data. Reuse the original baseline in Model Monitor.

contents.en: Retrain the model with new training data. Reuse the original baseline in Model Monitor.
contents.zh: 使用新的训练数据重新训练模型，在Model Monitor中复用原始基线

options.label: C
options.content: Retrain the model with new training data. Use the new baseline in Model Monitor.

contents.en: Retrain the model with new training data. Use the new baseline in Model Monitor.
contents.zh: 使用新的训练数据重新训练模型，在Model Monitor中使用新的基线

options.label: D
options.content: Rerun the SageMaker AI pipeline after enabling the emit_metrics option in the baseline constraints file.

contents.en: Rerun the SageMaker AI pipeline after enabling the emit_metrics option in the baseline constraints file.
contents.zh: 在基线约束文件中启用emit_metrics选项后，重新运行SageMaker AI管道

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：baseline_drift_check 违规意味着实时数据分布已经不再符合创建基线时捕获的统计信息和约束。使用当前数据重新训练并运行新的基线作业，可以让 Model Monitor 用反映当前数据的约束来比较生产流量，从而清除导致管道失败的违规。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Debugger 用于诊断训练作业内部的问题，不会更新产生漂移违规的 Model Monitor 基线。
  • B: 复用原始基线会继续用过时的约束比较新数据，漂移违规仍会持续出现。
  • D: emit_metrics 设置只控制 Model Monitor 是否发布 CloudWatch 指标，对漂移检查是否通过没有影响。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：baseline_drift_check 违规意味着实时数据分布已经不再符合创建基线时捕获的统计信息和约束。使用当前数据重新训练并运行新的基线作业，可以让 Model Monitor 用反映当前数据的约束来比较生产流量，从而清除导致管道失败的违规。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: SageMaker Debugger 用于诊断训练作业内部的问题，不会更新产生漂移违规的 Model Monitor 基线。
  • B: 复用原始基线会继续用过时的约束比较新数据，漂移违规仍会持续出现。
  • D: emit_metrics 设置只控制 Model Monitor 是否发布 CloudWatch 指标，对漂移检查是否通过没有影响。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: A baseline_drift_check violation means the live data distribution no longer matches the statistics and constraints captured when the baseline was created. Retraining on current data and running a new baseline job makes Model Monitor compare production traffic against constraints that reflect today's data, which clears the violations that fail the pipeline.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: SageMaker Debugger diagnoses problems inside a training job and does not update the Model Monitor baseline that produces the drift violations.
  • B: Reusing the original baseline keeps comparing new data against stale constraints, so the drift violations continue.
  • D: The emit_metrics setting controls whether Model Monitor publishes CloudWatch metrics and has no effect on whether drift checks pass.

questions.content: A company uses ML models to predict whether transactions are fraudulent. The company needs to identify as many fraudulent transactions as possible. Which evaluation metric should the company use to evaluate the models to meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: F1 score

contents.en: F1 score
contents.zh: F1分数

options.label: B
options.content: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC)

contents.en: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC)
contents.zh: 受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）

options.label: C
options.content: Precision

contents.en: Precision
contents.zh: 精确率

options.label: D
options.content: Recall

contents.en: Recall
contents.zh: 召回率

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：召回率衡量的是模型正确标记出的真实欺诈交易所占的比例，最大化召回率可以直接减少漏报（假阴性）。当核心需求是尽可能多地识别欺诈交易时，召回率就是应优化的指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: F1 分数同等权衡精确率和召回率，会惩罚公司为了多抓欺诈而愿意接受的额外误报。
  • B: AUC 概括的是所有阈值下的排序质量，并不针对实际运行阈值下抓到的欺诈数量。
  • C: 精确率衡量被标记交易中真正欺诈的比例，无法反映漏掉了多少欺诈案例。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：召回率衡量的是模型正确标记出的真实欺诈交易所占的比例，最大化召回率可以直接减少漏报（假阴性）。当核心需求是尽可能多地识别欺诈交易时，召回率就是应优化的指标。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: F1 分数同等权衡精确率和召回率，会惩罚公司为了多抓欺诈而愿意接受的额外误报。
  • B: AUC 概括的是所有阈值下的排序质量，并不针对实际运行阈值下抓到的欺诈数量。
  • C: 精确率衡量被标记交易中真正欺诈的比例，无法反映漏掉了多少欺诈案例。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Recall measures the share of actual fraudulent transactions that the model correctly flags, so maximizing recall directly minimizes missed fraud (false negatives). When the deciding requirement is to identify as many fraudulent transactions as possible, recall is the metric to optimize.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: F1 score balances precision and recall equally, so it penalizes the extra false positives the company is willing to accept in order to catch more fraud.
  • B: AUC summarizes ranking quality across all thresholds and does not target the number of fraud cases caught at the operating point.
  • C: Precision measures how many flagged transactions are truly fraudulent and says nothing about how many fraud cases were missed.

questions.content: A recommendation model uses ML and calls an Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint to get recommendations. An ML engineer must ensure that the model stays available during an expected increase in user traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure auto scaling on the SageMaker AI endpoint.

contents.en: Configure auto scaling on the SageMaker AI endpoint.
contents.zh: 为SageMaker AI端点配置自动扩缩容

options.label: B
options.content: Create a new SageMaker AI endpoint. Deploy the model to the new endpoint.

contents.en: Create a new SageMaker AI endpoint. Deploy the model to the new endpoint.
contents.zh: 创建一个新的SageMaker AI端点，将模型部署到该新端点

options.label: C
options.content: Use SageMaker Neo to optimize the model for inference.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Neo to optimize the model for inference.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Neo优化模型，提升推理性能

options.label: D
options.content: Attach an Auto Scaling group to the SageMaker AI endpoint.

contents.en: Attach an Auto Scaling group to the SageMaker AI endpoint.
contents.zh: 为SageMaker AI端点关联一个自动扩缩组

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker AI 端点与 Application Auto Scaling 集成，基于 InvocationsPerInstance 指标的目标跟踪策略会随着流量增长自动增加实例，在预期的流量高峰期间保持推荐模型可用。这是为现有端点增加容量的原生托管方式。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 部署同一模型的第二个端点不会随需求增长，还要求应用程序自行拆分流量。
  • C: SageMaker Neo 针对目标硬件编译模型以加快推理速度，但不会增加处理更多并发请求的容量。
  • D: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组无法关联到 SageMaker AI 端点，端点的扩缩容需要通过 Application Auto Scaling 配置。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker AI 端点与 Application Auto Scaling 集成，基于 InvocationsPerInstance 指标的目标跟踪策略会随着流量增长自动增加实例，在预期的流量高峰期间保持推荐模型可用。这是为现有端点增加容量的原生托管方式。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 部署同一模型的第二个端点不会随需求增长，还要求应用程序自行拆分流量。
  • C: SageMaker Neo 针对目标硬件编译模型以加快推理速度，但不会增加处理更多并发请求的容量。
  • D: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组无法关联到 SageMaker AI 端点，端点的扩缩容需要通过 Application Auto Scaling 配置。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker AI endpoints integrate with Application Auto Scaling, so a target tracking policy on the InvocationsPerInstance metric adds instances as traffic grows and keeps the recommendation model available during the expected surge. This is the native, managed way to add capacity to an existing endpoint.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: A second endpoint with the same model does not grow with demand and forces the application to split traffic itself.
  • C: SageMaker Neo compiles a model for faster inference on a target hardware platform but does not add capacity to absorb more concurrent requests.
  • D: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups cannot be attached to a SageMaker AI endpoint; endpoint scaling is configured through Application Auto Scaling.

questions.content: An ML engineer has trained an ML model by using Amazon SageMaker AI. The ML engineer determines that the model is overfitting and that the training data contains unnecessary features. The ML engineer must reduce the overfitting and the impact of the unnecessary features. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Increase the number of training iterations. Retrain the model.

contents.en: Increase the number of training iterations. Retrain the model.
contents.zh: 增加训练迭代次数，重新训练模型

options.label: B
options.content: Apply L1 regularization to the training data. Retrain the model.

contents.en: Apply L1 regularization to the training data. Retrain the model.
contents.zh: 对训练数据应用L1正则化，重新训练模型

options.label: C
options.content: Decrease the number of training iterations. Retrain the model.

contents.en: Decrease the number of training iterations. Retrain the model.
contents.zh: 减少训练迭代次数，重新训练模型

options.label: D
options.content: Use SageMaker Debugger to apply L1 regularization to the running model.

contents.en: Use SageMaker Debugger to apply L1 regularization to the running model.
contents.zh: 使用SageMaker Debugger对运行中的模型应用L1正则化

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：L1（Lasso）正则化会添加与权重绝对值成比例的惩罚项，把无用特征的系数压缩为恰好为零。使用 L1 正则化重新训练可以在约束模型复杂度的同时完成内置的特征选择，从而既减轻过拟合又消除无关特征的影响。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 增加训练迭代次数会让模型更贴合训练数据，通常会加重过拟合。
  • C: 减少迭代次数或许能提前停止训练，但所有无用特征仍会以非零权重留在模型中。
  • D: SageMaker Debugger 只在训练期间观察张量和资源指标，无法改变正在运行的模型的目标函数。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：L1（Lasso）正则化会添加与权重绝对值成比例的惩罚项，把无用特征的系数压缩为恰好为零。使用 L1 正则化重新训练可以在约束模型复杂度的同时完成内置的特征选择，从而既减轻过拟合又消除无关特征的影响。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 增加训练迭代次数会让模型更贴合训练数据，通常会加重过拟合。
  • C: 减少迭代次数或许能提前停止训练，但所有无用特征仍会以非零权重留在模型中。
  • D: SageMaker Debugger 只在训练期间观察张量和资源指标，无法改变正在运行的模型的目标函数。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: L1 (Lasso) regularization adds a penalty proportional to the absolute value of the weights, which shrinks the coefficients of unnecessary features to exactly zero. Retraining with L1 regularization therefore performs built-in feature selection while constraining model complexity, which reduces overfitting and removes the impact of the irrelevant features at the same time.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: More training iterations let the model fit the training data even more closely and typically increase overfitting.
  • C: Fewer iterations may stop training earlier, but it leaves every unnecessary feature in the model with nonzero influence.
  • D: SageMaker Debugger observes tensors and resource metrics during training; it cannot change the objective function of a model that is already running.

questions.content: An ML engineer wants to use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to perform preprocessing on a dataset. The ML engineer wants to use the processed dataset to train a classification model. During preprocessing, the ML engineer notices that a text feature has a range of thousands of values that differ only by spelling errors. The ML engineer needs to apply an encoding method so that after preprocessing is complete, the text feature can be used to train the model. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Perform ordinal encoding to represent categories of the feature.

contents.en: Perform ordinal encoding to represent categories of the feature.
contents.zh: 执行序数编码，表示该特征的类别

options.label: B
options.content: Perform similarity encoding to represent categories of the feature.

contents.en: Perform similarity encoding to represent categories of the feature.
contents.zh: 执行相似度编码，表示该特征的类别

options.label: C
options.content: Perform one-hot encoding to represent categories of the feature.

contents.en: Perform one-hot encoding to represent categories of the feature.
contents.zh: 执行独热编码，表示该特征的类别

options.label: D
options.content: Perform target encoding to represent categories of the feature.

contents.en: Perform target encoding to represent categories of the feature.
contents.zh: 执行目标编码，表示该特征的类别

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Data Wrangler 的相似度编码专门用于处理高基数且含脏数据（如拼写差异）的类别列。它比较每个字符串的字符 n-gram，把几乎相同的取值映射为几乎相同的编码，从而将数千个拼写变体折叠成紧凑、可用于分类模型训练的表示。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 序数编码给每个不同字符串分配任意整数，每个拼写错误都会成为独立取值，并带来毫无意义的隐含顺序。
  • C: 独热编码会为每个拼写变体创建一列，产生数千个彼此无关的稀疏列。
  • D: 目标编码把每个拼写错误当作独立类别并计算各自的目标统计量，噪声依旧保留，还存在目标泄漏风险。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Data Wrangler 的相似度编码专门用于处理高基数且含脏数据（如拼写差异）的类别列。它比较每个字符串的字符 n-gram，把几乎相同的取值映射为几乎相同的编码，从而将数千个拼写变体折叠成紧凑、可用于分类模型训练的表示。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 序数编码给每个不同字符串分配任意整数，每个拼写错误都会成为独立取值，并带来毫无意义的隐含顺序。
  • C: 独热编码会为每个拼写变体创建一列，产生数千个彼此无关的稀疏列。
  • D: 目标编码把每个拼写错误当作独立类别并计算各自的目标统计量，噪声依旧保留，还存在目标泄漏风险。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Similarity encoding in SageMaker Data Wrangler is designed for categorical columns with very high cardinality and dirty values such as spelling variations. It compares the character n-grams of each string and maps near-identical values to nearly identical encodings, so the thousands of misspelled variants collapse into a compact, usable representation for the classification model.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Ordinal encoding assigns an arbitrary integer to every distinct string, so each misspelling becomes a separate value with a meaningless implied order.
  • C: One-hot encoding would create thousands of sparse columns, one per misspelled variant, with no relationship between them.
  • D: Target encoding treats each misspelling as an independent category with its own target statistic, which keeps the noise and risks target leakage.

questions.content: An ML engineer is training a text generation model on Amazon SageMaker AI. After several epochs, the loss function does not converge, and the model’s accuracy on the validation dataset starts to show oscillating results. The ML engineer needs to ensure that the model achieves generalization. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Increase the learning rate and decrease the mini-batch size.

contents.en: Increase the learning rate and decrease the mini-batch size.
contents.zh: 提高学习率，减小小批量样本数量

options.label: B
options.content: Increase the learning rate as the number of epochs increases.

contents.en: Increase the learning rate as the number of epochs increases.
contents.zh: 随着训练周期增加，逐步提高学习率

options.label: C
options.content: Decrease the learning rate and increase the mini-batch size.

contents.en: Decrease the learning rate and increase the mini-batch size.
contents.zh: 降低学习率，增大小批量样本数量

options.label: D
options.content: Decrease the learning rate and decrease the mini-batch size.

contents.en: Decrease the learning rate and decrease the mini-batch size.
contents.zh: 降低学习率，减小小批量样本数量

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：损失不收敛且验证准确率震荡，说明每次更新步长过大且噪声过多。降低学习率可以缩小每一步的幅度，增大小批量规模则让每次梯度估计平均更多样本，两者结合可以稳定优化过程，使模型收敛到具备泛化能力的解。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 更高的学习率加上更小的批量会让更新更大、噪声更多，进一步加剧震荡。
  • B: 随训练进程提高学习率与标准的学习率衰减做法相反，会阻碍收敛。
  • D: 降低学习率有帮助，但缩小小批量会增大梯度方差，验证指标仍会不稳定。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：损失不收敛且验证准确率震荡，说明每次更新步长过大且噪声过多。降低学习率可以缩小每一步的幅度，增大小批量规模则让每次梯度估计平均更多样本，两者结合可以稳定优化过程，使模型收敛到具备泛化能力的解。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 更高的学习率加上更小的批量会让更新更大、噪声更多，进一步加剧震荡。
  • B: 随训练进程提高学习率与标准的学习率衰减做法相反，会阻碍收敛。
  • D: 降低学习率有帮助，但缩小小批量会增大梯度方差，验证指标仍会不稳定。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: A loss that fails to converge together with oscillating validation accuracy indicates that each update step is too large and too noisy. Decreasing the learning rate makes each step smaller, and increasing the mini-batch size averages more samples per gradient estimate, which together stabilize optimization and let the model converge to a solution that generalizes.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A higher learning rate with a smaller batch makes the updates even larger and noisier, worsening the oscillation.
  • B: Raising the learning rate as training proceeds is the opposite of standard learning rate decay and prevents convergence.
  • D: Lowering the learning rate helps, but shrinking the mini-batch increases gradient variance and keeps the validation metric unstable.

The company needs a hybrid system to make the shared data store accessible to on-premises servers and Amazon SageMaker AI notebooks that will consume the data. File locking is required for the data producers. Which AWS storage solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store the data. Use Mountpoint for Amazon S3 to mount the S3 bucket to the on- premises servers and the SageMaker AI notebooks.

options.label: B
options.content: Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to store the data. Mount the file system to the on- premises servers and the SageMaker AI notebooks.

contents.en: Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to store the data. Mount the file system to the on- premises servers and the SageMaker AI notebooks.
contents.zh: 使用亚马逊弹性文件系统（EFS）存储数据，将该文件系统挂载到本地服务器和SageMaker AI笔记本

options.label: C

contents.en: Use an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system to store the data. Mount the file system to the on-premises servers and the SageMaker AI notebooks.

options.label: D
options.content: Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume to store the data. Mount the volume to the on- premises servers and the SageMaker AI notebooks.

contents.en: Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume to store the data. Mount the volume to the on- premises servers and the SageMaker AI notebooks.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：Amazon EFS 是完全托管的 NFS 文件系统，支持 POSIX 文件锁定，可通过 AWS Direct Connect 或 VPN 挂载到本地 Linux 服务器，也可以挂载到同一 VPC 中的 SageMaker AI 笔记本和 Studio。它是唯一能在混合环境中提供带锁定功能的共享 NFS 存储的选项。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 以文件接口暴露对象存储，但不支持文件锁定和完整的 POSIX 语义。
  • C: Amazon FSx for Lustre 是面向计算密集型工作负载的高性能 Lustre 文件系统而非 NFS 共享，需要 Lustre 客户端，而不是现有 Linux 系统使用的 NFS 访问方式。
  • D: Amazon EBS 是挂载到单个可用区内 EC2 实例的块存储，无法被本地服务器挂载，也不能作为网络文件系统共享。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：Amazon EFS 是完全托管的 NFS 文件系统，支持 POSIX 文件锁定，可通过 AWS Direct Connect 或 VPN 挂载到本地 Linux 服务器，也可以挂载到同一 VPC 中的 SageMaker AI 笔记本和 Studio。它是唯一能在混合环境中提供带锁定功能的共享 NFS 存储的选项。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 以文件接口暴露对象存储，但不支持文件锁定和完整的 POSIX 语义。
  • C: Amazon FSx for Lustre 是面向计算密集型工作负载的高性能 Lustre 文件系统而非 NFS 共享，需要 Lustre 客户端，而不是现有 Linux 系统使用的 NFS 访问方式。
  • D: Amazon EBS 是挂载到单个可用区内 EC2 实例的块存储，无法被本地服务器挂载，也不能作为网络文件系统共享。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Amazon EFS is a fully managed NFS file system that supports POSIX file locking, can be mounted by on-premises Linux servers over AWS Direct Connect or VPN, and can be mounted by SageMaker AI notebooks and Studio in the same VPC. It is the only option that delivers a shared NFS store with locking across the hybrid environment.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 exposes object storage as a file interface but does not support file locking or full POSIX semantics.
  • C: Amazon FSx for Lustre is a high-performance Lustre file system for compute-intensive workloads rather than an NFS share, and it requires Lustre clients instead of the NFS access the existing Linux systems use.
  • D: Amazon EBS is block storage that attaches to EC2 instances in one Availability Zone and cannot be mounted by on-premises servers or shared as a network file system.

questions.content: A company needs to analyze a large dataset that is stored in Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format. The company wants to use one-hot encoding for some of the columns. The company needs a no-code solution to transform the data. The solution must store the transformed data back to the same S3 bucket for model training. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Configure an AWS Glue DataBrew project that connects to the data. Use the DataBrew interactive interface to create a recipe that performs the one-hot encoding transformation. Create a job to apply the transformation and to write the output back to an S3 bucket.

options.content: Configure an AWS Glue Data Catalog table that points to the data. Use Amazon Athena to write SQL commands to perform the one-hot encoding transformation. Configure Athena to write the query results back to an S3 bucket.

options.label: D

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：AWS Glue DataBrew 是可视化的无代码数据准备服务，可以直接读取 Amazon S3 中的 Parquet 数据，在交互式配方编辑器中提供内置的独热编码转换，并通过配方任务把转换结果写回 S3 存储桶。它满足无代码要求，同时把数据保留在同一存储桶中供模型训练使用。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Amazon Athena 需要编写 SQL 来表达独热编码，不是无代码方案。
  • C: AWS Glue 交互式笔记本需要在单元格中编写 PySpark 或 Python 代码。
  • D: Amazon Redshift Spectrum 需要预置集群并编写 SQL，既增加了代码又增加了基础设施。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：AWS Glue DataBrew 是可视化的无代码数据准备服务，可以直接读取 Amazon S3 中的 Parquet 数据，在交互式配方编辑器中提供内置的独热编码转换，并通过配方任务把转换结果写回 S3 存储桶。它满足无代码要求，同时把数据保留在同一存储桶中供模型训练使用。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Amazon Athena 需要编写 SQL 来表达独热编码，不是无代码方案。
  • C: AWS Glue 交互式笔记本需要在单元格中编写 PySpark 或 Python 代码。
  • D: Amazon Redshift Spectrum 需要预置集群并编写 SQL，既增加了代码又增加了基础设施。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: AWS Glue DataBrew is a visual, no-code data preparation service that reads Parquet data directly from Amazon S3, offers a built-in one-hot encoding transformation in its interactive recipe editor, and runs recipe jobs that write the transformed output back to an S3 bucket. It satisfies the no-code requirement while keeping the data in the same bucket for model training.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Amazon Athena requires writing SQL to express the one-hot encoding, so it is not a no-code solution.
  • C: An AWS Glue interactive notebook requires writing PySpark or Python code in cells.
  • D: Amazon Redshift Spectrum requires provisioning a cluster and writing SQL, adding both code and infrastructure.

explanations.zh:

  • A: 内置算法是预先封装好的实现，不接受自定义训练脚本。

questions.content: A company uses an Amazon QuickSight dashboard to track the sale prices of sneakers over time. The dashboard aggregates sale prices scraped from many retail websites. The company wants to determine which prices are unusually high outliers and to display the outliers visually. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use a vertical bar chart to visualize the outliers. Use a calculated field in QuickSight to take the square roots of the outlier prices to generate the chart. Configure a custom AWS Lambda function to scan the data for anomalies.

contents.en: Use a vertical bar chart to visualize the outliers. Use a calculated field in QuickSight to take the square roots of the outlier prices to generate the chart. Configure a custom AWS Lambda function to scan the data for anomalies.
contents.zh: 使用垂直柱状图可视化异常值，在QuickSight中创建计算字段，对异常价格取平方根后生成图表，配置自定义AWS Lambda函数扫描数据中的异常值

options.label: B
options.content: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to preprocess the data. Set the REMOVE_OUTLIERS operation to eliminate data rows that include unusually high prices. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to store the removed rows in Amazon DynamoDB.

contents.en: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to preprocess the data. Set the REMOVE_OUTLIERS operation to eliminate data rows that include unusually high prices. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to store the removed rows in Amazon DynamoDB.
contents.zh: 使用AWS Glue DataBrew预处理数据，设置REMOVE_OUTLIERS操作剔除包含异常高价的数据行，调用AWS Lambda函数将剔除的数据行存储到亚马逊DynamoDB

options.label: C
options.content: Use a vertical bar chart to visualize the outliers. Use a calculated field in QuickSight to square the outlier prices to generate the chart. Use QuickSight anomaly detection insights to determine which prices are unusually high.

contents.en: Use a vertical bar chart to visualize the outliers. Use a calculated field in QuickSight to square the outlier prices to generate the chart. Use QuickSight anomaly detection insights to determine which prices are unusually high.
contents.zh: 使用垂直柱状图可视化异常值，在QuickSight中创建计算字段，对异常价格进行平方运算后生成图表，使用QuickSight异常检测洞察功能识别异常高价

options.label: D
options.content: Use a QuickSight filter to find the lowest 10 values for sneaker price. Assign a specific color to the 10 lowest values.

contents.en: Use a QuickSight filter to find the lowest 10 values for sneaker price. Assign a specific color to the 10 lowest values.
contents.zh: 使用QuickSight筛选器找出运动鞋价格最低的10个值，为这10个最低值分配特定颜色

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：Amazon QuickSight 由机器学习驱动的异常检测洞察可以自动识别相对预期模式异常偏高的值，直接回答了哪些价格是异常值。在计算字段中对异常价格取平方会放大异常值与正常价格之间的差距，使垂直柱状图能够突出显示它们。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 取平方根会压缩高值、掩盖异常值，而且 QuickSight 已内置异常检测，无需自定义 Lambda 函数。
  • B: AWS Glue DataBrew 的移除异常值操作会删掉公司想查看的行，把它们存入 DynamoDB 也无法实现可视化。
  • D: 筛选价格最低的 10 个值针对的是分布的另一端，而不是异常偏高的价格。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：Amazon QuickSight 由机器学习驱动的异常检测洞察可以自动识别相对预期模式异常偏高的值，直接回答了哪些价格是异常值。在计算字段中对异常价格取平方会放大异常值与正常价格之间的差距，使垂直柱状图能够突出显示它们。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 取平方根会压缩高值、掩盖异常值，而且 QuickSight 已内置异常检测，无需自定义 Lambda 函数。
  • B: AWS Glue DataBrew 的移除异常值操作会删掉公司想查看的行，把它们存入 DynamoDB 也无法实现可视化。
  • D: 筛选价格最低的 10 个值针对的是分布的另一端，而不是异常偏高的价格。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: Amazon QuickSight ML-powered anomaly detection insights automatically identify values that are unusually high compared to the expected pattern, which answers the question of which prices are outliers. Squaring the outlier prices in a calculated field amplifies the gap between outliers and normal prices so the vertical bar chart displays them prominently.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Taking the square root compresses high values and hides the outliers, and a custom Lambda function is unnecessary when QuickSight has built-in anomaly detection.
  • B: The outlier removal step in AWS Glue DataBrew deletes the rows the company wants to see, and storing them in DynamoDB does not visualize them.
  • D: Filtering for the 10 lowest prices targets the opposite end of the distribution from the unusually high prices.

contents.en: A company uses an Amazon QuickSight dashboard to track the sale prices of sneakers over time. The dashboard aggregates sale prices scraped from many retail websites. The company wants to determine which prices are unusually high outliers and to display the outliers visually. Which solution will meet these requirements?

The ML engineer sets the Severity parameter to Low and above. The ML engineer sets the Direction parameter to All. What effect will the ML engineer observe in the anomaly detection results if the ML engineer changes the Direction parameter to Lower than expected?

options.label: A
options.content: Increased anomaly identification frequency and increased recall

contents.en: Increased anomaly identification frequency and increased recall
contents.zh: 异常识别频率提高，召回率提高

options.label: B
options.content: Decreased anomaly identification frequency and decreased recall

contents.en: Decreased anomaly identification frequency and decreased recall
contents.zh: 异常识别频率降低，召回率降低

options.label: C
options.content: Increased anomaly identification frequency and decreased recall

contents.en: Increased anomaly identification frequency and decreased recall
contents.zh: 异常识别频率提高，召回率降低

options.label: D
options.content: Decreased anomaly identification frequency and increased recall

contents.en: Decreased anomaly identification frequency and increased recall
contents.zh: 异常识别频率降低，召回率提高

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：Direction 设为“全部”时，QuickSight 异常检测会同时报告异常偏高和异常偏低的温度。改为“低于预期值”后，检测范围只剩低于预期区间的值，高温异常将不再被报告：识别出的异常数量减少，被捕获的真实异常比例（召回率）也随之下降。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 收窄方向会移除整整一类异常，识别频率和召回率不可能同时提高。
  • C: 高温异常不再被标记后，识别频率是下降而不是上升。
  • D: 每一个异常高温都会变成漏检，召回率因此下降而不是提高。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：Direction 设为“全部”时，QuickSight 异常检测会同时报告异常偏高和异常偏低的温度。改为“低于预期值”后，检测范围只剩低于预期区间的值，高温异常将不再被报告：识别出的异常数量减少，被捕获的真实异常比例（召回率）也随之下降。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 收窄方向会移除整整一类异常，识别频率和召回率不可能同时提高。
  • C: 高温异常不再被标记后，识别频率是下降而不是上升。
  • D: 每一个异常高温都会变成漏检，召回率因此下降而不是提高。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: With Direction set to All, QuickSight anomaly detection reports both unusually high and unusually low temperatures. Changing Direction to Lower than expected restricts detection to values below the expected range, so the high-temperature anomalies are no longer reported: fewer anomalies are identified and the share of true anomalies that are caught (recall) drops.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Narrowing the direction removes an entire class of anomalies, so frequency and recall cannot both increase.
  • C: Identification frequency falls rather than rises when high anomalies stop being flagged.
  • D: Recall falls because every unusually high temperature becomes a missed anomaly; it does not increase.

contents.en: An ML engineer is using Amazon QuickSight anomaly detection to detect very high or very low machine operating temperatures compared to normal. The ML engineer sets the Severity parameter to Low and above. The ML engineer sets the Direction parameter to All. What effect will the ML engineer observe in the anomaly detection results if the ML engineer changes the Direction parameter to Lower than expected?

Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.content: Redesign the ML services to be configured in Kubeflow. Deploy the new Kubeflow managed ML services to the EKS cluster.

options.label: B
options.content: Upload the Docker images to an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Configure a deployment pipeline to deploy the images to the EKS cluster.

contents.en: Upload the Docker images to an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Configure a deployment pipeline to deploy the images to the EKS cluster.
contents.zh: 将Docker镜像上传至亚马逊弹性容器注册表（ECR）仓库，配置部署流水线将镜像部署到EKS集群

options.label: C
options.content: Migrate the training data to an Amazon Redshift cluster. Retrain the models from the migrated training data by using Amazon Redshift ML. Deploy the retrained models to the EKS cluster.

contents.en: Migrate the training data to an Amazon Redshift cluster. Retrain the models from the migrated training data by using Amazon Redshift ML. Deploy the retrained models to the EKS cluster.

options.content: Configure an Amazon SageMaker AI notebook. Retrain the models with the same code. Deploy the retrained models to the EKS cluster.

contents.en: Configure an Amazon SageMaker AI notebook. Retrain the models with the same code. Deploy the retrained models to the EKS cluster.
contents.zh: 配置一个亚马逊SageMaker AI笔记本，使用相同代码重新训练模型，将重新训练后的模型部署到EKS集群

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：直接迁移（lift and shift）的要点是保持现有容器镜像不变，把独立的 Docker 镜像推送到 Amazon ECR，再通过部署流水线部署到 Amazon EKS，即可在不改代码和架构的情况下完成迁移。Kubernetes 清单和镜像都能直接沿用，因此运维开销最低。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 围绕 Kubeflow 重新设计所有服务属于重新架构而不是直接迁移，还会增加一个需要运维的新平台。
  • C: 把数据迁移到 Amazon Redshift 并用 Redshift ML 重新训练，会完全替换现有模型和流水线。
  • D: 在 SageMaker AI 笔记本中重新训练是多余的工作，训练好的模型已经存在于 Docker 镜像中。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：直接迁移（lift and shift）的要点是保持现有容器镜像不变，把独立的 Docker 镜像推送到 Amazon ECR，再通过部署流水线部署到 Amazon EKS，即可在不改代码和架构的情况下完成迁移。Kubernetes 清单和镜像都能直接沿用，因此运维开销最低。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 围绕 Kubeflow 重新设计所有服务属于重新架构而不是直接迁移，还会增加一个需要运维的新平台。
  • C: 把数据迁移到 Amazon Redshift 并用 Redshift ML 重新训练，会完全替换现有模型和流水线。
  • D: 在 SageMaker AI 笔记本中重新训练是多余的工作，训练好的模型已经存在于 Docker 镜像中。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: A lift and shift keeps the existing container images unchanged, so pushing the standalone Docker images to Amazon ECR and deploying them to Amazon EKS through a deployment pipeline moves the workloads with no code or architecture changes. This is the LEAST operational overhead because the Kubernetes manifests and images carry over directly.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Redesigning every service around Kubeflow is a re-architecture, not a lift and shift, and adds a new platform to operate.
  • C: Moving data to Amazon Redshift and retraining with Redshift ML replaces the existing models and pipelines entirely.
  • D: Retraining in a SageMaker AI notebook is unnecessary work; the trained models already exist inside the Docker images.

Each ML service runs from its own standalone Docker image. The company needs to perform a lift and shift from the on-premises Kubernetes cluster to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. options.label: A
options.content: Purchase Reserved Instances with a partial upfront payment.

contents.en: Purchase Reserved Instances with a partial upfront payment.

options.label: B

questions.explanation:

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 预留实例是 EC2 的购买选项而不是 SageMaker AI 的，为每月只运行几天的任务承诺容量会浪费预留。
  • B: 按需实例的小时价格最高，也没有利用任务可中断这一特点。
  • C: SageMaker AI Savings Plans 需要一年或三年的每小时支出承诺，不适合间歇性的月度任务，而且仍比竞价价格贵。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker AI 托管竞价训练使用闲置容量，价格最多比按需实例低 90%，自动保存到 Amazon S3 的检查点可以让被中断的任务从断点处恢复。由于训练任务可以容忍中断，且每月只运行一次 48 到 72 小时，竞价型实例是成本效益最高的选择。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 预留实例是 EC2 的购买选项而不是 SageMaker AI 的，为每月只运行几天的任务承诺容量会浪费预留。
  • B: 按需实例的小时价格最高，也没有利用任务可中断这一特点。
  • C: SageMaker AI Savings Plans 需要一年或三年的每小时支出承诺，不适合间歇性的月度任务，而且仍比竞价价格贵。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker AI managed Spot Training uses spare capacity at up to 90 percent below On-Demand prices, and automated checkpoints to Amazon S3 let a job that is interrupted resume where it left off. Because the training jobs tolerate interruption and run only once a month for 48 to 72 hours, Spot Instances are the MOST cost-effective choice.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Reserved Instances are an EC2 purchasing option, not a SageMaker AI one, and committing to capacity for a job that runs a few days per month wastes the reservation.
  • B: On-Demand Instances carry the highest hourly price and ignore the tolerance for interruption that Spot could exploit.
  • C: SageMaker AI Savings Plans require a one- or three-year hourly spend commitment, which does not fit an intermittent monthly job and still costs more than Spot pricing.

正确答案 A：Amazon Q Business 是面向企业内容的生成式助手，其文档属性筛选器（例如基于内置的创建时间或最后更新时间属性）可以把检索范围限制在满足条件的文档内。为价格相关查询应用只允许近一个月文档的筛选器，既能强制执行时效性规则，又能让全部文档继续服务于通用咨询。

  • C: Amazon Q Developer 是面向开发者的编码和 AWS 助手，不是基于业务文档的客户助手，按文件夹分段也只是手动的权宜之计。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：Amazon Q Business 是面向企业内容的生成式助手，其文档属性筛选器（例如基于内置的创建时间或最后更新时间属性）可以把检索范围限制在满足条件的文档内。为价格相关查询应用只允许近一个月文档的筛选器，既能强制执行时效性规则，又能让全部文档继续服务于通用咨询。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 来源归因引用只展示回答使用了哪些文档，并不限制检索哪些文档。
  • C: Amazon Q Developer 是面向开发者的编码和 AWS 助手，不是基于业务文档的客户助手，按文件夹分段也只是手动的权宜之计。

explanations.en:
Correct answer A: Amazon Q Business is the generative assistant for enterprise content, and its document attribute filters (for example on the built-in created-at or last-updated-at attributes) constrain retrieval to documents that match a condition. Applying a filter that limits price-related queries to documents from the past month enforces the freshness rule while the full document body remains available for general inquiries.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Source attribution citations show which documents an answer used; they do not restrict which documents are retrieved.
  • C: Amazon Q Developer is a coding and AWS assistant for developers, not a customer-facing assistant over business documents, and folder segmentation is a manual workaround.
  • D: Access controls on monthly folders would have to be rotated by hand every month, and Amazon Q Developer is the wrong service for a customer assistant.

questions.content: A travel company wants to create an ML model to recommend the next airport destination for its users. The company has collected millions of data records about user location, recent search history on the company’s website, and 2,000 available airports. The data has several categorical features with a target column that is expected to have a high-dimensional sparse matrix. The company needs to use Amazon SageMaker AI built-in algorithms for the model. An ML engineer converts the categorical features by using one-hot encoding. Which algorithm should the ML engineer implement to meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Use the CatBoost algorithm to recommend the next airport destination.

contents.en: Use the CatBoost algorithm to recommend the next airport destination.
contents.zh: 使用CatBoost算法推荐下一个机场目的地

options.label: B
options.content: Use the DeepAR forecasting algorithm to recommend the next airport destination.

contents.en: Use the DeepAR forecasting algorithm to recommend the next airport destination.
contents.zh: 使用DeepAR预测算法推荐下一个机场目的地

options.label: C
options.content: Use the Factorization Machines algorithm to recommend the next airport destination.

contents.en: Use the Factorization Machines algorithm to recommend the next airport destination.
contents.zh: 使用因子分解机算法推荐下一个机场目的地

options.label: D
options.content: Use the k-means algorithm to cluster users into groups. Map each group to the next airport destination based on user search history.

contents.en: Use the k-means algorithm to cluster users into groups. Map each group to the next airport destination based on user search history.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker AI 内置的 Factorization Machines 算法专为独热编码类别特征这类高维稀疏输入设计，是从 2000 个机场中预测下一个目的地这类推荐任务的经典选择。它能在数百万条记录的规模上高效学习特征之间的两两交互。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CatBoost 是用于表格分类和回归的梯度提升算法，可以原生处理类别值，但并非为稀疏的 2000 类推荐问题而设计。
  • B: DeepAR 是预测未来数值的时间序列预测算法，不是推荐算法。
  • D: K 均值是无监督聚类算法，无法学习从用户特征到目标目的地的有监督映射。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker AI 内置的 Factorization Machines 算法专为独热编码类别特征这类高维稀疏输入设计，是从 2000 个机场中预测下一个目的地这类推荐任务的经典选择。它能在数百万条记录的规模上高效学习特征之间的两两交互。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CatBoost 是用于表格分类和回归的梯度提升算法，可以原生处理类别值，但并非为稀疏的 2000 类推荐问题而设计。
  • B: DeepAR 是预测未来数值的时间序列预测算法，不是推荐算法。
  • D: K 均值是无监督聚类算法，无法学习从用户特征到目标目的地的有监督映射。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: The SageMaker AI Factorization Machines built-in algorithm is designed for high-dimensional sparse input such as one-hot encoded categorical features and is the canonical choice for recommendation tasks like predicting the next destination among 2,000 airports. It learns pairwise feature interactions efficiently at the scale of millions of records.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: CatBoost is a gradient boosting algorithm for tabular classification and regression that handles categorical values natively; it is not built for a sparse 2,000-way recommendation problem.
  • B: DeepAR is a time-series forecasting algorithm for predicting future numeric values, not a recommender.
  • D: k-means is unsupervised clustering and cannot learn a supervised mapping from user features to a target destination.

questions.content: An ML engineer is configuring auto scaling for an inference component of a model that runs behind an Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint. The ML engineer configures SageMaker AI auto scaling with a target tracking scaling policy set to 100 invocations per model per minute. The SageMaker AI endpoint scales appropriately during normal business hours. However, the ML engineer notices that at the start of each business day, there are zero instances available to handle requests, which causes delays in processing. The ML engineer must ensure that the SageMaker AI endpoint can handle incoming requests at the start of each business day. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Reduce the SageMaker AI auto scaling cooldown period to the minimum supported value. Add an auto scaling lifecycle hook to scale the SageMaker AI instances.

contents.en: Reduce the SageMaker AI auto scaling cooldown period to the minimum supported value. Add an auto scaling lifecycle hook to scale the SageMaker AI instances.
contents.zh: 将SageMaker AI自动扩缩的冷却时间缩短至支持的最小值，为SageMaker实例添加自动扩缩生命周期挂钩

options.label: B
options.content: Change the target metric to CPU utilization.

contents.en: Change the target metric to CPU utilization.
contents.zh: 将目标指标修改为CPU利用率

options.label: C
options.content: Modify the scaling policy target value to one.

contents.en: Modify the scaling policy target value to one.
contents.zh: 将扩缩策略的目标值修改为1

options.label: D
options.content: Apply a step scaling policy that scales based on an Amazon CloudWatch alarm. Apply a second CloudWatch alarm and scaling policy to scale the minimum number of instances from zero to one at the start of each business day.

contents.en: Apply a step scaling policy that scales based on an Amazon CloudWatch alarm. Apply a second CloudWatch alarm and scaling policy to scale the minimum number of instances from zero to one at the start of each business day.
contents.zh: 配置一个基于亚马逊CloudWatch警报的步进扩缩策略，再配置第二个CloudWatch警报和扩缩策略，在每个工作日开始时将最小实例数量从0调整为1

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：目标跟踪策略无法把推理组件从零实例扩容，因为没有调用到达模型，也就不会产生任何指标数据。SageMaker AI 支持通过绑定 NoCapacityInvocationFailures 指标 CloudWatch 警报的步进扩缩策略从零扩容，再配合第二个警报和策略在每个工作日开始时按计划把最小实例数从 0 提到 1，即可立即处理请求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 冷却时间只决定连续扩缩动作之间的间隔，而生命周期挂钩是 EC2 Auto Scaling 组的功能，SageMaker AI 端点并不支持。
  • B: 零实例运行时 CPU 利用率同样没有数据点，无法触发扩容。
  • C: 实例数为零时 InvocationsPerModel 指标根本不会发出，降低目标值也无济于事。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：目标跟踪策略无法把推理组件从零实例扩容，因为没有调用到达模型，也就不会产生任何指标数据。SageMaker AI 支持通过绑定 NoCapacityInvocationFailures 指标 CloudWatch 警报的步进扩缩策略从零扩容，再配合第二个警报和策略在每个工作日开始时按计划把最小实例数从 0 提到 1，即可立即处理请求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 冷却时间只决定连续扩缩动作之间的间隔，而生命周期挂钩是 EC2 Auto Scaling 组的功能，SageMaker AI 端点并不支持。
  • B: 零实例运行时 CPU 利用率同样没有数据点，无法触发扩容。
  • C: 实例数为零时 InvocationsPerModel 指标根本不会发出，降低目标值也无济于事。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: A target tracking policy cannot scale an inference component out from zero because no invocations reach the model and therefore no metric data is produced. SageMaker AI supports scaling from zero with a step scaling policy tied to a CloudWatch alarm on the NoCapacityInvocationFailures metric, and a second alarm and policy can raise the minimum instance count from zero to one on a schedule at the start of the business day so requests are served immediately.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Cooldown periods only govern how quickly consecutive scaling actions happen, and lifecycle hooks are an EC2 Auto Scaling group feature that does not exist for SageMaker AI endpoints.
  • B: CPU utilization also has no data points when zero instances are running, so it cannot trigger scale-out.
  • C: Lowering the target value does not help because the InvocationsPerModel metric is never emitted while the instance count is zero.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

contents.en: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to create a report that describes GPU utilization over time.

options.label: B
options.content: Add SageMaker Profiler annotations to the training script. Run the script and generate a report from the results.

contents.en: Add SageMaker Profiler annotations to the training script. Run the script and generate a report from the results.
contents.zh: 在训练脚本中添加SageMaker Profiler标注，运行脚本并基于结果生成报告

options.label: C

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：Amazon SageMaker Profiler 可以采集 GPU 和 CPU 利用率以及框架操作的时间线，在训练脚本中添加 Profiler 标注后，可以把利用率归因到具体的代码段。生成的报告能准确显示 DDP 脚本中哪一部分让 GPU 空闲，这正是优化资源利用率所需的信息。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon CloudWatch 报告的是实例级 GPU 利用率随时间的变化，无法把低利用率对应到训练脚本的某一行或某个阶段。
  • C: AWS CloudTrail 记录用于审计的 API 活动，不包含 GPU 或显存利用率数据。
  • D: SageMaker Model Monitor 用于检测已部署端点的数据和模型质量漂移，与训练作业的资源使用无关。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：Amazon SageMaker Profiler 可以采集 GPU 和 CPU 利用率以及框架操作的时间线，在训练脚本中添加 Profiler 标注后，可以把利用率归因到具体的代码段。生成的报告能准确显示 DDP 脚本中哪一部分让 GPU 空闲，这正是优化资源利用率所需的信息。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: Amazon CloudWatch 报告的是实例级 GPU 利用率随时间的变化，无法把低利用率对应到训练脚本的某一行或某个阶段。
  • C: AWS CloudTrail 记录用于审计的 API 活动，不包含 GPU 或显存利用率数据。
  • D: SageMaker Model Monitor 用于检测已部署端点的数据和模型质量漂移，与训练作业的资源使用无关。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: Amazon SageMaker Profiler captures GPU and CPU utilization together with the timeline of framework operations, and adding profiler annotations to the training script attributes that utilization to specific code sections. The generated report shows exactly which part of the DDP script leaves the GPUs idle, which is the information needed to optimize resource utilization.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Amazon CloudWatch reports instance-level GPU utilization over time but cannot map low utilization to a line or phase of the training script.
  • C: AWS CloudTrail records API activity for auditing and holds no GPU or memory utilization data.
  • D: SageMaker Model Monitor detects data and model quality drift for deployed endpoints and has nothing to do with training job resource usage.

After training the model, the ML engineer uses Amazon SageMaker AI to deploy the model for inference. The ML engineer wants to monitor the model predictions to detect whether the production data distribution differs from the training data distribution when there are changes in customer behaviors. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.content: Determine whether there is drift in the data quality.

contents.en: Determine whether there is drift in the data quality.
contents.zh: 检测是否存在数据质量漂移

options.label: B
options.content: Determine whether there is drift in the model quality.

contents.en: Determine whether there is drift in the model quality.
contents.zh: 检测是否存在模型质量漂移

options.label: C
options.content: Determine whether there is drift in the model bias.

contents.en: Determine whether there is drift in the model bias.
contents.zh: 检测是否存在模型偏差漂移

options.label: D
options.content: Determine whether there is drift in the feature attribution.

contents.en: Determine whether there is drift in the feature attribution.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Model Monitor 的数据质量监控会把捕获的生产输入的统计分布与基于训练数据集计算的基线进行比较，并在二者偏离时发出违规提示。这正是检测客户行为变化导致生产数据分布偏离训练分布所需的检查。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 模型质量监控是根据真实标签衡量预测准确度，而不是比较输入分布。
  • C: 偏差漂移监控跟踪的是敏感群体之间的公平性指标，而不是整体数据分布的变化。
  • D: 特征归因漂移监控比较的是 SHAP 特征重要性排序，属于可解释性检查而非数据分布检查。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 A：SageMaker Model Monitor 的数据质量监控会把捕获的生产输入的统计分布与基于训练数据集计算的基线进行比较，并在二者偏离时发出违规提示。这正是检测客户行为变化导致生产数据分布偏离训练分布所需的检查。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: 模型质量监控是根据真实标签衡量预测准确度，而不是比较输入分布。
  • C: 偏差漂移监控跟踪的是敏感群体之间的公平性指标，而不是整体数据分布的变化。
  • D: 特征归因漂移监控比较的是 SHAP 特征重要性排序，属于可解释性检查而非数据分布检查。
explanations.en:
Correct answer A: SageMaker Model Monitor data quality monitoring compares the statistical distribution of the captured production inputs against a baseline computed from the training dataset and raises violations when they diverge. That is exactly the check needed to detect when changing customer behavior shifts the production data distribution away from the training distribution.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: Model quality monitoring measures prediction accuracy against ground truth labels rather than comparing input distributions.
  • C: Bias drift monitoring tracks fairness metrics across sensitive groups, not overall data distribution changes.
  • D: Feature attribution drift monitoring compares SHAP feature importance rankings, which is an explainability check rather than a data distribution check.

  • C: 批量转换从 Amazon S3 而不是 Amazon EFS 读取输入，SQS 也无法通知最终用户。

explanations.en:
Correct answer B: SageMaker AI Asynchronous Inference is built for large payloads such as high-resolution images (up to 1 GB) and long processing times: requests reference input objects in Amazon S3, are queued, and results are written back to S3. The endpoint can publish success and error notifications to an Amazon SNS topic, which directly satisfies the requirement to notify users when processing completes.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Batch transform processes an entire dataset offline rather than each uploaded image as it arrives, and Amazon SQS is a message queue that applications poll, not a user notification mechanism.
  • C: Batch transform reads input from Amazon S3, not Amazon EFS, and SQS does not notify end users.
  • D: Asynchronous inference takes its input payload from Amazon S3, so storing the images in Amazon EFS does not fit the invocation model.

  • B: 一个月的实时流量已经提供了足够的证据，等待精确率提升是在优化公司明确表示不优先考虑的指标。
  • C: 影子测试已经在不影响用户的情况下验证了模型，部分切流本身并不能减少模型错误。

Correct answer A: The company's stated goal is to catch as many readmissions as possible while tolerating false positives, which means recall is the deciding metric and lower precision is acceptable. After a full month of shadow testing on live traffic, the shadow variant shows higher recall than the degraded production model, so it meets the business objective and should be promoted to production.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • B: A month of live traffic already provides sufficient evidence, and waiting for precision to improve optimizes a metric the company has said it does not prioritize.
  • C: Shadow testing has already validated the model without affecting users, and a partial traffic shift does not reduce model errors by itself.
  • D: Rolling back discards a model that better satisfies the requirement and keeps the degraded model in production.

explanations.en:
Correct answer D: Responsiveness depends on how quickly the scaling metric is observed and how soon the policy can act again. High-resolution CloudWatch metrics deliver InvocationsPerInstance data at 10-second granularity so the target tracking policy detects a spike within seconds, and keeping the default 300-second scale-in cooldown lets the endpoint release and re-add capacity sooner than a longer cooldown would.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Standard-resolution CloudWatch metrics are published at one-minute granularity, so a 10-second interval is not available with the standard metric.
  • B: The 600-second scale-in cooldown doubles the time the policy waits before adjusting again, making it less responsive than the default.
  • C: It combines a standard metric that cannot deliver 10-second data with the longer 600-second cooldown, so it is the least responsive configuration.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Clarify 可以计算类别不平衡（CI）这一训练前偏差指标，只有两类样本数量相等时它才为零，大于零表示类别不平衡。随后在 SageMaker Data Wrangler 中应用 SMOTE 生成合成的少数类样本，可以在不丢弃任何现有训练记录的情况下平衡 A 类和 B 类。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CI 为零已经表示类别平衡，而随机欠采样会删除多数类的行，导致训练数据丢失。
  • C: SageMaker JumpStart 提供预训练模型和解决方案，不会生成类别不平衡报告，欠采样也会丢弃数据。
  • D: 在 CI 为零（已平衡）时才触发平衡操作是错误的，而且 SageMaker JumpStart 不是偏差度量工具。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：SageMaker Clarify 可以计算类别不平衡（CI）这一训练前偏差指标，只有两类样本数量相等时它才为零，大于零表示类别不平衡。随后在 SageMaker Data Wrangler 中应用 SMOTE 生成合成的少数类样本，可以在不丢弃任何现有训练记录的情况下平衡 A 类和 B 类。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: CI 为零已经表示类别平衡，而随机欠采样会删除多数类的行，导致训练数据丢失。
  • C: SageMaker JumpStart 提供预训练模型和解决方案，不会生成类别不平衡报告，欠采样也会丢弃数据。
  • D: 在 CI 为零（已平衡）时才触发平衡操作是错误的，而且 SageMaker JumpStart 不是偏差度量工具。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: SageMaker Clarify computes the class imbalance (CI) pre-training bias metric, which equals zero only when the classes have equal sample counts; a value greater than zero shows that the classes are unbalanced. Applying SMOTE in SageMaker Data Wrangler then generates synthetic minority-class samples, balancing Class A and Class B without discarding any existing training records.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: A CI value of zero already means the classes are balanced, and random undersampling deletes majority-class rows, which loses training data.
  • C: SageMaker JumpStart offers pretrained models and solutions and does not produce a class imbalance report, and undersampling drops data.
  • D: Balancing would be triggered on CI equal to zero, which is the already-balanced case, and SageMaker JumpStart is not a bias measurement tool.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 B：location 变量只有 3 个无顺序的类别，独热编码可以把它变成三个二元列，供逻辑回归模型使用而不引入任何排序含义。job_seniority_level 变量从初级到高级具有天然顺序，序数编码可以把 10 个以上的级别映射为递增整数，同时只保留一列。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 标记化是处理自由文本句子的步骤，不是对三值类别变量的编码方法。
  • C: 分箱用于对数值区间分组，标准化缩放用于重新缩放数值列，二者都无法应用于字符串变量。
  • D: 标准化缩放要求数值输入，无法对字符串取值的 job_seniority_level 变量进行预处理。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 B：location 变量只有 3 个无顺序的类别，独热编码可以把它变成三个二元列，供逻辑回归模型使用而不引入任何排序含义。job_seniority_level 变量从初级到高级具有天然顺序，序数编码可以把 10 个以上的级别映射为递增整数，同时只保留一列。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 标记化是处理自由文本句子的步骤，不是对三值类别变量的编码方法。
  • C: 分箱用于对数值区间分组，标准化缩放用于重新缩放数值列，二者都无法应用于字符串变量。
  • D: 标准化缩放要求数值输入，无法对字符串取值的 job_seniority_level 变量进行预处理。
explanations.en:
Correct answer B: The location variable has only 3 unordered categories, so one-hot encoding turns it into three binary columns that a logistic regression model can use without implying any ranking. The job_seniority_level variable has a natural order from junior to senior, so ordinal encoding maps its 10-plus levels to increasing integers while keeping the feature to a single column.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Tokenization is a text-processing step for free-form sentences, not an encoding for a three-value categorical variable.
  • C: Binning groups numeric ranges and standard scaling rescales numeric columns; neither can be applied to string variables.
  • D: Standard scaling requires numeric input, so it cannot preprocess the string-valued job_seniority_level variable.

questions.explanation:
正确答案 C：SageMaker AI 实时端点以低延迟提供同步预测，为端点配置自动扩缩容后，实例数会随请求量变化自动增减。这一组合以完全托管的方式同时满足近实时的低延迟要求和流量波动的要求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • B: Amazon S3 只能存储模型文件，不能执行推理代码，API Gateway 没有可以调用的对象。
  • D: 负载均衡器后方的两台固定 EC2 DLAMI 实例需要自行管理服务器，也不会随请求量变化自动扩缩。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 C：SageMaker AI 实时端点以低延迟提供同步预测，为端点配置自动扩缩容后，实例数会随请求量变化自动增减。这一组合以完全托管的方式同时满足近实时的低延迟要求和流量波动的要求。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 批量转换离线处理已存储的数据集，无法近实时地响应单个请求。
  • B: Amazon S3 只能存储模型文件，不能执行推理代码，API Gateway 没有可以调用的对象。
  • D: 负载均衡器后方的两台固定 EC2 DLAMI 实例需要自行管理服务器，也不会随请求量变化自动扩缩。
explanations.en:
Correct answer C: A SageMaker AI real-time endpoint serves synchronous predictions with low latency, and configuring auto scaling on the endpoint adds or removes instances as the request volume changes. This combination meets both the near real-time latency requirement and the variable-traffic requirement with a fully managed service.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: Batch transform processes stored datasets offline and cannot answer individual requests in near real time.
  • B: Amazon S3 stores model artifacts but cannot execute inference code, so API Gateway would have nothing to invoke.
  • D: Two fixed EC2 instances with DLAMI behind a load balancer require you to manage servers and do not scale automatically with variable request volumes.

questions.content: A company runs a neural network model and retrains the model when the performance degrades. The company uses a training job that uses Amazon SageMaker AI distributed data parallelism (DDP). The training job takes several hours to run. The company wants to decrease the required time for the training job. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.label: A
options.content: Increase the number of epochs.

contents.en: Increase the number of epochs.
contents.zh: 增加训练周期数

options.label: B
options.content: Increase the number of neurons in the hidden layers.

contents.en: Increase the number of neurons in the hidden layers.
contents.zh: 增加隐藏层的神经元数量

options.label: C
options.content: Increase the number of layers.

contents.en: Increase the number of layers.
contents.zh: 增加模型的层数

options.label: D
options.content: Increase the number of instances.

contents.en: Increase the number of instances.
contents.zh: 增加训练实例的数量

questions.explanation:
正确答案 D：SageMaker AI 分布式数据并行会把每个训练批次拆分到多个 GPU 和实例上，增加实例数量意味着更多工作节点并行处理数据，从而缩短每个训练周期的实际耗时。横向扩展集群是在不改动模型本身的前提下缩短任务时间的手段。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 增加训练周期意味着对数据进行更多轮遍历，会延长训练时间。
  • B: 增加隐藏层神经元数量会增加参数量和每步的计算量，使训练更慢。
  • C: 增加层数会为每一步增加前向和反向计算，延长训练时间。

explanations.zh:
正确答案 D：SageMaker AI 分布式数据并行会把每个训练批次拆分到多个 GPU 和实例上，增加实例数量意味着更多工作节点并行处理数据，从而缩短每个训练周期的实际耗时。横向扩展集群是在不改动模型本身的前提下缩短任务时间的手段。

为什么其他选项错误：

  • A: 增加训练周期意味着对数据进行更多轮遍历，会延长训练时间。
  • B: 增加隐藏层神经元数量会增加参数量和每步的计算量，使训练更慢。
  • C: 增加层数会为每一步增加前向和反向计算，延长训练时间。
explanations.en:
Correct answer D: SageMaker AI distributed data parallelism splits each training batch across GPUs and instances, so adding instances increases the number of workers processing data in parallel and reduces the wall-clock time of each epoch. Scaling out the cluster is the lever that shortens the job without changing the model itself.

Why the other options are incorrect:

  • A: More epochs means more passes over the data, which lengthens training.
  • B: More neurons per hidden layer increases the number of parameters and the compute per step, making training slower.
  • C: Additional layers add forward and backward computation to every step and increase the training time.
